items.name: dsh-market
items.desc: Browse, search and install community plugins from inside DeepSeek Harness settings, with category filters, one-click updates, enable/disable, theme switching and configuration backup.

items.name: modlens
items.desc: Vision bridge for text-only models: paste an image, get structured JSON evidence (OCR, layout, semantics).

items.name: dsh-better-sidebar
items.desc: Full sidebar workbench with file rendering and editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party plugins can register new tabs.

items.name: dsh-vision-router
items.desc: Free vision for text-only agents: built-in keyless vision chain plus pixel tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots); paste an image to use it.

items.name: dsh-vision-toolkit
items.desc: Vision for text-only models: paste an image and the model switches to a Vision Toolkit variant for image Q&A, multi-image comparison, long-screenshot OCR, screenshot-to-UI reproduction, element grounding, and pixel diff. No API key by default — images are processed by the author-hosted free service, 100 per machine per day; configurable to your own provider.

items.name: dsh-tui
items.desc: Claude Code-style full-screen terminal UI: pixel-whale header, live status line, and streaming thought expansion.

items.name: dsh-agent-teams
items.desc: AgentTeams multi-agent teams.

items.name: dsh-pocket
items.desc: Remote phone access to the DSH Web UI: scan a QR code for LAN or public (cloudflared tunnel) access with real-time sync, a mobile-adaptive layout, and a settings tab.

items.name: upstream-radar
items.desc: Watches DSH and plugin releases, retests exact published artifacts in disposable runners, publishes machine-readable compatibility evidence, and reconciles managed issues after fixes.

items.name: hindsight#coding-agents
items.desc: Hindsight, agent memory that learns: long-term project memory with auto recall and retain, knowledge pages, deep reflection, and per-repo memory banks.

items.name: modsearch
items.desc: Web search bridge for text-only agents: ask the web or X, get structured JSON evidence (search, fetch, citations).

items.name: dsh-lark-bot
items.desc: Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness: scan-to-connect PersonalAgent binding, streaming cards, git-worktree project workspaces, parallel per-scope tasks, multi-role agents, cross-session notify, in-chat model/key management, and a safety-net guardian that still answers in Feishu after dsh crashes.

items.name: dsh-mnemon
items.desc: Cross-agent, local-first persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), powered by Mnemon. It shares long-term memory across Mnemon-enabled agents and adds runtime memory, searchable project documents, semantic recall, knowledge graph, and a Sidebar UI.

items.name: dsh-notifier
items.desc: DSH notification & remote-control plane: one `notify()` API across 28 outbound channels, six inbound control channels, phone approvals/questions/task control, a Native DSH Notify & Control UI, live outbound hot-apply, multi-agent routing, and zero runtime dependencies.

items.name: dsh-context
items.desc: DSH context insight panel: Context dashboard + /context command + Context browser — one-stop context lifecycle management with categorized composition, content details, evolution trends, compaction/injection events, and stats.

items.name: dsh-win32
items.desc: Diagnoses and repairs DeepSeek Harness on native Windows around the official persistent PowerShell and Workspace Write stack, creates the desktop shortcut, and keeps earlier Git Bash and BusyBox presets behind an explicit legacy setup. No WSL.

items.name: dsh-find-plugin
items.desc: Find plugins without leaving the agent: search this curated registry by keyword or category, with ready-to-run install commands.

items.name: dsh-mobile
items.desc: Access DeepSeek Harness from the Android app or a mobile browser with secure LAN and remote connections, persistent device pairing, and a customizable mobile interface.

items.name: dsh-free-vision
items.desc: Free vision bridge for text-only models: image understanding, OCR, UI and debug analysis via free-tier providers (Qwen3-VL-Flash, Doubao, DeepSeek-OCR) with a settings GUI.

items.name: dsh-dream-skin
items.desc: One-command skin plugin: 8 original themes, translucent wallpaper with opacity/blur, per-user accent, and shareable theme-pack import/export, favorites and surprise-me — purely native on DSH's token system.

items.name: dsh-config-manager
items.desc: One-click backup, export, import and migration of a whole DSH config: settings, plugins, MCP, skills and workspaces. Secrets are excluded by default and, if you opt in, are AES-256-GCM encrypted rather than written in the clear; imports preview first and auto-backup with rollback, profiles hold multiple setups, and remote sync pushes portable config through a private Git repo with secrets excluded.

items.name: dsh-webui-market-plugin
items.desc: In-harness plugin market for the dsh web GUI: browse the awesome-dsh-plugin.com catalog and install/uninstall plugins into a profile from Settings → Plugins → Plugin Market.

items.name: dsh-chat-import
items.desc: Import full-fidelity chat histories from 13 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, opencode, and more) as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions, with reverse export back to Claude Code.

items.name: dsh-plugin-writing-guard
items.desc: Academic writing guard (EN/ZH bilingual): removes AI-style defensive writing, protects scientific evidence (numbers, citations, claim strength, null findings, scope) during polishing, and calibrates writing toward a target journal (Journal Profile + Journal Fit). Deterministic local regex/statistics, zero network/LLM; writing_rules / writing_audit / writing_style_profile / writing_journal_profile with auto-audit on paper writes.

items.name: dsh-auto-continue
items.desc: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH Web requests: sends a queued 「继续」 after network, timeout or host-crash failures, with error classification, adaptive backoff, templated continue text and browser notifications.

items.name: dsh-auto-memory
items.desc: Proactive associative memory for DSH: zero-prompt recall injected at a fixed boundary, three-layer auto-consolidation, skill crystallization, and Astra-style context management - handoff ledgers and a PLAN whiteboard that survive context-window switches, water-level sensing with an auto-detected model window. Local Markdown storage, model-agnostic, zero deps; lexical 0GB floor with optional semantic tiers.

items.name: dsh-skills-manager
items.desc: Manages local DeepSeek Harness skills in Settings and shows shared Agent skills as read-only.

items.name: dsh-history
items.desc: Browse every message you sent in the current session: full-history listing with newest-first sort, text filter, one-click copy, and jump to a message (auto-loads earlier history when the target is not yet loaded).

items.name: dsh-extension-hub
items.desc: All-in-one DSH extension center in Settings: manage skills, MCP servers and plugins, a Plugin Market (curated + GitHub search, npm one-click install), and an Add-ons block to install, disable, uninstall and update companion features together.

items.name: dsh-tool-lens
items.desc: Deterministic AST code graph and architecture intelligence tool for call hierarchies, blast radius, circular dependencies, domain slices, and full-stack API contracts.

items.name: deepseek-harness-acp
items.desc: ACP profile plugin and standalone stdio server for using the full DSH agent from Zed and other ACP clients while sharing DSH credentials and sessions.

items.name: dsh-plugin-mall
items.desc: Open plugin marketplace: live GitHub dsh-plugin topic search with per-repo package.json verification (dsh.bundle/dsh.client manifest badges and a verified-only filter), npm-first installs with same-source anti-squatting checks, update detection, and five agent tools for headless use.

items.name: dsh-agency-agents
items.desc: Adds a summonable domain-expert roster that runs as subagents while the parent session keeps the task and final answer.

items.name: dsh-update-checker
items.desc: Update management for DeepSeek Harness and its plugins: semver-aware dual-source (npm/GitHub) checks for the main program and every installed plugin, a locale-aware banner (zh/en) listing updatable items, one-click updates (the main program is backed up, integrity-checked and rolled back on failure; plugins install via a temp directory without touching other packages), and a watchdog-guarded restart after updating. The settings page adds per-plugin version lamps, live update progress, and banner/notification toggles.

items.name: archify#integrations/deepseek-harness
items.desc: Generate validated, self-contained interactive architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams from repositories or system descriptions.

items.name: dsh-catppuccin-theme
items.desc: Catppuccin themes plus a toggleable glassmorphism skin for the DSH Web GUI: Latte, Frappé, Macchiato and Mocha registered into the native theme runtime, one-click switching with a persisted choice, and adjustable frosted glass for the top bar, sidebar, composer, stats line and trajectory view.

items.name: dsh-remote#plugin
items.desc: Mobile remote-control suite: bundle plugin with native sidebar entry and admin drawer, self-healing bearer-token gateway over LAN/Tailscale, Android app (sessions/approvals/questions/goals), /fs/* file transfer (Range resume, 2GB upload), latency-based multi-server auto-switch, offline chat cache.

items.name: dsh-commandcode-provider
items.desc: Unofficial Command Code LLM provider: registers a `commandcode` route with a live model catalog and reasoning-effort support.

items.name: dsh-im
items.desc: Connect IM bots to DeepSeek Harness via QR codes or bot credentials (9 channels: Feishu, WeChat, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Slack, Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp).

items.name: dsh-desktop-windowos
items.desc: Windows tray desktop shell: auto-installs and auto-updates the exe from GitHub Releases, creates desktop shortcuts for both the app and the web UI, and exposes a desktop_launch tool to start it from the conversation.

items.name: dsh-auth-gate
items.desc: Login gate for the dsh web surface: password or shared-token authentication, session cookies, rate limiting, and a user-management CLI (dsh.bundle manifest since 0.4.1, one-command `dsh plugin add` mounting).

items.name: dsh-browser
items.desc: Shared real browser for DSH: a native Electron window the human can watch and take over, driven by the agent over CDP with 20 browser_* tools (open/snapshot/execute/fill/screenshot/download/auth), per-task session isolation, cookie persistence, CAPTCHA detection; self-hosts on plain dsh web without a desktop shell.

items.name: dsh-openpencil
items.desc: OpenPencil design preview and editing plugin.

items.name: dsh-multi-chat
items.desc: Multi-window wall for the DSH Web UI: run and monitor N conversations side-by-side in one screen, with auto-discovery, per-window controls, and an authenticated LAN gateway for phone/tablet access.

items.name: dsh-doctor#plugin
items.desc: Offline diagnostic for DSH: 19 checks across env, profile, and session state, with a settings "Doctor" panel and a read-only JSON API.

items.name: dsh-browser
items.desc: Self-contained browser runtime: Playwright (chromium) + OpenCLI as plugin-local dependencies (global reuse fallback), exposes a `browser` service and 9 interactive browser tools.

items.name: dsh-auto-classifier
items.desc: Autonomous permission classifier for the auto preset: tool-scoped allow/deny rules, an LLM semantic judge, and git checkpointing for unattended sessions.

items.name: dsh-turn-rewind
items.desc: Rewind conversation and workspace state, powered by a persistent Change Ledger.

items.name: deepseek-harness-zh_pro
items.desc: UI enhancement suite for the DSH web client: Chinese locale completion, one-row stats, auto-expanded thinking, chat width, session archiving and delete, plus an optional prompt-injection switch (off by default).

items.name: dsh-plugin-vetting
items.desc: Vets third-party plugins before you trust them: static scan for malicious patterns (exfiltration, credential access, obfuscation, persistence) and over-privileged path use, transitive-dependency coverage, official-package hash baseline for supply-chain tamper detection, and an optional plugin-tool call gate.

items.name: dsh-chat
items.desc: Group chat rooms for DSH sessions with explicit @mentions, cold-session wake-up delivery, and optional cross-host transport through dsh-weave.

items.name: dsh-better-edit
items.desc: Hash-anchored read / edit / batch_edit / undo_last_edit tools: every line gets a unique 3-character content hash, edits target hashes instead of line numbers, and served-state verification rejects stale ranges with fresh anchors.

items.name: dsh-rewind
items.desc: In-place conversation rewind in the same session window without forking (Claude Code /rewind semantics): a per-message ↶ button cuts the model context back to any user message, with an optional Claude-Code-style file restore from disk-persisted before-backups.

items.name: dsh-passwords
items.desc: Turns DeepSeek Harness into a server-grade multi-tenant platform: remote access + auto HTTPS, subuser permissions & token/daily quotas, sandbox enforcement, encrypted auth & audit log.

items.name: dsh-pet#dsh-pet
items.desc: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI with 25 transparent animations, screen wandering, click reactions and drag, plus a reproducible asset-generation pipeline.

items.name: dsh-free-search
items.desc: Free, keyless web search for DSH: 7 engines (DuckDuckGo/Bing/SearXNG free + Exa/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), auto-failover, settings-page UI with API key inputs and official links, web_fetch, and an engine test tool.

items.name: dsh-tui-pro
items.desc: A full-screen terminal workbench for DeepSeek Harness with a durable assistant, workspace-grouped project sessions, transcript-only scrolling, and structured thinking, tool, diff, plan, and subagent views.

items.name: dsh-verify
items.desc: Independent browser acceptance testing for agent deliverables: JSON spec in, real-Chromium verdict out.

items.name: dsh-file-upload
items.desc: Claude-style drag-and-drop/paperclip file upload with content sniffing, document-to-Markdown via Microsoft MarkItDown (built-in JS fallback), text inlining, and a read_document tool for agents.

items.name: deepseek-harness-control-center
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness control center for official balance monitoring, per-session costs and tokens, third-party token totals, completion alerts, official recharge, flexible layouts, and agent-assisted session controls.

items.name: dsh-codex-connect
items.desc: Connect ChatGPT OAuth and OpenAI Codex models to DeepSeek Harness, with opt-in search and image tools.

items.name: dsh-any-background
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness appearance toolkit. Independently tune opacity + frosted-glass blur across 8 surfaces (main background, sidebar, cards & panels, inputs & controls, settings, conversation frame, trajectory view, produced/highlights — 9 with dsh-better-sidebar). Use any image or video as wallpaper with a drag-to-pan, scroll-to-zoom position editor and 5 layout modes (Fit/Fill/Stretch/Tile/Center); videos loop muted, survive refresh, and capture a live frame for preview, color extraction and framing. Rotate a pool of images (shuffle/order, every refresh/daily/weekly). Also: PS-style color wheel, one-click wallpaper color extraction, 6 presets + saved profiles, day/night auto switch, and full theme export/import.

items.name: dsh-archive-manager
items.desc: Adds an archived-sessions page in Settings to search, restore, and delete archived DeepSeek Harness sessions by workspace.

items.name: dsh-full-remote
items.desc: Remote DeepSeek Harness with full server-side API access (`settings.*` / `credentials.*` / `host.listDirectory`). Token-gated reverse proxy, per-device sessions, phone invite QR, fence self-check, optional approval / CIDR / idle timeout / local TLS, WebSocket/SSE.

items.name: dsh-email
items.desc: IMAP/SMTP email tools (list/read/search/send/folders/attachment/health/watch/mark/reply) with since/until date-range filters, email_mark for read/unread/star/move, email_reply for reply/reply-all/forward with threading headers, QQ/163/126/Sina/Aliyun/Gmail/Outlook/iCloud presets, multi-account support, a send-approval gate, a web settings page and a whale-girl new-mail popup driven by the incremental email_watch checker. Outlook OAuth2 device-code login works out of the box through a built-in community client, and an account can still supply its own clientId instead. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.

items.name: dsh-deepread
items.desc: Deep-read books and articles in five modes (quick, deep, knowledge map, Feynman, full book) with claim-evidence-data reports, Mermaid/XMind mindmaps, batch comparison, budget preflight, transparent background-job progress, and MD/HTML exports from URLs, files, or pasted text.

items.name: odai#odai-dsh-plugin
items.desc: Profile-wide DSH governance and routing with a Web Control Center for responsibility and evidence inspection, plus compaction, scoped semantic memory, safety continuity, and verified delivery; compatible with DSH 0.1.5-rc.1.

items.name: dsh-testkit
items.desc: Docker-isolated real-host lifecycle tests for DSH plugins across install, boot, tool registration, update, uninstall, reinstall, and recovery, with structured evidence.

items.name: dsh-devquest
items.desc: Turns coding into an RPG: finished turns, tool calls and completed todos earn XP, with 27+ achievement badges, levels, titles and seasons. Event-driven scoring with a pure-function engine — the work itself is the game.

items.name: dsh-spend
items.desc: Token usage and estimated spend for the dsh web UI: floating panel with per-model, per-day, and per-session stats.

items.name: dsh-telegram-duty
items.desc: Telegram duty gateway: phone-message task loop on a dedicated duty session, global approval forwarding with inline approve/reject buttons, telegram_ask choice questions, duty/local toggle with a web duty banner, zh/en messages, zero idle tokens.

items.name: dsh-deepseek-vision
items.desc: A vision-language gateway provider route: pasted images are described by a configurable VL model (Qwen-VL by default) before the DeepSeek wire.

items.name: dsh-peak-indicator
items.desc: Session header badge showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak status, per-model token prices on hover, and real session/turn costs from actual usage.

items.name: dsh-tianshu-tui
items.desc: A terminal UI (TUI) for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-eli-mode#packages/eli-mode
items.desc: Knowledge-base-driven agent preset: wiki long-term memory, a web KB UI, a management page and optional UI polish.

items.name: dsh-agfs
items.desc: File-browser web app for DSH: React frontend and REST API served by the host webserver, a /dsh-agfs command that opens at the current session workspace, and a browse_files model tool.

items.name: dsh-data-agent
items.desc: Let the AI connect to databases and write SQL for you.

items.name: dsh-ssh-ops
items.desc: SSH ops terminal for DSH Web UI: drive a connected server from the main conversation (ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect) while keeping an interactive xterm.js terminal on the right.

items.name: dsh-remote
items.desc: Multi-machine remote workspace: manage many SSH hosts, pick a local or remote workspace in the native Add-workspace flow (system folder chooser / local path / remote dir browse), mirror a remote workspace to a real local folder, and operate it with rw_* tools. The picker is a centered modal that opens on the local tab and auto-fills `/` for remote paths, live-completing each directory level.

items.name: dsh-memory-gate
items.desc: Bounded local memory with CBDC authority gating: SQLite + FTS5 claims, scoped recall with explainable use/verify/ignore decisions and a full audit trail, /memory commands, ≤3-claim/1200-char injection per call, no extra model call.

items.name: dsh-crew
items.desc: Runs work as a crew of role agents: a product manager writes the PRD or DoD, waits for your confirmation, then starts architect, engineer, QA and reviewers whose tool sets are locked per role, and shares work through files on disk.

items.name: dsh-movein
items.desc: Imports Claude Code setup into DeepSeek Harness from a native settings screen or CLI, with dry-run previews for skills, commands, agents, hooks, permission rules, and MCP config. Codex and OpenCode remain supported as secondary origins, with collision-safe apply and post-move checks.

items.name: dsh-zotero
items.desc: Zotero as an evidence store for agents: search your library, inspect metadata and notes, retrieve evidence passages, open source PDFs, and generate citations and bibliographies.

items.name: dsh-daemon
items.desc: Registers the DeepSeek Harness web server (dsh web) as an auto-start, self-healing background service — LaunchAgent / systemd / cron plus a 30s health-check watchdog — with seven dsh_daemon_* tools (install/uninstall/reinstall/status/start/stop/update).

items.name: dsh-excel-chat#bundle
items.desc: Talk to Excel in DeepSeek Harness: create, edit, repair, and verify spreadsheets by conversation, with automatic formula health checks after every edit.

items.name: dsh-suite#plugin-manager
items.desc: In-app plugin store for the DSH Web UI: browse, search, one-click install, compat badges.

items.name: dsh-vision-proxy
items.desc: DeepSeek brain + automatic image transcription: attach images in the GUI and each one is transcribed via the official deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp by default (a pure-text V4-Pro brain can see images), with any OpenAI-compatible VLM or local Ollama as alternatives.

items.name: vibe-mathematics
items.desc: Installs four multi-agent math-research presets for DSH: v2 (probability-driven pipeline with multi-verifier debate), v3 (paper-style Markdown knowledge base with a planner agent and a reusable method library), v4 (persistent self-organizing residents that message and meet), and v5 (a research institute with an academician who decomposes and assigns work, voting researchers, temp workers, group chat and a compare-and-set task board); all four support checkpoint resume, human intervention, and an optional Lean formal-verification switch (off/encourage/require) whose passing proof turns the vote into a fidelity check of the Lean statements.

items.name: dsh-taskboard
items.desc: Task board for DSH: create tasks with project and model assignment, run them manually or on cron schedules; new sessions in a project automatically pick up its todo tasks and move them to in-review when done.

items.name: dsh-tavily#packages/dsh-tavily
items.desc: Tavily search, extract, map and crawl tools with multi-key rotation, failover on HTTP 401/429/432/433, and a load-balance mode that caps in-flight requests per Tavily account, plus a key and usage card on the Plugins page. The built-in web_search is never replaced.

items.name: dsh-plugin-vet
items.desc: Plugin trust pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic static scan with verdicts, opt-in runtime guard with honeypot lures, agent audit-protocol skill, and a browser shield status light. Alarm-only, never an enforcer.

items.name: dsh-wallpaper-engine
items.desc: Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1+ (DSH Desktop >= 2.0.7) and dsh-better-sidebar >= 0.19.0 - update both before installing or updating this plugin. Plays local Wallpaper Engine Video/Web wallpapers behind the chat, renders Scene wallpapers as extracted static frames, and adds content-rating/type filters, custom uploads and an iOS-style liquid-glass settings window.

items.name: dsh-codex-subscription
items.desc: ChatGPT OAuth provider for Codex models with subscription web search, quota and safe reset, image tools, Fast mode, and model-aware context; no API key or Codex CLI.

items.name: dsh-toolbox-web
items.desc: Toolbox plugin for the Web UI: session/trash/subdirectory/search/preset/config management, tag grouping, long-message collapse, and a scheduled heartbeat with optional IM channel push.

items.name: dsh-mobile-hanui
items.desc: Mobile UI shell for the DSH Web GUI: turns the desktop three-column layout into a touch-friendly phone layout (overlay drawers, draggable FAB, full-screen dialogs, infinite-scroll history) under a 1024px viewport, with zero desktop impact. - Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on dsh-mobile-gate: secure remote-access gateway plus install-to-homescreen (manifest + service worker), offline capability, touch gestures (pull-to-refresh, edge-swipe back, pinch-zoom font), agent-done push notifications, and touch-first layout — desktop unaffected.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-obsidian-memory
items.desc: Persistent AI memory backed by a local Obsidian/Codex vault: five obsidian_memory_* read/write/search tools plus a sidebar vault browser.

items.name: dsh-plugin-market
items.desc: Plugin marketplace in Settings that targets any local profile, not just the running one: install, update and remove across web, headless and other profiles, with install-script warnings, an installed view that also covers non-catalog profile dependencies, and an automatic DSH restart when the current profile changes.

items.name: dsh-project-kanban
items.desc: Per-workspace project kanban board: nine kanban_* model tools for agent-driven planning plus a browser board UI, with disk persistence, undo, templates, and archiving.

items.name: dsh-chatvoice
items.desc: Free voice closed loop for the Web UI: browser SpeechRecognition mic input with live interim results plus read-aloud speaker buttons and auto-read for assistant replies, zero configuration and no API key.

items.name: dsh-im-connect
items.desc: Connects WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu, Lark, QQ, and Telegram to a local DeepSeek Harness agent, with each IM chat as a separate workspace channel.

items.name: dsh-meme
items.desc: Chat meme stickers: text-only send, mood auto-send, QQ/WeChat-style picker, auto-learn, custom packs.

items.name: dsh-anchored-monitor
items.desc: A whip for DeepSeek V4 Pro: it watches the reasoning fingerprint of every thinking block and pulls the model back when it slips from focused "We will / I will" mode into scattered "let me" mode.

items.name: dsh-remote
items.desc: Secure remote access for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a login gate, MFA/TOTP, signed session cookies, optional admin/user/guest roles, in-browser workspace selection, and allowlisted remote file previews.

items.name: dsh-desktop-shortcut
items.desc: Windows desktop shortcut for dsh web: launches the server, auto-opens the browser when ready, and stops the service when the Harness window closes.

items.name: dsh-edit-approval
items.desc: Ask-before-act approval for every edit and every bash command: a red/green line diff before a file is touched, a description+command panel before a command runs — approve once or reject, each gate with its own master switch in Settings → General.

items.name: mirage#dsh
items.desc: Swaps the filesystem and bash providers for a mirage virtual workspace: file tools and shell commands run over mounted resources (RAM, S3, Redis, Slack, Gmail, Notion, Postgres) instead of the host disk, with per-mount read/write/exec modes, per-command sandbox routing (monty, pyodide, quickjs in process; docker, e2b, daytona remote), and installed CLIs (git, gh, slack, linear, ntn, gws, or one you register) as head words in the virtual terminal.

items.name: dsh-agent-skills
items.desc: Browse, enable, disable, and manage Agent Skills from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, and custom directories in the DSH settings panel.

items.name: dsh-tool-writing
items.desc: A web-novel writing engine for DeepSeek Harness: parallel drafting, outlining and brainstorming with a separate DeepSeek key, lore and foreshadowing management, semantic vector retrieval, a corpus library, usage ledger, mechanical proofreading, and a local serialization plan.

items.name: dsh-research
items.desc: Curated research plugin market: adds a Research plugins page to Settings with hand-reviewed plugins for literature search, reference management, writing and workbenches — one-click install, update and remove pinned to the reviewed version, restart from the panel, and exactly one network request (its own catalog).

items.name: dsh-msg-hub
items.desc: IM channel bridge: WeChat (ilinkai) / QQ / Feishu with proactive push — wake the channel bot from scheduled tasks and deliver AI replies to your phone.

items.name: dsh-codex-sync
items.desc: Two-way Codex↔DSH bridge: skills from ~/.codex/skills, session import with workspace attach, live MCP mirroring of mcp_servers, and a Codex-side reverse MCP installer.

items.name: dsh-bloub-mood
items.desc: Animated mood icon: swaps the favicon, sidebar wordmark and hero headline for bloub expression animations that follow session state (working / awaiting input / done / idle), with 8 shapes, 12 colors and custom wordmark texts configurable in Settings.

items.name: dsh-message-edit
items.desc: Branch-based message editing, reroll, retry, and a version timeline.

items.name: dsh-imagegen
items.desc: AI image generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image through a configurable OpenAI-compatible endpoint (gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3), with an api_url/api_key settings card and a sidebar split-pane generation studio.

items.name: dsh-capability-optimizer
items.desc: Headless Claude Code consultations with advisor, reviewer, and designer roles, returned as reference answers.

items.name: dsh-plugin-wiki-tools
items.desc: Native tools for an Obsidian wiki vault: wiki_query, wiki_write, wiki_rename, wiki_scaffold, wiki_archive, and wiki_lint cover BM25 search with link-graph context, bookkeeping writes with sha256 source tracking, vault-wide renames, mode scaffolds, source archiving, and health checks — with cross-process locks and optional git auto-commit.

items.name: dsh-ui-usage-billing
items.desc: Sidebar billing dashboard: real usage aggregated from session logs (per-model and per-day calls/tokens/cache), cost estimated in CNY from a current multi-provider pricing catalog, subscription-plan (coding/token/agent) routes exempt, and per-provider health dots.

items.name: dsh-all-usage
items.desc: Analyze usage across models, providers, workspaces, and time ranges — including custom start/end dates over the full retained history — with live cache-hit visibility and separate model and provider breakdowns. Includes hourly single-day trends, daily cross-day trends, a 53-week GitHub-style heatmap, usage streaks, model and workspace Token-share donut charts with Token, cost, and percentage details, independent combinable filters, cache-efficiency trends, DeepSeek account balance, workspace aliases, CSV export, and a durable ledger that preserves successfully flushed usage after session deletion — and after a workspace is deleted, where its recorded usage is summed into one Deleted row — and rebuilds incrementally — on restart, unchanged sessions are applied from the ledger without re-reading their logs (a per-session log revision is the change signal), and only changed/new events are folded. The workspace registry is kept fresh automatically through the DSH domain/changed probe: only added/removed workspaces are reprocessed incrementally, unchanged workspaces reuse their computed aggregates and ledger with zero rescan, and usage is strictly limited to DSH-registered workspaces (unregistered cwds are ignored). After a scan, lightweight revision status fetches full history only when the Host/data state changes and exposes non-sensitive sync health (revision reuse, rereads, ledger recovery, and failures). Token accounting is explicit: input is fresh (cache read/write and reasoning are separate buckets) and zero-usage replays never overwrite recorded usage. Chinese uses local time, English uses UTC; API access is loopback-only.

items.name: dsh-file-preview#dsh-file-preview

items.name: better-reasoning-slider

items.name: dsh-approval-translator

items.name: dsh-mobile-glass
items.desc: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI on narrow screens: reveal drawer with the chat layer on top, drag gestures, bottom-sheet settings panel, composer and header fixes, zero desktop impact.

items.name: dsh-postman
items.desc: Upload files and folders straight into the conversation — images attach as real message blocks, text content is written into the composer draft, folders land by directory structure.

items.name: dsh-llm-cost
items.desc: Per-turn and session-wide LLM cost metering: a dollar cost line under each message, a session cumulative total with hover breakdown, and an LLM+web price auto-refresh tool.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-usage-cost
items.desc: Token usage and cost tracking with daily/session budget alerts and a usage_report tool.

items.name: dsh-deepseek-quota-left
items.desc: DeepSeek API quota panel collapsed into a left-edge handle for the Web UI: click to expand balance, official today's consumption (with platform token) and live conversation cost; fork of dsh-deepseek-quota.

items.name: dsh-plugin-deepseek-balance
items.desc: DeepSeek API balance, balance trend, and daily usage charts in DSH Web settings.

items.name: dsh-session-cost

items.name: dsh-token-anxiety

items.name: mmx-quota-tool

items.name: dsh-usage-stats-plus
items.desc: DSH usage and balance panel with official live balance, per-event official peak/off-peak pricing, all-channel spend estimates from daily balance snapshots, and a Codex-style 12-month token activity timeline. Fork of Ychris12138/dsh-usage-stats.

items.name: dsh-cost-crystal
items.desc: Floating cost crystal for the Web UI: balance card, real-time tok/s, peak/off-peak billing countdown, last-24h spend, and a 🔮 next-message cost forecast, all timezone-aware.

items.name: dsh-opencode-go-quota
items.desc: Bottom-right 余额 badge for the DSH Web UI: on expand it fetches the currently-selected provider's OpenCode Go plan limits or DeepSeek prepaid balance, plus local token usage and pricing-based spend estimates.

items.name: dsh-stylevault
items.desc: 30 classic open-source theme palettes (Catppuccin, Nord, Tokyo Night, Gruvbox, Solarized, etc.) mapped to official ThemeService tokens for DeepSeek Harness, with a Style Settings panel for live color/font/radius tweaks and JSON export/import for sharing config packs.

items.name: dsh-moonrise
items.desc: Moonrise dark theme for the DSH Web UI, with deep indigo surfaces and warm amber accents.

items.name: dsh-skin-nebula
items.desc: Anime skin pack for the DSH Web UI: five AI-generated HD themes (Ninja, Sakura, Bamboo, Ronin, Ryujin) with per-theme accent palettes, a top-right shirt-icon switcher, and an adjustable transparency slider.

items.name: dsh-skin-digital-arcade
items.desc: Opt-in pixel-neon arcade skin with Fusion Pixel fonts, animated whale-girl icons, custom crosshair and draggable detail windows; preserves light/dark/system themes. v0.3.2 includes local display-name controls, mobile menu improvements and an optional source patch for the arcade home screen, transitions and telemetry HUD.

items.name: dsh-dynamic-wallpaper
items.desc: Animated wallpaper plugin with 8 canvas backgrounds (particles, meteors, starfield, waves, rain, bubbles, matrix, aurora) plus custom video import, and speed/density/opacity/blur sliders with localStorage persistence.

items.name: dsh-api-key-pool
items.desc: API key rotation pool for your LLM providers: auto-discovers providers from settings, per-provider multi-key round-robin, failover on 401/403/429, and cooldown recovery.

items.name: dsh-fonts

items.name: dsh-subagent-default-model#plugin
items.desc: Configurable default model for subagent delegations via settings.yaml, with single-model and multi-model round-robin or random strategies.

items.name: oh-my-dsh
items.desc: Tiered model routing for DeepSeek Harness: think/build model tiers, vision delegation (the vision model only describes images; the working model acts), image generation, and a high-impact guard.

items.name: dsh-llm-cursor

items.name: dsh-llm-grok
items.desc: xAI Grok subscription chat: SuperGrok or X Premium+ OAuth, a displayed model subset, Responses through the Grok CLI proxy, and always-on server-side web_search and x_search.

items.name: dsh-subagent-model-picker

items.name: dsh-delegation-suite

items.name: dsh-archived-conversations
items.desc: Archived conversations list in the sidebar footer with read-only previews of the most recent messages, for sessions the product deliberately keeps hidden and unreopenable.

items.name: dsh-branch-review

items.name: dsh-fork-diff

items.name: dsh-fork-graph

items.name: dsh-local-share
items.desc: Export complete Web Sessions to local Markdown or self-contained HTML, with stable rendered previews, default redaction, and opt-in bounded tool-call details.

items.name: dsh-session-unarchive
items.desc: Restore archived sessions to their original workspace from the Web GUI sidebar.

items.name: dsh-context-proxy
items.desc: Thin on-demand context retrieval: context_query / context_slice / context_grep tools that read already-persisted history back with replay-safe citations.

items.name: dsh-rolehub-bridge

items.name: dsh-humanized-deepseek-maid
items.desc: Adds a configurable humanized whale-girl maid persona with immersive roleplay, speaking modes, and a lightweight layered memory with query-triggered recall.

items.name: dsh-session-nav
items.desc: A floating button beside the chat that opens a searchable list of all questions in the session for quick jumps, with smooth hover-open/close behavior.

items.name: dsh-session-manager
items.desc: Session manager for the DSH Web UI: browse all and archived sessions, restore/unarchive, delete with two-step confirmation, and preview conversation content from the Settings panel.

items.name: dsh-whale-companion
items.desc: Automatically starts a fresh Web session near the context limit with the last complete turn, and adds an editable additive whale-maid persona with on-demand reload.

items.name: dsh-shelf
items.desc: Session lifecycle CLI: export (md/json/jsonl), archive/restore, trash, search, and stats. Read-only by default; nothing is ever deleted by the engine.

items.name: dsh-butler-memory
items.desc: PostgreSQL-backed durable memory for DSH agents: MCP memory tools plus a Web panel for reviewing memories and candidates.

items.name: dsh-memory-protocol

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-memories
items.desc: Project-scoped persistent key-value memories with set/get/list/delete/search model tools and JSON-file storage.

items.name: dsh-headroom
items.desc: Automatic context compression for DeepSeek Harness: compresses tool outputs before they reach the model and keeps every lossy compression reversible via CCR retrieval tools.

items.name: dsh-file-memory
items.desc: File-backed working memory: memorize/recall key premises verbatim in a session notes file so they survive context compaction losslessly.

items.name: dsh-premise-guard
items.desc: Post-compaction premise-drift guard: injects a one-shot notice when a compaction summary drops a critical literal anchor.

items.name: dsh-cue-bank
items.desc: Cross-session event-cue memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto-extracts task/conversation cues and user language habits from every turn into a persistent global cue bank, then re-injects remembered context on topic-switch detection (keyword or vector matching).

items.name: dsh-memoria-extra
items.desc: Advanced memoria tools: session context injection (profile + recall), recent decisions, health report, namespace allowlist, memory relation graph, and entity search; companion to dsh-memoria.

items.name: dsh-project
items.desc: Organize folders and sessions into projects with shared PROJECT.md memory and AGENTS.md instructions injected into every session, plus a project tree sidebar.

items.name: dsh-compaction
items.desc: Compaction backend replacing LLM summarization with a deterministic semantic extractor (keeps code/paths/commands, drops chatter) plus 28.4x KV-compression accounting.

items.name: dsh-memory-director
items.desc: LLM-driven remember/forget memory: after each turn a model decides what to keep (MemoryDirector), injects relevant memories before each step, dedups, and persists cross-session.

items.name: deepseek-harness-hanako-memory
items.desc: Hana-style assistant manager for DSH: visual preset management (cards, yuan personalities, avatar cropping) plus a full Hana memory stack (rolling summaries, layered compilation, SQLite fact store, deep memory).

items.name: dsh-plugin
items.desc: PLUR memory rendered into the system prompt on each assembly rather than exposed as a tool call, so the block is replaced instead of appended and context stays flat across a session. Fully local hybrid search (BM25 + BGE fused with RRF), plain YAML storage you can edit, per-workspace scoping, and a /plur-memory browser.

items.name: dsh-cognition
items.desc: Project memory for coding agents on DeepSeek Harness: similar past edits surface as precedents, out-of-scope edits are blocked, and cognition persists across sessions (47 upstream-verified fixes, gold-free 20-task run).

items.name: dsh-plugin-asmemory
items.desc: Action-state time memory: record typed states and actions, then analyze trends, anomalies, and causality.

items.name: dsh-agentmemory
items.desc: DSH ↔ agentmemory session-memory bridge: mirrors session lifecycle into a local agentmemory daemon (REST), exposes memory_recall / memory_remember tools, and injects a per-session memory context window via agent/pre-step.

items.name: dsh-logtimeline
items.desc: Query local log files with Chinese natural-language time expressions (e.g. "yesterday afternoon", "3 hours ago") — precise time range, matched lines, ERROR/WARN/INFO level stats, fully offline.

items.name: dsh-asimovbox
items.desc: Connects DeepSeek Harness to AsimovBox for creating, updating, rendering, and finishing videos through API-key-authenticated tools.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-mcp-client-v2
items.desc: Enhanced MCP client: paginated tool discovery, non-blocking startup, mcp_tool_search, hand-rolled stdio/streamable-http transports.

items.name: dsh-tool-imagegen
items.desc: OpenAI-compatible image generation in DSH Desktop chat: generate inline, edit reference images or chain-edit previous results directly (image-to-image) without re-uploading, with storage cleanup.

items.name: dsh-content-lab
items.desc: Content workshop tools for DSH — topic, title, post and content-calendar generation through the built-in LLM.

items.name: dsh-remote-workspace
items.desc: SSH/SFTP remote sites and workspaces: manage connections and remote directories like local workspaces.

items.name: dsh-plugin-call-trace
items.desc: Persistent model tool-call trace recorder: every tool call is durably written to a JSONL file that survives restarts, queryable via a structured call_trace tool and a callTraceHistory service, with size rotation and an optional floating canvas UI add-on.

items.name: dsh-console
items.desc: Slash-command console for dsh: /web start|stop|restart|status, /tunnel SSH forward management, one-shot /ask, and a console TUI launcher.

items.name: dsh-codebase-memory
items.desc: Code knowledge graph bridge for codebase-memory-mcp: semantic symbol search (BM25), source snippets, architecture overview with Leiden communities, call/data-flow/cross-service traces, graph-augmented grep.

items.name: dsh-nuphus-mcp
items.desc: Desktop and browser automation bridge (36 tools): window/screen/mouse/keyboard control with PaddleOCR element perception, Chrome CDP browsing with accessibility snapshots.

items.name: dsh-auto-open-web
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness automatically opens browser plugins and includes a built-in WebView2 program to achieve a lightweight desktop experience.

items.name: computer-control

items.name: model-catalog
items.desc: Auto-discovers model listings, pricing and capabilities from OpenAI-compatible API hosts, normalizes them, and emits ready-to-use model configs for dsh.

items.name: dsh-jenkins

items.name: dsh-plugin-autoevo
items.desc: Search-first capability workflow for DSH agents (v1.0.0): reuse local tools or review exact-source plugins before installation, adapt or create capabilities in managed source work, and use receipts that distinguish installed, loaded, activated, and verified states; version tools cover rollback, adoption, and upstream updates.

items.name: dsh-mcp-lazy
items.desc: Lazy-loading router for MCP servers: auto-discovers compatible MCPs and keeps only a shared router in the tool catalog, revealing a server's schemas when a turn needs them and hiding them again at turn end, so many installed MCPs stop costing context on every request. Falls open to normal visibility on any uncertainty, and the original MCP keeps ownership of execution, permissions and process lifecycle. Also supports explicit lazy connections with warm reuse, bounded reconnection, stdio and Streamable HTTP.

items.name: msds-chain-mcp#dsh
items.desc: Chemical safety intelligence through the hosted MSDS Chain MCP endpoint: 23 tools for compatibility and mixing order, GHS hazards, PPE, storage, waste disposal, exposure limits, transport classification, multi-region regulatory compliance, SDS lookup and version diffs, and signed audit reports, each answer citing the supplier SDS and revision date it is grounded in.

items.name: dsh-tools

items.name: dsh-code-intel
items.desc: Indexes workspace symbols with Tree-sitter and provides lexical or optional embedding-assisted code search.

items.name: dsh-plugin-nexterm
items.desc: Nexterm fleet maintenance in a DSH session: 6 agent tools (auth with password/TOTP/device-code login, fleet listing, single-host exec, parallel batch exec, preset health checks, CPU/memory/disk monitoring) over the Nexterm REST API, plus a minimal settings page; no SSH private keys needed on the DSH machine.

items.name: dsh-multi-workspace
items.desc: Multi-workspace sandbox: grants file-write access to every registered workspace automatically — add a workspace, write to it immediately, no config or escalation needed.

items.name: dsh-pubmed
items.desc: PubMed deep-research toolset: literature search, author investigation, same-name disambiguation, institution statistics and mentor-student matching.

items.name: dsh-memoryleak

Zero tokens throughout — nothing goes through the model, and your notes stay ordinary local files that git and any editor can read.

items.name: dsh-svg-motion
items.desc: Turn any SVG logo into a motion video inside DSH: an `animate_svg` tool renders a transparent 30fps assembly animation (parts fly in, or the whole mark settles) and synthesizes an MP4 with ffmpeg.

items.name: dsh-git-proxy
items.desc: On-demand GitHub proxy for the Web UI: one-click git/SSH proxy toggle with connectivity tests.

items.name: dsh-human-task#dsh-human-task
items.desc: Human-in-the-loop tools (`human_task` / `human_task_ready_check`): pause the agent until the user performs a real-world action or returns an observation (GUI operation, game testing, visual verification, hardware checks), gated by session consent and an AFK presence check, returning a structured JSON result via a web task dialog.

items.name: dsh-wash-calendar
items.desc: Recurring-habit scheduling from pure date math: next occurrence, range schedules, and overdue advice.

items.name: browser-automation
items.desc: Real-browser automation for dsh via an MCP server (Playwright core): navigate, click, fill, type, screenshot, and act on accessibility snapshots with numbered references - all 22 web_* tools re-exposed to the harness over stdio.

items.name: dsh-plugin-search
items.desc: Keep the built-in web_search tool without an official DeepSeek API key: disable web-search-deepseek and use Tavily keyless by default.

items.name: dsh-cdp-browser
items.desc: CDP bridge to an already-running Chrome/Edge for DSH: screenshots, pixel assertions, DOM/CSS checks, and page JS evaluation over HTTP + WebSocket, with zero child processes, zero npm dependencies, and zero per-use approval.

items.name: dsh-image-search

items.name: dsh-vision-solution

items.name: win11-oneocr
items.desc: Local Windows 11 OneOCR tool for DSH: `oneocr_recognize` returns OCR text and structured line/word polygons, confidence, rotation, and handwriting style.

items.name: dsh-vision-plugin
items.desc: Give your text-only model eyes - chat image attachments are auto-described via a vision model (default prompt), with iterative re-parsing through model-generated prompts when details are missing; system/custom model modes + GUI config panel, key-safe secret handling, and a small host patch for DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 (see repo README).

items.name: dsh-easyvision
items.desc: Give text-only models vision: a describe_image tool that delegates images to a vision model from your dsh model list over the harness's own LLM runtime.

items.name: dsh-voice-ai-girlfriend-plugin
items.desc: Voice AI girlfriend for the Web UI: FunASR mic input, Qwen3-TTS spoken replies, companion animation window, and two-way QQ chat (text/voice/image push) via NapCat.

items.name: dsh-dingo
items.desc: Sound reminders with one-click jump for concurrent sessions: the current session gets crisp dang/dang-dang tones, other sessions a soft ding/ding-ding plus a top-right card that jumps straight to the replying conversation.

items.name: dsh-voice
items.desc: Full-duplex voice mode for the Web UI: tap-to-toggle or hold-to-talk dictation (send key or `Ctrl`) with a live caption, host-side SenseVoice ASR via sherpa-onnx, sentence-by-sentence spoken replies, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). No API key.

items.name: dsh-fish-tts
items.desc: Reads assistant replies aloud via Fish Audio API only (bring your own key): per-message read-aloud, auto-read toggle, and a settings page for model, voice reference_id, encrypted API key, and proxy.

items.name: dsh-voice-input
items.desc: Voice input for the web UI: a mic button in the composer that transcribes speech into the draft via the Web Speech API, with an optional auto-send toggle.

items.name: dsh-voice-live

items.name: arch-doc
items.desc: Analyze a codebase and generate architecture documentation: module responsibilities, dependencies, entry points and run methods.

items.name: sendpage-mcp
items.desc: Publish an HTML document as a shareable link that opens in one tap and previews as a card in chat apps; publish, update, and export to PNG/PDF/Word.

items.name: dsh-starter-zh
items.desc: Beginner starter pack for DeepSeek Harness: welcome flow, 0→1 learning path, scenario-based plugin recommendations and a self-check checklist, paired with the dsh-handbook-zh Chinese tutorial repo.

items.name: dsh-preset-scaffold
items.desc: DSH project scaffold preset: strict 5-phase init runbook, engineering standards and six runnable starter templates (node-ts / react-vite / python / go / spring-boot / monorepo).

items.name: dknowc-dsh
items.desc: Trusted office suite for government/enterprise work by Beijing Caizhi Technology (深知可信智能): three skills — trusted consulting (policy/regulation Q&A with citation markers + provenance HTML), trusted search (authoritative policy/standard retrieval with traceable HTML + clean Markdown), and official-document writing (draft/rewrite/Word/red-head delivery); all interfaces go through the dknowc trusted workbench MCP (Bearer auth), products land in the session workspace, one-time key setup persists for later sessions; ships on npm as dknowc-dsh.

items.name: oh-my-deepseek-harness

items.name: mattpocock-skills-dsh

items.name: redfox-community-dsh

items.name: math-research-dsh

items.name: lunheng-article-pipeline-dsh

Installs with `dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` (package.json#dsh.bundle.patch plus a lib/index.js entry that registers the skill); ships role cards for T1-T9, templates and 36 zero-dependency verification scripts, with five-language READMEs.

items.name: dsh-plugin-aflare
items.desc: Workflow tools for the local aflare binary: generate, validate and run local-first deterministic YAML workflow DAGs (WAL crash recovery, Saga compensation) through the local aflare binary, with 300+ templates built in.

items.name: dsh-verification#dsh-verification

items.name: fullstack-expert

items.name: dsh-frontier-repro

items.name: file-planning

items.name: dsh-dual-agent-presets

items.name: dsh-git-nexus

items.name: dsh-ocr-review

items.name: adversarial-review

items.name: dsh-ci-context

items.name: dsh-tool-github

items.name: kongmu-im-bridge
items.desc: Feishu bridge for DeepSeek Harness (derived from dsh-im-bridge): WebSocket long connection, approval cards, group @-mention-only replies, streaming card updates, /stop command.

items.name: dsh-email-push-master
items.desc: Email reminders from your DSH agent when you are away, with stable SMTP (no 535 retry loop), connect and idle timeouts, and a --check self-test.

items.name: dsh-wecom
items.desc: WeCom (Enterprise WeChat) Smart Robot bridge: two-way chat over the aibot WebSocket gateway, no public endpoint needed.

items.name: dsh-sound-cue
items.desc: Short Web Audio cues when a session needs your attention (approval, question, or plan review) and when a task finishes; synthesized inside the page in two selectable styles with a volume setting — no popups, no OS notifications, no audio files, no network — and one bundle that covers DSH 0.1.7+ (desktop & web) and 0.1.0-rc.6.

items.name: dsh-weixin
items.desc: WeChat (iLink) channel: chat with your DSH agent from the WeChat app, one persistent session per conversation, reusing DSH credentials.

items.name: dsh-task-notify
items.desc: Native Windows system notification (Notification Center toast) when a task completes: goal completion or agent turn end.

items.name: dsh-notify
items.desc: System-level desktop notifications: turn-completion and workflow-end banners, plus a modal alert when an approval is needed (macOS osascript / Linux notify-send).

items.name: dsh-plugin-verify
items.desc: Verification toolkit for DSH agents: evidence-based claim checking against workspace files with line citations, config validation (JSON/YAML), and read-only URL/npm/GitHub submission-readiness probes.

items.name: dsh-trend-radar
items.desc: Ecosystem trend dashboard (行情面板): snapshot the dsh-plugin topic and the awesome list into local history, then report weekly trends — new plugins, star gainers, category heat, awesome coverage — plus a keyword radar for new plugins and star surges.

items.name: bash-on-windows
items.desc: On Windows, the available bash tool is limited to Git Bash and PowerShell is disabled.

items.name: dsh-project-manager
items.desc: Manage development projects from the DSH web UI in a draggable floating window: add/remove, one-click start/stop/restart, hot-reload restart on file changes, and real-time persistent logs.

items.name: dsh-effect-doctor
items.desc: Verifies that Cordis-managed runtime resources return to baseline after isolated plugin teardown, with deterministic cleanup receipts.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-system-proxy
items.desc: System proxy detection (scutil/env/PAC) with a status tool and a proxy_export bash snippet tool.

items.name: dsh-tool-call-stats
items.desc: Per-process tool-call statistics: a `tool_stats` tool reporting per-tool call counts, error counts, and average durations.

items.name: dsh-worlds
items.desc: Runs the agent's filesystem, bash and PTY terminals inside a Docker container by providing the `ctx.fs` and `ctx.subprocess` seams, so cwd, environment and background processes survive a harness restart.

items.name: dsh-tmuxctl
items.desc: Take control of your tmux panes: list/send-keys/capture, run long jobs in a pane with watch mode, and approval-gated destructive commands.

items.name: hooks-adapter
items.desc: Reuses hooks declared in Claude Code, Codex and opencode configs on dsh, executing shell, webhook, oracle and proxy handlers with zero runtime dependencies.

items.name: dsh-network-settings
items.desc: Visualize the DSH process network path on Windows or WSL with layered DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP probes, detect stale proxy configuration, and apply snapshot-guarded repairs.

items.name: dsh-orcana#dsh-bundle
items.desc: Runtime governor for DeepSeek Harness: zero-progress steering, generation-bound verification evidence, evidence-aware completion guarding, and task-profile tool restriction.

items.name: dsh-desktop-lifecycle
items.desc: Close and restart controls for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web on Windows, in Settings → General.

items.name: dsh-change-budget
items.desc: Configurable per-turn budgets for supported file mutations, limiting distinct files, mutation calls, and UTF-8 payload bytes before tool execution.

items.name: dsh-preset-anchored-standard
items.desc: Minimal-anchored agent preset: request #1 keeps the real bash + str_replace_editor pair with auto-injected context stripped, then promotion unlocks the full Standard catalog and posts a one-shot background-jobs notice against sleep-polling habits.

items.name: dsh-spill-s3
items.desc: S3-compatible backend for the spill seam: oversized tool output goes to object storage (S3, MinIO, R2) with hashed session prefixes and unguessable keys, instead of the agent's local disk.

items.name: dsh-single-instance-guard
items.desc: Aborts startup when another live dsh instance holds the same DSH_HOME data directory, preventing the concurrent session-log writes that corrupt transcripts.

items.name: dsh-guard
items.desc: A development safety kit: rolling config snapshots, automatic rollback on plugin failures, boot-failure rescue, and an in-settings management panel.

items.name: dsh-shield
items.desc: A hands-off safety net: directories the agent deletes go to a trash folder first and symlinks are never followed, with zero approvals.

items.name: dsh-rule-evolve
items.desc: Verification-driven self-evolution loop: failure logs become verified AGENTS.md rules; in-session plugin (evolve_learn / evolve_apply / evolve_touch / evolve_recall), tool-verify gate, rule lifecycle, local recall.

items.name: dsh-gov
items.desc: Agent governance suite: policy-based tool gating (allow/deny/ask with wildcards and priorities), a structured JSONL audit trail, and per-agent token quotas against the host token meter, with state under $DSH_HOME/gov.

items.name: dsh-plugin-gate
items.desc: Installation safety gate for DSH plugins: antivirus-style scan of install scripts, permissions, secrets and network callbacks on local directories or npm tarballs, returning a BLOCK/WARN/PASS verdict before "dsh plugin add".

items.name: dsh-permissions
items.desc: Claude Code-style permission rules engine: hard/deny/ask/allow tiers with a hard tier above full access, workspace-scoped rules, wildcard path protection, and a visual staged editor; rules persist in settings.yaml.

items.name: dsh-auto-reviewer
items.desc: Codex-style auto-review permission mode: adds an auto-review preset that auto-approves safe sandbox escalations, asks on risky or ambiguous ones, and rejects critical unconfirmed operations.

items.name: dsh-plugin-sentinel
items.desc: Static pre-install security auditor for plugin bundles: lifecycle scripts, dynamic execution, credential-exfiltration combos, and patch-layer hazards, with zero dependencies and in-memory tar parsing.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-approve-for-me
items.desc: Automated approval review: auto-approve read-only tools, auto-deny dangerous commands, fail-closed policy engine.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-secret-redactor
items.desc: Automatic secret redaction in tool results: masks API keys, tokens, JWTs, private keys and configured secrets before the model sees them.

items.name: safety-net
items.desc: Destructive-command interception gate for dsh: parses shell semantics, judges risk against 41 built-in rules, and holds irreversible rm -rf, git reset --hard, and git push --force style commands at a confirmation gate.

items.name: secret-guard
items.desc: Blocks agents from reading or writing sensitive files (.env, credentials, key material), masks leaked secret-shaped values in tool results, keeps an audit journal, and exposes safe sg_* inspection tools that never print raw values.

items.name: dsh-taintguard
items.desc: Taints the agent when tool results carry untrusted content, gates the privileged calls that follow, and refuses credentials passed to network-capable tools in every mode.

items.name: dsh-code-runtime-container
items.desc: Container-isolated backend for the `ctx.codeRuntime` seam: each Code Mode program runs in a fresh container with no network, a read-only rootfs, dropped capabilities, and kernel-enforced memory, CPU and pid ceilings.

items.name: dsh-credentials-vault
items.desc: HashiCorp Vault backend for the credential seam: KV v2/v1, AppRole machine auth, per-operation reads so rotation needs no restart, and compare-and-swap writes.

items.name: dsh-plugin-remote
items.desc: Remote access gateway for the DSH Web GUI: login auth plus an HTTP/WebSocket reverse proxy to the loopback server, no --trusted-host needed.

items.name: dsh-feed
items.desc: Cross-ecosystem aggregation data layer: syncs the GitHub dsh-plugin topic and the npm registry into one open JSON index, queried by model tools, a CLI, and a minimal stdio MCP server.

items.name: dsh-need-finder
items.desc: Requirement-driven dsh plugin discovery and environment recipes: plugin_guide matches natural-language needs to a curated plugin directory with reasons and install commands; recipe installs whole setups (通知全家桶, 安全审计套装...) from bundled community bundles with ordered plans.

items.name: dsh-plugin-recommend
items.desc: Plugin recommender for DSH: search and rank plugins from an embedded 1100+ entry marketplace catalog by need description, category and tags, with match reasons and a live catalog refresh from the awesome-dsh-plugin README.

items.name: dsh-recipe
items.desc: Scenario bundles of dsh plugins (插件界的 dotfiles): a recipe tool that lists, searches, applies and composes ready-made plugin environments with ordered install sequences.

items.name: huahua-dsh-plugin-orchestra
items.desc: A plugin management system for DeepSeek Harness: plugin inventory with L0/L1/L2 AI purpose summaries, changelog tracking, update alerts, one-click upgrade, and backup/rollback with crash recovery.

items.name: dsh-plugin-scout
items.desc: Scouts the deepseek-harness repo and every dsh-plugin-tagged repository to discover harnesses related to your goal, then judges each as worth trying, watching, or skipping.

items.name: find-dsh-plugins
items.desc: Conversational DSH plugin finder: four-source unified index, BM25 pre-filter plus LLM semantic ranking, candidates carry evidence grades and local static security audit, safe install flow with post-install verification.

items.name: dsh-idle-deepcompute
items.desc: Terminal-style AI-lab idle game where you hoard compute, train and upgrade models, publish papers, and prestige from neural nets to ASI.

items.name: dsh-pixel-studio#dsh-cli-anything-aseprite
items.desc: Aseprite-style pixel art studio: the AI draws sprites stroke by stroke with selections, layers, animation frames, gradients, symmetry and reference layers, each step rendered live as ANSI terminal frames.

items.name: dsh-bull-bear
items.desc: Real-time quote bull/bear desk pet for DSH: a portfolio-average-driven pet that runs faster and jumps higher the closer gains reach 20%, with a watchlist panel for searching and adding stocks plus a live "race" of how each holding is moving.

items.name: ui-muyu
items.desc: A floating cyber wooden fish widget — tap it to strike and accumulate merit, drag it anywhere on the page.

items.name: dsh-pet-evolve
items.desc: The pet that grows with your agent: 5 evolution stages earned from real signals (verified rules, completed sessions, tool calls, compactions), agent-state mirroring, and one-click growth share cards. Zero dependencies, 100% local.

items.name: dsh-j-space
items.desc: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 native agent preset and standalone Cordis plugin: 13 modules, persistent controller and decoupled workspace.

items.name: dsh-prompt-polish
items.desc: Turns a one-line DSH draft into a complete task brief (role / goal / constraints / output format). The engine is a byte-verified port of linshenkx/prompt-optimizer (three modes, 10 templates identical to upstream); history is consent-gated with version chains and structural comparison; every run reports its token usage. Nothing is written back or sent without a click.

items.name: dsh-answer-reviewer
items.desc: Agentic answer reviewer for DeepSeek Harness: each final assistant turn is re-reviewed by a separate LLM graded 1-100; below-threshold scores steer the agent back with concrete feedback. The score is shown as a chip on the answer's action row (green pass / red needs-work, with retry count and reason on hover). Live gate config from the Reviewer 配置 tab in the conversation view ring above the composer (对话 / 轨迹 / 记忆系统 / Reviewer 配置), from a 127.0.0.1 HTTP server, or from an optional right-sidebar tab via dsh-better-sidebar.

items.name: dsh-quality-review
items.desc: Audit each finished assistant turn with an independent reviewer model and steer the agent to fix failed output, with at most 2 review rounds per turn and SOP-folder standards injected as an extra review dimension.

items.name: dsh-advisor-flow
items.desc: Executor/advisor workflow ported from pi-advisor-flow: the executor calls ask_advisor for a second opinion at key decisions, after repeated failures and before completion; equivalent repeated tool calls are intercepted before execution for an advisor review with a proceed/revise/blocked verdict, and hard mode force-reviews every turn before it closes. Per-call token and cost ledger with /advisor status readout, privacy tiers for repo context and file contents, six-shape secret redaction, and a web settings card; advisor failures never stall the main loop.

items.name: clearai-dsh
items.desc: An agent preset for evidence-checked research: every step advances only through system-verified observations, L3+ claims go to an independent evaluator, and the session folds into a replayable ledger that grows into a browsable domain ontology. Requires DSH >=0.1.7-alpha.1.

items.name: dsh-atn
items.desc: Adaptive topology multi-agent preset for DeepSeek Harness with peer messaging, task handoff and live network visualization.

items.name: dsh-outsourcing-expert
items.desc: Agent presets whose leader does no work itself: every non-management tool call is denied at the harness boundary so the task has to go to a subagent, after a one-time lookup of the available subagent models and a per-task model choice; a second preset deliberately picks the model least suited to the task.

items.name: deepseek-harness-game-studios
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness port of Claude Code Game Studios (CCGS v1.1.2, MIT): 76 skills, 49 agents, hook bridge.

items.name: dsh-cot-anchor
items.desc: Injects conclusions already established in the previous reasoning block after each tool result, so the model continues from them instead of re-deriving the same conclusions.

items.name: dsh-expert
items.desc: Expert roster for DeepSeek Harness: 636 experts across 22 divisions with full Chinese names and bios, summoned as subagents from the @ menu or by the model through list_t_experts / summon_t_expert / summon_t_experts, plus custom experts and a skill on/off switch.

items.name: dsh-proactive
items.desc: Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: the model schedules its own alarms (once, recurring interval, or cron, with optional random jitter), cold sessions are woken on time by session resume, model-initiated follow-ups are gated by quiet hours and a daily delivery budget, silent wake turns end with proactive_reclaim and fold out of model context as tombstones, declared schedule files glob-sync JSON schedules into host alarms idempotently, min_idle_seconds defers wakes until the destination session quiets down, and a web panel (settings section plus per-session tab, SSE live refresh) manages alarms and wake history — the heartbeat engine for AI companions and roleplay characters with their own daily routines and world evolution.

items.name: dsh-simulated-life
items.desc: Simulated life context for DeepSeek Harness: every turn injects the past 24h of simulated life events from the workspace .life/ directory (sliding-window filter, session-level deduplication with delta updates, world summary) as a collapsed context notice, and the life_react tool lets the agent record feelings, thoughts and actions back into its life log for the next round of world evolution — turning a DSH agent into a roleplay character with a persistent daily life.

items.name: dsh-gungnir#dsh-plugin
items.desc: Evidence-driven goal verification plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Locks goals via /ultragoal and verifies completion against command exit codes and generated artifacts, preventing the model from falsely reporting task completion.

items.name: dsh-heartbeat
items.desc: Heartbeat loop for DeepSeek Harness: every 20 minutes (by default) the agent wakes on its own to keep a local profile of your interests and preferences, search the web for things you care about, and keep what it finds. When it has something worth sharing, it sends a short package of notes to the sessions you link it to. A set of rules in code - quiet hours, busy windows, a daily limit, a cooldown - decides whether it may speak at all, and the agent in that session decides whether to actually say anything. Windows only.

items.name: dsh-engram
items.desc: Cross-session long-term memory under the "memory palace" metaphor: dual-scope SQLite stores (user + per-git-origin project), hybrid FTS5 + local-vector retrieval with RRF fusion and recency/proof ranking boost, automatic capture from the session log (including the final turn), provenance audit chains, consolidation distillation and decay forgetting, and a settings-page Memory Library panel with corridor topology, tour butler, and refurb list.

items.name: dsh-advisor-plugin
items.desc: Pairs the running executor with a stronger reviewer model through zero-parameter advisor() calls and step-based patrol checks, returning plan, correction, or stop guidance.

items.name: dsh-remote-control
items.desc: Let Agents directly control independent local DSH instances with zero intrusion—no plugins or components required on the target. Isolated environments enable autonomous configuration and testing, while Agents with different models and personalities can chat, role-play, or form nested control chains. Supports conversational setup, user-like operations, incremental reading, saved references, and remote session/workspace search.

items.name: dsh-pua
items.desc: Adds /pua to steer the agent to try another approach and verify results before claiming completion, with 15 company styles, persona modes, global and per-conversation settings, and an optional loop that continues until a verification command passes, the iteration limit is reached, or the user cancels.

items.name: dsh-switchman
items.desc: Turns the main model into a dispatcher: six pools (economy/mechanical/main/hard/vision/review) route each subtask to the right model, with ranking and per-route reasoning-effort pins. A context watermark (50k/90k/130k) nudges delegation early and, at the force level, forks a backup session, writes a handover doc, compacts, and continues without losing in-flight subagent work; /ctx-pause, /ctx-resume and /ctx-handover pause, resume or trigger the same machinery by hand. Optional Agent Teams mode adds persistent teammates and a shared task board; /vision lets text-only models handle images via the vision pool; tiered verification sends bigger diffs to a tester and an independent reviewer. Settings UI, READMEs and the conversation / code-comment / document language preferences all cover the same 11 languages (en, zh, zh-TW, ja, ko, de, es, fr, it, pt, ru); the plugin UI follows the DSH app locale unless forced otherwise. Bundles three skills: read-only MySQL/Redis verification, commit-message generation, and a requirements/design document convention.

items.name: muche-dsh-plugin
items.desc: Chat panel for the MuChe companion with per-user backend settings, plus an outbound bridge that runs tasks on the user's local dsh.

items.name: dsh-pua
items.desc: Fork of @michengai/dsh-pua that removes the upstream global kill-switch so the composer entry is always visible while the feature stays off by default and can be toggled per session; the entry is a dropdown (Turn on / Turn off / Options) with a more compact options panel.

items.name: dsh-host-rsi
items.desc: Reflective self-evolution plugin for local Qwen3.8 27B/3.8 Flash and online APIs: a coding-loop convergence steerer curbs Qwen3.8 27B/Flash repeated-verification deep-thinking to converge faster and cut thinking time; a five-state delivery guard detects and corrects stuck turns and infinite loops; model-agnostic host logic, mostly compatible with online APIs; per-use continual self-improvement with counter-reason self-checks, critic escalation, inverted-index memory retrieval, coding-loop convergence steering, and a five-state delivery guard.

items.name: orbital-agents
items.desc: Persistent Endeavour and Challenger peer sessions for DeepSeek Harness that plan, execute sequential tasks, and verify reported results.

items.name: dsh-goalloop-agentteams
items.desc: Deterministic goal-completion gate for DSH: a contract-first AC grammar with named failable check commands, a gate that re-runs every check itself (zero model trust), verdicts bound to a tree digest so file changes void passing verdicts, and a hard deny on false completion at update_goal via tools/pre-execute with a false-complete counter that blocks after two catches; scope-aware task-level claim handling (strict or goal-only) keeps multi-task Agent Teams loops from deadlocking.

items.name: dsh-network-engineer
items.desc: Standalone Network Engineer Assistant agent preset plus a bundled 32-doc command knowledge base skill for DPtech, H3C, Huawei and Ruijie switches and routers: KB-first retrieval, cross-vendor command translation, topology and CLI-output screenshot reading, online manual lookup with cited sources, and mandatory risk annotations for dangerous commands; answers networking topics only.

items.name: dsh-dream
items.desc: Experience memory and reflection for DSH agents: automatically extracts candidate lessons after tasks and recalls user-reviewed lessons in relevant later tasks. Supports source provenance, project-scoped retrieval, conflict handling, usage feedback and expiry review; capture and recall have separate controls, and writing lessons to AGENTS.md requires preview and explicit application. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.

items.name: dsh-linghun
items.desc: A judgment core for DeepSeek Harness: a cognition loop that gives every decision a source and attribution and drives planning to a close, hippocampus memory that condenses running experience into knowledge (journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay), judgment identity responsibilities in the architecture (consistent rubric, judgment bound to its source), and an A2A memory-management team via dsh-linghun-assembler. Requires DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7 (rc.2 supported).

items.name: dsh-linghun-assembler
items.desc: Memory-assembly team for DeepSeek Harness: every message triggers a five-step cognition loop (judge, retrieve, assemble, feedback, calibrate) carried by role-playing subagents (judge, retriever, archivist, advocate, editor, scribe), using BM25 retrieval, time-ordered material, and LLM assembly to build useful material packs injected into linghun. Works with dsh-linghun.

items.name: portable-dsh-multi-agent-plugin
items.desc: Route each task to one model and its review to a different one, with qualification evidence, failover and a durable journal.

items.name: dsh-codex-peer
items.desc: Peer collaboration between a DeepSeek Harness agent and the local Codex CLI: split a goal into a shared work list, hand tasks over, review what comes back, and keep every prompt, event stream, and answer on disk.

items.name: dsh-loop-continue
items.desc: Resumes an agent turn that ended after narrating its next action without calling a tool: the guard replays the turn log on agent/turn-stopping, asks a judge model one true/false question, and steers the same turn to run one more step.

items.name: dsh-plugin#dsh-claude-code-web
items.desc: Embeds Claude Code as a workbench in DSH, serving an in-host HTTP/WebSocket backend with a sidebar entry and a draggable overlay panel.

items.name: dsh-workspace-menu
items.desc: Workspace/chat context menu for the DSH home page: pin, rename, open in file explorer, archive, fork, copy, and open in a new window.

items.name: dsh-forge-studio#plugin-notes
items.desc: Sticky-notes board for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar entry opens a Markdown note panel with auto-save, colors, image paste and task-list rendering.

items.name: dsh-about
items.desc: Adds an "About" settings page to the DeepSeek Harness web interface, showing the running DSH version and recent release notes.

items.name: dsh-prompt-polish
items.desc: Input-bar prompt optimizer: rewrites drafts with 6 strategies × 3 languages plus custom instructions, optional goal/todo/compaction-summary/tool-result and chat context, a confirm dialog, last-5 history and three-tier settings persistence.

items.name: agent-body#dsh-anatomy-panel
items.desc: Anatomy panel for the Agent-Body organs: serves a live vitals dashboard at /anatomy inside the harness itself - organs, heartbeat, healing ledger, self-training counters and the real pulse stream - read straight from the runtime files rather than retyped. Host-only, no client bundle and no build step.

items.name: dsh-text-inject
items.desc: Adds a "Text Injection" section to the DSH Settings sidebar: user-maintained blocks in a standalone Markdown file are injected into the system prompt every turn or into session context with keyword gating, with hot reload and automatic history backups.

items.name: dsh-plugin-crypto-ticker
items.desc: A live crypto ticker card in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar footer, above the balance and Settings, showing BTC, ETH, SOL and JUP prices, 24-hour change and 24-point sparklines, with a pulse on each price tick, zero dependencies and no API key.

items.name: dsh-harness-chat-control
items.desc: Adds ChatGPT-style stop, edit-and-resend, native quote annotations, and an independent sidebar follow-up chat with model and image input for DeepSeek Harness Desktop.

items.name: dsh-session-diff
items.desc: Session-scoped diff view for the DSH Web right sidebar: opening a file the current conversation changed renders it in place with git-style added/removed line backgrounds, +/− gutter markers and dual old/new line numbers under syntax colouring, a header with +added −removed counts, a Changes only / Whole file toggle and a Re-read button, plus a companion tab that lists every file the session changed and opens each one in the same view. Files the conversation did not touch keep the shipped text viewer.

items.name: dsh-draft-attachments
