items.desc: Adds a composer button that optimizes the current prompt or designs the next one from the current session and project context.

items.name: deepseekharness-mcp-manager
items.desc: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: add, edit, enable/disable, restart and delete MCP servers from Settings → MCP 管理, with JSON export/import, four mcp_manager_* model tools and an HTTP API; install via npx, npm or cross-platform scripts.

items.name: dsh-conversation-map
items.desc: A live conversation map for DeepSeek Harness web: real-time session tree with subagent lineage, running state, and one-click navigation.

items.name: dsh-prompt-optimizer
items.desc: Adds an optimize button beside the composer that analyzes and rewrites the prompt draft with SSE streaming, conversation-context awareness (template vs intent-polish strategies), an edit-continuity memory chain, undo, and model routing with fallback and a connectivity test.

items.name: dsh-knj-menu
items.desc: Third-party menu manager for the DSH Web UI: collects new menu entries added by other plugins into one place, with fold/collapse and pinned menu items.

items.name: dsh-knj-prompts
items.desc: Prompt scene picker for DSH: choose a scene from a dropdown and it opens a new session with the prompt already filled in (with {variable} placeholders), so you only tweak and send.

items.name: dsh-erii-boot-splash
items.desc: Erii (Sakura) themed boot splash animation — falling sakura petals, a mint monster mascot with a blossom on its head, and a soft pink progress bar; fades out after ~3 seconds without blocking input.

items.name: dsh-plugin-chat-zoom
items.desc: Zoom only DSH chat messages and input (80%–200%) using Ctrl shortcuts or settings, with local memory and no sidebar scaling.

items.name: dsh-editor
items.desc: VS Code-style code editor: sidebar file tree over the workspace, Monaco editing, file read/write, Git status and diff, search, and Markdown preview.

items.name: dsh-550c-boot
items.desc: Full-screen 550C boot intro for DSH: a 4-second simple cut and a 16-second rewrite sequence, skippable by click or Esc, with four phosphor palettes. The host half injects the opening frame while the document is still parsing, so the built-in loading card never shows; the desktop caption strip turns transparent, so those window buttons float on the animation.

items.name: dsh-about
items.desc: About section for the DeepSeek Harness settings: version info, npm latest/next update check with one-click install and auto-restart, and GitHub release history.

items.name: dsh-prompt-enhancer
items.desc: Prompt enhancement for the composer: an "✨ Enhance" button rewrites your draft prompt into a clearer, more structured version with first-principles thinking, grounded in session context, memory and recent conversation; asks clarifying questions in a card when key info is missing, then previews the result before applying it to the input.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-focus-composer
items.desc: Returns the caret to the session composer on Ctrl+I; the key is rebindable in Settings and works from any region of the desktop window.

items.name: coderdd#dsh-rdd-goal-tree
items.desc: Read-only goal-tree status strip above the composer: planners see the full node tree, workers see their claimed node, and worker reports call back to the planner session.

items.name: dsh-agent-grid
items.desc: Replaces the DSH sidebar with a fixed 2×4 board of eight standing agent seats; each seat shows its own status, latest tool call, reasoning and result, and a settings switch restores the stock sidebar at any time.

items.name: dsh-split-screen
items.desc: Split-screen workspace for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI - chat with several agents side by side in panes that look and behave exactly like the stock conversation: drag-to-split, live sessions with queued messages and in-pane ask_user/approval cards, per-pane view tabs (Chat/Trajectory/plugin views), a compact TUI composer mode (Alt+T) and pane-focus shortcuts. Requires DSH 0.1.5+.

items.name: dsh-full-view
items.desc: Keeps the current chat in a movable, resizable floating window when the right file or browser panel enters full view, with a compact input bar, a whale restore button and a return to the original split layout.

items.name: dsh-recent-sessions
items.desc: Opens the recent sessions in a sheet that floats over the sidebar workspace list, from one row above Settings: rows sorted by last activity with their run state, a draggable height, and a list that settles onto whole rows after stopping. The sheet paints no surface of its own, so it reads as part of the sidebar.

items.name: dsh-selection-explain
items.desc: Select text in the DSH web UI to stream a translation and an explanation of what it means in that specific context, read against the conversation it came from; the panel keeps a replayable history and can be promoted into a full session.

items.name: dsh-think-flow
items.desc: Chain-of-thought panel for the DSH Web right sidebar: folds the live reasoning stream of each session into turn → step groups carrying the reasoning text and the tool calls made in that step. Only the newest turn is expanded by default and earlier turns collapse to one line; steps are grouped into activity phases by a local rule, the step waiting on a tool is marked, tool failures show their reason, full reasoning text is fetched per step on demand, an all-turn directory searches turn titles, user text and turn numbers locally, and a whole turn can be summarised into a Chinese title with one model call.

items.name: dsh-prompt-market
items.desc: Prompt market beside the composer: browse and search three built-in online prompt sources, bookmark or write your own, and insert into the input box.

items.name: dsh-claude-slider
items.desc: Replaces the reasoning-effort dropdown with a draggable snapping slider, and draws 13 canvas effects across five style families (thrust, fluid, fantasy, tech, texture) with three tiers that unlock as the effort level rises. Custom mode combines 10 particle forms with 8 flow trajectories; 9 accent presets and a hex picker recolor every effect, and optional key sounds cover two voice clips, a synthesized duck squeak, a mechanical click and a local audio file.

items.name: deepseek-harness-plugins#file-change-viewer
items.desc: Takes over the edit/write rows in the chat stream with the official native row shell and collapse behavior; expanding shows per-file code cards with file-type icon, add/delete stats, per-block collapse, highlight/plus-minus toggle, syntax-highlighted unified diff with real file line numbers, and a configurable context margin. Also ships a patch tool (beta, off by default) that applies multi-spot multi-file patches atomically via the *** Begin Patch envelope.

items.name: dsh-workspace-studio
items.desc: Three-pane workspace layout with file-tree browsing, file editing, a non-linear conversation mindmap view, and mobile mode support.

items.name: dsh-math-copy
items.desc: Copying rendered math from the chat puts the formula's LaTeX source on the clipboard instead of KaTeX's visual glyph text.

items.name: dsh-select-ask
items.desc: Select text in the chat to quote it into the composer as an annotation, or to ask about it in a throwaway side panel that leaves no record.

items.name: dsh-pins-fixtool
items.desc: Pins passages selected in a conversation into a per-conversation right-sidebar panel, marks them in the transcript, jumps back to the source passage on click, and quotes a pinned passage into the composer from the selection toolbar or by typing @; the panel tags, searches, filters and exports the pins as a Markdown outline.

items.name: dsh-thinking-highlight
items.desc: Counts keywords inside thinking rows and highlights them once a row is expanded, with a count chip per keyword on the title line that doubles as an on/off switch for that word, per-keyword tint, text colour and text size (10-22px, the same range the host body-text setting uses), typeface, bold / italic / underline and whole-word matching, plus a dedicated settings section.

items.name: dsh-pomodoro
items.desc: Classic 25/5/15 pomodoro timer for DSH that ties each run to the current session task or a manual project name, with a stats panel, a 365-day heatmap, a draggable floating timer and a corner pill, local JSON storage, and CSV export.

items.name: dsh-artifact-center
items.desc: Artifact center: search, preview and open files produced by DSH conversations.

items.name: dsh-read-image-view
items.desc: Display read_image results in DSH Web and Desktop: complete previews, grouped multi-image galleries, transparency checkerboards, keyboard and touch zoom, and session-authorized loading. Verified with DSH Desktop 0.11.1 / Harness 0.2.0-rc.2.

items.name: dsh-free-models-hub
items.desc: A drawer panel for the DSH web UI with a paginated list of free LLMs; one-click or batch writes each as a custom model provider into Settings, plus a local multi-key rotation proxy.

items.name: dsh-decision-split
items.desc: Decision split view for DSH web UI: a decision summary card in the main window plus the full plan in an independently scrollable side panel, so you can review the whole plan while writing decisions and send them back to the agent with one click.

items.name: deepseek-media-gallery
items.desc: Sidebar button that opens a semi-transparent popup for browsing, previewing, downloading and deleting generated images and videos, with a settings page for the media, record and download directories.

items.name: dsh-rail-equalizer
items.desc: System-audio visualizer for the turn navigator rail: the rail reacts in real time to whatever the default playback device is rendering, with four motion modes (spectrum, pulse, sway, travelling wave), a 16-band logarithmic spectrum from a 2048-point FFT on the host, and live sensitivity, strength, bass-punch and wave-speed controls. Audio is captured host-side through WASAPI loopback, so there is no permission prompt, no microphone and no screen capture. The browser half adds one attribute, one stylesheet, some CSS variables and a sidebar control row, and never patches the official component; switching it off removes the attribute, the stylesheet and the variables, returning the rail to its default styling. Windows only.

items.name: dsh-mobile-ui
items.desc: Phone-first drawer shell for DSH Web. Collapses the session list into a tap-to-open drawer, keeps header plugin actions, and turns Settings into a full-width sheet.

items.name: dsh-prompt-polisher
items.desc: Composer prompt polisher: a button in the input tool row rewrites the current draft through the session model (workflow engine, enabled automatically) or an OpenAI-compatible standalone API with host-side key storage, backfills the rewritten text with a replace/give-up dialog when the draft changed mid-run, and ships concise/structured style presets, custom templates with a {draft} placeholder, one-click restore from the status dock and reference-chip protection.

items.name: dsh-chat-thinking-editor
items.desc: Adds an edit action to finalized assistant replies in DeepSeek Harness, letting you rewrite the reply text or reasoning chain; the edit is saved as a surface replacement.

items.name: dsh-reveal-files
items.desc: Turns each produced-file chip into a per-file menu: open the file, copy its path, reveal it in the native file browser, or open a terminal cd-ed into its directory.

items.name: dsh-window-control
items.desc: Tired of going fullscreen by hand every time you open Harness? This plugin fills the screen for you - auto-maximize (keeps the window buttons) or true fullscreen on launch, then maximize / restore / minimize / always-on-top anytime. It quits only after a native confirmation dialog - Esc, double Esc, or Ctrl+Q; in fullscreen, Esc leaves fullscreen first. The window channel installs itself, so no script or Python is needed; the first install takes effect after two DSH restarts.

items.name: dsh-wide-conversation
items.desc: Sets the DSH web client conversation column to a percentage of its own width (40-100, default 100 = full width) instead of the built-in 680-920px reading measure, edited from a collapsible card under Settings > Plugins.

items.name: dsh-sidepanel
items.desc: A Codex-style right side panel for the DSH Web UI — session artifacts browser (live file tree, scan include, preview, reveal) plus a side chat that forks the current session with a model picker, human-pacing scheduled runs and smart send-to-bottom scrolling.

items.name: dsh-soul
items.desc: SoulFusion-style personalization: 9 response styles, custom instructions, persona cards, per-session switching, long-term memory with audit trails.

items.name: dsh-t3-model-picker
items.desc: A port of the T3 Code model picker into the composer: a provider rail, search results grouped under provider headings, favorites kept in the browser, unavailable-provider badges, and Cmd/Ctrl+1..9 jump shortcuts for the first nine rows of the visible list.

items.name: dsh-t3-new-session-screen
items.desc: A T3 Code-style New Session screen for the composer: a "What should we build in <project>?" headline whose project name opens a workspace menu, a reasoning-effort picker in the composer tool row, and a git branch strip under the card that searches local and remote refs and switches with git checkout.

items.name: dsh-t3-session-ui
items.desc: Session-context surfaces ported from T3 Code: a session-row hover card showing machine, git branch, model, agent preset, approval policy and token usage, a status pill covering pending approval, awaiting input, working, error and subagent work, a provider and model chip, a per-session header strip, a lineage breadcrumb, row-menu actions that copy the context or run DSH compaction, and a preference row in DSH Settings for choosing which facts appear. Nothing is added to the composer.

items.name: dsh-custom-style
items.desc: Adds a Custom CSS section to Settings for adjusting dialog dimensions, font sizes, full-window wallpapers, and inspecting stable selectors.

items.name: dsh-assistant-bubble
items.desc: Adds a configurable bubble behind assistant replies, with an optional liquid-glass material and matching chrome for process, tool-call and reasoning rows.

items.name: dsh-plan-build-mode
items.desc: Plan / Build mode switcher for DeepSeek Harness: an always-visible dropdown in the composer beside the permission control that switches the current session both ways through the shipped /plan and /plan off commands, plus a Default mode row in Settings → General that decides the starting mode for newly created sessions.

items.name: dsh-preset-workshop
items.desc: Preset workbench for editing per-agent personas, system prompt sections and tool descriptions, selecting tools and skills, previewing request context, and importing or exporting JSON/YAML configurations.

items.name: dsh-side-chat
items.desc: Codex-style /side side conversations for DeepSeek Harness: a temporary fork of the current chat in a floating panel, inheriting context without interrupting the main task.

items.name: dsh-any-attachment
items.desc: Lets the DSH web UI attach files of any type as pathless @-mentions: pick a workspace file from the @ menu or drop one into the composer, and the agent reads it directly.

items.name: dsh-drop-any-file
items.desc: Extends the DSH web chat drag-and-drop to accept every file type: non-image files are saved into the active session workspace so the agent can read and use them.

items.name: dsh-mcp-toggle
items.desc: Enables or disables MCP servers from Settings → MCP Servers: stops or starts each @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client connection immediately and persists the change across restarts.

items.name: dsh-inline-comments
items.desc: Annotate on selection, persist through refresh; send the notes with your message and the model answers each one.

items.name: dsh-deepseek-chat
items.desc: Web chat entry for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar button opening chat.deepseek.com in a dedicated desktop window under dsh-desktop, with in-webview fallback for plain web environments.

items.name: dsh-desktop-shell
items.desc: A dsh web plugin that wraps the running Harness in a native Windows desktop window: it bundles a Wails v3 desktop client (so installing the plugin is enough), probes the web port and writes the ~/.dsh/dsh-web-port.json protocol file for the client, registers a system tray, desktop/Start Menu shortcuts and a startup autostart toggle, and the client can start dsh itself if it is not running.

items.name: dsh-composer-live
items.desc: Live Markdown rendering and typing enhancements for the DSH web composer - syntax-highlighted code blocks, list/quote continuation, format toolbars.

items.name: dsh-video-bg
items.desc: Play a local video behind the DeepSeek Harness chat UI, with play/pause, opacity, scrim and fit controls.

items.name: dsh-snippets
items.desc: Manages CSS and JS snippets for the DSH web GUI, injecting enabled CSS as style elements and running enabled JS in the page, with a sidebar-footer quick toggle, its own page in the Settings navigation, and optional folder or Gist sync.

items.name: dsh-coros-badge
items.desc: Shows the linked COROS watch model and cumulative activity days in the Web UI, expanding to a one-line review and suggestion when clicked.

items.name: dsh-pricing-badge
items.desc: Shows the DeepSeek API peak and off-peak hours, the current model's output price and the account balance in the Web UI.

items.name: ai-plugin#dsh-plugin
items.desc: Aipx toolkit: skills plus a Hub Console that fronts every MCP server with ~4 meta tools — server pool health, per-tool enable/disable, a tool catalog, and a search playground showing exactly what mcp_search hands the model.

items.name: dsh-diagram
items.desc: Renders mermaid code blocks in the chat as diagrams in place (flowchart, sequence, class, state, ER, gantt, pie), with zoom, source toggle, copy PNG and SVG download.

items.name: dsh-quote-annotate-pro
items.desc: Adds selection quoting and anchored annotations to DSH conversations: selected text enters the composer as an anchored quote reference, a quote bar jumps back to the source message and highlights it, and the sent quote block names the turn and role it came from.

items.name: dsh-a2ui-studio
items.desc: A2UI-inspired agent-authored application cards with a persistent machine directory, SSH probes, and reviewed monitoring and control actions. SSH probes require OpenSSH (ssh, ssh-keyscan, ssh-keygen).

items.name: dsh-prompt-forge
items.desc: Prompt optimizer for the composer: a button in the tool row rewrites your draft through a model channel you already configured, streaming into a panel that floats above the composer without taking up layout. Your draft changes only when you click Accept — and Accept is refused while the answer is still streaming, so a half-finished reply can never be written back. It asks first when the draft carries @ references or attachments, which a whole-draft replace would flatten into plain text. No global keyboard shortcuts, and no API key ever reaches the browser: the host half makes the call.

items.name: dsh-rollback
items.desc: TRAE-style conversation rollback rebuilt for DSH 0.1.7-rc.2: per-turn file checkpoints restore touched files and truncate the model context in place under the same session id. Adds a /rollback doctor framework-contract self-check, an affected-file diff preview computed against the current on-disk state so it stays correct after a restart, a one-click undo-last action with a Ctrl+Shift+Z shortcut, a setting for whether rolled-back messages stay hidden, and English UI text.

items.name: dsh-chat-typography
items.desc: Set the DSH Harness conversation flow's font, font size and line spacing, plus the padding between the conversation text and the window edges.

items.name: dsh-hover-archive
items.desc: Codex-style session archiving: hovering a sidebar conversation row reveals an Archive icon at the far right; one click archives the session via the official workspace archive API.

items.name: dsh-image-annotate
items.desc: Draws circles, arrows, boxes and text on the DSH image preview, keeps every mark selectable so it can be dragged, scaled or re-edited later, and attaches the flattened PNG to the composer at the original image resolution.

items.name: dsh-whale-tray
items.desc: Whale tray launcher for DeepSeek Harness: a Windows system-tray app and a macOS menu-bar app that start/stop the dsh service, summon the Web UI, restart and top up — running independently of the dsh process, like a Steam launcher for dsh.

items.name: dsh-web#packages/dsh-task-board
items.desc: Task board for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar multi-column kanban whose cards run in real DSH agent sessions and can also be scheduled with cron expressions, executed host-side even with the browser closed.

items.name: dsh-web#packages/dsh-web-all
items.desc: Plugin and skin collection for the DSH Web UI: task board, Git graph, right-side panel, remote mobile UI, pet, live token stats, and a skin center.

items.name: dsh-gpu-pulse
items.desc: Floating GPU monitor for the DSH Web UI: a compact, draggable strip with one row per discrete GPU (exact name, utilization, VRAM, temperature, power draw) from nvidia-smi, stays visible over side panels and side cards, with a top-VRAM-process list when the driver reports it; degrades to an n/a pill on machines without an NVIDIA driver.

items.name: dsh-adaptive-reasoning
items.desc: Pixel-art reasoning-effort slider for DSH Web with continuous 0–100 dragging, 16ms throttled writes, snap-to-level commits, and a WebGL ember fire that ignites as the slider moves.

items.name: dsh-feedback-combined
items.desc: One-click thumbs up/down feedback UI that injects rating summaries into model context.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-annotations
items.desc: Browser and mini-program element annotations with collapsible composer notes and source locations.

items.name: dsh-prompt-seed
items.desc: Rewrites drafts with one model call or predicts the next reply when empty; independent tasks, safe draft replacement, result previews, and original-text recovery.

items.name: dsh-settings-drawer
items.desc: Lets you choose which items appear in the DeepSeek Harness settings left nav.

items.name: toolfolk-for-dsh
items.desc: Visualize the plugin and model call flow as a 3D office with six fixed workstations, thought bubbles and a delivery sheet.

items.name: dsh-composer-keys
items.desc: Composer key remap for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: bind Enter, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, Shift+Enter or any custom chord to the Send, Newline or Interrupt actions, with cross-action migration, durable persistence and native behavior preserved by default.

items.name: dsh-agent-bridge
items.desc: Adds a Web composer switch between the native DSH agent and Grok Build, proxying Grok Build sessions and slash commands through ACP.

items.name: dsh-paperclip
items.desc: DSH Web GUI paperclip button: a 📎 button in the composer opens a file picker (drag & drop supported) and inserts file contents into the textarea.

items.name: dsh-sticky-notes
items.desc: Quick sticky notes with colored labels, pin, timed reminders, and password protection for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-startup-intro
items.desc: Startup video intro with per-clip playback parameters (segment, speed, brightness, fit, blurred cinema fill, hold ratio and fade duration) and light/dark clip variants selected by the app theme.

items.name: dsh-effort-slider-split-seat
items.desc: Fork of dsh-effort-slider that splits the composer model seat into two buttons: the model name opens the model list, the effort label opens the Claude-style slider with WebGL fire.

items.name: dsh-draft-fold
items.desc: Folds long composer drafts into a compact summary card once a character threshold is reached, without changing message submission.

items.name: dsh-model-picker
items.desc: Replaces the chat input model picker with a provider-grouped, collapsible list: groups models by provider, folds vision-bridge mirror providers back into their upstream, and carries the reasoning-effort options each model declares in settings. Tested on DSH Desktop only; the DSH web build is untested.

items.name: dsh-task-details
items.desc: Task details sidebar for DeepSeek Harness: a "View task details" button under every finished turn opens a resizable right-sidebar panel showing that task's input files, intermediate artifacts, output files, tools and skills used, inferred languages, a step-by-step flow timeline, and the model provider with token usage and cache hit rate.

items.name: dsh-selection-followup
items.desc: Select any text in a DSH chat reply to get a floating Follow-up/Copy pill: one click quotes the selection into the composer so you can type your own follow-up question, or copies it.

items.name: dsh-prompt-enhance
items.desc: Adds a sparkle button left of the model selector in the composer: it rewrites the draft into a clearer, more complete task brief, replaces it in place with one-click undo, offers five rewrite styles, and greys out while the draft carries file/command chips.

items.name: ybkkasi
items.desc: Asset governance console for self-hosted AI infrastructure. Registers MCP servers, skills, agents and AI apps in one ledger with a lifecycle state machine, per-tool RBAC permission points, department x agent x skill cost attribution, dependency topology and an append-only audit trail. Ships 27 plugin packages, 354 REST routes and 83 MCP tools; selftest runs 1486 end-to-end assertions. Not a hosted service, no cloud contract.

items.name: dsh-forge-studio#plugin-usage-billing
items.desc: Usage and cost view for DeepSeek Harness: aggregates real token usage from existing session logs, locks each cost at the price of its event time, and shows month and today spend against a budget from a sidebar card or an input-bar pill.

items.name: dsh-plugin-quota
items.desc: Live usage gauge injected into the system prompt every turn: session tokens and estimated spend, a next-turn estimate, and two predictions the model can act on — which step fills the context window and which step burns the budget. /qm panels, zero-config by default, optional price table, and it publishes a summary.json budget contract sibling plugins read.

items.name: dsh-api-dashboard
items.desc: Multi-platform API balance and usage dashboard for the DSH web GUI: balances for DeepSeek, Zhipu GLM, Kimi, StepFun, SiliconFlow, MiniMax, OpenRouter, Novita and xAI under the composer, estimated per-session and per-subagent cost with DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing, automatic discovery of relays configured in DSH settings, and an optional draggable whale widget.

items.name: dsh-team-cost
items.desc: Team cost captain: meters every model call (subagents included), attributes each call to a member by workspace rules, prices it with the built-in DeepSeek 2026-09 catalog (peak/off-peak, CNY/USD) or user overrides, and appends it to a local JSONL ledger. Adds hot-reloadable member budgets, 80%/100% webhook alerts, optional over-budget enforcement, a team_cost_report tool with CSV export, and a settings-page team dashboard served over a Typert RPC service.

items.name: dsh-tokenrhythm-bill
items.desc: Tokenrhythm (基元律动) finance dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: account balance & expiring credits, category-filtered model price cards (with discounted prices), service status and platform key management; login via platform account or session cookie — credentials stay on the local host.

items.name: agent-clinic
items.desc: Read-only clinic for DSH session logs: 22 named diagnostics (token waste, retry and failure loops, context bloat, cross-session amnesia, idle MCP servers and skills), each reported with a replayable evidence locator such as session.v4.jsonl.zstd#L101-L110, and each finding turned into an executable prescription — a profile-patch YAML snippet or a command with current to suggested values, risk, verification and source — plus a feedback command that retires a prescription you reject, after which the report states it was removed by your feedback. Zero dependencies, default zero egress, session files are never written.

items.name: dsh-cache-bricks
items.desc: Visualizes prompt-cache hit rates and model request activity in DSH Web, with request details, comparison, and conversation navigation.

items.name: dsh-usage-analytics
items.desc: Local-first personal usage insights in Settings, with 1/7/30-day token heatmaps and a 30-day calendar, token composition, model mix, and skill-call status.

items.name: dsh-commandcode-usage-inline
items.desc: Inline Command Code plan usage badge in the DSH composer toolbar beside the model selector: 5h and weekly window usage plus remaining credits, clicking the badge opens an upward detail popover with reset countdowns; reuses the commandcode/report remote from @mars-sea/dsh-commandcode-provider.

items.name: dsh-peak-runner
items.desc: A price-aware task runner for DeepSeek: during an off-peak pricing window a batch of prompts goes straight to deepseek-flash; near peak it queues the batch behind a self-held timer and runs it at the start of the next off-peak window. Exposes `peak_run`, `peak_schedule` and `peak_cancel`, with configurable peak windows and a lead time.

items.name: dsh-session-stats-panel
items.desc: A right-side session stats panel showing average cache-hit rate, session cost, runtime, request count, cumulative tokens and account balance.

items.name: dsh-balance-tracker
items.desc: Real DeepSeek account balance and official spend tracker in the session header, with peak/off-peak badge, monetary alert with auto-stop, and one-click top-up.

items.name: llmdshplugin_token-usage
items.desc: Local-only, read-only DSH token dashboard: provider-reported usage across all backends, all-time totals, a 365-day heatmap, input+output and cache read/write details, turn/step counts, average tok/s, and durable history after sessions are archived.

items.name: dsh-balance-chip
items.desc: Live DeepSeek API balance in the sidebar footer plus an always-visible bottom-right pill: status dot and amount, refreshed every 60 seconds, the API key is read from the local credential store and never embedded.

items.name: dsh-llm-balance-siderbar
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness plugin for querying LLM service provider usage: reads DeepSeek and Moonshot balances plus Kimi For Coding and OpenCode Go quota windows on the host and shows them in an always-visible card with three view modes, edge docking and a collapsed letter bubble.

items.name: zcode-usage-stats
items.desc: Token usage statistics panel for DeepSeek Harness: usage trends, model breakdown and activity heatmap, hand-written SVG, zero chart libraries.

items.name: dsh-balance
items.desc: Provider-aware account balance chip for the DSH sidebar, showing the active model provider balance for DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Moonshot/Kimi, Zhipu/GLM, and MiniMax, plus DeepSeek peak/off-peak status.

items.name: dsh-plugin-balance
items.desc: A floating credit/quota widget for the DeepSeek Harness Web: shows DeepSeek / OpenCode Go balances and usage, and tracks DSH session token usage and estimated cost by day, month, and model.

items.name: dsh-minimax-usage-pro
items.desc: Shows MiniMax Token Plan usage in the Settings page through webServer routes and reads either subscription key name from environment or credentials file.

items.name: dsh-cost-tracker
items.desc: Tracks DeepSeek Harness LLM token usage and cost (CNY, peak/off-peak pricing) with a settings dashboard, agent tools, HTTP API and persistent storage.

items.name: dsh-token-stat
items.desc: Cumulative token usage tracking for DeepSeek Harness, with per-model and per-day breakdowns, a settings-page dashboard and an online-changeable data directory.

items.name: dsh-cap-profile
items.desc: Per-model capability profiling for DSH: turns local session history into per-model dashboards of session counts, tool usage, error rates, and top error signatures, with time-range filters and multi-model comparison.

items.name: dsh-cost
items.desc: Account balance and cost statistics pill for DeepSeek Harness. It adds a pill at the right-hand end of the official stats row below the session composer, combining the billing period (peak/off-peak, colour-coded), the account balance and the current session cost; clicking it expands a per-session breakdown with cache-hit input, cache-miss input and output amounts, plus cost per model. The rate table is refreshed with plugin releases to follow official pricing.

items.name: dsh-opencodego-status
items.desc: Floating overlay in the Harness Web UI with OpenCode Go usage: 5-hour rolling, weekly and monthly percentages, reset countdowns and the renewal date, with device-code sign-in and silent token refresh.

items.name: dsh-opencode-go-usage
items.desc: OpenCode GO quota widget pinned to the sidebar, with rolling/weekly/monthly usage bars, an elapsed-versus-remaining time bar under each, a same-origin usage proxy, an /opencode-go command, and the runtime x-opencode-session fix for GO gateway chat requests. Fork of yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage.

items.name: dsh-zhipu-plan
items.desc: Zhipu coding-plan sign-in, quota, usage and reset panel for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-connectors#balance-widget
items.desc: Session-header balance readout for DeepSeek Harness: shows the spendable account total (recharge and bonus wallets combined) in the conversation header, refreshed every two minutes, and renders nothing when the account is signed out or the query fails.

items.name: dsh-ocgo-usage
items.desc: Shows OpenCode Go quota usage in the web sidebar's bottom-left corner — rolling/weekly/monthly progress with a hover card, plus a Beijing-time DeepSeek peak-hour timeline.

items.name: my-dsh-plugins#dsh-my-context
items.desc: Context lens: visualizes token usage of every request (context composition, KV cache hit rate) and enforces per-turn / per-session budgets with warning and blocking (npm: `dsh-my-context`).

items.name: dsh-plugin-usage
items.desc: A usage and reference-cost panel for DeepSeek Harness with today, 7-day, 30-day, all-time and custom ranges aggregated by hour or day; a model filter and a per-model breakdown of requests, input and output tokens, cache, reference cost and share; a model-share card showing the top four models by total tokens with the rest grouped as others; a configurable per-million-token price table seeded with DeepSeek's prices, with reference cost switchable between ¥ and $ at a fixed 1 USD = 7 CNY; and a yearly heatmap drawn only with theme variables, with no third-party chart library.

items.name: dsh-cache-billing
items.desc: Per-call cache billing inside the context-meter popover: current step, round and session totals with hit/miss/output tokens and amounts, automatic Beijing working-hour peak/off-peak pricing, per-model rates, and third-party relays billed too.

items.name: dsh-live-token-stats
items.desc: Live token stats under the DSH Web composer: streamed tokens/s, output token and first-byte latency, plus per-step estimate-vs-actual reconciliation using the official BPE tokenizer, to tell a slow stream from a stalled one.

items.name: dsh-peak-block
items.desc: During Beijing working-day peak hours (default 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00) it blocks official DeepSeek requests or reroutes them to a configured target provider; off-peak traffic flows to official as usual.

items.name: dsh-balance-tasks
items.desc: Floating card showing DeepSeek balance, peak/off-peak tier countdown, and remaining tasks estimated from historical per-task token usage and the current context.

items.name: dsh-cache-hit-monitor
items.desc: Live prompt-cache telemetry for the current session in the DSH right sidebar, drawn as a register bank and a reactor-core history board.

items.name: dsh-token-ledger-pro
items.desc: Cost panel for DeepSeek Harness: meters every request from session events, prices it against a built-in catalog of 136 models across 16 providers, and shows the current model, account balance, session, today and month spend plus a monthly budget bar next to the composer. Bilingual zh/en.

items.name: dsh-quota-viewer
items.desc: Multi-provider quota panel for DeepSeek Harness: DeepSeek official balance, jojo code, SCNet and Ark Coding Plan usage windows in the sidebar footer, with 90 days of local history and trend charts.

items.name: dsh-deepseek-balance
items.desc: Shows DeepSeek API balance and local DSH Flash and Pro usage costs.

items.name: dsh-balance-and-cost
items.desc: DeepSeek account balance and model cost tracking with official peak/off-peak pricing, three-tier token billing (cache miss, cache hit, output), per-model and per-session breakdowns, a composer summary bar with hover details, CSV export, and a settings panel.

items.name: dsh-usage-dashboard
items.desc: DeepSeek usage dashboard for DSH Web: days-left estimate from recent average spend, daily/monthly/cumulative costs with period-over-period comparison, per-model cost ranking, cache savings, peak/off-peak pricing impact, and a draggable floating balance widget.

items.name: deepseek-time#dsh
items.desc: Peak and off-peak pricing-period indicator for the DeepSeek API in the DSH chat UI, with a countdown to the next period and an API balance readout on hover.

items.name: dsh-team-reporter
items.desc: Reports each machine's token usage to a team server you host, with one-time enrollment codes, an offline disk queue, and idempotent replay, so an administrator can see every member's usage and cost in one place.

items.name: dsh-token-ledger
items.desc: Auditable token ledger for DeepSeek Harness: folds the durable session log into restart-safe totals, recomputes the same numbers from the raw logs and diffs them, and turns usage into a bill by workspace, session, model or vendor, exportable as CSV or JSON.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-sidebar-quota
items.desc: Displays DeepSeek and MoonShot API balances, Codex remaining quotas, and estimated local daily API spending in the DSH sidebar.

items.name: dsh-opencode-usage
items.desc: Shows the remaining OpenCode Go quota (5-hour, weekly, monthly) in the DeepSeek Harness Web composer dock.

items.name: dsh-balance-monitor
items.desc: Monitors multi-provider balances, DeepSeek peak/off-peak usage costs, per-session analytics, and configurable spending limits in the DSH sidebar.

items.name: suanzhang-dsh
items.desc: Trading-terminal style cost tracker for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar balance and today spend, per-step RMB cost table, auto-synced official pricing with peak/off-peak, cross-session and per-day summaries, tool-level attribution, and cost forecast.

items.name: dsh-tlogs
items.desc: Token usage meter in the DSH sidebar footer that runs both data sources at once rather than picking one: the DeepSeek platform account's usage and cost endpoints, which cover every device on the account but only the official channel, and local session logs, which cover this machine in real time across every provider but carry no cost. The two are merged per day — the official channel takes the larger figure, since one call is recorded by both, and providers the platform cannot see are added on top. History is backfilled month by month from the platform, providers are classified by channel rather than model name, days follow the platform's UTC boundary, and no token has to be pasted because the platform figures reuse the DSH account you are already signed in to. Totals appear as all-time, current-project, today, week, month, last-7 and last-30 in a compact bar, an expand panel and a detail modal with calendar, chart, model, provider, year, month and day tabs.

items.name: dsh-workspace
items.desc: Sidebar usage dashboard: DeepSeek balance and today's cost, project file explorer, Git diff & history, built-in terminal, and one-click Harness updates.

items.name: dsh-whale-post#gate
items.desc: Daily sending quotas and quiet hours for agent mailboxes: letters are counted in named buckets that each carry a per-day limit, the day boundary is configurable, and a quiet window tells the core to hold online letters rather than deliver them.

items.name: dsh-billing-badge
items.desc: Peak and off-peak billing season in the composer statistics row, right after the cache-hit reading, with a coloured dot, a countdown to the next switch, and a panel that shows the account balance split into total, granted and topped up in the currency the API reports.

items.name: dsh-wakatime
items.desc: Tracks DSH's file reads, image views, and code edits in WakaTime, including exact counts of lines added and deleted by AI. Keeps activity tracking running while DSH responds, batches updates across files, and coordinates per-project reporting limits across parallel DSH processes. Automatically installs and updates wakatime-cli.

items.name: dsh-cost-receipt
items.desc: Shows what each assistant turn cost under every reply, priced from the token usage of that turn at the official peak and off-peak CNY rates, together with the account and bonus balances; when a turn cannot be priced it states the reason instead of guessing.

items.name: dsh-pulse
items.desc: Cross-session usage and cost observatory for DSH — token trends from hourly lines to 90-day and 1-year heatmaps, per-model DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing reconciled against the official balance, GLM/Kimi/MiniMax subscription-quota windows with burn-rate forecasts, cache-hit ring, project rankings, CSV export, and a dsh-tui terminal face.

items.name: dsh-usage-lite
items.desc: Sidebar panel for account balances and local token usage, with provider/model breakdowns and a 27-week daily heatmap.

items.name: dsh-balance
items.desc: DeepSeek API balance badge in the sidebar footer beside Settings — reads the key DSH already stores, shows granted/topped-up breakdown on hover, flags a balance under ¥2, and refreshes every 60 seconds or on click.

items.name: dsh-glm-quota-dock
items.desc: Shows GLM Coding Plan quota windows (5-hour, weekly, monthly tools) as an always-visible pill in the composer stats row with a 5h reset countdown, opening a card-grid detail panel with limits, reset times, 24h per-model token usage and one-click plugin self-update.

items.name: dsh-usage-meter-harness
items.desc: Real-time usage, cost and balance meter for DeepSeek Harness: official-API balance, cost accuracy within ¥0.02, per-turn / per-session / per-model cost ledger, live color-tiered token speed and a docked one-click popup.

items.name: dsh-plugin-usage-stats
items.desc: Adds a whole-corpus usage statistics page to DSH with daily and cumulative tokens, cache hit rate, per-model breakdown and a year-long activity heatmap, all read from the provider-reported usage.

items.name: dsh-plugin-usage-meter
items.desc: Local-first usage and cost meter for the DSH web UI: composer button with live session cost and balance; panel with a stacked per-model daily/7-day chart priced per effective list-price interval (official pricing page synced daily), monthly usage tiers with a canvas share card, 30/50/85% context-pressure warnings with one-click /compact, budget alerts, and an in-panel npm update check with one-click update.

items.name: dsh-balance-vision
items.desc: DeepSeek balance and per-session cost in the DSH web composer dock, with official peak/off-peak pricing (peak hours Mon-Fri BJT 9-12 / 14-18, weekends off-peak) and built-in deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp vision model rates billed at flash price (images billed as tokens, max 384 tokens each).

items.name: dsh-multi-clear
items.desc: Multi-select clear (archive) workspace conversations and bulk-delete empty workspaces in the DSH sidebar. Workspace-level selection (tri-state), select-all, progress and failure reporting; delete keeps folders and session logs (sessions move to Ungrouped).

items.name: dsh-dsbal
items.desc: Shows the DeepSeek API account balance in the DSH Web sidebar with 30s auto-refresh, click-to-refresh, hover details, and low-balance threshold warnings.

items.name: dsh-quota
items.desc: AI Quota & Usage Monitor for DSH: real-time balance and reset countdown tracking for Codex, Cursor, Google Antigravity, and OpenCode-Go.

items.name: dsh-token
items.desc: Local token usage and cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: four-segment token breakdown (miss/cache-hit/cache-write/output), cache savings estimate against the miss/hit price gap, per-session drill-down with context-growth curves and anomaly flags, global filters with shareable URLs, monthly budget progress with month-end projection, and day/month aggregate fast-path queries (O(days)) with incremental rescan.

items.name: dsh-commandcode-quota
items.desc: Command Code balance and quota panel: a status row under the composer showing the available balance and the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows.

items.name: dsh-dual-checkin
items.desc: Checks in Trae and WorkBuddy daily from local login files, with a sidebar status and credits panel.

items.name: dsh-token-cost
items.desc: Per-project LLM token usage and RMB cost in the DSH Web sidebar, split by input (cache miss), cache hit, and output with model price auto-pricing.

items.name: dsh-balance
items.desc: Shows DeepSeek API balance and tells whether the current moment is peak or off-peak pricing time, with a live countdown to the next switch.

items.name: dsh-token-usage
items.desc: Token usage panel in DeepSeek Harness Settings: folds session logs into day, week and month totals per model or per provider, persisted in the plugin storage domain and served over a same-origin /token-usage-rpc route; SVG line chart with crosshair hover, ranking with share and optional cost, cache hit-rate and cache read/write cards, a user-supplied price table priced per million tokens, daily and monthly budget alerts, CSV or JSON export of the current range, auto-refresh while visible, preset and custom start/end date ranges, and a rebuild that asks for confirmation before dropping history whose session logs no longer exist.

items.name: dsh-deepseek-billing
items.desc: View DeepSeek API account balance and billing info in DSH, with a /deepseek-billing slash command.

items.name: dsh-cost-meter
items.desc: Session cost chip in the DeepSeek Harness conversation header showing live token usage by bucket, peak/off-peak tariff pricing, and a countdown to the next tariff switch.

items.name: dsh-key-limits
items.desc: Shows API-key and subscription quota limits in the DSH provider interface and settings.

items.name: dsh-usage-guard
items.desc: Normalizes malformed token-usage samples so broken session histories remain loadable.

items.name: dsh-cost-meter
items.desc: Estimate session and turn costs with model prices in USD or CNY and price sync from models.dev, OpenRouter, or DeepInfra.

items.name: dsh-team-panel
items.desc: Counts token usage for one selected project per machine, syncs the totals to a self-hosted team server, and shows each member's project, spend and last active time in a sidebar panel.

items.name: dsh-gpt-niang-quota
items.desc: Draggable companion widget by Tokyo with Codex quota monitoring, manual executable discovery, and editable replies. Requires the Codex CLI (codex app-server) and a ChatGPT login; API-key logins expose no subscription quota.

items.name: dsh-hann-usage-dashboard
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness Usage tab for DeepSeek account balance, official peak/off-peak pricing, live countdown, platform usage link, and local balance warning light.

items.name: dsh-deepseek-monitor
items.desc: Official DeepSeek platform monitoring inside the provider card: a live balance chip left of the composer model name plus an expandable account-details panel with per-model monthly usage and a daily stacked chart.

items.name: dsh-usage-statistics-panel
items.desc: Usage statistics settings panel: 26-week activity heatmap, daily token trend with a cache hit-rate curve, per-model donut and breakdown, time-range filters, summary cards, one-time historical backfill and lossless rebuild.

items.name: dsh-discipline-guard
items.desc: Agent discipline guard for DeepSeek Harness: four gates enforced at the harness boundary — loop circuit-breaker, token-cost fuse, route-switch warning, plan approval — where prompt-level reminders can't reach, so an agent can no longer burn a weekly quota in minutes; one-click 🛡 chip, hot-reloadable thresholds, and presets from invisible-but-armored to warn-only.

items.name: dsh-usage-guard
items.desc: Usage statistics panel for the Web GUI and the Desktop app: silent per-model token collection, activity heatmap, trend charts, cost estimation and a daily-limit guard.

items.name: dsh-mimo-quota
items.desc: Model usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: automatic per-call accounting from session logs with real timestamps, full history and live increments, showing tokens, cost, requests, trend and model composition with per-model, per-project and per-session views and editable tiered pricing.

items.name: dsh-volcengine-usage
items.desc: A draggable Volcengine Coding Plan usage card for DeepSeek Harness Web using a local console session.

items.name: dsh-balance-card
items.desc: A draggable balance and usage card for the web UI. Clicking the character button slides the card out from the left side of the image and clicking it again retracts the card; it shows the official DeepSeek account balance split into granted credit and top-up, and token usage folded from local session logs for today, the last 7 days and the month, priced per call with the official peak/off-peak rates (cache hits, cache misses and output are priced separately).

items.name: dsh-price-tip
items.desc: Keeps a pricing-period badge in the sidebar footer of the Web UI. It shows whether the DeepSeek API is currently in an off-peak or peak period, plus how long until the next switch. Click it to open the rules, the price table currently in force, and the balance of the signed-in DeepSeek account.

items.name: dsh-token-pulse
items.desc: Local-first token usage heatmap inside DSH settings: GitHub-style week/month/quarter/year grids, hourly usage per day, per-model and per-provider Top 5, and persisted history that survives session deletion. Zero network, zero billing.

items.name: dsh-agent-billing
items.desc: Agent billing and usage observability for dsh web: session-log direct-scan recording (zstd, per-event timestamps, watermark + lastSeq double dedup), multi-account rate profiles per provider and model, per-window live badge reading the window session id via React fiber, full glassmorphism dashboard with 14-day sparkline, budget alerts, relay-station balance queries and a 332-model official price library.

items.name: dsh-token-use
items.desc: Settings section that reports token usage: totals for input, output, cache read, cache write, reasoning and call count, with breakdowns by model, day, month and project plus a per-day trend chart for the last 30 days; history is rebuilt once on a worker thread and then kept current from live session events.

items.name: dsh-reasoning-distill
items.desc: Distill over-long model reasoning into its useful core, replay the compressed version on every later request, and report each session's cost and savings. Disabled by default: you must install and select one of the two rewrite backends (in-place needs 14 source patches and a rebuild; message-edit needs a third-party plugin).

items.name: hwfee-dsh#usage-stats
items.desc: Usage panel on the blank-session hero: sessions, messages, total tokens, active days, peak hour, favourite model and a contribution heatmap, over all time, 30 days or 7 days.

items.name: dsh-quota-watch
items.desc: Provider-reported quota snapshots for GLM Coding Plan and GitHub Copilot in DSH: a draggable floating capsule with detail panels for quota windows, reset times, per-model usage and Copilot credits, plus an optional sidebar card hidden by default; credentials are resolved by the DSH host and no quota history is stored.

items.name: dsh-usage-card
items.desc: Sidebar card that prices this session's tokens in RMB at official peak/off-peak rates and splits context share by source, with per-turn pricing and a Markdown/CSV history report.

items.name: dsh-chat-cost
items.desc: Live token cost for every chat in the DSH Web UI: the chat, its subagents and the whole session tree, priced from a bundled models.dev snapshot of seven providers and 139 priced models, with cache read and write rates wherever the provider publishes them and DeepSeek from its own peak and off-peak table. Every finished answer carries its own price in the transcript, and a chat that is not currently open is priced from the log instead of disappearing. Spend is costed per interval from an append-only JSONL ledger in the project folder, so logged work keeps the tariff it was billed at. On top of it: budget-aware work plans packed against a money limit, routing scenarios that show which models are worth connecting, a generated plan document in English, Chinese or Russian, and a warning when spend belongs to no plan unit.

items.name: dsh-keep-running
items.desc: Watchdog for quota exhaustion: on a 429 or quota error it creates a recurring schedule that re-sends a continue-the-task prompt until a turn closes normally, so a long task resumes without manual restarts; /keep-running list and /keep-running cancel <id> manage those schedules. Requires @deepseek-ai/dsh-schedule to be mounted first (it registers the schedules).

items.name: dsh-model-surplus
items.desc: Shows the active model's usage and remaining balance in the session header: OpenCode Go plan usage (rolling, weekly, monthly) with the selected model's monthly cap, Command Code 5-hour and weekly window usage with remaining credits, and DeepSeek account balance.

items.name: dsh-cache-saver
items.desc: Slims oversized MCP tool JSON Schemas per agent without changing dispatch, and reports token usage, cache hits and context composition on a settings page.

items.name: dsh-model-balance
items.desc: Auto-detect the current model vendor (7 built-in) and show its balance or quota in the composer input row, with custom endpoints for unsupported vendors.

items.name: dsh-workspace-hub
items.desc: DSH workspace hub: organize workspaces into color-coded folders in the sidebar (three-level drag reorder for folders/workspaces/sessions, inline edit, one-click expand/collapse, dual-channel search) with per-workspace and per-session token usage and cost stats from real session logs (official DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing for any deepseek model, three spend calibers, hover detail cards, overview panel) plus OpenCode Go plan usage; data persists to host disk and refreshes live every 30 s.

items.name: dsh-tokenslash
items.desc: Intelligent token optimization via Jev System One triage, dynamic tool pruning, and subagent routing.

items.name: dsh-plugin-token-cost
items.desc: Live token spend for the current DSH session beside the composer, pricing the four server-reported token buckets with the profile's own table and showing both the peak and off-peak rate.

items.name: dsh-plugin-opencode-usage
items.desc: Shows OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling, weekly and monthly used and remaining percentage with reset times) in a floating panel anchored to the bottom-left of the session window.

items.name: dsh-token-pet
items.desc: Floating DSH desktop pet with 12 authored state animations for requests, tools, compaction, archive and prompt enhancement; live context occupancy; a persistent cross-session Lifetime Ledger; per-provider/model totals, hourly trends and 7/30-day views; dark/light theme switching; optional cost estimates (off by default) with a visual price editor and monthly budget alert; client-side skin ZIP import; JSON/CSV usage export; snapshot-only panel reads with background incremental indexing; and opt-in prompt enhancement with editable preview and DSH composer submission.

items.name: dsh-token-usage-stats
items.desc: DeepSeek-styled cross-session token usage, request count, and tiered cost analytics dashboard.

items.name: dsh-usage-stats
items.desc: Desktop-only token statistics, provider quotas, custom quota queries, optional WorkBuddy credits and an advanced model selector.

items.name: commandcode-usage#plugins/dsh
items.desc: Command Code plan quota in the DSH sidebar above Settings: 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows as used percentages with reset countdowns, a /quota command, and a zero-dependency CLI. It reads the key from your own provider route, so it needs no configuration and no other plugin.

items.name: dsh-usage-panel
items.desc: DeepSeek balance and per-session token usage in the session header, with a three-level balance alert and editable thresholds, one-click top-up links, a segmented token bar with cache-hit statistics, and a visibility-aware poller.

items.name: ccs-balance
items.desc: Sync cc-switch provider balances and track token usage & cost by day/month/total with relay-aware currency settings.

items.name: dsh-cachescope
items.desc: Prompt-cache diagnostics dashboard showing provider-reported token usage, adjacent logical-input changes, and Call TTFT.

items.name: dsh-balance-quota#dsh-balance
items.desc: Provider balance and quota status bar for DSH Web, with model capability settings, external JSON health monitoring, visual field binding, and per-model status details.

items.name: dsh-subusage
items.desc: Shows subscription quota and account balance beside the DeepSeek Harness model selector for 28 provider entries, with a shared settings page and a read-only quota tool.

items.name: dsh-token-usage
items.desc: Global token totals across every local DSH conversation, de-duplicated by message id, with custom date ranges and per-provider monthly quota tracking.

items.name: dsh-bottom-cost
items.desc: Per-turn session cost chip in the composer stats row: each turn's spend with the model it used, the conversation total split into cache-hit and cache-miss (CNY), priced from an official price table that refreshes on demand.

items.name: dsh-api-ledger
items.desc: Tracks API token usage and estimated costs with per-route model pricing, optional billing groups, synchronized CNY/USD display, session reports, composer totals and a clickable daily sidebar total.

items.name: dsh-usage-monitor
items.desc: DSH Usage Monitor: auto-query provider credit balances and time-window limits from configured API keys, with input capsule and custom provider support.

items.name: dsh-simple-cost
items.desc: DeepSeek account balance above the sidebar account area, the running cost of the open conversation, the cost of each turn beside its token count, and a one-click AI breakdown for any turn above a token threshold.

items.name: dsh-token-monitor
items.desc: Header quota badge plus a usage-monitoring tab: live balance/quota remaining and reset countdown per provider, with requests, tokens (input/output/cache-read/cache-write), cache hit rate, estimated cost and average latency tracked per session, provider, model and client, stored locally in SQLite with cross-device import/export.

items.name: dsh-plus-plus
items.desc: Adds a /dshpp slash command that reports session and token usage, cache-hit rate, and estimated cost from harness session logs; the repo also ships a CLI and local web console for lifecycle, provider, session, and plugin-security management.

items.name: dsh-desktop-linux-updater
items.desc: One-click update for the self-built Linux dsh-desktop: check fork releases, download the deb, swap the app and restart.

items.name: dsh-peak-hours
items.desc: A composer switch between running always and running only in off-peak hours, set per session: a task is judged by the session that owns it, so changing one session no longer changes the others, and a session without its own choice follows a default. In off-peak mode every task, including one already running, is held at its next agent step or tool dispatch when a Beijing peak window starts (Monday to Friday 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00, statutory holidays excluded), and one timer releases it at the boundary; weekends and holidays are idle all day. The holiday calendar lists every statutory day off in 2025 and 2026 from the State Council notices, and a year with no data is reported as unknown rather than assumed to be a workday.

items.name: dsh-turn-price
items.desc: Shows what each completed turn cost in CNY on its own row under the turn, with a click-to-open breakdown naming the tokens per category, the unit rate, the matched price rule and the billing instant; per-model rates are edited on a settings page inside DSH — four token categories plus weekly recurring peak/valley rules with arbitrary multipliers and absolute time-window promo prices that override them. 0.2.3 adds account awareness: it reads the balance or remaining quota of 14 providers (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Zhipu GLM, Moonshot, MiniMax, Kimi Coding, OpenAI-compatible relays and more) and shows today / this month / this session spend next to it; spend is accumulated in a local ledger (atomic writes, one book per API key, 1-24 month retention, JSON export), and a monthly calendar lets any day be corrected by hand - including days with no balance observation - with an optional note. Usage and rates are computed locally from what the provider reported; balance is read straight from the provider API with your own key, and nothing is sent to a third party.

items.name: dsh-offpeak
items.desc: Pauses peak-hour requests that target official or listed models and lets everything else run, with editable peak windows, a per-model interception list and per-session free-run in the badge panel.

items.name: dsh-balance
items.desc: Real-time DeepSeek account balance readout in the session header: host /api/balance route resolves the API key through the credentials seam (never sent to the browser), 60-second auto-poll plus manual refresh.

items.name: dsh-balance-widget
items.desc: A balance and cost widget for the DSH web GUI: a sidebar footer card shows the account balance, a remaining-ratio bar and today costs; clicking opens a four-tier cost breakdown (last prompt / this session / today-this-project / today-all) with term explanations and a one-click top-up link. Zero external dependencies, works on Node 24.

items.name: dsh-hub-oauth-gateway
items.desc: DSH Web Usage Center with local SQLite history, HUD and dashboard, Hub account/quota snapshots, custom pricing and fee ledger, and CSV/JSON export, plus coding-plan OAuth and an optional loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway.

items.name: dsh-token-bar
items.desc: A per-turn token usage strip in each reply's icon row: a grey/yellow/green segmented bar plus a legend giving that turn's uncached-input, cache-read and output split and each one's share.

items.name: dsh-codex-reset-tracker
items.desc: Displays today's public Codex reset status and upcoming schedule in the DSH composer, with a read-only tool for status and paginated records.

items.name: dsh-token-saver
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness plugin that trims tool output (head/tail plus grep folding), adds optional prompt shaping (Caveman and Ponytail), instant local responses, RTK command-output compaction, context-pressure handling, optional LLM-summary compaction, stable prompt-cache layout, a Web settings UI, and persisted savings telemetry.

items.name: dsh-token-chart
items.desc: Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness with a session drawer and today / last-3-day / last-7-day panels, plus configurable charts and metrics.

items.name: luxueliu-usage-command
items.desc: Daily cost card for your local LLM gateway: /usage reads gateway_usage.jsonl and itemizes spend per model and per hour, covering official direct, OpenRouter relay, and in-plan metered pools.

items.name: dsh-balance-usage
items.desc: Shows the DeepSeek account balance and the current peak / off-peak phase in the sidebar, and estimates per-session and per-turn cost using the official peak and off-peak rates.

items.name: dsh-model-visibility
items.desc: Model visibility manager for DeepSeek Harness: hide or show any model in the conversation model selector from a dedicated settings page. Per-model switches, search, provider-level batch actions, reset-all. Zero intrusion - writes only its own hidden list, never the provider config; hiding a model in use never interrupts a running session.

items.name: dsh-llm-key-rotation
items.desc: Rotates configured LLM API keys after quota, rate-limit, or authentication failures.

items.name: dsh-entry-shaper
items.desc: Proxy provider that reshapes each outbound payload through a per-category op chain before forwarding upstream, keeping the prompt prefix monotonic between turns so unchanged history is not re-paid at full price; op names are transports (exec / http / inline) and accept user-defined algorithms.

items.name: dsh-hotkey
items.desc: Configurable VS Code style keyboard shortcuts for the DSH web GUI, with a settings-page keybinding editor, conflict detection and JSON import/export.

items.name: dsh-third-party-api-balance-wallet
items.desc: Compact DSH wallet panel for any Sub2API-compatible third-party balance site. Uses /v1/usage with a long-lived API Key, auto-discovers configured providers, and shows balance plus daily usage.

items.name: dsh-cost-dashboard
items.desc: Cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: aggregates model input/output/cache tokens across all local sessions, prices them with a builtin table (including DeepSeek peak/off-peak), and shows daily trends plus per-model and per-session tables.

items.name: dsh-provider-quote
items.desc: Queries the balance and token prices of the model providers configured in DSH, whichever endpoint or relay they use, accepts cc-switch usage scripts, and shows the selected provider's balance under the composer.

items.name: dsh-quota
items.desc: Bottom-right quota pill and panel aggregating membership quotas across AI platforms (Kimi Code, DeepSeek, Zhipu Coding Plan, BigModel, Qwen, Scnet, TokenRouter, SupaWriter), auto-syncing API keys from the DSH credentials domain with colored usage bars.

items.name: missher-dsh-usage-statistics
items.desc: Local session and Token statistics with daily and hourly activity charts for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-usage-stats#usage-stats
items.desc: Token statistics for every stored DSH session: a Host service folds the durable session logs into a persisted checkpoint and serves them over one read-only HTTP route, and the Usage settings page paints the saved aggregate immediately, then updates it in the background. Days are bucketed by hour behind a date picker, next to a trailing window with per-model breakdowns, request and web-search counts; no cost or pricing model.

items.name: dsh-token-stats
items.desc: Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness: per-model daily and range charts plus a yearly contributions heatmap.

items.name: dsh-speed-gauge
items.desc: Real-time generation-speed gauge for DSH: a half-circle dial and a flowing trend curve, sampling tok/s 50 times a second for finer, more accurate measurement.

items.name: dsh-liangwengu
items.desc: DeepSeek API pricing reminder with a game HUD: Beijing-time countdowns to peak/off-peak windows, a draggable HP capsule with day/moonlight themes, and a nine-realm cultivation system with breakthrough animations.

items.name: dsh-context-governor
items.desc: Context fullness bands, the per-session compaction threshold derived from the model window, per-step cost computed from cache read and cache write rates, cache-hit, DeepSeek balance with the peak/off-peak tariff, and a one-click handoff. It never calls a model and spends no tokens.

items.name: dsh-gateway-wallet
items.desc: Live remaining balance for the current API key from Sub2API, New API, or official DeepSeek, plus actual spend when the site publishes it, not a local token estimate.

items.name: dsh-plugin#dsh-usage-dash
items.desc: Session usage statistics panel: token and request stats at day/hour/minute granularity, an activity heatmap, bottom-bar session info takeover with per-turn cost chips, and cost estimation under multi-condition time-segmented pricing. Re-implemented from HaoyueQin/dsh-usage-statistics-panel with extensions.

items.name: dsh-plugin#dsh-usage-panel
items.desc: Multi-platform LLM balance and quota panel: configure DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, MiniMax, NewApi or custom endpoints, poll on a schedule, draw balance and quota trend charts, and push threshold and window-reset notices through multiple channels.

items.name: dsh-prompt-templates
items.desc: Global and per-session prompt templates in a right-side panel — insert into the draft or send now, edit, promote session templates to global, with SQLite persistence via the built-in node:sqlite.

items.name: dsh-billing
items.desc: Prices tokens with the official model price table, keeps the per-session and global running cost beside the composer context meter, mirrors your DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar, blocks a turn once this period passes your own global ceiling (clamped to that balance) or a per-session ceiling (each session sets its own, independently), and resets the billing baseline per session or globally — the two are independent, so resetting one never resets the other — so the period goes back to zero while history only rolls into the lifetime total.

items.name: dsh-api-cost
items.desc: Registers an apiCost session projection that estimates DeepSeek spend from reported token usage at published peak / off-peak rates, in CNY and USD, over self, delegation-tree or verified-team scopes: a composer-dock pill and its detail panel, the /cost command, a session_cost tool, and GET routes for the view and the current rate card. A panel switch parks model requests at the llm/stream waterfall while peak rates apply and dispatches them unchanged once the off-peak window opens, so the call is billed at the off-peak rate with no failure reported to the session.

items.name: dsh-plugin-balance-ui
items.desc: Shows DeepSeek account balance and today's token usage in the sidebar footer, and reconciles locally estimated spend against the balance the account actually lost over the days it has sampled.

items.name: dsh-better-stats
items.desc: Composer stats strip for the DSH Web UI: official CNY pricing with auto-synced peak/off-peak tiers, per-model accounting, live timers, subagent-tree merging, DeepSeek account balance, budget alerts, and streaming cost estimation.

items.name: dsh-token-meter-panel
items.desc: Adds a sidebar panel to the DeepSeek Harness web UI that reports token usage and cost straight from DeepSeek's own usage API (today's spend, 7/30-day trends, today's hourly split, a history table, cost breakdown, peak/off-peak tier pricing), plus per-session detail from local logs. Zero-config: it reads the browser sign-in for the official figures, and falls back to local session logs with the source labelled.

items.name: dsh-minimax-usage
items.desc: Shows MiniMax Token Plan usage beside the DSH Web UI model selector with compact 5h/7d bars, click-to-refresh, automatic idle and heartbeat refreshes, and endpoint fallback. Reuses subscription keys configured under Settings → Model and appears only for MiniMax Token Plan providers.

items.name: dsh-budget
items.desc: Per-plugin usage budgets and cost caps on the llm/stream waterfall: per-model usage accounting, session and monthly budgets with warn/block transitions, latency windows, and a carbon-footprint estimate.

items.name: dsh-meow-cachebilling
items.desc: Per-round cache billing inside the composer context-meter popover: what the current call spends on cache hits, misses, and output in CNY, with automatic official peak/off-peak and per-model pricing; hidden on non-official DeepSeek routes.

items.name: dsh-token-stats
items.desc: Token usage dashboard for the DSH web GUI — today/week/month totals, per-model breakdown and a stacked 30-day chart, with a 4-language UI.

items.name: dsh-cost-audit
items.desc: Shows token and CNY cost per turn and per session in the harness's own statistics form, a whole-account bill over 1/7/30-day windows with cost-per-unit-of-work trends, and an advisor that re-measures its own suggestions after you adopt them.

items.name: dsh-personal-center
items.desc: Personal center for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session usage statistics, per-model cost estimation, global custom instructions, a global font-size adjuster, a data-driven desktop pet with bitmap & vector skins, and a conversation status overview, all local and offline.

items.name: dsh-tool-cost-hint
items.desc: Per-turn tool cost line in the chat stream: after each turn a collapsible row under the reply lists which tools ran, how many times, and how many tokens each tool injected into the context (input plus output), expandable to per-tool detail.

items.name: dsh-token-viewer
items.desc: CC Switch-style token consumption statistics for the dsh web GUI: per-request usage log, real-consumption hero, request-time-bucketed trend chart, per-model peak/off-peak list pricing, per-project and per-model stats, and account balance.

items.name: balance-dsh
items.desc: Shows DeepSeek account balance and current-session token and cost usage in the sidebar footer and composer dock, including peak and off-peak billing and subagent consumption.

items.name: dsh-desktop-statusbar
items.desc: Replaces the stats line under the message input in the DSH desktop app with a configurable status bar of ten optional fields, with live cost estimates at DeepSeek's official peak and off-peak rates, custom per-model prices, a CNY or USD switch and account balance.

items.name: deepseek-harness-chat-billing
items.desc: DeepSeek account balance, this session's billed spend, and today's total spend in the session-header badge; a turn-cost row in the message actions strip, a detail panel with per-model pricing and a today session-spend ranking. Official peak/off-peak pricing; balance from the real /user/balance API.

items.name: dsh-balance
items.desc: Real-time DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer with a 5-day spending chart.

items.name: dsh-where-did-my-tokens-go
items.desc: Realtime token counter beside the deep-thinking indicator in chat, with merged or split input/output display, per-step operation counts, and auto-scaling K/M/G/T units.

items.name: dsh-key-manager
items.desc: Manage multiple API keys per provider in Settings → API 密钥: keep a pool of keys with notes, switch the active key with one click, and the switch really takes effect on the next model call.

items.name: dsh-minato
items.desc: Optional read-only bridge plugin that publishes live dsh session and token statistics as one JSON snapshot for the standalone dsh-minato toolkit to read.

items.name: dsh-abacus
items.desc: Buckets every model call by local date, provider and model, then shows the totals in a sidebar card, a per-chat pill under the composer and a settings page, alongside each provider's account balance and subscription windows.

items.name: dsh-per-request-cost
items.desc: Composer pill with the DeepSeek account balance, the live peak/off-peak pricing phase, and this session's spend priced request by request at the rate in effect when each request was sent. Subagent sessions' costs are aggregated into the parent session; Search and Fetch fees are charged only for DeepSeek's search engine, while third-party engines (Tavily, Bing, Exa, …) are counted but free. The balance refresh interval is configurable.

items.name: dsh-token-saver
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness plugin that aggressively saves tokens without affecting task quality: lossless head/tail truncation of tool results (default), grep-result folding, pressure-triggered dsh-compaction-basic delegation, and an LLM-summary CompactionEngine subclass for the aggressive mode. Saves 97.6% of input tokens on an 8-scenario synthetic suite, with all reductions routed through dsh event flow so model-visible = logged stays intact.

items.name: dsh-balance-monitor
items.desc: Shows selectable DeepSeek, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, and TeamoRouter balances in the DSH Web sidebar, with per-provider details, usage data, and refresh controls.

items.name: dsh-platform-usage#plugin
items.desc: Account-level DeepSeek platform usage inside the DSH settings page — 52-week token heatmap, per-API-key and per-model breakdown, live balance.

items.name: dsh-thinking-token-stat
items.desc: A lightweight plugin that adds model thinking token statistics to the bottom Dock.

items.name: dsh-usage-dash-board
items.desc: Cross-session usage rollup that resolves opaque route keys to real model names, with a per-request log, an editable four-bucket price table that leaves unknown models unpriced instead of guessing, and a calendar-day-filled bar trend whose values appear only on hover or keyboard focus.

items.name: dsh-agent-token-stats
items.desc: Cross-agent token usage dashboard: aggregates local conversation logs from Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor IDE, DSH, OpenClaw, CodeWhale, Hermes and more into a persistent ledger that survives log deletion, with cache-hit rate, cost estimation, period comparison and day drill-down analytics in a sidebar panel.

items.name: dsh-rub-cost
items.desc: Session cost in rubles in the composer dock — the tariff in effect with its countdown, the API cost at that tariff, the CBR rate, the total including subagents, cache savings, and DeepSeek Platform balances.

items.name: dsh-plugin-ds-balance
items.desc: DeepSeek API balance + per-call cost tracker: durable per-call cost ledger from real usage chunks with official Beijing peak/off-peak (x2) pricing, 60 s balance polling, and a sidebar footer action showing balance and today's spend.

items.name: dsh-plugins#balance
items.desc: DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer plus spend per session, today, this month and all time, priced by a configurable time-of-day price table per currency (DeepSeek CNY/USD defaults included). Two read-only remote methods, no host routes, key read through the host credentials seam on every call, egress only to the configured provider origin.

items.name: dsh--prompt--enhance
items.desc: Prompt enhancer for the DSH web UI with basic/standard/expert modes: standard/expert modes rewrite drafts with project context and recent session history, retry gracefully when gateways reject reasoning-effort settings, and show a before/after review with undo.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-status
items.desc: DeepSeek account wallet balance and the current peak or off-peak billing period, in a fixed status region at the sidebar foot, with a manual refresh and an official top-up link.

items.name: dsh-coding-plan-quota
items.desc: Quota ring beside the DSH model selector that reads OpenCode Go and 14 other coding-plan quotas or balances, cycles the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, and colours itself by urgency.

items.name: dsh-usage-state
items.desc: Shows the account balance or coding-plan quota (5h/7d/30d) of the provider behind the current model, on its own line above the composer input; display only, no cost accounting.

items.name: dsh-usage-mini
items.desc: Floating usage window for DSH Web showing Claude and Codex subscription windows with reset countdowns, plus DeepSeek API spend and balance; display-only companion to dsh-cost-meter.

items.name: dsh-offpeak
items.desc: Holds DeepSeek model calls for the rest of each peak-hour window you configure instead of sending them, so they are billed at off-peak rates; also pauses active goals while it waits and shows the account balance with an 8-hour spend chart.

items.name: dsh-deepseek-usage
