items.desc: Shows the DeepSeek account balance as a row in the sidebar footer with a refresh button, and opens a popover with the balance card, daily token and estimated-cost charts over a 7/30-day window, a per-model table, and a link to the platform usage page. The balance comes from the official /user/balance endpoint; usage is aggregated from local DSH session logs and priced with the published peak/off-peak rate card in CNY, so it is labelled an estimate and its scope is stated on the panel.

items.name: dsh-musage
items.desc: Shows coding-plan usage and balance for 5 AI providers (MiniMax, DeepSeek, Kimi, OpenRouter, Zhipu) beside the composer input, switching with the selected model and reusing API keys configured in DSH model settings.

items.name: deepseek-harness-wallet-patched
items.desc: Maintained fork of feibi-mochi/deepseek-harness-control-center, which has not been updated since 2026-09-09. Pricing follows the official model pool instead of a hardcoded model prefix, so DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (`deepseek-flash`) is billed and shows its peak/off-peak clock, and the official price page is parsed structurally so a renamed or retired model no longer stops price sync. Adds an English interface beside the original Chinese. Otherwise the same plugin: balance, per-session cost and token breakdown, a 24-hour peak/off-peak clock, Z.ai plan quota, and a local usage ledger, following the host light/dark theme.

items.name: dsh-otel
items.desc: Exports the agent loop to GreptimeDB as OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs, with seven Grafana dashboards covering token usage, cost, session outcomes and per-turn latency.

items.name: just-dsh-plugins#dsh-auto-update
items.desc: One-click upgrade to Deepseek Harness, with version number displayed in the sidebar.

items.name: dsh-toolkit#dsh-api-balance
items.desc: Shows DeepSeek API balance and per-turn conversation cost directly in the session UI.

items.name: deepseek-harness-session-cost-pill
items.desc: Live estimated session spend in the composer dock, pricing each assistant step at DeepSeek's peak or off-peak rate for its own timestamp.

items.name: dsh-opencode-go-usage
items.desc: Floating pill for DeepSeek Harness that shows OpenCode Go usage for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows as three rings, optionally alongside the DeepSeek account balance; a hover popover lists each window with its reset countdown, and a minimal mode nests the rings. Settings cover refresh interval, progress basis, what the pill shows and its position.

items.name: dsh-cache-hit-precision
items.desc: Refines the built-in cache-hit percentage to three decimals in place across the composer stats row and the token-usage dialog.

items.name: dsh-aliyun-balance
items.desc: Floating one-line widget showing how much Alibaba Cloud credit is left (voucher balance + account balance), with voucher face value, used amount and earliest expiry on hover. Read-only BSS queries, no spend tracking.

items.name: dsh-opencode-go-usage
items.desc: Plan-usage pet for the DSH web GUI: a floating skeletal-animated character reports quota in a speech bubble, auto-matching the configured provider (OpenCode Go, Command Code, DeepSeek) to show a plan percentage or an account balance, and falling back to local token stats when the provider API is unavailable; draggable, wheel-scalable (90-260px), synthesized click sounds, loopback-only routes.

items.name: dsh-composer-tokens
items.desc: Real-time token estimates for the DSH conversation composer, combining the current context baseline with the draft and showing exact or heuristic counts.

items.name: dsh#tally
items.desc: Per-request cost ledger covering retries and subagents, holiday-aware peak/off-peak pricing, shared pricing/usage/balance/budget services, and DeepSeek bill reconciliation.

items.name: dsh#tally-ui
items.desc: Cost readouts for the composer, turns and sessions, a usage dashboard, daily/monthly budgets and settings, with DeepSeek balance from dsh-tally-balance-deepseek.

items.name: dsh-turn-cost
items.desc: Per-turn and per-session estimated cost in the DSH Web UI, computed from provider-reported token usage in four buckets with the built-in official DeepSeek CNY peak/off-peak card — peak hours are Monday-Friday 9:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 Beijing time, weekends and Chinese statutory holidays are off-peak all day. An optional local JSON rate table overlays prices for other or self-hosted models, and models without a price show tokens only.

items.name: dsh-opencode-go-quota
items.desc: OpenCode Go quota in the sidebar foot under the workspace list: one cell for the most constrained window plus a hover popover with the rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly percents, each with a usage bar, an elapsed-time marker, the remaining share and a reset countdown, refreshed every 60 seconds from OpenCode's official usage API using the key already in the DSH credential store.

items.name: dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-provider-usage
items.desc: Multi-provider usage stats framework (v2 adapter contract): persistent capsule plus detail panel; DeepSeek official (interval-bookkeeping daily usage derivation with a peak/valley countdown badge, working even without an official usage endpoint) and OpenCode Go built in; any other data source joins by dropping in a single mjs adapter file, hot-swappable from the settings page, with API keys kept on the host.

items.name: dsh-cost-gauge
items.desc: Peak/off-peak billing cost dial for the DSH Web GUI: session token usage billed at the official DeepSeek peak and off-peak rates, a rate dial with a model-colored needle and switch countdown, a balance ring with a low-balance alarm, drag-to-resize, and a minimized status-lamp mode.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-cpa-quota
items.desc: CLIProxyAPI quota for DeepSeek Harness: a ring beside the model picker plus a settings panel listing every account quota windows with plans and reset times.

items.name: dsh-token-cost
items.desc: Live token usage and estimated cost in the sidebar: the current task plus every session combined, an as-of clock for those totals, per-session time detail (elapsed, turns/steps, first-token, model vs tool time, decode speed), and a per-turn breakdown with each turn cost on hover.

items.name: dsh-token-live
items.desc: Composer readouts for the DeepSeek Harness: CJK-weighted draft token count, session spend at official peak/idle rates, context occupancy, and what the same usage would have cost on the costliest other model; client-only, with no host half and no credential access.

items.name: dsh-usage-dashboard
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness usage analytics dock on the composer: Beijing-time peak/valley pricing with all-day weekend valley rate, live balance, cross-session history, by-date drill-down and charts.

items.name: dsh-damage-pulse
items.desc: Tracks DeepSeek token usage, per-call and session costs, and account balance with cache-aware charge animations in the DSH Web UI.

items.name: dsh-api-balance
items.desc: Live DeepSeek API balance and this session's token usage in the conversation header, with a detail panel for the topped-up / granted balance split, request count, input, output and cache-hit tokens, and context pressure. The API key is read on every query and is never cached, written to disk or returned to the browser.

items.name: dsh-token-usage-xc
items.desc: Token usage statistics plugin for DeepSeek Harness - today's token consumption by model, cache hit rate, 7-day trend chart, optional header badge, persistent storage with auto cleanup.

items.name: dsh-usage-suite
items.desc: Tracks this turn cost under the input box, today tokens and spend in the sidebar with peak and idle pricing, and pins the latest question to the top of the conversation.

items.name: dsh-usage-stats
items.desc: Token usage statistics by model, session and date in a sidebar panel, plus OpenCode Go quota, DeepSeek balance and Z.ai quota monitoring.

items.name: dsh-clear-usage
items.desc: Local Token usage dashboard in DSH Settings with hourly activity, daily heatmaps, custom date ranges, model breakdowns, local/API filters, and native cache-hit accounting, without cost estimates or composer overrides. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer.

items.name: dsh-tide-badge
items.desc: Billing-period and balance pill under the DSH composer: it shows the account balance and the current conversation cost alongside the peak/off-peak state and a countdown to the next switch. The peak/off-peak rules cover China statutory holidays and weekends, and the conversation cost is measured as the decrease in account balance between the plugin's 60-second idle balance refreshes.

items.name: dsh-token-usage-ledger
items.desc: Persistent token-usage ledger and Web Usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-token-plan-quota
items.desc: Balance badge that follows the active model provider: official readings for DeepSeek, Qwen Token Plan and Aliyun BSS, plus Moonshot and OpenRouter endpoints not yet key-verified.

items.name: dsh-smart-scenario-router
items.desc: Routes dsh requests by conversation scenario and retries with fallback models when requests fail.

items.name: dsh-cpa-status
items.desc: CPA account-pool status panel: sidebar health light, quota bars, success-rate ticks, and gateway key endings.

items.name: dsh-service-monitor
items.desc: Monitor the account balance for 3rd-party services those AI agents often use, such as Tavily, SerpAPI, Firecrawl, Bocha, Tinyfish, etc. Optionally you can select to inject the account balance into the system prompt, so the agent can use the services accordingly.

items.name: dsh-deepseek-cost-live
items.desc: Real-time DeepSeek API balance (official endpoint) and today-spend estimate (this DSH instance session-log usage x per-model price table) for the DSH web: composer dock strip, always-on floating badge, full settings dashboard (7-day trend, per-model cost, editable price table and polling, history rescan). The API key never leaves the host.

items.name: dsh-prompt-lab
items.desc: Agent-structured prompt optimizer for DeepSeek Harness: rewrites composer drafts into role/task/context/constraint/format with normal, slim, and expand modes, a confirm modal with score, continue-optimize, and local, hybrid, DSH, or cloud-API engines.

items.name: dsh-token-frugal
items.desc: Cuts session input tokens three ways, each with its own switch in a panel under the composer: lossless structure-aware compression of tool results on `tools/post-execute`, then a per-tool head/tail elision that always names a recovery path through the shared spill store; tool-catalogue visibility per agent on `agent/created`; and a per-workspace memory document that recall matches against each new message and injects through `agent.inject`, so the transcript is not re-read. Measured 41.76% fewer prompt tokens over 149 recorded requests, with a bundled script that re-measures any profile.

items.name: dsh-output-setting
items.desc: Auto-expand reasoning and tool cards, tune code-block font size and line spacing, and choose the model output language (auto, Chinese or English).

items.name: deepseek-harness-plugins#token-meter
items.desc: Unified token quota and usage statistics for dsh: multi-vendor rolling/payg quota with sidebar cards and provider ops, plus session-log token aggregation with trends, heatmap, and per-model breakdown.

items.name: dsh-float
items.desc: Floating DeepSeek API balance capsule for the DSH Web GUI: a corner pill shows the remaining balance, clicking expands the total, granted and topped-up breakdown, double-clicking refreshes at once and the balance polls every 5 seconds; the host half proxies /user/balance so the key never reaches the browser.

items.name: dsh-balance-display
items.desc: Real-time DeepSeek account balance badge in the sidebar footer with odometer roll animation, multi-currency support, balance trend chart, per-key usage statistics with historical backfill, and GitHub version auto-check.

items.name: dsh-token-attention
items.desc: Token attention management panel for DeepSeek Harness: per-task/day/week/month token usage and cost tracking (input hit/miss, output, reasoning), DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing, task-type recognition, and advice on when to switch sessions, write a hand-off, or compact context.

items.name: dsh-usage-heatmap
items.desc: Token usage dashboard in the DSH settings page: nine metric cards (total, today, yesterday, peak day, longest session, active-day streak, active days, sessions, subagent tokens), a GitHub-style daily/weekly/cumulative heatmap, and an activity insight list, aggregated locally from session logs and projection caches, keeping token history after a session is deleted.

items.name: deepseek-cost-usage-status-plugin
items.desc: Adds a colored status line under the DSH conversation stats showing live DeepSeek API cost, usage and account balance, with on/off-peak pricing indicators.

items.name: headroom-stats-plugin
items.desc: Shows real-time token and cost savings from the Headroom compression proxy in the DSH web UI: a Settings dashboard plus a persistent stats line under the composer.

items.name: llmtrim-stats-plugin
items.desc: Live llmtrim savings dashboard in the DSH web UI: Settings page with paid, would-have-cost, saved-today and saved-this-week cards plus per-model breakdown, and a configurable rotating or static stats strip under the composer.

items.name: dsh-usage-orb
items.desc: Cross-session usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on usage ring plus a draggable panel that aggregates token usage, cache-hit rate, cost and balance from local session logs, with per-tool cost attribution, iOS-style tile layout editing and an optional animated companion face.

items.name: dsh-mini-usage
items.desc: Local token totals, per-model usage and a 12-week heatmap in a Chinese sidebar panel.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-balance
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows the DeepSeek API account balance and OpenCode Go plan usage (consumption ring, hover details) in the sidebar footer, with adaptive polling and zh/en locale support.

items.name: dsh-balance-meter
items.desc: Reads the API balance or subscription quota behind the current DSH route — including OpenDesign (AMR) wallet and Design Plan windows via the control plane — and never guesses a figure: a miss reports its cause (the raw response is echoed only when parsing fails). OpenDesign needs `vela login` or a desktop `controlKey` in `~/.amr/config.json`.

items.name: ai-token-report#dsh-plugin
items.desc: Token usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: a bar above the composer opens billing token totals, trend charts, per-model and per-project breakdowns and a custom date range, read from local session logs of DSH, Codex, Claude Code, Trae and WorkBuddy. With a self-hosted portal URL and an app key it also reports usage events to that portal; with neither configured it collects nothing. It exposes token_usage tools plus a ctx.tokenReport service, and never collects conversation content.

items.name: dsh-call-shrink
items.desc: Extreme LLM-call compression for DeepSeek Harness: title short-circuit, in-flight dedup, 24h replay cache, and batch-merging N parallel requests into 1 upstream call via a `[[TASK n]]`/`[[ANSWER n]]` delimiter protocol - fewer API calls, less spend, same answers.

items.name: dsh-budget-handoff
items.desc: Session budget gate for DeepSeek Harness: prices every turn against the official price table, warns at 80%, stops the task at 100%, and writes a handoff snapshot so the next session can continue the work.

items.name: dsh-token-optimizer
items.desc: Token-cost pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: pressure-aware layered compaction (lossless projection below 40% context pressure, LLM summarization above), per-agent tool allowlisting, long-text-to-image with vision summarization, and a /token-status command tracking pressure, tiers, and saved tokens.

items.name: dsh-commandcode-usage
items.desc: CommandCode usage & balance panel for DeepSeek Harness: API usage, credit balance, 5-hour/weekly windows from the sidebar footer.

items.name: dsh-chatgpt-style
items.desc: ChatGPT-like conversation layout for the DeepSeek Harness Web client: a 768px centered column, right-aligned neutral bubbles for user turns, full-width assistant text at 16/28, and rounded code blocks with their own copy banner. Adds semantic inline markup (`==confirmed==`, `!!risk!!`, `++key word++`, with bare 4xx/5xx codes highlighted automatically) and line-start check/warn/tip callouts; a fast/thinking chip in the composer that switches the model reasoning effort through ctx.modelDirectories; and sidebar contrast, where the selected session gets a tinted row with an accent bar and workspace folder icons are colored.

items.name: dsh-codefall
items.desc: Adds a Matrix-inspired digital-rain startup animation for DeepSeek Harness, a rectangular light portal that opens to both sides, optional replay when the desktop window reopens, and a green UI theme with adjustable hue.

items.name: dsh-boo550wt-animation
items.desc: Plays a full-screen video while DeepSeek Harness starts and reveals the UI only after it ends. Esc skips it.

items.name: dsh-aqua-theme
items.desc: Aqua glassmorphism theme for the DSH Web UI, adapted to DSH v0.2.x and desktop v0.22.3+: the header, sidebar, composer, stats line and trajectory view become frosted glass panes over a live WebGL fluid board or an image/video wallpaper, with mica and compatibility layouts, adjustable blur, frost, hue and brightness, marine decorations (particle whale, fish, mesh, cursor glow), a one-click reset-to-defaults button, and a master switch whose off state restores the stock UI exactly; adapted from WYH66666666's original (0.1.x) and du-u-uck's 0.1.1-rc.2 port.

items.name: dsh-bliss-glass
items.desc: Theme that pairs Windows XP-era scenery wallpapers with a modern frosted-glass interface: a fixed background layer behind the DeepSeek Harness web UI, panel styling applied through theme tokens, a wallpaper picker with custom image import, and a light/dark toggle. Works on desktop and mobile web surfaces.

items.name: air-pixel-liquid-glass
items.desc: A configurable Liquid Glass theme for DeepSeek Harness with translucent surfaces, wallpaper, desktop transparency, window blur, custom cursors, click ripples, and per-side conversation contrast controls.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-skin-real-madrid
items.desc: Real Madrid dual-mode skin: Bernabeu night stadium for dark, white-kit pinstripes with crest and 1902 layers for light. Unofficial fan work.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-aqua-patched
items.desc: Aqua glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, forked from upstream and repaired to load on DSH 0.1.2-rc.1: mica and compatibility modes with adjustable blur and frost, fluid or wallpaper backdrop, background brightness, and a master switch that restores the stock UI.

items.name: dsh-yukimi-theme
items.desc: Yukimi Sajo theme with illustrated backgrounds, interactive characters, and an optional Windows desktop companion.

items.name: deepseek-harness-hello-kitty-suite
items.desc: Hello Kitty-styled task-completion and question alerts for DSH Web, bundled with an optional light/dark pink Skin Center v2 theme and local install scripts.

items.name: dsh-wallpaper-position
items.desc: Per-wallpaper offset for dsh-dream-skin - nudge the current wallpaper along X and Y in pixels from Settings, remembered separately for each image, URL or gradient.

items.name: dsh-theme-prts
items.desc: An unofficial Arknights P.R.T.S.-inspired interface theme for DSH Web with appearance presets, accessibility controls, and conversation navigation.

items.name: dsh-style-hub
items.desc: Theme studio for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: eight switchable preset styles, accent and panel-translucency fine-tuning, host-side wallpapers painted on the first frame, and a one-click fix when the wallpaper-engine glass tint greys out light styles.

items.name: mahoutsukainoyoru-dsh-skin#skin
items.desc: A Witch on the Holy Night (Mahoutsukai no Yoru) visual-novel theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with original-style menus, three characters with personas, day and night playlists, and an ending sequence. The repo ships no assets of its own; the 380 files / 263 MiB it drives (136 sprites, 208 UI parts, 13 backgrounds, 23 audio) must be recovered from your own copy of the original game, and the screen stays largely empty until then. The 23 audio files are a header strip away from working OGG; the 357 images use proprietary .mzp/.cbg formats, so the per-file mapping guide offers two routes and one of them expects you to supply your own decoder.

items.name: dsh-wallpaper
items.desc: Full-screen dynamic wallpaper from local videos and images, with live effect controls, wallpaper switching and Wallpaper Engine workshop import; settings persist automatically.

items.name: dsh-bg-switcher
items.desc: Adds a Background button above Settings in the sidebar foot that fills the window with one of six preset wallpapers, the theme default, or a custom image URL, remembered across reloads.

items.name: dsh-yexueqing-skin
items.desc: Ye Xueqing (Justice Online) theme skin: two switchable artwork variants (wisteria courtyard / snowy river) rendered as a mask-edged band behind all UI text, bundled LXGW WenKai GB interface font with a toggle, and an exclusive mode that disables other skin plugins while it is on.

items.name: dsh-theme-native#plugin
items.desc: A token-based DeepSeek Harness theme plugin with ten presets, custom colors, and system font pickers.

items.name: mdsm
items.desc: MDSM (Male DeepSeek Mascot) appearance layer for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: wears the bundled mascot character as the GUI background (surface-token fade with opacity, blur, scrim and position controls), seats the matching square avatar as the sidebar and conversation brand mark, and edits it all from a Settings section; the host serves the artwork and config locally under /api/MDSM, and the config lives at $DSH_HOME/MDSM.json.

items.name: nai
items.desc: Nai milk-frog mascot appearance layer for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: wears the bundled milk-frog artwork as the GUI background (surface-token fade with opacity, blur, scrim and position controls), seats the matching square avatar as the sidebar and conversation brand mark, and edits it all from a Settings section; the host serves the artwork and config locally under /api/nai, and the config lives at $DSH_HOME/nai.json.

items.name: tangsan
items.desc: TangSan mascot appearance layer for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: wears a generated TangSan portrait as the GUI background (surface-token fade with opacity, blur, scrim and position controls), seats the matching square avatar as the sidebar and conversation brand mark, and edits it all from a Settings section; the host serves the artwork and config locally under /api/tangsan, and the config lives at $DSH_HOME/tangsan.json.

items.name: dsh-cyrene-theme
items.desc: Pink-and-white frosted-glass skin for the DSH Web GUI, themed after Cyrene from Honkai Star Rail. Also rewrites the agent persona (editable from the sidebar), adds Cyrene reaction stickers, replaces the new-session hero with her, and adds a full-page background picker with enable / pick / rotate / fade. Unofficial non-commercial fan project; Cyrene and related art are (c) miHoYo / HoYoverse, not affiliated or endorsed.

items.name: dsh-ui-plugin
items.desc: Restyles the DeepSeek Harness welcome area and composer, with workspace, mode, and skill shortcuts.

items.name: dsh-theme-studio
items.desc: Adds a Theme row to Settings → General between Appearance and Font size — 8 builtin palettes plus Default, hover previews without writing, click applies and is persisted by the host; imports/exports custom dsh-theme.json files, with an optional Theme Creator skill behind /dsh-theme-creator.

items.name: dsh-uiskin-theme
items.desc: A Blue Glass ocean-fantasy skin for DeepSeek Harness Web: crisp ocean backdrop, glass bubbles, an ocean sidebar with a gold-gradient HARNESS wordmark and a bottom cartoon character, a whale settings button, and gradient model text.

items.name: dsh-whale-atelier
items.desc: Full-interface whale skin pack for the DSH Web UI — layered wallpaper, metallic trim, lace and bows, a corner mascot that reacts to agent state, ambient particles, plus an installable third-party skin-pack format.

items.name: dsh-wallpaper
items.desc: Wallpaper Engine integration for the dsh web GUI: scan the local WE library (Steam workshop 431960 + local projects) and use its wallpapers as the page background — image/video/web rendered natively, scene wallpapers as softened static previews — with a 壁纸设计 panel (opacity, scope, fill, blur, vignette, fps, parallax, carousel, theme linkage) and agent tools wallpaper_scan/list/set/config.

items.name: dsh-cool-theme
items.desc: Theme plugin — supports dark/light appearance switching, ships 34 preset themes, and supports creating, sharing, and importing custom themes.

items.name: dsh-yoimiya-theme
items.desc: Genshin Impact Yoimiya theme: two hand-tuned palettes, a procedural fireworks particle layer, and a local music player that reads your own files — songs and covers are never uploaded. Warm syntax colors and a hand-drawn goldfish brand mark; apart from the wallpaper every pixel is CSS gradients and hand-written SVG.

items.name: dsh-bloomglass
items.desc: A DeepSeek Harness Web theme: ten OKLCH Chinese-traditional-colour palettes that adapt to light and dark, plus an optional wallpaper behind frosted glass panels; tailored for the DS Bot (bot team) interface; the palette and wallpaper persist locally.

items.name: dsh-protect-eyes-skin
items.desc: An eye-friendly green skin that reskins the whole DeepSeek Harness Web UI to a low-blue-light green palette, with complete light and dark mode coverage.

items.name: dsh-csdn-theme
items.desc: Ports CSDN blog article typography into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — heading hierarchy, quote blocks, solid-grid tables, inline code and Atom One syntax highlighting, in matching light and dark palettes.

items.name: dsh-whale-aqua-theme
items.desc: macOS-style skin with a swimming whale aquarium background and a dot-matrix whale send button for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.

items.name: dsh-shunshun-wallpaper
items.desc: Fan-made wallpaper plugin themed on the streamer Zhang Shunfei: full-screen high-definition rotating colorful pegasus GIF wallpaper with theme blending and prominence control, plus a Bilibili music player (add songs by pasting a link, delete, volume, seek, single/list/shuffle loop, and a sidebar mini player).

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-theme
items.desc: Twelve curated palettes, eight accent colours, a contrast slider and font/scale overrides for the DSH web UI, with an inlined first-paint script that prevents theme flash.

items.name: dsh-theme-mineradio
items.desc: Mineradio glassmorphism theme for the DSH web UI: champagne-gold glass panes, a fluid or wallpaper backdrop, and a one-switch toggle that restores the stock look exactly.

items.name: dsh-plugin-gemini-theme
items.desc: Gemini-styled skin restyling the conversation ground, sidebar rows, hero greeting and composer through one stylesheet over the --dsw-* tokens, with light and dark both covered.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-skin-bayern
items.desc: Bayern Munich skin for the dsh web GUI: home-red/away-white canvases, real match-photo backdrops for 19 first-team players plus drawn shirt, squad-wall, Allianz-Arena and plain backdrops, switchable player and accent colour.

items.name: dsh-colors
items.desc: 22 light-only palettes (Pantone / Chinese traditional / Morandi) and 14 composable surface effects for DeepSeek Harness, with twelve-shichen clock rotation, manual picks that lead until the next boundary, workspace binding, per-session colour marks and a nickname/avatar row whose editor lives in the settings page.

items.name: dsh-transparent-ui-plugin
items.desc: Aqua glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: mica and compatibility modes with adjustable blur and frost, fluid or wallpaper backdrop, background brightness, particle-whale accent, and a master switch that restores the stock UI.

items.name: dsh-vietnam
items.desc: Vietnamese UI language for the DSH web client (all 2,615 core strings), three Vietnamese palettes in light and dark, and a rotating Vietnam-landscape backdrop from Wikimedia Commons with per-photo attribution.

items.name: dsh-theme-mediascape
items.desc: Media-scape theme for the DSH web UI: standing/character-art and video wallpapers (mp4/webm, local + online) with boot animation, base color schemes (single-source JSON + presets + picker), capsule host-element styling, ambient particles, background music player (covers/playlists/random), typing sound effects, and a draggable dock toolbar with a unified upload entry — wallpapers and music uploaded together (suffix-classified), mid-upload no-disk buffering, pause→.part snapshots with offset resume, filename+size dedup with "skipped" notices, and true-delete removal with list refreshes.

items.name: dsh-skin-xuyuanwu
items.desc: Wishing House theme skin with warm amber glow, live moon phases, meteors, typing sparks, procedural chime audio, and daily fortune slips.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-dracula
items.desc: Dracula (VS Code) dark theme for the DSH Web GUI: the vampire palette mapped onto the product colour tokens, plus a denser type scale, a 1080px reading column and code blocks that scroll instead of re-wrapping. Dark mode only.

items.name: dsh-theme-eink-retro
items.desc: A paper-and-ink client-side theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: Balanced preserves semantic status colors, and Immersive maps supported surfaces to monochrome.

items.name: dsh-theme-liquid-glass
items.desc: Genuine Liquid Glass theme for DSH Web UI: SVG feDisplacementMap edge refraction on input card, send button, bubbles, view tabs, queue dock and sidebar. Built-in animated demo wallpaper, customizable background blur & brightness, redesigned model selector popup, glass-styled buttons throughout, and a unique water-drop settings icon.

items.name: dsh-thirteen-bg
items.desc: Animated and video live wallpaper for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — GIF, animated WebP/APNG and static PNG/JPEG images, plus MP4/WebM video backgrounds, with auto format detection, a dim slider, and UI chrome tone matching.

items.name: dsh-theme-macintosh
items.desc: Classic Macintosh (System 7) pixel theme: desktop pattern canvas, Finder sidebar, monochrome buttons and dialogs, light/dark support.

items.name: dsh-everforest
items.desc: Everforest palettes for the DeepSeek Harness Web/Desktop UI: six schemes (dark and light, each in hard, medium or soft) applied as token-level overrides, with the Host half painting the boot palette so the Web loading screen and first frame are already Everforest; a Settings page picks the scheme and can follow the system appearance.

items.name: dsh-f1-skin
items.desc: An F1 Race Control theme for DSH Web with four switchable team skins, broadcast-photo backgrounds, light and dark modes, and native appearance controls.

items.name: dsh-theme-inkstone
items.desc: Inkstone is a monochrome theme inspired by Obsidian Minimal E-ink, with inverted sidebar interactions, colored Markdown headings and locally installed LXGW WenKai font fallbacks; it preserves native font and appearance preferences and targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.

items.name: dsh-za-warudo
items.desc: Adds an Appearance switch to the DSH sidebar with a three-second time-stop transition, synchronized sound, and light/dark theme switching.

items.name: rhine-lab-codex-theme#dsh
items.desc: Rhine Lab-inspired light and dark themes with animated backgrounds for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-wallpaper
items.desc: Local images and videos as the DSH desktop window background: timed rotation with 0.7s cross-fades, first-frame-ready before fading in, automatic light/dark ink for readability, adjustable blur and panel/sidebar opacity, video thumbnails, and a probe endpoint reporting load, layer and selector health. Reads only the local files you point it at.

items.name: dsh-theme-frost
items.desc: Turns an image folder into a frosted-glass global wallpaper for the DSH web UI, keeping the official palette.

items.name: dsh-cutesnowgirl-background
items.desc: Adds a muted looping video behind the Harness workspace and makes the composer translucent after the boot splash finishes.

items.name: deepseek-harness-background
items.desc: Custom background image for the DSH Web UI: upload a picture or paste an image URL behind the whole app surface, with opacity, theme-aware scrim, panel transparency, frosted-glass and wallpaper blur, live preview and persisted settings, plus an optional DeepSeek-style timeline rail with per-question bookmarks for long conversations.

items.name: dsh-background-by-model
items.desc: Per-model appearance for the DSH Web UI: an ordered rule list matched against the current session model name, each rule carrying its own wallpaper, theme colour, layout mode, framing and wallpaper opacity and blur, plus per-surface opacity and frosted-glass blur for the main background, left panel, right panel, cards and panels, input and controls, settings panel, conversation text frame and trajectory view.

items.name: dsh-entry-transition
items.desc: One-shot entrance animation when the workspace opens: the logo is written onto the canvas, then an inverted color bar sweeps across on exit; mirrors light/dark themes automatically.

items.name: hcguo-public#amber-forge
items.desc: Amber CRT-style skin for DeepSeek Harness: overrides 14 theme tokens and 23 static palette entries, forces a monospace font stack everywhere outside KaTeX math, adds scanlines and a screen vignette, replaces the brand emblem with an inner SVG gear-and-skull mark whose corners are transparent, rewrites the new-session slogan, and raises the agent-preset selector width by 10%.

items.name: dsh-theme-herta
items.desc: A Herta theme for DeepSeek Harness: an ASCII boot opening ported from the upstream Herta project, a violet palette of design tokens, swappable wallpapers (four bundled, plus image URL, local import, solid colour or off) and a "Herta Appearance" page in DSH settings. Doubles as the theme that dsh-herta ships with.

items.name: deepseek-whale-wallpaper
items.desc: Live dot-matrix whale wallpaper for the DSH Web UI: ~1,750 breathing WebGL2 particles with pointer liquid vortices, light/dark themes, and a Canvas2D fallback.

items.name: dsh-orca-glass
items.desc: DSH Web plugin that injects an SVG (feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap) refraction filter and applies it through backdrop-filter to panels, bubbles and the input card, and bundles the orca-scene skin with theme tokens plus light and dark backgrounds.

items.name: hwfee-dsh#cds-theme
items.desc: Claude Design System theme for DeepSeek Harness — remaps the host's tokens onto CDS warm-grey surfaces and the clay accent, and refines the composer, sidebar, message rows, code blocks and markdown body.

items.name: dsh-skins
items.desc: Hot-switchable brand skins for the DSH Web UI: an OpenBMC skin, a UEFI skin and an unofficial fan-made skin based on A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, each with light/dark schemes, plus a personal wallpaper gallery, per-skin tagline and transparency controls, and a one-click path back to the official look.

items.name: dsh-ui-liquid-glass
items.desc: DSH full liquid-glass skin: 13 adjustable refractive glass surfaces, time-of-day wallpapers, four theme colours and a water-drop style selection lens.

items.name: dsh-theme-blackhole
items.desc: A black hole theme plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web UI.

items.name: dsh-inkscreen-theme
items.desc: Ink-and-paper Apple-inspired theme for the DSH web client with a handwritten jimmy sidebar brand.

items.name: xiao-theme-dsh-ui-plugin
items.desc: A fully customizable theming framework for DSH UI, with Xiao from Genshin Impact as the default theme.

items.name: dsh-huashu-pixel
items.desc: Warm pixel theme for the DSH Web UI: cream-paper and arcade-phosphor palettes, hard-edged pixel chrome with bundled pixel fonts, CRT motion on streaming and state changes, three intensity tiers, and a pixel loading bar while a turn runs.

items.name: dsh-official-homepage-theme
items.desc: A web theme recreating the DeepSeek Harness homepage with a fluid background, an elastic pointer grid, animated fish, and adjustable effects.

items.name: ocean-wave-theme
items.desc: Animated ocean waves with a whale swimming behind the page, plus translucent surfaces.

items.name: dsh-bg-carousel
items.desc: Rotates images and videos from a media folder as the DSH UI background, with panel controls for the rotation interval and UI opacity.

items.name: dsh-firefly-spring-skin
items.desc: Firefly "Spring Missive" theme skin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Overrides 74 --dsw-alias-* design tokens in matched light and dark sets, draws a spring-window backdrop with drifting petals and fireflies, places one character illustration on each side of the layout, and keeps the centre column legible with a radial spotlight scrim. Registers a Settings section with switches for the skin and for the artwork; both choices persist in localStorage.

items.name: dsh-nekojishi-vn
items.desc: Visual-novel theme with responsive characters, task-state expressions, role skills and a music player, including an original demo pack and optional local game imports.

items.name: dsh-ui-appearance
items.desc: A customized fork of TQSY114514/dsh-ui-appearance for theme palettes, wallpapers, and glassmorphism, with a layout fix for duplicate blank space alongside better-sidebar 0.18.0.

items.name: dsh-whale-particles-bg
items.desc: Animated whale background for the DSH Web UI: a particle field sampled from the whale silhouette plus a dot-grid layer, both full-screen click-through canvases mounted in the shell.overlay seat; the particles gather on load, breathe when idle and are pushed away from the pointer, the grid dots swell near it, and the palette follows the page light/dark theme.

items.name: dsh-skin-studio
items.desc: Local semantic-token theme editor with palette extraction, WCAG auditing, preview, and export.

items.name: dsh-raiden-theme
items.desc: Violet-gold acrylic DSH Web theme with light and dark stage art, framed chat, workspace mascot, and an optional Raiden agent preset.

items.name: dsh-taffy-theme
items.desc: Candy-pink acrylic DSH Web theme with light conservatory and dark stage art, gold-pink chat frame, Taffy character overlays, and an optional agent preset.

items.name: dsh-wallpaper-rotator#wallpaper-rotator
items.desc: Rotates the DSH app background wallpaper from a folder on a timer with cross-fade transitions; falls back to four bundled SVG gradients when no folder is set, and adds background-opacity, wallpaper-dimming, blur and text-shadow controls so panels and text stay readable.

items.name: deepseek-style-theme
items.desc: DeepSeek homepage-style theme skin for the dsh web GUI: fluid particle background, glass sidebar and composer, running-subagent progress panel, and DSTT peak-hour color modes.

items.name: dsh-any-background-plus
items.desc: An enhanced fork of dsh-any-background. Its own work, from v0.4.0 onward, adds a dual-lane wallpaper: the same picture down each side of the window, split at the exact centre so the wallpaper stays visible beside the conversation column. Each lane can also read its own folder (one directory per side) while sharing a single rotation cadence and mode, and both lanes take identical edge feathering.

items.name: dsh-skin-win2000
items.desc: Windows 2000 desktop skin for the DSH Web GUI: metric-accurate grey chrome, two-tone gradient title bars, 1px bevels, square corners, 16px scrollbars, and the pixel font it renders with served by its own host route.

items.name: ds-hentai
items.desc: ExHentai.org-inspired UI for DeepSeek Harness. DS Hentai / DeepSeek Hentai. Charcoal background, light-gray text, gray borders. The session list reads like a gallery index; the composer reads like a search bar. Live Demo: https://dshentai-demo.arkady14.site/

items.name: dsh-qq-skin
items.desc: A QQ NT messenger skin for DeepSeek Harness: light and dark share one QQ NT language — clean restrained light mode (brand blue #12B7F5, light-blue bubbles) and a calm blue-gray dark mode (#101822) — applied as reversible token and layout layers that never touch your Light/Dark preference.

items.name: dsh-skin-liquid-glass
items.desc: iOS 26 liquid-glass skin: one white-grey-blue fog field behind the whole window, a single 40px frost on top of it, a floating glass sidebar and reply bubbles. Light and dark palettes, no photo wallpaper, no dependencies (33 KB).

items.name: dsh-jcc-theme
items.desc: Unofficial Golden Spatula fan theme for the DSH Web GUI: an original hextech arena backdrop with a golden spatula crest (a parchment chart in light mode), four accent palettes (gold, cyan, violet, blue), a hex-board lattice, an optional aurora-and-gold-dust ambience, soft or sharp corners, and a floating hex-core panel that can turn the theme off without uninstalling.

items.name: dsh-theme-windowsxp
items.desc: Windows XP (Luna) skin for the DSH web GUI: beige Luna panels, gradient buttons, #7F9DB9 input fields, rounded blue scrollbars and a CSS-drawn Bliss-style desktop, plus a chime when a turn finishes and a different cue when the agent stops for approval.

items.name: dsh-skin-pixel-anime
items.desc: Pixel Dynamic Starfield theme: five palettes, four layered text schemes, five pixel fonts including a simplified-Chinese face, square or rounded corners, a rotating pixel starfield with meteors, and a header pixel clock — configured from its own settings tab.

items.name: dsh-endfield-theme
items.desc: Arknights: Endfield theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: charcoal and hazard-yellow industrial HUD, a boot splash injected ahead of the shell, a conversation backdrop, and a re-cut Windows title bar. Restyles the sidebar brand to 终末地工业 / ENDFIELD INDUSTRIES, which a URL flag reverts.

items.name: dsh-effort-ultra-skin
items.desc: A CSS skin that restyles the reasoning-tier control drawn by hytime/dsh-thinking-effort into a blue-to-violet pill with a starfield and a sheen sweep, with matching light and dark palettes. Requires that plugin to be installed; it adds no UI of its own.

items.name: dsh-workbench-theme
items.desc: Light/dark colour theme for the DSH web UI with an APTX capsule logo, browser tab title and icon branding, and optional Ai Haibara (Detective Conan) artwork panels, configured under Settings → General → Appearance with a no-decoration mode.

items.name: dsh-whale-decor
items.desc: Deep-sea whale-blue reskin for the DSH Web GUI: 14 theme tokens in light and dark, five whale-tail-maid placements, a clock and weather card, and a collapsible hardware readout (CPU, memory, GPU, per-drive temperatures via HWiNFO). No backdrop image is bundled; drop your own in. MIT code, MIT character art.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-skin-kitty
items.desc: Hello Kitty pink theme skin for the DSH Web UI: overrides the --dsw-alias-* semantic tokens in light and dark mode and paints a custom wallpaper on the app frame. Installs as a static profile plugin, so the theme restores automatically on every Harness start.

items.name: dsh-skin-rotation
items.desc: Picks a random installed skin on every DeepSeek Harness launch and enables exactly that skin, with an on/off switch and a shuffle action inside the Skins settings page. Skins the running host would refuse to load are excluded, and a manual switch still applies until the next launch.

items.name: dsh-appearance
items.desc: A lightweight font and theme plugin for the DSH client: Latin/Chinese/code font pickers that list only installed families, and five official palettes (One Dark Pro, Dracula, Nord, GitHub, Catppuccin) applied through the official theme tokens, including code-block syntax colors. No bundled fonts, no dependencies, no build step. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer.

items.name: dsh-theme-customizer
items.desc: Visual theme customizer for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — backgrounds, text colors, borders and details, all adjustable visually, with presets you can import and export, persisted across restarts.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-mc-skin
items.desc: Minecraft-styled skin for the DSH Web client: MC GUI palette and pixel bevels, a pixel logo, on/off switch art, two persistent toggles in Settings, and an optional 16 MB Minecraft AE pixel font served on demand by the host half.

items.name: dsh-skin-background
items.desc: Image-background skin with four shipped wallpapers, a user wallpaper directory, custom image URLs, and live dim/blur controls in Settings.

items.name: dsh-markdown-xyy
items.desc: Lightweight Markdown conversation theme plugin — enhances native color scheme with 4 built-in themes (light/dark dual), user-defined CSS themes, system-aware auto-switching, in-browser theme editor, designed to enhance reading speed and clarity.

items.name: dsh-theme-presets
items.desc: Adds Nord, Dracula, Catppuccin, Tokyo Night, One Dark, Gruvbox, Solarized, GitHub, Everforest, Kanagawa and Rosé Pine presets to the DSH Web GUI theme picker, layered over the built-in light/dark/system appearance.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-skin-tianlight
items.desc: Tianlight skin for DeepSeek Harness: 4K video/image wallpapers, local upload and auto-rotation, optional WebWallGL scenes, liquid glass, and a Mint cat companion. Alt+W opens the wallpaper panel.

items.name: dsh-hu-tao-skin
items.desc: A Genshin Impact Hu Tao (Wangsheng Funeral Parlor) skin for the dsh web GUI - a 14-token ink-black, crimson and amber palette, falling plum petals and spirit butterflies, a plum-blossom brand mark, and a floating petal toggle that tracks the sidebar.

items.name: dsh-darksoft-theme
items.desc: Dark theme plugin for dsh web (port of Obsidian things-soft-colorful-headings): warm-gray dimmed text via --dsw-alias-label-* token overrides plus soft colorful h1-h6 headings, zero dependencies.

items.name: dsh-nico-theme
items.desc: Switchable liquid-glass theme for the DSH web UI — 14 panels become frosted glass over a fluid backdrop, with material sliders and hover elasticity.

items.name: dsh-yorha-ui
items.desc: A NieR:Automata / YoRHa-inspired industrial terminal theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with sand-and-charcoal palettes, square geometry, and interface-wide styling.

items.name: dsh-ui-liteglass
items.desc: A lightweight appearance skin for DeepSeek Harness: custom wallpaper, glass-like panel transparency, and an accent color; server-side settings shared across devices, native light/dark mode left untouched.

items.name: prts · 源石协议
items.desc: Arknights PRTS Originium Protocol theme featuring interactive 3D crystal, tactical HUD, memory fragments, and boot sequence.

items.name: dsh-starry-sky-theme
items.desc: Dark-only starry-sky theme for the Web UI: both Light and Dark resolve to one deep-space night palette with a twinkling click-through starfield and four constellation figures, and the appearance preference is pinned to Dark while the plugin is enabled.

items.name: dsh-sky-window#dsh-sky-window
items.desc: Adds a city-local sky theme with a moving sun, day and night colors, drifting clouds, time previews, and an immersive sky view to the DSH web workspace.

items.name: gord-dsh-saber-theme
items.desc: Saber (Fate) theme for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web with light/dark palettes, 30 on-demand chat wallpapers rotating every five minutes, and a task attention tray below the right-side turn index, compatible with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2.

items.name: dsh-wallpaper-bg
items.desc: Standalone wallpaper background for the DSH Web UI and desktop app: built-in wallpapers, local image/video uploads stored in IndexedDB, and a read-only local Wallpaper Engine library served by the bundled wallpaper-engine-api service in the repository; renders images, video and scene workshop previews, with light-fog/dark-overlay, blur, brightness and safe-zoom controls plus a read-only follow-desktop-wallpaper mode.

items.name: dsh-claude-style
items.desc: Claude Code Desktop look-and-feel for the DSH Web GUI — ivory/warm-black dual canvas, clay accent, three-font typography, permission segmented control and brand switcher, via CSS overrides and client DOM overrides.

items.name: dsh-edex-xry-ui#bundle
items.desc: eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI themed as an XRY/B1 medical HUD: ECG heartbeat waveform and a rotating radar scan disc on the right bar, power-gen energy-cell meters on the left bar, a DATA TIMELINE scan-log table on the bottom, all in a cyan-on-near-black CRT skin around the original UI.

items.name: dsh-liquid-glass-studio
items.desc: iOS 26 style liquid glass theme for DeepSeek Harness: a fully transparent workspace, layered glass panels, a built-in wallpaper gallery, and a control center for workspaces and plugins.

items.name: dsh-bluefatfish
items.desc: Deep-sea skin for the DSH Web UI: an 80-token light/dark theme layer, a two-layer background, a gradient sidebar with a whale sticker, a wordmark that doubles as the skin switch, and a rotating turn-status line.

items.name: dsh-wechat-classic-theme
items.desc: WeChat-style light theme with a dark icon rail, grey conversation list and green chat bubbles.

items.name: dsh-sky-skin
items.desc: Sky: Children of the Light skin for the dsh web UI - light children on a glowing star map, candlelight gold and starry night.

items.name: dsh-theme-kami
items.desc: Kami-inspired editorial skin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, with a warm parchment canvas, ink-blue accent, serif typography and hairline borders in light and dark palettes.

items.name: dsh-client-theme-cyber
items.desc: Dark navy glass theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with a cyber-city background and holographic-cube cyan accents.

items.name: codex-ui
items.desc: Codex-style appearance for the DSH Web interface: window edge hairlines and shadows, sidebar colours and row alignment, a model picker with a reasoning-effort power rail, composer and right-panel geometry, a full-page settings-modal pass, a Trajectory view exit, and a settings card for theme, accent, background, foreground, fonts, sidebar translucency and contrast.

items.name: dsh-colorlab
items.desc: Colour engine for the chat UI: ships the Mariana palette as the default preset, exposes 18 colour slots and 9 Markdown prose roles, lets you save up to 12 presets, and colours LaTeX blocks by running Sublime's own LaTeX syntax.

items.name: dsh-theme-manager
items.desc: Two-level theme manager for the DSH Web UI: pick a culture / scene, a national flag, a developer palette, or a high-contrast pairing first, then a concrete style (58 built-in palettes, light and dark).

items.name: dsh-xingkong-theme
items.desc: Deep-space theme for the Harness Web GUI: two fully designed light and dark palettes over a seamless cross-dissolve nebula wallpaper, plus a model probe that reports which configured models actually answer and their real context window.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-skin-verdandi
items.desc: An Aether Gazer Verdandi-inspired DSH Web UI skin with light and dark backgrounds, wedding-themed chrome, responsive character art, and themed conversation and sidebar surfaces.

items.name: dsh-theme-tuner
items.desc: Add a theme-adjustment panel under Appearance to customize accent, background, foreground, contrast and gradient, applied live through theme token overrides.

items.name: dsh-theme-liuguang#liuguang
items.desc: Two switchable design languages for the DSH GUI — liquid glass with inner-lit surfaces and pointer specular, and Soviet constructivism with cream/ink/red poster geometry — plus a personalization panel, drop-in CSS skin packs, and a seven-expression whale-girl pet.

items.name: dsh-theme-escook
items.desc: Signature escook theme ported from VS Code: 4 classic aesthetic color schemes (Dark, Dark Soft, Light, Light Soft) with high-contrast syntax highlighting for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-deep-diving
items.desc: Adds selectable animated skins to the "Deep diving..." status row, with configurable size and optional status-text replacement.

items.name: dsh-custom-skin
items.desc: Browser-local wallpaper and translucent-panel controls for DSH Web, with multiple images, fit and position choices, shading, blur, and panel opacity.

items.name: harness-plugin
items.desc: Adds two switchable themes, built-in and local-folder background slideshows, and per-session token usage details to DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop.

items.name: dsh-skin-lab
items.desc: Skin author workbench: official token browser (169 --dsw-* variables with Chinese descriptions and module-usage tags), live try-on, durable skin save, theme freeze, seven spectrum presets with SVG backdrops and custom backdrop upload.

items.name: dsh-vae-theme
items.desc: An ink-wash theme for DeepSeek Harness inspired by Luzhou Moon, a guofeng song by the Chinese singer Vae. Built on dsh-theme-customizer, it repaints the app background, sidebar, composer, new-session button, settings panel, Cordis panel and floating panel with generated ink-landscape artwork, adds gold filigree frames and a full-screen rain effect, and rotates vertical lyrics drawn from 24 of his Chinese-style songs.

items.name: dsh-kaze-tachinu-theme
items.desc: Kaze Tachinu (The Wind Rises) skin for the DSH Web GUI: a full-screen film wallpaper behind glassmorphism surfaces, sky-blue interaction tokens, redrawn vector logos for the sidebar and home hero, a restyled composer card with themed placeholder text, and a bottom fade on the message list.

items.name: claude-style-skin
items.desc: Claude-style warm-editorial skin for the DSH web GUI — ivory/warm-black canvas, a clay ember accent, serif display + sans UI + mono labels, hairline borders and pill CTAs, light/dark themes.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-skin-qingxiao
items.desc: Qingxiao (Wuthering Waves) themed skin for the DSH web GUI, with ice-blue/jade/moon-white palette, sword-light motes and user-swappable backgrounds.

items.name: dsh-minecraft-ui
items.desc: Presents DSH Web as a playable, full-screen first-person Minecraft-style voxel interface—not a color-only skin: users walk through a persistent Three.js block world and access native workspaces, sessions, conversations, tools, model selection, permissions, context information, and the composer through in-world facilities and a workbench.

items.name: dsh-arknights-theme
items.desc: Arknights theme for the DSH Web GUI: twelve full-screen wallpapers whose edge blur, feathering and glass opacity are computed per image; ink solved in OKLCH to hold WCAG AA; Rhodes Island iconography throughout; and approval and question cards signed with operator autographs.

items.name: dsh-homepage-glass
items.desc: Fixed deep-blue gradient sidebar for the DSH Web UI plus three light-mode content backdrops (native white, a flowing blue WebGL shader ported from the deepseek.com homepage, or a muted blue), and brand-blue token overrides.

items.name: dsh-harness-os#dsh-harness-os
items.desc: Main UI skin that extends the dsh-startup-screen archive layout to the whole workspace, picking up from the boot animation when it hands off.

items.name: dsh-skin-switcher
items.desc: Skin switcher for the dsh web UI: one-click theme switching with auto-discovery of community skins.

items.name: dsh-deepseek-theme-studio
items.desc: Client theme plugin for the DSH Web GUI: a fluid background, frosted glass panels and quantised shader effects, with 100 adjustable parameters persisted to a JSON file.

items.name: dsh-custom-font
items.desc: Customize the interface font, size, weight, color and layout from the settings page, Word-style and WYSIWYG, auto-saved. Ships two bundled open-source fonts (STIX2Text, Latin Modern Mono Light) plus an author-recommended typography, and stores settings under ~/.dsh.

items.name: dsh-xia-plugins#packages/client-game-assistant
items.desc: Sakura theme, companion notifications (approval/job/answer), message read-aloud, and voice settings for the DSH web GUI.

items.name: dsh-theme-taojian
items.desc: Taojian (陶笺): Claude-inspired DSH theme with warm paper, clay accent, Noto Serif SC, and Cascadia Mono.

items.name: dsh-scenery
items.desc: Capy-style ambient background for DSH with wallpaper, bottom black gradient, and composer aura.

items.name: dsh_genshin_nicole_skin
items.desc: Genshin Nicole PV wallpaper skin for the DSH web GUI — 14 subtitle-free frames rotate on a timed crossfade queue with pause and manual switching.

items.name: eva-inspired-theme
items.desc: A Neon Genesis Evangelion-inspired skin for DeepSeek Harness: Title Card (light) and Central Dogma (dark) modes over one removable override layer, 55 measured color tokens, a wallpaper paint layer whose two surface alphas are solved against a WCAG contrast budget, a boot mask and a brand mark. It also rewrites the sidebar identity line, replaces the new-session heading, hides six official entries, and reshapes the composer control row. Unofficial fan work, non-commercial: the background pictures are fetched from third-party URLs at paint time, not shipped in the repository.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-appearance-gallery
items.desc: Fifteen curated theme families and nine complete dsh-web-ui skin replicas in one plugin behind a single settings entry, with CSS-only custom theme JSON, controlled custom skin-pack import via folder picker, preview, apply, delete and restore-default. Ships on npm as `dsh-appearance-gallery`.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-theme-black-hole
items.desc: A switchable WebGPU black-hole theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that retains the built-in Dark palette and animates only the new-session background.

items.name: dsh-kinich-theme
items.desc: Kinich and Ajaw theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with three visual styles, session-state feedback, companion interactions, and configurable ambient effects.

items.name: dsh-xiao-theme
items.desc: Xiao character theme for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop with light and dark palettes, selectable illustrations, a draggable companion, session-state feedback, and optional official DeepSeek balance display.

items.name: dsh-theme-eye-care
items.desc: Three switchable low-glare themes (Warm Paper, Sage Green, Warm Grey) for the DeepSeek Harness GUI, each a full alias-token layer with a light and a dark face.

items.name: dsh-outerwilds-theme
items.desc: Outer Wilds theme with a static starfield, campfire effects, appearance settings, and bundled Jost and Source Han Sans fonts.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-seaglass
items.desc: Seaglass is a highly customizable glassmorphism theme.

items.name: deepseek-colorful
items.desc: UI theme customizer, acrylic frosted glass, and panoramic live video/wallpapers for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-skin-im2005
items.desc: 2005-era instant-messenger skin for the DeepSeek Harness client: right-angle 1px window chrome, a blue-gradient title bar, SimSun for the Chinese UI, a buddy-group sidebar with an avatar card and editable signature, per-message name/time headers, and three switchable intensities. All artwork is original SVG; the reskinned toolbar also carries a cross-session notepad, a running-session panel, and an 8-ball game, minesweeper, a token garden and heads-up poker that a built-in focus mode silences.

items.name: dsh-theme-songgrid
items.desc: Song-dynasty-inspired theme for the DSH web UI: a light "rice paper" and a dark "night ink" variant, Ru celadon carrying interactive states while kiln copper is reserved for blockquotes, plus a 4pt spacing scale and a 46-glyph mask icon set.

items.name: dsh-chat-background
items.desc: Chat wallpaper: use a local image, a local video or one of six preset gradients as the chat background, with clarity, opacity, zoom, position, dark veil, fit mode, motion and glass panels; files stay in IndexedDB and nothing is uploaded.

items.name: dsh-local-background
items.desc: Local-folder wallpaper for the DSH Web UI: it defaults to your Pictures library (C:\Users\<you>\Pictures) and the host serves those images over same-origin HTTP, rotating one every N minutes (0-1440, default 5) in a shuffled pass with no repeats; the settings page under Plugins picks a different folder through the native system dialog, and tunes image opacity (100%), darkening scrim (25%) and panel opacity (15%) with changes applied live. Dialogs, modals and menus keep the default opaque background so text stays readable. Reads .jpg .jpeg .png .webp .gif .avif .bmp straight from disk, and keeps per-user settings under $DSH_HOME so upgrades never ship your folder path.

items.name: deepseek-harness-plugins#web-style
items.desc: Web appearance suite with a 7-theme gallery (each a full 122-token --dsw-* mapping) plus one-click switching persisted in settings, Material You wallpaper color extraction that generates a whole dynamic palette, and a global corner-radius control. Themes ride on the official look system as override layers instead of fighting it, so the official light/dark/auto row stays valid.

items.name: dsh-theme-endfield
items.desc: Arknights: Endfield industrial-editorial theme for the DSH Web UI: cream paper, ink text, zero border radius, two switchable accent palettes (signal yellow / teal-cyan), plus optional marching-squares contour background, ENDFIELD watermark and boot progress plate.

items.name: dsh-skin-asuka-p01
items.desc: Unofficial Asuka-themed skin for DeepSeek Harness with dual character illustrations, day and night city-dome backdrops, and five appearance settings covering mode, backdrop, character position, backdrop intensity, and character size.

items.name: dsh-wallpaper_share
items.desc: Syncs the wallpaper currently applied in Wallpaper Engine to the DSH Web UI background through a local bridge: preview/capture/full render modes, monitor lock, a wallpaper library panel for local and market content, focus lens with eye tracking, immersive mode, and a Windows app launcher that installs software from direct links or a cloud-drive share link and starts it with one click.

items.name: dafy-whale-theme
items.desc: Ocean-blue theme for the DSH web interface: swimming fish, rising bubbles, a daily-quote ticker above the input box, and a replacement brand area; Settings → Marine Theme exposes 7 groups and 32 options (brand text and size, badge, primary color, watermark, fish, quotes, overall scale) that apply instantly without a reload, plus a two-step reset to defaults.

items.name: dsh-acrylic-light
items.desc: Windows Acrylic window material plus layered frosted panels for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, with a liquid-glass composer whose opacity slider runs from fully transparent to fully opaque. The window material needs a one-time app.asar patch via apply-when-closed.ps1; installing the plugin alone only styles the page.

items.name: dsh-use-wallpaper
items.desc: Renders Wallpaper Engine scene wallpapers in real time in the browser (three.js player plus a Rust/WASM CPU particle simulation) and plays video and web wallpapers, falling back to the preview image, with no Wallpaper Engine runtime required. Scans the local Steam workshop library (431960) by auto-detection or a manual path, and offers a settings panel for wallpaper selection, library and engine directories, glow, pause and quality.

items.name: sakura-afternoon-skin
items.desc: Sakura-afternoon pastel skin for the DSH Web UI: light and dark sakura token palettes, a click-through falling-petal overlay with a soft vignette, a header petal toggle and a General-settings master switch.

items.name: dsh-pixel-ui
items.desc: Four-palette pixel-art skin for DSH Web (wood, parchment, warm, terminal green) with a bundled CJK pixel font served by the plugin's own host route, and a flat, shadow-free look.

items.name: dsh-codex-appearance
items.desc: Adds appearance settings with blue-gray, light and dark themes for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-open-meadow
items.desc: A coastal theme for official macOS DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2, with animated clouds, local waves, swaying foreground plants and Chinese settings.

items.name: dsh-theme-whalegirl
items.desc: Whale Girl light theme for the DSH Web UI, ported from a DreamSkin skin package: registers one native runtime theme with a full --dsw-* token remap derived from the source palette, layers the artwork as an ambient fixed wallpaper behind a frosted UI, and pins the theme against appearance-preference resets.

items.name: pixel-skin
items.desc: Pokémon-style skin for DSH Web with GBA frames, HP-bar status, effort level panel, and customizable color palettes.

items.name: dsh-claude-desktop-theme
items.desc: Claude Code Desktop-style theme for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS and Windows, with compact sidebar and chat layouts, light and dark themes, model and reasoning-effort controls, and an interactive pixel whale with spout, hop and tail-wag reactions on new sessions.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-paopaocat
items.desc: Fantasy glassmorphism skin for the DSH Web UI: a moonlit nether-forest scene with drifting teal clouds, red spider lilies spreading from the lower-left and a sleeping cat in the corner, drawn over a WebGL2 fluid background with its own wallpaper and video backgrounds. Ships two switchable variants (pale / saturated blue), plus cat-paw, fish, bubble and starlight decorations. One switch restores the stock interface exactly.

items.name: dsh-vscode-themes2
items.desc: Browse, search, install, and apply VS Code color themes to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: bundles 14 curated themes with live color-swatch previews, searches the official VS Code Marketplace for more, and one-click installs map any theme's palette onto the DSW design tokens with live switching and persisted selection.

items.name: dsh-reasoning-tiers
items.desc: Declares per-model reasoning-effort ladders for third-party providers in the llm-pi-ai settings section, so DSH's stock thinking-intensity selector works on models the pi-ai catalog does not describe.

items.name: dsh-model-info-fill
items.desc: Fills missing context window, max tokens, thinking levels, and image input on custom DSH models from models.dev, and lists unmatched models for manual edits.

items.name: dsh-subagent
items.desc: Registers local Qoder and QoderCN subscription CLIs as DSH subagent backends, with live progress, per-run credit display, a settings page, and /qoder and /qodercn commands.

items.name: dsh-plugin-adapter
items.desc: Exposes OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness with no API key, tracking Zen gateway changes.

items.name: dsh-router-loomy
items.desc: Registers the Xunfei Loomy cloud channel as an OpenAI-compatible supplier in dsh-router, adding model listing and streaming chat completions.

items.name: dsh-official-workbuddy-credit-proxy
items.desc: Pools every WorkBuddy account signed in on this machine into one auto-failing-over provider, serving OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages from the same pool, with model aliases, usage statistics and scheduled credit automation.

items.name: dsh-subagent-role-router
items.desc: Route DSH subagent delegations to configured models with per-role routing for explore, plan and patch subagents, round-robin or random distribution, cross-provider failover, and active-window slicing of fork seeds.

items.name: dsh-model-auto-enricher
items.desc: Model channel auto-enricher for DeepSeek Harness: eliminates manually configuring contextWindow, maxTokens, \[text, image] multimodal input, and {low, high, max} reasoning effort tiers model by model after adding a provider channel, with live auto-enrichment on save, a Settings UI page, and timestamped backups.

items.name: dsh-llm-opencode-go
items.desc: OpenCode Go in the DeepSeek Harness model list, providing subscription quota display, model discovery, session affinity, and more.

items.name: dsh-multi-model-discussion
items.desc: Multi-model deliberation pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: independent proposals, blind peer review, program-executed evidence verification, immutable revision and independent acceptance on a fresh context.

items.name: dsh-opencode-zen-plugin
items.desc: OpenCode Console (Zen) models for DeepSeek Harness: paste a Console API key under Settings → Plugins and the Console's chat models become selectable, with the catalog synced automatically, each model routed to the endpoint the official docs assign, and free *-free models hidden by default because they only run inside the OpenCode client.

items.name: dsh-switch
items.desc: Mirrors cc-switch providers and models into DeepSeek Harness the moment they are saved, and shows each provider's plan windows, account balance, or custom usage script in the composer and the settings card.

items.name: dsh-antigravity-oauth
items.desc: Unofficial Gemini Cloud Code Assist OAuth integration with isolated account storage; carries account-ban risk.

items.name: dsh-model-fusion
items.desc: Adds a model route where a Lead plans and reviews while a Sidekick performs code changes.

items.name: dsh-oauth-login
items.desc: Adds subscription OAuth and provider Plan API-key logins through Pi adapters, using a DSH-owned credential store.

items.name: dsh-openai-oauth
items.desc: Connect a ChatGPT account to Codex models in DeepSeek Harness through browser PKCE or device-code OAuth, with automatic token refresh and Web or headless login.

items.name: dsh-0-tools
items.desc: One-click free-model setup for DSH web, built for coding beginners: one-click installer for Windows (install.bat) and macOS/Linux (install.sh, v1.7.0+); four permanently free channels — Zhipu GLM (text + image), SiliconFlow (Qwen3-8B plus 15+ sub-9B models), iFlytek Spark Lite and the OpenRouter free pool, which routes through openrouter/auto and picks from a pool that changes over time; bottom-left setup hint hides once any free model is connected; real-time DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing reminder; bundled beginner help center.

items.name: dsh-model
items.desc: One authenticated OpenAI-compatible endpoint (built on CLIProxyAPI) for dsh and other tools: gathers WorkBuddy, OpenCode Zen, local Ollama / LM Studio and CLI subscriptions such as Codex and Kimi, signs in from the dsh page without installing their CLIs, and syncs the picked models into dsh grouped by source. The settings page has a switch per source with free / paid tags, plan usage, API keys with 24-hour stats, per-source model picking, and update / uninstall. Runs on macOS, Linux (including next to dsh-vps) and Windows.

items.name: dsh-ark-coding-provider
items.desc: Unofficial Volcengine Ark Coding Plan LLM provider: registers an `ark-coding` route with 12 models (capacity facts measured per model), multi-account with automatic rotation, a bundled pinned arkcli for the official model catalog and live plan quota, plus a settings wizard and a sidebar usage card.

items.name: dsh-harness-switch
items.desc: Adds Kimi models to native DSH sessions with per-model selection of the embedded Kimi core or DSH native execution.

items.name: dsh-agy-link
items.desc: Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DSH — streaming chat with Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions, native tool cards, thinking turns, and in-GUI Google OAuth login.

items.name: dsh-model-manager
items.desc: Control panel for local LLM inference servers in the DSH web view: service registry with health checks and stop controls, named parameter profiles for llama.cpp, SGLang and vLLM with pre-save KV/VRAM validation, GPU detection, and tok/s benchmarks.

items.name: dsh-anthropic-membership
items.desc: Sign in to DeepSeek Harness with a Claude Pro/Max membership (no API key), downscale Anthropic request images to a 2000px long edge, slim /compact summarizer payloads, and show 5-hour/weekly plan usage plus DSH message counts.

items.name: dsh-codearts-auth
items.desc: Signs in to Huawei Cloud CodeArts and registers CodeBuddy, WorkBuddy, LobsterAI, Qoder (global and China), TRAE, Cline, Loomy, Raccoon Work, MiniMax Code, TeleAgent, ZCode, Step Code and Antigravity as LLM providers, with per-provider account pools; several of them also show quota balance and daily check-in in the same panel.

items.name: dsh-mimo-connect
items.desc: Brings the models included in the Xiaomi MiMo desktop app (free during beta) into DeepSeek Harness, with zero configuration in the DSH conversation window.

items.name: dsh-model-channel-manager
items.desc: Model channel manager: several provider/model candidates share one virtual route (roundrobin/<group>) with failover, retry, timeout and cooldown; a settings tab edits providers and groups, runs per-model speed tests and real single-model request tests, and a seven-day health panel aggregates latency, failures and upstream token usage (input, output, cache and reasoning).

items.name: liquid-dsh-plugin
items.desc: Adds the Liquid Inference auction exchange as a model route, with liquid.auto and its ranking variants, and four tools that read offers, markets, routers and job receipts. Requires a Liquid Inference API key (LIQUID_API_KEY, spend scope).

items.name: dsh-ollama-cloud
items.desc: Ollama Cloud provider for DeepSeek Harness that configures the route on install, publishes each model's own thinking levels for the composer effort control, and shows account usage with an API-key field in the Models page and sidebar.

items.name: reasoning-setup
items.desc: Edit reasoning effort levels and thinking formats for models that declare none.

items.name: dsh-reasoning-effort-new
items.desc: Fork of dsh-reasoning-effort with a two-level model picker in the composer: a provider list, a model pane that slides out beside it, search, and compact rows, alongside the reasoning-effort slider and its max-level effects.

items.name: dsh-codex-harness
items.desc: Codex-shaped coding tools and agent presets for GPT models on DeepSeek Harness: exec_command, write_stdin, apply_patch and view_image, plus OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses API routes, bridged to DSH-native plan, ask, approval and compaction. Long-running commands become DSH background jobs with bounded head/tail output readable through job_output, and each subagent type can be pinned to its own preset, provider, model and reasoning effort.

items.name: dsh-llm-api-pool
items.desc: Pools several OpenCode Go API keys and hot-switches each request to the least-used one, with official usage and balance lookup plus a graphical settings page.

items.name: dsh-chatgpt-subscription
items.desc: Adds native Codex OAuth sign-in, main-Agent default model selection, and direct or local-proxy settings for DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on Windows.

items.name: dsh-multi-model-orchestrator
items.desc: Multi-model orchestrator: the main brain decomposes complex tasks and dispatches subtasks to GLM / Kimi / Qwen sub-agents by each model's strengths, with per-model token usage.

items.name: dsh-proactive
items.desc: Proactive multi-model scheduling plugin: multi-source signal intake with dedup and urgency ranking, a four-way execute/defer/dismiss/ask-user decision engine, DAG plan generation with parallel model execution, quality reflection with automatic retry and model switch, long-term memory for task patterns and lessons, and strategy evolution via genetic algorithms with sandboxed evaluation and canary rollout.

items.name: dsh-model-router
items.desc: Rule-based multi-provider model routing for DeepSeek Harness with pre-first-token failover, cooldown circuit-breaking, usage accounting, and a status API.

items.name: dsh-magpie-connect
items.desc: Magpie gateway provider for DSH: syncs gateway models into the picker with visibility control, image input and thinking levels.

items.name: owndsh#owndsh-plugin
items.desc: Early-stage plugin connecting DeepSeek Harness to a separately deployed, self-hosted OwnDsh server for team identity, model access control, quotas, and usage auditing.

items.name: dsh-openrouter-live
items.desc: OpenRouter provider that reads the live /models list, so new models appear without a harness release: models sorted by name with input/output prices, per-model reasoning levels, image input, reasoning_details replay, Anthropic prompt caching, and actual spend per session including subagents from OpenRouter usage.cost, shown under the Web UI composer and by /cost.

items.name: dsh-codex-oauth
items.desc: Adds a Codex sign-in page to DSH settings, driving the built-in llm-pi-ai OAuth flow for browser or device-code login and showing masked account status without a separate provider or credential store.

items.name: dsh-router
items.desc: An AI routing gateway that runs as a DSH plugin. Adds a Routing System sidebar panel for suppliers, account pool, fallback combos and API keys, and serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at http://localhost:3080/v1.

items.name: dsh-router-codebuddy
items.desc: CodeBuddy supplier plugin for dsh-router. Handles one account at a time with polling OAuth login and token refresh, leaving account selection, cooldown and check-in to dsh-router core.

items.name: dsh-router-traework
items.desc: TRAE SOLO supplier plugin for dsh-router, ported from traework2api. Provides the traework supplier, a free SOLO chat channel, and reports single-account status to dsh-router core.

items.name: dsh-bifenggang
items.desc: Time-based model routing: a settings panel defines weekday peak and off-peak windows and the provider/model each one uses, the choices are read from the harness registry (API keys and subscription logins alike), and a global switch decides whether that policy sets the model and reasoning effort of every request. The switch is independent per session, each session row carries a light showing its own state, and the settings panel names the model in force right now and why. A day no window matches — every weekend and holiday — uses the primary model of the first plan; the advanced thinking model is a separate axis, used only when a session itself asks for max reasoning.

items.name: deepseek-harness-plugin
items.desc: Adds configurable reasoning levels for third-party models and a model-strength picker in the composer.

items.name: dsh-hyperworkbuddy
items.desc: Bring the WorkBuddy accounts signed in on this machine into DSH, managing CN and international accounts separately. Supports automatic failover between accounts, one-click refresh of model catalogs and credits, the CN daily check-in, and a togglable OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

items.name: dsh-newapi-video
items.desc: Call a new-api (one-api style) relay station's video model from the conversation with @-referenced image/video materials, supporting Seedance 2.0 and Happyhorse text-to-video and image-to-video across four relay protocols.

items.name: dsh-workbuddy-trae-qoder-connect
items.desc: One DSH plugin that aggregates the models of WorkBuddy (personal multi-account, enterprise and the WorkBuddy AI international edition), Qoder CN and Trae CN into a single model picker with a shared conversation history, live credit multipliers, per-model reasoning effort, the largest context window the international edition declares, and daily check-in where the channel offers one.

items.name: dsh-wtq-pool
items.desc: Brings the WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder desktop logins on this machine into DeepSeek Harness as OpenAI-compatible local endpoints, with an account pool, automatic account switching when WorkBuddy is rate limited, and a settings panel.

items.name: dsh-model-rotator
