items.desc: Keeps notes as local Markdown files grouped by directory under a root folder you choose, with a sidebar page, AGENTS-style rule files surfaced as writing context, and six agent tools.

items.name: agent-feedback-loop#agent-feedback-loop-dsh
items.desc: Feeds every dsh prompt into the local agent-feedback-loop feedback-memory pipeline — captures dissatisfaction, reviews it offline into reflections, and attaches the compiled recurrence-rule context back to the turn, never blocking a prompt. Requires the agent-feedback-loop runtime; running agent-feedback-loop install afterwards wires existing dsh profiles automatically.

items.name: dsh-memos-bridge
items.desc: Bridges the MemOS memory service over MCP: the agent gets add/search/update/delete memory, multi-cube sharing, and a memory scheduler as mcp__memos__* tools.

items.name: dsh-context-control
items.desc: A context usage ring with configurable character-based automatic compaction, manual compaction, protected user requirements and recoverable original history for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.

items.name: dsh-akn-plugin
items.desc: Local-first Agent Experience Network for DeepSeek Harness, distilling task-level experiences from traces and live manifests, grading by H0-H4 evidence, discovering by compatibility, and promoting only after explicit review.

items.name: dsh-linghun-memory
items.desc: A memory subsystem for DeepSeek Harness: full ontological memory (event/fact/rule three-ontology) plus a goal system (goal.js) — belief values written via Bridge trigger words, goal activation scored at read time (0.25 domain + 0.35 bridge + 0.40 sim) to recover goal/value long-range associations, journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay, memory_append/read/consolidate plus linghun_goal_update/get/state closed loop. Independent of the original dsh-linghun line. 16/16 on LoCoMo-Plus.

items.name: tabilet-skills
items.desc: Shared engineering skills, a read-only memory-bank dashboard with stages and SQLite audit browsing, and workflow request previews for DSH.

items.name: dsh-long-memory
items.desc: Cross-session long-term memory: a hybrid-retrieval memory store (BM25 plus CJK bigrams), chunked long-document search, chat-log extraction and distillation, and context-summary archiving and browsing, with important memories and the latest summaries auto-injected into the prompt.

items.name: dsh-session-notebook
items.desc: Notes taken from DeepSeek Harness conversations: quotes whole replies or selected passages, keeps highlights rendered at their original position in the session, attaches editable Markdown notes, tags them, filters by workspace or session, and exports Markdown or a full JSON backup stored as local JSON files.

items.name: dsh-trilogy
items.desc: Per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness. Three Markdown files per workspace — PROJECT.md, DECISIONS.md and SESSIONS.md — are auto-created on the first step of any session in that workspace, re-read from disk and re-injected only when they change (and re-injected if compaction dropped them), and written back by classification through a memory_checkpoint tool, with a bounded end-of-turn nudge when a turn did work but recorded nothing. memory_read and memory_search read the live log and the archive, the latter over a zero-dependency BM25 index. The session log is capped at 200 entries with the overflow moved to SESSIONS-archive.md — never injected, but visible, readable and searchable, and restorable one entry at a time. Settings page: a workspace list with a path filter, read-only tabs for the three memory files plus the archive, reload, export/import of one workspace's memory as a JSON bundle, a two-step clear, a panel that rewrites or removes the AGENTS.md instruction block, and a PROJECT.md staleness reminder. A composer status chip shows that workspace's sync state and creates the files on click. Zero dependencies — no vector store, no embeddings, and no model calls.

items.name: dsh-self-evolution
items.desc: Bounded self-managed long-term memory (Hermes-style MEMORY.md / USER.md with hard character limits and a safety scan), a review that runs after every turn and writes plain-language notes or refines an existing skill instead of adding a near-duplicate, a curator that finds and surgically repairs skills the loader would silently discard, cross-session search over past messages, and a learning card above the composer that appears only when there is news and asks before it deletes or rewords a memory.

items.name: dsh-ltm
items.desc: Local SQLite long-term memory with CJK-aware search, BM25 and character n-gram cosine reranking, deduplication, and lifecycle management.

items.name: mosaic-memory-compress
items.desc: Forgetting-curve in-place dialogue compression for DeepSeek Harness: recent turns stay verbatim, middle turns are structurally dehydrated (zero-LLM), ancient turns fold into a bounded summary pair — unbounded conversations on a bounded memory budget.

items.name: dsh-relationship
items.desc: Local relationship-memory workbench with a confirmation gate: every AI write — extracted memories and newly created contacts alike — lands in a pending queue until the user confirms it in the GUI; materials are archived verbatim with quote-level provenance checks on AI extraction, and confirmed memories aggregate into per-contact timelines, gift occasions and reciprocity views. Ships a native relationship agent preset for conversation capture; JSON storage by default with an optional SQLite backend, zero production dependencies.

items.name: dsh-llm-wiki-plugin#dsh-llm-wiki
items.desc: An Obsidian-style knowledge base: ingest sources, let the LLM build and maintain an interlinked wiki, and ask questions grounded in it.

items.name: dsh-plugin-save-token
items.desc: Reversible context slimming for DeepSeek Harness: TOON-style lossless tabular re-encoding of uniform JSON arrays, stride-sampled table windows with line numbers, and cross-turn dedup for repeated tool output; every replacement passes a byte-plus-token gate (≤72% bytes, strictly fewer estimated tokens) and the original is spilled to disk behind a `[save-token #id]` notice retrievable in one call via the `save_token_expand` tool, with billed and avoided token metering on a settings dashboard.

items.name: deja-vu#extensions/dsh
items.desc: Reads the session files thirty-three other coding agents on this machine already wrote — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code Copilot Chat, opencode, OpenClaw, Hermes, Kimi, Cline, Zed and more — including sessions from before it was installed: six tools (deja_recall, deja_session, deja_blame, deja_fix, deja_how, deja_remember), a /deja command, and optional automatic recall added to the runtime context. Local BM25 index, no LLM, no embeddings, no network (dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deja).

items.name: dsh-anima-rag
items.desc: Anima-style vector memory for DSH: injects retrieved historical summaries into the system prompt each turn, exposes an anima_query semantic-search tool, and isolates the vector store per playthrough. SiliconFlow embeddings sent as array-shaped requests; timeouts and provider errors surface as honest, classified notes in the injection slot — never silent.

items.name: dsh-memory-archive
items.desc: RP memory built on pmp tavern: RP history summaries ride the native compaction pipeline, with plain tool sessions kept out of the way. Full recall requires the downstream anima plugin. Requires the plugin-provided roleplay preset to be enabled.

items.name: dsh-xia-plugins#packages/gameassist-memory
items.desc: Single-file persistent companion memory: interests, preferences, tasks, and past works summarized into the system prompt, with read/update tools.

items.name: dsh-mirror
items.desc: Make the AI remember how you think, not what you said: actively captures your principles, redlines, and working habits across sessions — with memory capacity, graceful decay, and human-readable reasoning for every entry. 0.7.0 brings an intuitive persona portrait with evidence tracing.

items.name: context-razor
items.desc: Context trimmer: lists the current session's context entries with role, preview and ≈token estimate (cl100k), highlights over-threshold items, and removes selected entries exactly without LLM summarization.

items.name: hermes-loop
items.desc: Automatic session retrospective: after a conversation wraps up, distills useful experience into reusable skills stored in the skill library for the model to call, with signal-accelerated triggers, manual runs, an approval mode, and skill-library governance (archive/restore, never deletes directly).

items.name: dsh-logseq
items.desc: Syncs Logseq 2.0 DB graphs (including E2EE) with a Logseq sync server via the headless Logseq CLI, adds 11 logseq_* tools to search, query and edit them, and a Settings section to log in and configure sync.

items.name: dsh-dev-progress-memory
items.desc: Per-turn development progress memory: completed turns are classified into date-indexed Markdown files under doc/progress/ with a maintained INDEX.md, system-level bugs are kept in a cross-project SYSTEM_MEMORY.md and re-injected on error keywords, and a progress_read tool loads full documents on demand.

items.name: dsh-memory-file
items.desc: File-backed memory: injects your own Markdown memory file at each session start, adds read/write tools with backup and undo, and reports DSH_HOME drift. Reads no conversations by default; an opt-in autoScan switch surfaces your own recent lines from local session logs. Never opens a network connection.

items.name: dsh-seed-society
items.desc: Memory consolidation tuning for dsh-mneme (autoDream enabled, schema-max output budget, deepseek-chat route) plus the llm-deepseek reasoning-effort fix, an MCP bridge to the auditable seed-society agent runtime, and six yogacara seed skills.

items.name: mylife
items.desc: A local-first personal state record and decision engine for dsh: keeps every input byte-for-byte with line-level provenance, argues against its own conclusions by generating defeaters first, ages each stored fact with its own TTL, and reports where a decision rests on nothing at all.

items.name: dsh-company-kb
items.desc: Local-folder knowledge base for DSH: builds a SQLite FTS5 index over Office, text, PDF and scanned files, ships five tools (kb_search / kb_read / kb_list / kb_status / kb_session) plus a Web panel, and retrieves or syncs only when the user explicitly asks.

items.name: dsh-memory-lite
items.desc: Read-only enhancer for a file-based long-term memory library (markdown cards in git): a memory_find search tool, a small budgeted memory digest injected into the system prompt, and a settings page with library overview, health-check status and toggles.

items.name: dsh-openviking-manager
items.desc: Configuration UI for the official OpenViking memory plugin: connection and user-key setup, local connection diagnostics, a per-session memory toggle in the composer, memory isolation that keeps recall inside the current topic, and recall tuning for score threshold, injected item count, query expansion and excluded URIs.

items.name: minta#dsh-plugin
items.desc: DSH-native integration layer for the Minta memory engine: composes the official dsh-mcp-client row, registers the minta-memory-governance skill plus a session-start memory prewarm, and ships a Minta agent preset; requires the separately deployed Minta engine (Python/Docker) to provide the 19 MCP tools - not usable without it.

items.name: dsh-user-memory
items.desc: User-authored long-term memory in four tiers (must-follow rules, behavior settings, user profile, optional rules), injected as a system-prompt section, with agent tools to propose edits and a Chinese panel where the user reviews and applies them.

items.name: dsh-skill-manager
items.desc: View and delete persistent skill memory from the DSH sidebar.

items.name: dsh-memory-vault
items.desc: SQLite-backed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: add, search, update and archive entries with categories and tags, automatic conversation logging, tiered compression, and a project dimension that scopes retrieval to the current workspace plus global facts.

items.name: dsh-knj-obsidian
items.desc: Built-in Obsidian-style knowledge base for DSH: agents distill conversations, documents and web sources into a structured .wiki graph, with retrieval, graph export, note editing, incremental builds and multi-vault management.

items.name: dsh-powercontext
items.desc: PowerContext for DeepSeek Harness: WorkBuddy-style project memory and inspectable handoff workflows - bounded context recall before each model step, 19 pc_* tools for memory, handoff, experience and skills, with a Windows server watchdog for resident operation.

items.name: dsh-living-memoir
items.desc: Cross-session memory kept as a short Markdown living document that is rewritten in full at the end of every turn, written to by model tools, the page, and automatic rewriting alike.

items.name: dsh-engramory-recall
items.desc: Local BM25 auto-recall, a fail-closed write guard, a static doctor and a memory panel for an Engramory markdown store. No network, no daemon and no model calls unless you opt in; recall quality is measured by a reproducible benchmark in the repository.

items.name: dsh-cc-haha-dream
items.desc: Background memory consolidation (auto dream) for DeepSeek Harness: periodically reviews recent sessions and existing memories to dedupe, refresh stale entries, remove contradictions and rebuild the MEMORY.md index, with hybrid/volume auto triggers, /dream command and a settings-panel config card.

items.name: dsh-cc-haha-memory
items.desc: Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: memory read/write/retrieve tools, per-turn auto-recording, project-scoped recall injection and a management UI, with non-destructive Claude Code memory import.

items.name: dsh-learn-skills
items.desc: DSH plugin: a four-entry learning flow in the session input bar — scaffold a preset, collect candidates, merge reviewed changes, and run a read-only workspace audit.

items.name: dsh-memory-plugin
items.desc: Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness with curated facts, automatic turn retention, and graph- and vector-ranked recall.

items.name: dsh-decision-log
items.desc: Decision log for DeepSeek Harness: record key decisions (chosen option + why) into a versionable DECISIONS.md via decision_log / decision_list / decision_audit tools, and auto-inject the summary into future sessions so decisions stay traceable and are never re-litigated.

items.name: dsh-env-profile
items.desc: Global experience archive for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: probes local tools (with versions and PATH-first hits), convenient paths, network latency and disk speed; folds per-session stats from session/event; LLM-extracts durable facts; env_profile tool with remember; byte-stable summary injected every turn to speed up sessions and cut token use.

items.name: dsh-memory-snapshot
items.desc: Injects your existing markdown documents (notes, rules, knowledge-base files) into every dsh session's system prompt as read-only memory — list file or directory paths in `files`; no database, no service, no write path; UTF-8 byte-budgeted truncation with line-boundary fallback, total budget, YAML front-matter stripping, and freshness timestamps.

items.name: dsh-memvault
items.desc: Bridges DSH to a local MemVault store: core memory blocks injected into the system prompt, finished turns extracted through MemVault's own pipeline, and a panel to browse, trace, review and replay what was stored.

items.name: dsh-mega-plugins#dsh-memo
items.desc: Week-keyed personal memo service: stores entries in ISO-week tables, resolves week/month/quarter/year navigation from one period calendar, archives quarters, runs AI analysis and Markdown report export, requires an explicit force flag to edit a past week, and turns one suite-wide telemetry failure analysis into a GitHub issue report.

items.name: dsh-plugin-thread
items.desc: Decision-and-goal memory with lineage: explicit commands and a model tool record decisions deterministically, a status card re-anchors them across compaction, a lossless event stream with BM25+jieba retrieval backs it, and a scenario-level fidelity regression suite gates releases.

items.name: dsh-flomo-report
items.desc: Generate AI-narrated DSH session reports (daily/weekly/monthly, any date range) and sync them to flomo (浮墨笔记) with one configurable tag (default #write/dsh) and automatic # stripping, via a web settings panel with daily reminder.

items.name: dsh-memory-system
items.desc: Local-first persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: bounded pre-step hot-memory injection, exact and Chinese-bigram BM25 cold recall, six agent tools, approval-gated lease-lock writes with recovery receipts, and read-only governance and trajectory-review candidates.

items.name: memsearch#memsearch
items.desc: Shared Markdown memory for DSH and other coding agents, with automatic capture, pre-step context injection, searchable recall, and memory-to-skill self-evolution through a review panel.

items.name: dsh-ecolink#adapter
items.desc: DSH side of the dsh-ecolink memory ecosystem: bridges chat.deepseek.com and DeepSeek Harness through a browser extension that harvests DSM-format memory tags and injects recalled memories into web chats, a zero-dependency local service that writes a shared memory pool, and this adapter, which injects memories pre-step and offers /ecolink-push write-back; compression is transactional (staging pool with commit/rollback).

items.name: dsh-openclaw-memory
items.desc: Share an existing OpenClaw Markdown workspace with DeepSeek Harness as bounded persona and memory context, with Sidebar browsing and editing.

items.name: dsh-crypto-portfolio
items.desc: Self-hosted crypto portfolio dashboard: BTC, EVM (73 chains via DeBank), Solana, Dogecoin, Cardano, Hyperliquid L1, five exchanges (Binance, Bybit, Backpack, OKX, Bitget) and tokenised equities in one view, with multi-provider failover, custom asset labels, a tunable asset-health report, a shareable PNG card, per-source connection tests, multi-profile configs, scheduled refresh and zero-dependency charts (Python stdlib + vanilla JS, no CDN).

items.name: dsh-mysql
items.desc: MySQL connector for DeepSeek Harness: configure multiple connections in the settings page with per-connection table allowlist and write permission, switch the active connection from the composer, and expose mysql_query / mysql_tables / mysql_execute tools to every agent preset.

items.name: ai-residue-cleaner
items.desc: Sweeps AI byproducts (scratch files, backups, logs, caches) into a reversible trash per project, and on project close classifies deliverables, archives reference results and writes a cleanup report. Requires Python 3 on PATH (the cleanup engine is a Python script; python3 / python / py are auto-detected, and without one cleanup cannot run and says so).

items.name: dsh-media-studio
items.desc: Generate images and videos directly in chat and deliver them to the conversation: generate_image / generate_video / send_media tools, a built-in Agnes free tier plus any OpenAI-compatible backend, background jobs that auto-push finished media, and inline gallery and video cards with download, lightbox, and native open.

items.name: dsh-redstone-music
items.desc: Minecraft redstone music: rm_render renders instrument samples from a SoundFont and aligns every onset to within 3 ms, and rm_build compiles a song plus lane table into a datapack of scheduled mcfunction shards (optionally deployed over RCON).

items.name: dsh-plugin-nlbi
items.desc: Natural-language data queries + BI reports: Text2SQL, charts, report saving, schema/data grid panel, and a sidebar workbench — all behind DSH's MySQL connection layer.

items.name: dsh-desktop-uia
items.desc: Windows desktop control through UI Automation: nine tools that read a window control tree and drive elements by id through their own UI Automation patterns, with every write gated by an approval policy, an append-only action log and a settings panel.

items.name: dsh-armory
items.desc: Unified MCP, skill and expert management board for DeepSeek Harness: connection status, tool schemas, enable/disable and reconnect for MCP servers across global and per-project scopes, enable/disable of SKILL.md skills, attach/switch/detach WorkBuddy expert personas in any conversation at any time (429 experts) with no mid-session preset lock, a tool tailor that scans local session logs for per-tool call counts, error rates and context-token cost with one-click disabling, and three install markets (SkillHub 190k+ skills, WorkBuddy connectors, 47 verified built-in services).

items.name: dsh-obsidian-board
items.desc: Turns a local Obsidian vault into a dedicated RAG chat panel: a sidebar page with the note browser, the retrieval-augmented chat and the cited source side by side, answering from fully local BM25 plus CJK-bigram retrieval over your notes and streaming through the DSH model channel, with clickable \[n] citations and mtime-based incremental indexing.

items.name: dsh-feishu
items.desc: Creates and edits Feishu and Lark cloud content through ten tools - Bitable databases and their records, documents with Markdown converted to native blocks, spreadsheets, wikis, drive files and messages - plus Base V3 dashboard charts and server-side aggregate queries.

items.name: feishu-dsh-plugin
items.desc: Feishu (Lark) integration for DeepSeek Harness: 25 tools for chat messages and history, cloud documents (including knowledge-base pages, generated charts and images), bitable records, spreadsheet ranges and drive permissions, using your own enterprise self-built Feishu app.

items.name: 3chatai-deepseek-harness-plugin
items.desc: Connect DeepSeek Harness to 3Chat via OAuth for customer and conversation search, context retrieval, confirmed messaging, and batch-send tracking.

items.name: dsh-search
items.desc: Web search, page fetch and one-call research through DeepSeek's official Search and Fetch API; needs a DeepSeek API key.

items.name: dsh-zspace
items.desc: Turns a ZSpace (极空间) NAS into native agent tools: list, stat, search, read, download, upload, write, create folders, rename, move, copy and delete files on the NAS. Works across networks through the desktop client relay — no LAN, no WebDAV, no SSH — and switches to the faster direct WebDAV transport automatically when the NAS is on the same network. Deletes require an explicit confirm: true; write, upload, create-folder, rename, move and copy run directly, and zspace_write overwrites a same-named file unless overwrite is false.

items.name: dsh-plugin-veriscope
items.desc: Release gate for AI answer quality. Two channels: replay an existing VeriScope archive through the original Python quality gate, or run a threshold gate over a Ragas per-row export with Node only — no VeriScope, Python or pandas. Returns PASS, FAIL or REVIEW with source evidence and a re-checkable receipt; supports per-row thresholds and exact decimal comparison. It never re-evaluates and never calls a model, and REVIEW never becomes PASS.

items.name: dsh-sciwork
items.desc: A research library panel and skill set for DSH: project folders, figures with registered provenance, drafts, references, data tables, journal profiles and submissions, plus writing, citation and Origin-plotting discipline for research agents.

items.name: dsh-douyin-publish
items.desc: Take a local video all the way to a Douyin creator post: open the upload page, trigger the picker, hand the file over with verification, fill the title, set visibility - then stop before publishing unless explicitly told to publish.

items.name: dsh-file-handover
items.desc: Hand a local file to any program's file picker: wait for the native Open dialog, paste the path through the clipboard, read it back to verify character by character, then confirm. The target is always explicit and every step leaves evidence. Windows only (EnumWindows / UI Automation).

items.name: dsh-gui-guard
items.desc: Windows GUI automation reliability layer: probes whether a window is minimized, foreground or DPI-scaled, then clicks and types with the coordinate space and activation order handled for you. Zero dependencies, local only.

items.name: dsh-lighthouse
items.desc: One screen for every work you have shipped: local project facts, GitHub stars and last push, whether the plugin market has picked it up and how many downloads it has, plus pending pull-request wait times against the upstream median.

items.name: dsh-restart-planner
items.desc: Let the agent restart its own DSH host: schedule a self-restart, finish the turn first, then a detached helper stops and relaunches the app and reports what happened. Dry-run, a status check, and an optional "when can I blink" confirmation are built in.

items.name: dsh-slipway
items.desc: Ship a local DSH plugin project to GitHub and the plugin market in one call: preflight, per-file upload with byte verification, the market registry PR, then pull every published file back and compare bytes.

items.name: dsh-a11y-scan
items.desc: Native WCAG accessibility scanner: runs axe-core over local HTML files / build output / URLs and reports violations (rule id, impact, WCAG 2.1 mapping, element targeting, fix suggestions) as Markdown/HTML/JSON. Read-only, CI-able.

items.name: dsh-asciinema
items.desc: Record terminal/tool output as asciinema v2 (.cast), replay with an offline embedded player, and export HTML.

items.name: dsh-dep-vuln-scan
items.desc: Scan project lockfiles (npm/pnpm/yarn/pip/go/cargo/maven/gradle/...) against the free OSV API and report confirmed dependency vulnerabilities with fix versions and remediation commands.

items.name: dsh-invoice-tools
items.desc: Parse Chinese e-invoice PDFs (XML attachment first, text-layer regex fallback) into structured JSON with amount cross-check, and generate expense reports (Markdown / xlsx).

items.name: dsh-mcp-tunnel
items.desc: Expose a local MCP server to remote agents through an outbound-only tunnel stack (mcp-proxy + cloudflared Quick Tunnel), then register the public URL into dsh-mcp-client streamable-http config.

items.name: dsh-pr-description
items.desc: Analyze the current branch diff and generate a Conventional Commits PR title, motivation/scheme/testing/risk description and a self-review checklist, write PR_DESCRIPTION.md, optionally open the PR via gh.

items.name: dsh-receipts
items.desc: Mine local DSH session logs (JSONL) into personal usage & impact receipts: Markdown day/week/month reports plus a self-contained HTML receipt, cross-referenced with local git log — zero-network, privacy-first.

items.name: dsh-waste-market
items.desc: A-share market dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: realtime market indices, stock screener with 13 technical signals and multi-strategy intersection, 7×24 multi-source news aggregation, watchlist with group management, market sentiment thermometer (limit-up ladder, breadth), K-line charts with MA/EXPMA/BOLL overlays, and sector/limit-up/longhu rankings.

items.name: dsh-cuadrive-mac
items.desc: macOS computer-use tools backed by a plugin-owned Cua Driver runtime.

items.name: dsh-ai-armor
items.desc: Five production-grade DSH tools bundled into one plugin (8 tool slots total): git regression finder (find introducer, recent changes, bisect, blame age), stack-trace decoder with local code context, YAML/ENV/properties config validator with typo suggestions, cross-platform shell escape (POSIX/PowerShell/cmd), and MyBatis Plus SQL static auditor (N+1, missing @Transactional, LIKE leading %, SELECT *, missing WHERE). Zero npm dependencies, all offline and concurrency-safe.

items.name: dsh-weknora-archive
items.desc: Archive DeepSeek Harness sessions into a self-hosted WeKnora knowledge base with extraction, summarization and incremental dedup.

items.name: fuxux-claude-plugin#dsh-fuxux
items.desc: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Fuxux over MCP: list connected social media accounts and draft, schedule or publish posts to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Discord, Kick and Twitch; adds a fuxux workflow skill.

items.name: dsh-quick-launch
items.desc: One-click create, update or remove the DeepSeek Harness desktop shortcut with switchable custom icons and a draggable whale button.

items.name: dsh-mcptoon
items.desc: Mounts the mcptoon MCP gateway as one stdio server, so the agent discovers the tools of every MCP server you have configured through mcptoon's compressed view instead of full JSON schemas on each turn. Ships a doctor CLI that checks the mcptoon executable resolves and prints the exact command/args override when it does not.

items.name: dsh-vercel
items.desc: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the official Vercel MCP server over OAuth, with per-Agent on-demand tool loading, slimmed tool schemas, paged long results and 34 bundled Vercel skills.

items.name: dsh-graft-plugin
items.desc: Shows which graft index a dsh session is serving and whether it still matches the code, and gives the model graft_ask, graft_grep, graft_callers, graft_skeleton and graft_map as native tools.

items.name: dsh-plugin-adwhispr
items.desc: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the AdWhispr remote MCP server through mcp-remote with browser OAuth sign-in, adding tools for competitor ad research, ad creative cloning, and launching and managing Meta, Google and TikTok campaigns. Requires an AdWhispr account.

items.name: aurify#bundle-patent
items.desc: Patent-writing gatekeeper for dsh - screens the idea against Chinese prior art first, then runs five-party alignment interviews, eight-chapter disclosure drafting, figures and simulation runs, seven-dimension review and docx/PDF export. Skills work out of the box; the search, export and experiment tools come from a bundled Python MCP service that ships disabled - one line in ~/.dsh/patent-services.yaml enables it, and uvx fetches the wheel from PyPI.

items.name: dsh-ark9canvas
items.desc: Image generation workbench and agent tool for DSH: one tool (ark9_generate_image) paints text-to-image and image-to-image via any OpenAI-compatible API. Channels are entirely user-configured - no bundled endpoint, you bring your own baseURL, key and model name (manual input supported). Agent-initiated generations are approval-gated by default: requests queue in the floating panel and nothing bills until you approve; approval is non-blocking (the agent replies "awaiting your approval" immediately, and results, denials or timeouts are injected back so the agent reports them in the next turn). Floating glass workbench with five tabs (Generate / Approvals / Prompts / History / About), aspect-ratio grid with quality-budget + 16px-alignment sizing, transparent background, batch up to 10 images as aggregated sub-tasks, prompt library with custom JSON sources fetched through a host proxy, persistent generation logs with one-click retry, multi-channel aggregation with per-channel model fetching, bilingual UI (zh/en), stroke-SVG icon set, config import/export. Registers as a Better Sidebar tab when dsh-better-sidebar is installed; stacks above the dsh-cua FAB when both are present.

items.name: dsh-cua-pre
items.desc: Windows desktop automation for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility-first observe/act loop with 30 standard tools (element/coordinate targets, auto/a11y/event strategy routing), superseded-observations and no-replay safety semantics, persistent kill switch, RuntimeId/rect-drift stale protection, chat cards and a floating panel (live ops, frame wall, env auto-detect settings), tiled vision describe for low-res models, JSONL audit trail and a pid allowlist. Requires Windows 10+ and Python 3.9+ with uiautomation and pillow (installable from the settings page).

items.name: dsh-literature
items.desc: Self-contained literature library for DSH with optional Zotero export: full-text PDF fetching (Unpaywall/arXiv/custom URL templates), loose Crossref-backed search, APA/GB-T 7714/MLA/Chicago citation generation, a side-panel PDF reader with highlights and notes, and AI-assisted Q&A/translation steered into the current conversation.

items.name: dsh-model-failover
items.desc: Model failover router that queues all connected DSH models, retries with continue text on failure, switches to next model, and quarantines failing models for the day.

items.name: ai-courses#package
items.desc: Turns a learning request and local materials into a structured, locally stored AI course with outline, lessons, diagrams and learning progress.

items.name: dsh-vba-bridge
items.desc: Read, edit, export and verify Excel VBA projects through a real Excel COM instance: modules, UserForm code, procedure lists and .frm/.frx exports. Windows only, with desktop Excel installed, Python 3.10+ with pywin32, and AccessVBOM=1.

items.name: dsh-skill-mcp-manager
items.desc: One-stop visual management of DSH Skills & MCP: on-demand MCP loading, in-session hot reload, SKILL & MCP descriptions viewable in the plugin.

items.name: dsh-qianyuan
items.desc: Mount the QianYuan MCP server inside DeepSeek Harness: one config-layer bundle brings 15 agent-record tools (pitfalls, cached results, identity, task board) to mcp__qianyuan__*. No runtime code; reads are anonymous, writes are ed25519-signed.

items.name: dsh-study-coach
items.desc: Study coach for DeepSeek Harness: turns a course into a knowledge map of subject, module and unit, records mastery per unit in six stages, plans daily tasks against a materials index, keeps a wrong-answer book and spaced-repetition cards, and serves its own web panel.

items.name: dsh-cos
items.desc: Adds COS storage browsing and transfers, workspace artifact uploads, temporary links, and conversation attachments that retain local copies with cloud object identity, plus Agent tools for Tencent Cloud COS, CI, and MetaInsight.

items.name: dsh-ca-ref
items.desc: Clean Architecture reference library for DSH: 8 pinned reference repos (Go, Java, C#, Python) indexed into a local FTS5 database, with assertion rules, a review ledger, and a read-only observation panel.

items.name: anysearch-dsh
items.desc: AnySearch-powered real-time web and vertical search provider for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: cst_ai
items.desc: Safe, resumable automation and analysis tools for CST Studio Suite, with task planning, solve-budget control, persistent runs, result extraction, far-field analysis, and parameter sweeps.

items.name: dsh-clock-context
items.desc: Injects the current date and time into the runtime context on every turn, so the agent can read the time instead of inferring it.

items.name: dsh-rea-agents
items.desc: Pinned-version REA for DeepSeek Harness: installs rea-agents locally, starts its MCP server from that pinned copy, and upgrades only when you press Update.

items.name: dsh-workbuddy-websearch
items.desc: Makes the WorkBuddy desktop app's web search the dsh web_search provider, reusing the app's existing sign-in with no extra configuration.

items.name: dsh-computer-use
items.desc: Linux X11 computer use for DeepSeek Harness: 9 tools (screenshot, move/click/drag/scroll mouse, type, key combos) driven by a zero-dependency Python XTest helper — native-pixel coordinates, per-action verification, optional auto-observation screenshot.

items.name: dsh-literature-search
items.desc: Literature search for DeepSeek Harness: pubmed_search, pubmed_paper and pubmed_related over the official NCBI E-utilities (including elink related-article ranking), plus scholar_search and scholar_cite (MLA/APA/Chicago/Harvard/Vancouver/BibTeX via SerpApi). Both backends return one paper shape, and a settings card configures the API keys, the Scholar backend and the rate/result limits.

items.name: dsh-bilibili-video-summary
items.desc: Downloads a Bilibili video with yt-dlp, samples key frames, and transcribes it — from the site subtitles, or from a local faster-whisper install when there are none. Registers the skill the agent uses to write the summary; activates when a user message contains only a video link. Requires yt-dlp and ffmpeg on PATH; transcription needs faster-whisper.

items.name: dsh-rea-toggle
items.desc: One switch that takes an MCP server's tool schemas and its instructions block out of the model context for every agent, live and without a restart, built for the 207 tool schemas REA registers whether or not a task is reverse engineering. A pill in the composer dock, /rea on|off|status|toggle, and GET/POST /rea-toggle/state; the position is remembered across restarts and subagents are covered before their first step.

items.name: travelplanner
items.desc: Trip-planning agent preset for mainland China that answers in Chinese: queries 12306 train availability, Fliggy and Tuniu flight and hotel prices, and real Amap transit routes, checks closures and weather, and delivers a single offline HTML roadbook with draggable maps, three hotel price tiers and an itemized budget. Ships 9 skills, an environment doctor that walks users through missing API keys, and a patch for the 12306 MCP server; it plans and queries but never books or pays.

items.name: dsh-connectors#desktop-connector
items.desc: Windows desktop control connector: through 10 agent tools it captures the screen (including occluded and partially off-screen windows), lists and focuses windows, moves, clicks, drags and scrolls the mouse, and sends key chords or arbitrary Unicode text. Built on koffi FFI: no compiler, no per-call subprocess, and its own GDI screenshot plus PNG encoder.

items.name: dsh-geolibre
items.desc: Render GeoJSON or vector data into an interactive GeoLibre map in a sidebar tab, and let agents operate the live map through tools: layers, styles, view, feature identification, GeoLibre processing algorithms, and the Whitebox toolbox (WASM in the browser).

items.name: dsh-proxy-control
items.desc: Pre-launch and runtime HTTP proxy control: writes the proxy into DSH's user-level .env so the launcher and the requests before any plugin loads use it, then keeps that file in sync from a switch in the Plugins page.

items.name: bailinghub-dsh-plugin
items.desc: Let a local DeepSeek Harness Agent use BailingHub to query data, update records, and run permitted actions in an online store, SaaS, or other admin system.

items.name: meb-dsh#workbench
items.desc: Construction cost workbench for DeepSeek Harness projects.

items.name: dsh-api-client
items.desc: Agent-native API client for DeepSeek Harness: Postman-like debugging UI (request tree with context menus and full keyboard navigation, resizable sidebar, layered auto-generated header preview with per-item suppression and constant secret masking), six api_client_* agent tools sharing the same request core, redaction and audit chain with the human UI, Postman Collection v2.1 import with a migration report, environment variables with SecretRef indirection, and a fail-closed SSRF network policy.

items.name: dsh-nuke-plugin
items.desc: Transactional uninstall engine: every destructive action runs validate/preview/execute/undo with Saga rollback, WAL crash recovery, hash-chain audit, hardlink dedup, and a Bayesian oracle that predicts success probability before you commit.

items.name: dsh-wechat-collector
items.desc: WeChat Official Account source collector: QR-login credential profiles, rate-limit-safe crawling with cooldown, RSS second water source, and secret-safe handoff to ContentStudio.

items.name: dsh-rf-toolkit
items.desc: Six RF calculators as agent tools: level conversion, link budget and maximum range, cascade noise figure, Shannon capacity, and impedance match.

items.name: dsh-jev-adapter
items.desc: Use the Jev (System One) decision-model paradigm with any OpenAI-compatible LLM — no TypeSafe key required. Registers a jev_decide tool that returns probability-distributed answers to typed questions (choice/score/boolean) in one call.

items.name: dsh-guardian#dsh-guardian
items.desc: WebUI panel for the dsh-guardian watchdog: start, stop and inspect two macOS LaunchAgents with status, log tail and explicit failure states.

items.name: dsh-bgjobs
items.desc: Runs commands as background jobs that keep executing when DSH exits, with an optional sandbox to constrain file effects, plus a live web panel and offline CLI/GUI management. Windows only for now.

items.name: dsh-database
items.desc: Connect DeepSeek Harness Web to MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle and MongoDB for schema discovery and read-only queries through session-authorized MCP tools.

items.name: dsh-project-mcp
items.desc: Per-project MCP servers: a project declares servers in its own documents (`.dsh/mcp.json` by default; the local and global file lists are settings), and they are mounted only for the sessions working in that project — on the first turn of a session, released when it goes idle. A right-sidebar tab and a Settings page list each project with a live session, the status of every server and the session holding each mount, with `Sync` / `Retry` / `Release`, an `enabled` switch and an editor over one existing entry; a per-project tool policy (`disclosure` / `direct` / `off`) with pins and `mcp_search_tools` decides what the model sees; `${VAR}` references resolve through the project `.env` files and the credentials file; per-server call counters outlive the sessions that produced them.

items.name: dsh-zcode-farm
items.desc: Multi-instance ComfyUI orchestration: probes every configured ComfyUI endpoint for its GPU, free VRAM and queue depth, then dispatches a generation job to the idlest eligible instance. Ships three tools (comfyui_farm_status, comfyui_farm_pick, comfyui_farm_run). An instance is eligible only if it is reachable, has at least the requested free VRAM, and its queue is no deeper than the configured ceiling; eligible instances are ranked by free VRAM minus queue depth times a weight, so an idle shallow queue wins over a busy large one. Zero runtime dependencies. Optional retry on probe failure, because a single timeout across an SSH tunnel is not proof that an instance is down.

items.name: dsh-routed-subagent
items.desc: Adds a subagent_routed tool that runs a one-shot subagent fully mounted on any agent preset from any session, with per-call model/provider override and a model-availability pre-check.

items.name: dsh-engineer-tools
items.desc: Engineering work-tools for DeepSeek Harness: registers two model-facing Host Tools — a scoped `git` runner, and a package-manager runner (`dev`) that detects npm/pnpm/yarn/bun from the workspace lockfile and picks the right verb per manager. Both run through dsh's sandboxed shell and return structured stdout/stderr/exitCode, so the agent gets focused, reviewable results instead of raw bash, and adding another tool is a copy-paste of one register block.

items.name: dsh-icloud-calendar
items.desc: Read and write Apple iCloud Calendar over CalDAV through five tools: list calendars, read a window with recurring events expanded, create an event, and delete behind a dry run that must confirm the exact object count. Credentials come from DPAPI, Keychain or libsecret, or from an environment variable.

items.name: dsh-hot-search
items.desc: Resident search index living in the host process: hot_find (fuzzy filename and path match, with frecency and git status), hot_fuzzy (content search that tolerates typos, including in Chinese), hot_grep (literal and regex content search), hot_plan (groups hits per file so a batch of files can be read in order) and hot_stats. One in-memory line index is built once and rebuilt on demand, so a query does not spawn a process.

items.name: dsh-origin-bridge
items.desc: Drive local Origin/OriginPro from chat via 27 MCP tools: import .dat/.csv/.txt and CHI workstation .bin files, plot, style, fit, and deliver PNG/TIF/SVG/PDF plus an editable .opju project, with read-back verification on plots, styles and exports. Requires Windows, Origin/OriginPro 2021+ and Python 3.10+, plus `pip install originpro numpy` into the interpreter dsh launches: without the package every tool answers `missing_originpro`, and without an interpreter on PATH no tools register at all.

items.name: dsh-router-ext-rtk
items.desc: RTK (Rust Token Killer) extension for dsh-router: rewrites each bash tool call through `rtk rewrite` so the agent reads compressed command output, and falls back to the original command when rtk is missing or has no equivalent.

items.name: lume
items.desc: A persona and memory plugin for DSH Desktop. Distill characters from chats, novels, scripts, or character sheets; keep long-term and temporary memories, learn style corrections and approved replies, detect persona leakage after switching, visualize memories, and import or export persona cards. Task guidance is reduced to one lightweight fixed discipline with no plans, ledgers, or dynamic reminders.

items.name: dsh-econ-tools
items.desc: Econometrics research assistant: 6 tools covering method selection, data preparation, model specification, empirical analysis with Python/R/Stata code templates, robustness checks, and result reporting.

items.name: dsh-unidoc
items.desc: A document preview / edit / management plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It provides a VSCode-style "Document Center" workbench inside the DSH Web GUI: a file tree on the left, click-to-preview, editable code & Markdown with Ctrl/Cmd+S save; and exposes three document tools (doc_read / doc_edit / doc_create) to agents, letting models read and write workspace documents through natural language.

items.name: dsh-scan-mcp
items.desc: Scans MCP servers configured in Claude Code, Codex and CodeBuddy and probes real connectivity via stdio and streamable-http initialize handshakes, with enable/disable toggles and a /mcp control panel.

items.name: dsh-proxy-routing
items.desc: Per-execution HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy routing for Agent fetches, LLM providers, and shell commands, with settings-backed hot reload, approval-gated controls, and credential-safe status.

items.name: dsh-gemini-tool-schema
items.desc: Normalizes every tool schema before it reaches the model, rewriting it into the strict OpenAPI 3.0 subset that Gemini function declarations accept — a type on every node, items on every array, no empty enum entry, $ref inlined — so a single offending MCP or built-in tool no longer fails the whole request with HTTP 400.

items.name: dsh-plugin-porter
items.desc: Moves DSH plugins between machines and profiles: export a migration bundle where local plugins keep their source and remote ones reinstall by version, restore it elsewhere with the bundle's own restore.mjs, copy plugins to another profile, or pack the whole environment (config, memory, sessions, attachments, plugin sources) into checksummed volumes with a restore script.

items.name: dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace
items.desc: Lets one session read, write and run bash across several folders, not just the primary root — additional roots are registered from a sidebar Folders panel or the /workspace-folders command (inherit/read-only/read-write) and share the primary root's file-fence + OS-sandbox authorization; adds no new tools.

items.name: cn-linebreak
items.desc:
Static HTML auditor for Chinese line-breaking: checks explicit-`
` orphan lines, keep-all CSS coverage, CJK line-start/line-end punctuation rules, and protected-phrase splits, then inserts at natural breakpoints; exposes a cn_linebreak_audit tool for agents.

items.name: dsh-system-net
items.desc: Make DSH follow your system network settings: route through the OS proxy and trust its certificate store, so TLS-intercepting accelerators work without environment variables or a restart.

items.name: dsh-context-toolkit
items.desc: Keeps bulk output out of the conversation: ctk_execute, ctk_execute_file and ctk_batch_execute run code in a child process and return only the conclusion, ctk_index and ctk_search file long material into a local FTS5 knowledge base built on node:sqlite, and a routing gate refuses curl and wget before they execute. Ships ctk_stats and ctk_doctor plus a settings page with a live context-occupancy panel. No third-party runtime dependencies.

items.name: dsh-shell-command
items.desc: Claude Code-style shell integration: /! for single-command analysis and /terminal for interactive PTY sessions with on-demand history reference.

items.name: dsh-plugin-midscene
items.desc: AI UI automation via Midscene — android_ui and web_ui tools that tap, type, query, and assert on a real Android device or an already-running Chrome through the ctx.midscene seam.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-hiddify
items.desc: Drives a local Hiddify installation from DeepSeek Harness without its GUI: seven tools to start and stop the core, switch split-tunnel modes (rebuilds the config and restarts the core), rotate exit nodes through the Clash control plane, and search or fetch pages through the proxy. Windows only.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-scholar
items.desc: Literature search tools for DeepSeek Harness: four model-facing tools — paper_search, paper_get, paper_citations and book_search — over OpenAlex, arXiv, Crossref, Semantic Scholar and PubMed, with open-access PDF resolution through Unpaywall.

items.name: dsh-d1
items.desc: Cloudflare D1 tools for agents: d1_list/query/exec/schema/stats/health over the D1 HTTP API, read-only by default with a SQLite-accurate lexical guard, LIMIT row cap, CSV/JSON query output and an approval-gated write path.

items.name: dsh-123pan
items.desc: 123 Cloud Drive (123pan) client: signs in with a phone number or email plus password, or a pasted token, browses and drag-drop uploads and downloads through a sidebar panel, backs up a workspace incrementally while keeping its directory tree, and exposes 15 tools for an agent to list, upload, download, rename, move and delete files. Network, MD5, 16MB multipart upload and token encryption run in a bundled statically linked C++ core, so it needs no Python or other runtime. Windows 10/11 x64 only.

items.name: dsh-interview
items.desc: AI interview practice for DeepSeek Harness Web: generates questions across four modes (concept review, mock interview, scenario, LeetCode Hot 100), scores answers, and provides explanations.

items.name: dsh-cool-terminal
items.desc: Terminal plugin — a real shell, workspace sync, persistent state, common-command management, and command completion.

items.name: dsh-academic
items.desc: Academic tools in TypeScript, no Python or MCP server: the Zotero library through its local API or zotero.org (search, annotations, full text, citation export; add by DOI / arXiv id, notes and tags when writing is turned on), starting Zotero when it is closed; paper search across arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, PubMed and Europe PMC, plus CNKI and Google Scholar through a browser window; open-access full text, citations from the DOI registry, reference checking; 11 bundled skills.

items.name: dsh-computer-use
items.desc: Computer use for Windows: screenshot, mouse, keyboard, clipboard and window tools with per-app access that goes through DSH approval; while the agent is in control the screen shows an orange glow and a status bar, and Esc pauses or resumes.

items.name: dsh-proxy
items.desc: Network proxy settings page for DeepSeek Harness: set a global HTTP(S) proxy with bypass hosts, or give each LLM provider its own proxy or a direct connection; changes apply on save without a restart.

items.name: dsh-plugins#tool-disclosure
items.desc: Progressive tool disclosure: a deferred tool group costs one catalog line instead of its full schemas until the model loads it with tool_search, with one switch per group in Settings and each group measured against the live registry.

items.name: dsh-plugin-baizhi-agent-toolkit
items.desc: Optional DSH configuration bundle that connects the existing MCP client to hosted BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit using a user-provided BAIZHI_API_KEY Bearer header; tool calls may incur charges.

items.name: dsh-cpp-probe
items.desc: C++ runtime info probe for Windows via CDB: cpp_trace prints variables at multiple breakpoints in one session (replaces hand-written print), cpp_probe dumps the call stack at a conditional breakpoint. Install: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cpp-probe.

items.name: dsh-electro-lab
items.desc: Electrical and electronics calculation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: every computation runs through dedicated tools on self-describing complex value objects in SI base units, with an isolated calculation agent preset and a records panel that archives every solve on disk.

items.name: dsh-reckoner
items.desc: A deterministic calculation engine for DeepSeek Harness, including a preset that guides the LLM to calculate through the engine rather than by text generation.

items.name: dsh-plugin-rea
items.desc: Third-party adapter that registers the upstream REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server into DeepSeek Harness as mcp__rea__* tools. 2.x provisions its own runtime (Node, the REA CLI, a JDK, Ghidra) under <DSH_HOME>/plugins/rea-bundle and launches REA through a shim, so a machine with nothing pre-installed works after one setup run; 1.x (branch v1, npm 1.0.6) is configuration-only and expects REA and Ghidra to be installed already. Analysis is upstream's: native binaries (Hopper/Ghidra/IDA), JavaScript/Electron apps, .NET assemblies, websites, Android APKs and adb devices, firmware, and process captures.

items.name: dsh-codegraph-project
items.desc: Connects an existing local CodeGraph CLI to each session's indexed project, shares one MCP process per project, and updates session-scoped tools when the working directory or index changes.

items.name: dsh-stash
items.desc: Registers external databases and document corpora as callable model tools: a per-source access boundary, a credential reference ledger that never stores values, and a fetch ledger that keeps fingerprints and content hashes instead of payloads.

items.name: dsh-balance-inquiry
items.desc: Balance dashboard, allowing the addition of multiple pay-as-you-go/Token plans, while simultaneously checking balances.

items.name: dsh-import-newapi
items.desc: Import the copied connection information from the new API site with a single click.

items.name: deepseek-harness-community-plugins#dsh-agent-mail
items.desc: An AI collaboration mailbox in DeepSeek Harness for messaging, task handoffs and delivery receipts. One package includes MCP integration and a mailbox UI. Version 0.2.2 requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2. Requires a separately installed Agent Mail 1.0.0-alpha.7 provider; no automatic model wake or continuous online status.

items.name: deepseek-harness-community-plugins#dsh-ai-asset-hub
items.desc: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a deployment-owned AI Asset Hub MCP server and exposes eight reviewed read-only asset tools.

items.name: dsh-codex-web-search-mcp
items.desc: Registers codex-web-search-mcp as native DSH MCP tools (mcp__codex-web-search__codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch) for model-independent Codex and Grok web search and deep research.

items.name: moneypal#dsh-moneypal
items.desc: Personal finance plugin for DSH with structured Beancount ledger tools.

items.name: dsh-delivery-receipt
items.desc: A delivery receipt panel for a project hand-off. One trigger collects the branch and commit, the test and build results, screenshot dimensions with sha256, and the secret-scan verdict, then assigns every line to one of three zones by evidence alone — verified, local-only, or unverified. A claim in the unverified zone keeps its label and prints an explicitly empty slot instead of the claim itself, because a confidently worded sentence with nothing behind it is the exact thing the receipt exists to catch. Test failures and secret-scan hits are still evidence, so they land in the verified zone with a red tone rather than being quietly dropped.

items.name: dsh-ship-receipt
items.desc: A shareable delivery receipt for a project hand-off. The `ship_receipt` tool measures what it can and records what it was told, then sorts every line into three zones: verified (evidence this run produced and that reproduces elsewhere — a command that actually ran with its exit code, a file hash for a file that is under version control, a scan that found files, a git ref present in the recorded remote), local-only (true on this machine alone — uncommitted changes, unpushed commits, an artifact no one else can see), and unverified (no evidence, including every sentence a human typed). A claim with no evidence keeps its label and leaves the body blank rather than printing the claim; declares the commit and branch, artifact byte sizes and sha256 with PNG dimensions, and the three pre-push checks.

items.name: dsh-aoci-bind
items.desc: AOCI binding toolkit for DSH hosts: discover workspaces that have an AOCI index, diagnose and repair their MCP bindings, initialize unbound repos, and expose status and doctor tools.

items.name: dsh-bash-terminal-ts

Written in TypeScript, targets DSH 0.1.2+.

items.name: dsh-patch-edit-plus
items.desc: Patch-style file editing: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), applying every change all-or-nothing after a full read-only verification pass, with sandbox-aware delete and move and a dry-run mode.

items.name: lightroom-py
items.desc: Adobe Lightroom Classic as native dsh tools through the lightroom-py MCP server: read the catalog, apply develop settings and presets, export JPEG/TIFF/PSD/DNG, and write ratings, labels, keywords and IPTC — 15 tools driving the Lightroom Classic installed on the local machine, no cloud round-trip; the Python package is on PyPI and the Lightroom plugin installs with one command.

items.name: dsh-ds-balance
items.desc: Shows the DeepSeek account balance at the bottom of the sidebar, with a configuration card on the Plugins page.

items.name: dsh-zhihu-search

items.name: dsh-data-cleaning-agent
items.desc: Data cleaning and data enrichment for CSV/XLSX/JSON enterprise lists in DeepSeek Harness, including spreadsheet cleaning, deduplication, profiling, optional Qichacha MCP and exports.

items.desc: AI form filling and spreadsheet autofill for XLSX in DeepSeek Harness, using authorized Qichacha MCP facts with cell previews, user confirmation and export to a new copy.

items.name: dsh-mcp-connector
items.desc: MCP Connector for DeepSeek Harness: an MCP manager with one panel to connect servers, configure authorization, search tools across connections, and troubleshoot failures. Browse a continuously updated catalog of over one hundred connectors; filter by connection/server/status, inspect readable parameters and the last successful cache time, and rediscover tools. Supports OAuth 2.0 PKCE, API keys, stdio/HTTP, and mcpServers JSON import. Maintained by Qichacha/QCC.

items.name: qcc-mcp-legal-oauth
items.desc: One-click OAuth (PKCE) connect to Qichacha (qcc.com) legal-data MCP services — regulation search and case search — with dynamic client registration, token auto-refresh, and dynamic mcp-client configuration.

items.name: dsh-to-figma
items.desc: Create and edit Figma designs through natural-language requests in DSH, read existing UI frames to support frontend development, and capture screenshots or export assets. Requires a companion plugin running in Figma.

items.name: wincu
items.desc: Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness: a persistent PowerShell UIA backend behind 16 merged MCP entries (read/click/type/observe/verify), a hardened policy layer (red lines, approvals, observation binding, point-ownership and focus guards) and a performance pass (prewarm, caching, pixel-hash stability probe). Fork of dsh-computer-use-win.

items.name: dsh-qboson-ising-solver
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness plugin that exposes QBoson Kaiwu Ising solving as an agent-callable solve_ising tool.

items.name: eduwork#dsh-literature

items.name: eduwork#dsh-mail
items.desc: Read-only IMAP search and attachments, plus SMTP sending under DSH permissions, with separate reading and sending switches and a credential-backed settings page.

items.name: dsh-netassist
items.desc: Network and proxy doctor for DSH: checks system proxy settings, probes local proxy ports, detects TUN adapters, tests GitHub, TCP and HTTP reachability, scans hosts conflicts and prints concrete suggestions for what to change.

items.name: dsh-connect-atomcode

items.name: hermes-dsh-bridge
items.desc: Embedded MCP server letting external agents (Hermes, Claude Code, etc.) drive DeepSeek Harness over StreamableHTTP: sync/async task execution, a three-tier file sandbox, a Web-backed approval bridge, session management and search, and path-jailed file tools.

items.name: dsh-venv
items.desc: Per-project runtime environments for DeepSeek Harness: auto-adopt or create a project-local Python venv (.venv_local/python) and wire in the toolchains and env vars for the runtimes each project uses (python venv / node / go) — python & pip always resolve to the project, never silently to system Python.

items.name: dsh-custom-headers
items.desc: Adds configurable HTTP header profiles that can be selected per model.

items.name: dsh-codegraph-plugin
items.desc: Codegraph CLI as eight code-intelligence tools for DSH — symbol search, callers/callees, impact analysis, codebase exploration, symbol/file reading, index status and sync.

items.name: invoice-downloader#dsh-invoice-downloader
items.desc: Local IMAP invoice download, OCR, archive, and Excel reimbursement summaries for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-progressive-tools
items.desc: Cache-stable progressive tool discovery: a fixed tool_search and tool_dispatch surface on every request, in-memory catalog search, nested dispatch through the Harness pipeline, and a byte-stable native tool list across discovery.

items.name: dsh-system1
items.desc: Asks System One models for yes/no, choice, score, and image-box judgments with probabilities, via an agent tool or a plugin service.

items.name: dsh-research
items.desc: Adds local PDF reading, a durable paper library, traceable evidence records, and cross-paper comparison and synthesis tools.

items.name: dsh-dcp

items.name: dsh-subagent-registry
items.desc: Register locally-defined custom agents as callable subagents in dsh: the main conversation invokes any agent by name via use_agent, each running as a real dsh subagent with its own persona. Supports breakpoint resume for interrupted runs.

items.name: dsh-polymarket-knowhow
items.desc: Polymarket toolkit for DeepSeek Harness and Claude Code: market-data tools for Gamma/CLOB/Data-API (31 model tools in DSH; read-only subset exposed over MCP), opt-in authenticated trading tools, WebSocket stream service, and an embedded Polymarket knowhow skill.

items.name: leisuretimequeue
items.desc: LeisureTimeQueue is a local leisure-time task queue plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: auto-mouse
items.desc: Windows desktop UI context picker for Codex, DeepSeek Harness, and MCP clients: select windows, UI elements, or screen regions with hover highlighting, UI Automation, screenshots, and local OCR, then review and approve Markdown/JSON context before output.

items.name: cua-computer-use
items.desc: Bridges the Cua Driver MCP server into DSH: installs the cua-driver executable when it is missing, starts it over stdio through the in-box MCP client, and registers its 60 accessibility-first window, input, menu, and browser tools with a bundled workflow skill and one-time macOS permission guidance.

items.name: dsh-lit-search
items.desc: Academic literature search and citation tools for DeepSeek Harness: paper search via Crossref and OpenAlex with no API key, related-works discovery, and citation formatting in GB/T 7714, APA and BibTeX.

items.name: dsh-workspace-capabilities
items.desc: Chooses which skills and MCP servers each workspace may use, from a "Skills & MCP" item in the workspace row's "..." menu; unchecked skills leave the session catalog, the `skill` tool and `/name`, and unchecked servers have their `mcp__<server>__*` tools denied for that workspace's sessions, running ones included from the next turn.

items.name: game-crash-doctor
items.desc: Windows-only game crash diagnosis from Event Log, WER reports and crash dumps, with a diagnose_game_crash tool and an optional background notifier.

items.name: dsh-serial-debugger
items.desc: Windows serial-port monitor for DeepSeek Harness — port parameters, live text/hex receive and data sending.

items.name: dsh-plugin-sirchmunk
items.desc: DSH settings section for managing a local Sirchmunk knowledge backend: graph inspection, cluster management, audit history, runtime metrics, and privacy controls.

items.name: fnos-dsh#dsh-failover-search-plugin
items.desc: Multi-source web search and fetch failover for DeepSeek Harness sessions: takes over the session searchProvider and fetchProvider seams and tries configured sources in a chosen order — TinyFish, Tavily and the official search as a fallback that always participates and can be repositioned but not removed. Multiple API keys per platform are spread round-robin, usage snapshots drive pre-flight exclusion of exhausted accounts, and per-request timeouts plus same-platform retry control failover granularity. items.name: fnos-dsh#dsh-midscene-plugin
items.desc: Runs Midscene on the models already configured in DeepSeek Harness instead of separate third-party API keys: hosts an OpenAI-compatible bridge on 127.0.0.1 (default port 8787, automatically skipping occupied ports) that proxies chat completions, streaming and non-streaming, to the DSH host model layer, so DeepSeek official routing, CodeBuddy, Codex and custom OpenAI/Anthropic endpoints all become available to Midscene agents while credentials stay inside the provider plugins and the bridge never touches them. A `/v1/midscene-env` endpoint generates the four MIDSCENE_MODEL_* environment lines with the model family inferred, and seven built-in skills — browser, desktop, Android, iOS and HarmonyOS automation plus a Vitest E2E skill and a Midscene knowledge reference — appear in the session skill catalog without `npx skills add`. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-midscene`.

items.name: foggy-deepseek-harness-plugin
items.desc: Foggy Java data-analysis integration for DeepSeek Harness with a managed Runtime, CLI, Launcher, onboarding Skills, and semantic-layer workflows.

items.name: dsh-ai-research#dsh-ai-research
items.desc: AI research toolkit for DSH: a model release radar, a per-model benchmark and community report from 13 structured leaderboards plus Chinese and English community discussion, and an AI news radar over 46 feeds and 22 official X accounts; registers four tools and three skills and renders every report to Markdown with a generated table of contents.

items.name: dsh-drawai
items.desc: An editable diagram canvas in the DSH sidebar plus two agent tools (diagram_read, diagram_apply) that read and edit the workspace in place, using native .drawio files: the canvas opens and saves them losslessly — cells it does not understand are preserved byte-for-byte — and a file-fingerprint revision powers optimistic locking against concurrent edits.

items.name: free-dsh-plugins#agent-import
items.desc: Imports the MCP servers Codex and Claude Code already declare as dsh mcp-client tools, links the skills of 22 known agent skill directories into ~/.dsh/skills as symlinks instead of copying them, and adds a Settings page that lists what was mounted, toggles each skill, and changes the source on a name conflict.

items.name: dsh_kline
items.desc: Interactive K-line analysis for DeepSeek Harness with multi-market quotes, technical indicators, news, and fundamentals.

items.name: dsh-stool-plugin
items.desc: Nine consolidated tools that give agents full access to the stool ops CLI: server management, database query/redis, log search/tail, CI/CD deploy and history, MFA codes, git operations, notes, todos, and misc utilities (accounting, weekly reports, audit, project listing, nginx presets).

items.name: dsh-mcp-studio
items.desc: Manage MCP servers and skills from a panel in the DSH sidebar: edit rows in the profile or global cordis.patch.yml, toggle them, check whether an HTTP server answers, scan Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Gemini configs and import the servers they declare, and browse, create, edit, enable or delete skills by rewriting the user-invocable policy in SKILL.md.

items.name: dsh-guikit
items.desc: Windows desktop control exposed as native DSH tools - whole-screen and single-window capture (the window one goes through PrintWindow, so a covered window still captures), click, drag, typing, keyboard shortcuts, scrolling, window management, pixel and window polling, and UIA queries that can invoke a control or read its value instead of clicking coordinates. 13 tools over a PowerShell 7 child process; no MCP server, no resident process, no API key.

items.name: postiz-agent#dsh-postiz
items.desc: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Postiz over MCP: list connected social media channels, fetch per-platform posting rules, and schedule, draft, or publish posts to X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Bluesky, Mastodon, Discord, Slack, Telegram and more; adds a postiz workflow skill.

items.name: dsh-generation
items.desc: Adds generation_fork and generation_run to copy an agent preset and run a task on a new session.

items.name: dsh-agent-frugality
items.desc: Multi-agent frugality defense plugin: read-ledger dedup metrics, compaction-immune rules, completion gate, cheap-model review lane.

items.name: dsh-context-lens
items.desc: AST-based context compression, test log filtering, and token budget guard for DeepSeek Harness: strips redundant syntax, prunes noisy log lines, and enforces a token ceiling so the context window never overflows.

items.name: dsh-grok-xsearch
items.desc: Adds an x_search tool for X/Twitter search to DeepSeek Harness, authenticated through a separate SuperGrok OAuth account so it does not consume the session provider quota.

items.name: dsh-image-gen
items.desc: Adds a generate_image tool backed by the FAL queue, any OpenAI-compatible images API, or a ChatGPT/Grok subscription, and shows the result inline in the conversation.

items.name: dsh-live-canvas
items.desc: Renders HTML, React (JSX/TSX), Vue, SVG, Mermaid and Markdown written by the agent in an isolated iframe sandbox with SSE hot-reload, and adds a DOM click inspector, side-by-side visual diff, a responsive device matrix and one-click Vite ZIP export.

items.name: dsh-moa
items.desc: Mixture-of-Agents plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a /moa slash command fans a prompt out to multiple models in parallel, merges their responses in a file workspace, and integrates with Live Canvas for visual output.

items.name: dsh-tool-see-image
items.desc: Provides the see_image tool for DSH: send an image file to a configurable OpenAI-compatible vision model and relay its description back to a text-only model.

items.name: dsh-grafana
items.desc: Conversational Grafana operations: inspect live dashboard data across named sources, then make safe, reviewable dashboard changes with approval and version checks.

items.name: dsh-folder-timemachine
items.desc: Folder time machine for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot any folder, browse its timeline, roll back with one click — Git-like history without needing Git, for folders that never had a repo (game saves, app config dirs, loose documents). Snapshots are content-addressed and deduplicated, and unchanged files are not re-hashed. Automatic snapshots come in two modes: realtime (fs.watch — one version ~8s after the last change, so a save-all or a build counts once) and timed (checks every N minutes, stores only when something actually changed; identical content never adds an empty version). Empty folders are recorded and recreated on restore. Every restore takes a safety snapshot first, so a rollback is itself undoable, and exact-mode cleanup only removes files and empty folders — a non-empty folder is never deleted. Ships a folder_timemachine model tool (status/history/diff need no approval; writes ask first) plus a floating panel with the timeline, one-click restore and mode switching. Pure JS, zero runtime dependencies, 110 tests included.

items.name: dsh-unreal-agentlink
items.desc: Bridge to the UnrealAgentLink editor plugin: the Unreal Engine editor dials this WebSocket bridge on 127.0.0.1:17860 and the agent drives it through 12 tools covering all 170 cataloged commands (actors, levels, blueprints, materials, PCG, screenshots, logs, undo).

items.name: dsh-tool-activator
items.desc: Loads only the basic DSH tools by default and activates the rest on demand, with a per-tool switch list in the plugin settings.

items.name: dsh-codex-computer-use
items.desc: Let a DSH model inspect and operate Windows applications through an installed Codex Computer Use runtime, with per-session app approval.

items.name: dsh-agent-project-sync
items.desc: Discovers Codex and Claude project directories and registers them as shared DeepSeek Harness workspaces.

items.name: dsh-obsidian
items.desc: Bridge local projects into Obsidian: bounded manifest scanning, deterministic dependency/tech/topic edges, and wiki-linked notes written into a managed graph/ vault namespace via the Local REST API or the vault filesystem.

items.name: dsh-lexiforge

Ships a GitHub pack marketplace, a ZIP installer with path, size and file-type checks, and a mandatory risk disclaimer gate.

items.name: dsh-tool-reading-map
items.desc: Give the agent a priority-ranked, coverage-honest map of any codebase before it edits.

items.name: dsh-talebook-plugin

items.name: motor-hospital-plugins#motor-cost-quote

items.name: motor-hospital-plugins#motor-decision-report
items.desc: Summarises the case evidence, diagnosis, repair procedure, parts list and cost-option comparison for a motor into a Markdown repair recommendation report with data provenance.

items.name: motor-hospital-plugins#motor-fault-diagnosis
items.desc: Combines fault knowledge-base symptom-to-cause rules with similar past cases to rank candidate motor diagnoses with evidence terms and suggested extra tests.

items.name: motor-hospital-plugins#motor-parts-selector
items.desc: Builds a motor-repair replacement-parts BOM from the fault and motor rating, listing stock, lead time and domestic or imported alternatives.

items.name: avoid-ai-writing-cn
