Seven tools: jev_decision (1-25 parallel atomic verdicts in one call; noul/choice/score; typed answers with calibrated confidence; measured median 266-484 ms; verdicts only, never prose), jev_choose (rank 2-10 candidate approaches - fit 0-3 and risk - into an explicit composite with a recommended pick), jev_batch (NEW in 0.8.6: one set of 1-5 judgments over 1-20 texts, one real call per text at bounded concurrency, returning a paste-ready markdown table sortable by a judged dimension; built-in sentiment/priority/intent/pii/spam presets; a failed row is reported as failed with the raw error, never guessed), jev_usage (locally measured usage: calls, tokens, estimated cost, latency median and p95, per-tool mix, rolling windows, projected burn rate, optional local hard budgets, and a declared-balance remainder), jev_overview (session ledger), jev_guard_status (guard counters plus a registrations block that surfaces per-surface registration failures) and jev_verify (frozen 27-question live benchmark at concurrency 6: 96.3%, 26/27). WHAT IS NEW IN 0.8.6 - the ledger survives a restart, the remainder is derived instead of invented, and the plugin can now do batch paperwork. (1) The local ledger persists to $DSH_HOME/jev-usage.json BY DEFAULT, so the cumulative total no longer resets when the host restarts. Two real bugs behind the old silent zero were found and fixed: the ledger path only honoured DSH_HOME (absent inside the host process, so persistence was silently disabled and the file name was null), and save() wrote the still-empty in-memory ring over the history file because it ran before the first load while the debounce window swallowed the follow-up write. (2) Remaining is derived, never invented: TypeSafe exposes no balance endpoint - /v1/usage, /v1/quota, /v1/account, /v1/account/balance, /v1/balance, /v1/credits, /v1/billing, /v1/me, /v1/limits and a dozen more all return 404, and only /v1/models answers, with no balance headers - so the panel shows the remainder as your declared balance (quota.declaredBalanceUsd) minus locally measured spend since quota.balanceSince, and says plainly that it cannot be fetched instead of printing a number. (3) The composer pill re-reads every 20 s instead of every 60 s, so a call you just made shows up while you are still looking at it. (4) The collapsed pill leads with the remainder once you declare a balance, and the cumulative row is renamed when the ledger is on disk. Every tool has an in-conversation structured view; the Settings > Plugins card covers credentials, tool switches, the auto-guard, the dashboard, the prompt section, usage/quota and auto-triage. Honest by design: no API key means an explicit error, never fabricated results; every registration is quarantined so a failure degrades one surface. Tests 38/38 (npm test, ~2.5 s). Client half applies on refresh; server half needs a host restart.

items.name: dsh-lang-guard
items.desc: Pins a Chinese (zh-CN) thinking and answering constraint into the system prompt, and registers a per-step runtime reminder so the agent does not drift back to English after tool output. Zero runtime dependencies, single file; falls back to a second registration path and only logs a warning when the host API changes.

items.name: dsh-database-explorer
items.desc: Database explorer panel for DeepSeek Harness: connect SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis, Elasticsearch and Qdrant from a third Conversation tab — browse schemas, page through data, edit cells, insert rows, design and drop tables, run SQL, import/export CSV/JSON/SQL/Markdown, and draw editable E-R diagrams. Read-only connections enforce statement-level allowlists, agent tools ship read-only by default with an opt-in write flag, and every write (including refused attempts) lands in an auditable log. Ships an MCP stdio server exposing the same connections to external AI clients.

items.name: dsh-vision-hub#file-drop
items.desc: Drag-and-drop file upload for PDF, Word, Excel and images: dropped files are saved to a local directory and referenced by path, no base64 bloat in the chat.

items.name: dsh-profile-settings
items.desc: Per-profile settings overlay for DeepSeek Harness: global settings.yaml stays the baseline while each profile overrides any namespace through its own profiles/<name>/settings.patch.yml — object sections merge recursively, scalars and arrays replace wholesale, and !unset masks an inherited value. The overlay is transparent to existing plugins (they keep reading ctx.settings unchanged), writes land in the profile overlay only, and official schema validation, revision semantics, expectedRevision conflicts, watchers and events are untouched. Ships a settings command family (get/set/unset/mask/unmask/promote/demote/migrate/diff/layers) plus a Profile Settings section in the web Settings panel over a loopback RPC channel.

items.name: dsh-proxy-pro
items.desc: Routes model requests, web fetches/searches and spawned tools through the Windows system proxy or a custom address — idempotent kernel (reads never rebuild the dispatcher), header one-click toggle, per-URL route diagnosis and NTLM-aware 407 hints.

items.name: dsh-media-card
items.desc: Show local images and short videos in the DSH conversation card with one-click download of the original file, or offer any other local file for download; works over local and remote connections and keeps the media itself out of the model's vision context.

items.name: dsh-disk-browser
items.desc: Sidebar disk browser for DeepSeek Harness - browse any folder on the server (including hidden ones) with text preview, streaming download and upload (multi-select / drag-and-drop, overwrite confirm), responsive on desktop and mobile.

items.name: coderdd#dsh-rdd-explore
items.desc: Cache-first code exploration: the rdd_explore tool queries the project's .rdd/exploration index and, on a miss, dispatches a read-only worker subagent to explore and register findings; rdd_models serves the live model catalog for dispatch-time model selection.

items.name: dsh-subagent-claude-code-wrapper
items.desc: Subagent delegation provider that runs any Claude-compatible CLI binary pointed at by a configurable executablePath field.

items.name: dsh-wb
items.desc: Bridge between DSH and the local WorkBuddy desktop app, in four parts: read, search and append WorkBuddy memory, skills, plans and daily logs; run tasks through the local CodeBuddy CLI with four permission profiles; drive the running WorkBuddy window over CDP (open a conversation, read its replies as sanitized rich HTML, type and send, switch the account-billed model, relaunch it with a debug port when it is missing); and a sidebar panel that puts that conversation surface inside DSH. 25 tools and 15 HTTP routes in one plugin.

items.name: dsh-yeelight-smart-home
items.desc: Control, organize, diagnose, design, personalize, and answer product knowledge questions for a Yeelight smart home, powered by the local yeelight-home runtime.

items.name: dsh-tmp-cleaner
items.desc: Keeps the /tmp cleanup daemon alive: an in-process watchdog revives it within about two minutes after Android kills it, runs the due cleanup inside dsh while it stays down, and adds a settings page for status, config, clean and dry-run. The cleaner ships inside the package (bin/tmp-clean, Python 3), so no extra install step is needed.

items.name: dsh-mcp-matlab
items.desc: Bridges a local MATLAB MCP server into DSH: evaluate MATLAB code, run .m scripts and tests, and inspect installed toolboxes via mcp__matlab__* tools. Requires MATLAB and the MathWorks MATLAB MCP Server binary, and a path edit after install — the plugin on its own registers no tools.

items.name: dsh-mol#dsh-bundle
items.desc: Registers the dsh-mol stdio MCP server, built on RDKit with no network access, into a DSH profile. It exposes 12 tools: three-level SMILES validation with human-readable diagnostics and character positions, molecular properties, drug-likeness and structural alerts, structure rendering to PNG/SVG, multi-molecule grids, format conversion (SMILES, InChI, InChIKey, MOL, SDF, formula), standardisation with a per-step change log, deduplication, SMARTS substructure matching, fingerprint similarity, and batch clean-up that reports every rejected row. The patch only registers the server; the tools live in this repository's Python package and must be installed first — the README gives a `pip install` route and a from-source route, and until the package is on PyPI the from-source one is what works.

items.name: dsh-mol#dsh-ui
items.desc: A chemistry workbench panel in the DSH web UI. Draw structures on a Ketcher canvas (a script downloads the build; it renders locally in the browser with no backend), then compute on the current molecule with RDKit without calling a model — formula, molecular weight, exact mass, logP, TPSA, hydrogen-bond donors and acceptors, ring counts, Fsp3, stereocentres, Lipinski and Veber rule-by-rule checks, QED, PAINS/BRENK structural alerts and the Murcko scaffold, plus SMARTS substructure matching, fingerprint similarity, format conversion, standardisation and batch clean-up. A retrosynthesis tab talks to a pluggable backend (Retro* by default) over a single JSON-in/JSON-out process, and states what is missing when the backend is not installed instead of inventing a route. The calculations run in this repository's Python package (rdkit), which is installed with pip separately.

items.name: deepseek-harness-plugins#mcwiki-search
items.desc: Query Chinese Minecraft Wiki (MediaWiki API) and convert raw wiki text into clean AI-readable output — search, page intro, full-page Markdown, and random entry; templates, references, images and cross-language links are stripped before reaching the model.

items.name: dsh-bangumi
items.desc: Anime subscription manager for DeepSeek Harness: Bangumi metadata lookup, nyaa/dmhy torrent search, qBittorrent auto-download with RSS-based new-episode polling, local media-library dedup, and a calendar/progress sidebar GUI with 11 LLM tools (bangumi_lookup / bangumi_search / bangumi_subscribe / bangumi_unsubscribe / bangumi_list / bangumi_progress / bangumi_calendar / qb_status / qb_configure / qb_add_torrent / library_scan).

items.name: dsh-dingtalk-connector
items.desc: DSH plugin: read and write DingTalk AI Tables through the official dws CLI, adding ten DingTalk AI Table tools (nine `dingtalk_aitable_*` plus `dingtalk_sync_job`), a settings panel, and scheduled CSV export.

items.name: dsh-mcp-client-manager
items.desc: DSH plugin: a settings panel to list, add, rewrite and toggle @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client MCP rows — no more hand-writing them into cordis.patch.yml. Zero build, zero runtime dependencies.

items.name: dsh-siyuan
items.desc: SiYuan (思源笔记) notes integration: 17 siyuan_* host tools covering notebook and document listing, full-text search, SQL query, reading documents and blocks, creating and appending content, moving and renaming documents, daily notes and block attributes, plus a Web settings page for the SiYuan URL, API token and per-tool switches.

items.name: dsh-reference-checker
items.desc: Reference verification for DeepSeek Harness (参考文献真实性检查器): the reference_checker model tool checks a paper's bibliography (.pdf/.bib/.tex/.txt or pasted text) against Crossref, OpenAlex and arXiv, reports found / partial / not_found / error per entry, and emits corrected citations in the input's style (APA, GB/T 7714, IEEE, Vancouver, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, ACS, BibTeX).

items.name: dsh-desktop-tools
items.desc: DSH environment management: auto-installs a Rust/Tauri desktop host (downloaded per-OS from dsh-desktop-host releases, source build as fallback), one-click runtime updates, Windows platform compatibility, official DeepSeek billing, and a built-in code editor for the workspace.

items.name: dsh-tool-archive
items.desc: Pack a directory into a deterministic tar, read an archive's contents without extracting it, unpack while refusing every member that could reach outside the destination, and verify what came out against what went in by SHA-256. No external dependency — the tar format is written and read in this plugin. Extraction is deliberately more permissive on reading than on writing, because a reader's job is to report what an archive says, while a writer must never emit what it cannot read back. A tar has no central index, so the walk tracks whether it reached the end-of-archive marker: without that, a half-file checksums fine and reads as complete.

items.name: dsh-tool-browser
items.desc: Open a page, wait for it the way it actually needs, extract the readable article, and take a screenshot. Playwright is optional: when it is absent the tools fall back to a static fetch and say so in the result, because a page whose JavaScript never ran means something different from one that rendered. Content is chosen by scoring candidate subtrees on prose density rather than on tag names, so a container loses to the article inside it instead of winning by containing more of the document.

items.name: dsh-tool-comfyui
items.desc: Generate images from chat by calling a fleet of local or LAN ComfyUI workers, with workflow templates, worker health checks and queue control.

items.name: dsh-tool-epub
items.desc: Read, build and take apart EPUB 3 books with no external dependency — the ZIP reader/writer and the XML scanner are both built in. Inspect metadata, reading order and TOC for structural problems, assemble a book from chapters, or split one back into per-chapter HTML.

items.name: dsh-tool-gzh-publisher
items.desc: WeChat Official Account pipeline: validate a draft against a publish gate, then push it into the draft box.

items.name: dsh-tool-invoice
items.desc: Pull invoice number, date, parties, tax IDs and the amount/tax/total triplet out of text, then verify that amount plus tax really equals the total and flag documents that do not reconcile.

items.name: dsh-tool-media
items.desc: Drive a local ffmpeg as six structured tools: probe a file's streams, transcode or trim it, pull evenly-spaced frames or the audio track, and compress video to a byte budget with two-pass encoding.

items.name: dsh-tool-mining
items.desc: Turn a GitHub repository's raw counts into a defensible judgement — contributor concentration and bus factor with single-author files, merge time reported as a median beside the mean so an outlier is visible rather than hidden, and an issue backlog with pull requests and drafts filtered out. Reads the public REST API with no SDK, and never claims a truncated page is the whole answer.

items.name: dsh-tool-notion
items.desc: Convert Notion blocks and Markdown in both directions, with no API client and no external dependency. A Notion paragraph is an array of rich-text runs while Markdown says one string, so the two directions are a split and a merge rather than a pair of inverses — rich-text runs are cut at every annotation boundary one way and re-merged the other, with fences widened when the content already contains backticks. Reports every lossy step instead of swallowing it.

items.name: dsh-tool-ocr
items.desc: Extract text from an image or PDF, reading a born-digital text layer directly and falling through to a configured OCR engine for scans.

items.name: dsh-tool-podcast
items.desc: Turn a raw recording into a published podcast with a local ffmpeg — detect chapter boundaries from silence, cut at those boundaries, normalise loudness to a broadcast target in two passes, and write an iTunes-compatible RSS feed whose enclosure byte lengths are measured from disk.

items.name: dsh-tool-protobuf
items.desc: Read, audit and diff Protocol Buffer definitions without installing protoc: a zero-dependency .proto parser exposing six tools (status, outline, describe, diff, audit, next_number). diff classifies every change as breaking, risky or additive and names the wire-format consequence; audit catches what protoc accepts but a reviewer should not — duplicated or illegal field numbers, reserved-range collisions, unresolved types, and unreserved gaps below the high-water mark.

items.name: dsh-tool-qrcode
items.desc: Generate QR codes from a from-scratch ISO/IEC 18004 encoder with no external tools, plan symbol version and error-correction headroom before producing anything, and decode an existing symbol back to text.

items.name: dsh-tool-subtitle
items.desc: Read, write, convert and retime a subtitle track across SRT, WebVTT and ASS, audit it for over-long or unreadable cues, and transcribe audio through a configured speech recogniser.

items.name: dsh-closet
items.desc: Per-workspace closet for temporary scripts and their run logs, kept in a .dsh-fix directory inside each project. Registers a script with its language and purpose, scans a project for leftover scratch scripts, backups and log files, runs registered scripts with a timeout and writes each run to a timestamped log, and sweeps chosen files into a reversible trash with per-batch restore. Scanning only lists and never deletes; cleanup moves files instead of deleting them; files already tracked by git are refused unless forced. Ships 7 agent tools and a settings panel.

items.name: dsh-conversation-nav-dots
items.desc: Navigation dots for DSH Web conversations — quickly jump between user messages.

items.name: dsh-prompt-system
items.desc: Prompt optimizer in the composer: rewrites the draft into an eleven-section analytical prompt using the conversation, workspace files and the session's selected model, with one-click undo.

items.name: dsh-web-search-litellm
items.desc: Web search provider for the ctx.web seam that routes the DeepSeek web_search tool through a LiteLLM proxy using the OpenAI Responses API, reusing LITELLM_API_KEY.

items.name: dsh-overall-mcp
items.desc: Host-wide MCP server panel: imports the servers declared in Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and Codex CLI configs, searches six upstream catalogs and installs from whichever of them declares an install plan, asks only for the fields a server actually declares, and checks each row for whether the mount, the handshake and its tool list really work.

items.name: dsh-user-addons
items.desc: Drag-and-drop file upload into the conversation composer, token usage pill with quota tracking, and session archive management — a three-in-one daily-driver addon.

items.name: dsh-pdf-mineru
items.desc: Provider-independent DSH document parsing powered by MinerU, with native background jobs, immutable results, and safe request coalescing.

items.name: dsh-web-search-enhanced
items.desc: Web search with Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily and Tinyfish, per-session search connection and freshness preferences, and a chat-toolbar selector.

items.name: dsh-webui-launcher
items.desc: Cross-platform Web UI launcher for DeepSeek Harness: webui_start/stop/status/open model tools, a /webui start|stop|status|open slash command, a Settings-page launch card, and an optional desktop shortcut that starts the Web UI hidden and opens the browser once it is fully ready (dsh default icon).

items.name: multisim-mcp#deepseek-harness
items.desc: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Multisim MCP for circuit generation, simulation, diagnostics, design optimization, and experiment report export.

items.name: dsh-table-attach
items.desc: Attach tables and documents (xlsx, csv, pdf, zip…) to the DSH composer via paste or drag-and-drop: files are saved into the session workspace and an @reference is inserted.

items.name: dsh-gpt-image
items.desc: Game asset production pipeline: generate images, video and audio, turn a video into a coherent sprite animation, derive recoloured variants, adapt assets to an engine schema, install them into the project and verify the code actually references them. Requires ffmpeg for the video-to-sprite path, and an image/video API key (Agnes AI / OpenAI / fal) for generation.

items.name: dsh-algo-trainer
items.desc: Algorithm learning toolkit syncing Codeforces and AtCoder submissions, profiling weaknesses, generating AI training plans, and tracking spaced-repetition reviews across a 114-lesson algorithm curriculum.

items.name: sci-fork
items.desc: A biomedical Research Graph grounded in literature and experiment results. Fork hypotheses, connect evidence, advance research.

items.name: dsh-claude-code
items.desc: Delegates a self-contained coding task to the local Claude Code subscription through the official Claude Agent SDK, and adds a session tab with live output, cost and remaining quota.

items.name: dsh-lazy-mcp
items.desc: MCP gateway for dsh that connects each server on first use and disconnects it after an idle window; tool lists are cached on disk, existing mcpServers files can be imported, and child-process environment variables are scrubbed.

items.name: dsh-cubox
items.desc: Cubox sync for DeepSeek Harness: scheduled sync of your bookmarks, an AI daily brief generated from your own prompt template straight into Obsidian, and per-card markdown export.

items.name: dsh-zhihu
items.desc: Zhihu (知乎) for DeepSeek Harness: wraps the local pyzhihu-cli as 18 zhihu_* tools — 14 read-only (search, hot list, question, answer, user, feed, topic, notifications, collections) plus 4 publishing tools that are not registered until readOnly is turned off — with a web panel in the sidebar for login, config and lookups.

items.name: weread-export
items.desc: WeChat Reading (WeRead) multi-target export for DeepSeek Harness via the official Skills API gateway: browse your bookshelf, export highlights & thoughts to flomo, a local Markdown file, or Notion, optionally reworked by a configurable LLM prompt.

items.name: dsh-anysearch
items.desc: AnySearch-backed search tools for agents: general and vertical-domain search, parallel batch queries, vertical-domain capability discovery, and page-to-Markdown extraction, plus an API key panel in Settings. It registers its own tools instead of a web_search provider, so it cannot be installed alongside @anysearch/anysearch-dsh.

items.name: dsh-plugin-agnes-image
items.desc: Adds an agnes_image tool that calls the Agnes Image Flash models (2.5, 2.1, 2.0) for text-to-image, image-to-image and multi-image composition, and ships a settings-page console for the active model, default size and aspect ratio, output folder, API key and generation history.

items.name: dsh-go-sensei
items.desc: Go (weiqi) review coach: parses SGF records, backfills winrate and score analysis with a bundled KataGo engine, explains the costly moves in the chat, and writes the commentary back into an SGF copy; a web panel shows the board with problem moves, AI choices and variations.

items.name: dsh-deepseek-model-router
items.desc: Auto-switch DeepSeek models: routes every request to the vision model when images are present, to the pro model for complex tasks, and to the fast model otherwise; includes a switch_model tool for manual overrides.

items.name: dsh-deepseek-billing-period
items.desc: DeepSeek API billing-period chip in the composer dock: shows whether the current time is peak or off-peak with a countdown to the next rate switch, opens the peak/off-peak window rules on click, and during peak hours intercepts sending to ask for confirmation first.

items.name: dsh-keep-awake
items.desc: Keeps the DSH host awake during active tasks using native power assertions and releases them when tasks finish.

items.name: bazidiy#ontology
items.desc: BaziDIY ontology plugin: deterministic bazi/wuxing/bead/style rules as DSH tools (calculate_bazi, propose_designs, generate_design, save_design, load_design), plus bracelet SVG rendering and a bead editor; no LLM calls inside execute.

items.name: dsh-atom-market
items.desc: Software Atom Market for DeepSeek Harness - lets agents browse a shared store of contract-typed capability atoms: search atoms, read full manifests, validate submissions, draft new atoms (atom_search/atom_read/atom_validate/atom_draft); GitHub store as zero-config default source.

items.name: dsh-milvus
items.desc: Read-only DSH Web plugin for inspecting and searching Milvus or Zilliz Cloud collections from chat, including scalar, BM25, dense, and hybrid queries.

items.name: dsh-valuation-service
items.desc: Registers one `valuation_service` tool that reads a workpaper tree of 01/02/04 JSON and returns one unified schema: six ratio groups, forecast ratios, DCF input slots with explicit missing markers, comparable PS/PE and IRR. Deterministic and local: missing WACC, growth, capex, D&A or working-capital inputs stay blank instead of being guessed, and assumption differences are flagged for review.

items.name: dsh-mcp-control
items.desc: Settings panel for MCP servers registered by @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client: toggle each server on or off with live effect, see the registered tool count and estimated context-token cost of each server, and persist the choice to the home cordis.patch.yml with a timestamped backup before every write. Maintained fork of dsh-mcp-toggle.

items.name: dsh-frecency
items.desc: Resident-index grep for DeepSeek Harness that shadows the built-in grep/glob tools under the same names: repeated content searches hit an in-memory index ranked by access/modification frecency, and glob serves the built-in ripgrep semantics when available, falling back to the index otherwise.

items.name: dsh-web-search-multi
items.desc: Selectable SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Gemini Search Grounding, or Wikipedia backend for the native web_search tool, with Web settings and no implicit fallback.

items.name: dsh-browser-use
items.desc: Browser Use cloud bridge for dsh: run real web tasks — open pages, click, type, fill forms, and extract data — through the Browser Use API.

items.name: dsh-firecrawl
items.desc: Scrape URLs to LLM-ready Markdown and search the web via the Firecrawl Cloud API.

items.name: dsh-behavior-enhancer
items.desc: Tool-call discipline for DeepSeek Harness: injects a static behavior-constraint prompt section, drops the parallel pool to 1 after a tool failure (restoring after 3 consecutive successes), nudges the model to stop retrying after repeated failures, verifies writes with .bak rollback, gates high-risk commands, and tracks compliance stats via /behavior-status.

items.name: dsh-agnes-tools
items.desc: Agnes AI image and video generation tools for DeepSeek Harness, where long video jobs can be resumed in a later call. Requires an Agnes API key (AGNES_API_KEY).

items.name: dsh-auto-retry
items.desc: Adds supplemental request retries, turn auto-continue and a no-response watchdog on top of built-in dsh retries, with a live countdown banner, toast notifications and a usage dashboard.

items.name: vision-use
items.desc: Desktop computer-use for DSH: captures the Windows screen into the agent vision channel and drives mouse/keyboard through a Codex-style overlay with Esc abort; auto-detects Windows native or WSL hosts.

items.name: dsh-device-bridge
items.desc: Generic Companion-protocol bridge from DeepSeek Harness to phones/IoT/legacy agents (includes Termux companion example).

items.name: dsh-mac-companion
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness to macOS companion daemon (notify / Shortcuts / clipboard read-write).

items.name: dsh-remote-ssh
items.desc: Allowlisted SSH into Unix/AIX/macOS from DeepSeek Harness (no shell; read-only by default), with remote_ssh_probe OS-aware suite.

items.name: dsh-wsl-browser
items.desc: Opens http(s) URLs from WSL in the Windows default browser.

items.name: dsh-wsl-cal
items.desc: Read-only khal calendar list.

items.name: dsh-wsl-clipboard
items.desc: Reads and writes the Windows clipboard from WSL.

items.name: dsh-wsl-clock
items.desc: Detects WSL2 clock skew versus Windows that can break TLS and tokens.

items.name: dsh-wsl-compose
items.desc: Docker Compose ps/logs with richer status; up/down double-gated.

items.name: dsh-wsl-cred
items.desc: Safe Git Credential Manager hints for WSL without exposing secrets.

items.name: dsh-wsl-db
items.desc: Read-only psql + redis-cli probes.

items.name: dsh-wsl-defender
items.desc: Windows security posture from WSL: Defender real-time state and signature age, recent detections, exclusions, and firewall profiles.

items.name: dsh-wsl-distro
items.desc: Reports the current WSL distro and warns about multi-distro setups.

items.name: dsh-wsl-dns
items.desc: Compares WSL versus Windows DNS resolution for common endpoints.

items.name: dsh-wsl-docker
items.desc: Reports Docker CLI, context, and daemon reachability in WSL, plus vLLM :8000 /v1/models health and GPU runtime hints.

items.name: dsh-wsl-download
items.desc: Lists or copies files from the Windows Downloads folder into the WSL workspace.

items.name: dsh-wsl-editor
items.desc: Opens a WSL Linux path in Windows Cursor, VS Code, or Notepad (optional line/column; win_editor_status).

items.name: dsh-wsl-encoding
items.desc: Reports PowerShell, cmd, and LANG encoding for UTF-8 versus code-page issues.

items.name: dsh-wsl-env
items.desc: Injects WSL distro, Linux path mapping, /mnt/c CRLF and git caveats, and NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY into the system prompt.

items.name: dsh-wsl-eventlog
items.desc: Read recent Windows event log entries from WSL, filtered by log name, level, provider and time window.

items.name: dsh-wsl-expose
items.desc: Advises or applies allowlisted Windows portproxy for a WSL listen port, preferring the kit :3081 relay and launch token for local dsh UI.

items.name: dsh-wsl-fetch
items.desc: Registers a wsl-proxy ctx.web fetch provider so official web_fetch uses undici ProxyAgent through HTTP(S)_PROXY instead of connecting from WSL to a DNS-pinned public IP (the official path that produces TypeError: fetch failed behind a Windows proxy).

items.name: dsh-wsl-git
items.desc: Capped Git status / diff --stat / log --oneline (no full patches).

items.name: dsh-wsl-github
items.desc: Uses a GitHub App to report open PRs and the latest Actions run for the current repo without returning secrets.

items.name: dsh-wsl-glab
items.desc: Read-only glab MR / issue / ci status.

items.name: dsh-wsl-gpu
items.desc: Probes nvidia-smi and GPU visibility inside WSL.

items.name: dsh-wsl-helm
items.desc: Read-only Helm list / status / history.

items.name: dsh-wsl-hostsvc
items.desc: Probes Windows-host Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, and llama-server from WSL, compares ctx, and reports /v1/models apiReady versus TCP.

items.name: dsh-wsl-im
items.desc: Bridges Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, QQ, Slack, Discord, Telegram and Mattermost into dsh agents (outbound WS/Stream/Gateway/long-poll/webhook), with im_status, optional local Whisper ASR, plain-text outbound for QQ/DingTalk/Telegram/Mattermost, and env CSV allowlists (DSH_IM_*_ALLOWED_USER_IDS). Empty allowedUserIds means EVERYONE can drive your agent — set a whitelist before exposing a bot.

items.name: dsh-wsl-jev
items.desc: Call TypeSafe Jev / OpenRouter System One for noul, choice, and score (jev_ask / jev_check / jev_rank).

items.name: dsh-wsl-k8s
items.desc: Read-only kubectl get / describe / logs / contexts for dsh on WSL (configurable log tail).

items.name: dsh-wsl-launch
items.desc: Launches allowlisted Windows apps such as VS Code, Explorer, and browsers from WSL.

items.name: dsh-wsl-llamacpp
items.desc: OpenAI-compatible client for llama.cpp / Unsloth Desktop (default :8080).

items.name: dsh-wsl-mail
items.desc: Mail list/search via himalaya / notmuch (no send).

items.name: dsh-wsl-media
items.desc: Local media/doc pipeline: ffprobe, extract, thumbnail, PDF, ASR, pandoc, OCR, exif (allowRoots include IM inbox).

items.name: dsh-wsl-mnt
items.desc: Warns when the workspace path sits on slow /mnt/c.

items.name: dsh-wsl-net
items.desc: Adds a net_doctor tool that reports proxy environment, NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY, and reachability of the DeepSeek API and the npm registry, and sets NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY on bash and npm child processes.

items.name: dsh-wsl-notify
items.desc: Shows a short Windows MessageBox or toast (BalloonTip) from WSL when a long task finishes.

items.name: dsh-wsl-obscura
items.desc: Optional Obscura headless-browser tools from WSL (obscura_status / obscura_fetch / obscura_mcp_hint). Not the same as dsh-wsl-browser win_open_url (Windows GUI browser), and not a replacement for dsh-wsl-fetch web_fetch.

items.name: dsh-wsl-obsidian
items.desc: Bridges a WSL dsh agent to a Windows Obsidian vault on NTFS: status/list/search/read/write/append, wikilink resolve, write/append require confirm=true, plus obsidian:// open. Keep the vault under /mnt/<drive>/; Linux-disk vaults via \\wsl$ are unreliable.

items.name: dsh-wsl-ollama
items.desc: Local Ollama status / list / chat / embed for dsh on WSL (unreachable status includes Windows/WSL gateway hints).

items.name: dsh-wsl-open
items.desc: Opens WSL Linux paths from DeepSeek Harness chat in the Windows default app or Explorer.

items.name: dsh-wsl-path
items.desc: Converts Linux and Windows paths with /mnt/c caveats for WSL.

items.name: dsh-wsl-perf
items.desc: Windows host performance from WSL: CPU, memory, disk and top processes.

items.name: dsh-wsl-picker
items.desc: Browse WSL directories under / and /mnt for workspace picking (start/filter; im-workspace shortcuts).

items.name: dsh-wsl-pkg
items.desc: Dependency tree summaries: npm / pip / cargo.

items.name: dsh-wsl-playwright
items.desc: Headless Playwright fetch (title + body text) in WSL.

items.name: dsh-wsl-port
items.desc: Diagnoses WSL port listening and Windows localhost forwarding, with a 3080/3081 uiPlaybook for the dsh web relay and launch token.

items.name: dsh-wsl-power
items.desc: Windows power state from WSL: active power plan, all schemes, battery, sleep timeout and hibernation availability.

items.name: dsh-wsl-rclone
items.desc: Read-only rclone listremotes / lsf / about.

items.name: dsh-wsl-registry
items.desc: Read-only Windows registry access from WSL, restricted to an allowlist of key prefixes; list a key's values or its child keys.

items.name: dsh-wsl-search
items.desc: Sandboxed ripgrep / fd / ast-grep under allowRoots (defaults include ~/.dsh/im-workspace).

items.name: dsh-wsl-secret
items.desc: Read-only pass / age secrets with allowPrefixes; reveal defaults to false.

items.name: dsh-wsl-service
items.desc: Read Windows service state from WSL: list services, or inspect one by name with its dependencies, logon account and binary path.

items.name: dsh-wsl-shot
items.desc: Saves a Windows clipboard image into a WSL file (clear ok:false + hint when clipboard has no image).

items.name: dsh-wsl-ssh-agent
items.desc: Hints how to forward the Windows OpenSSH agent into WSL without dumping keys.

items.name: dsh-wsl-struct
items.desc: Sandboxed jq / yq / read-only sqlite3.

items.name: dsh-wsl-systemd
items.desc: Read-only systemd --user list / show / journal.

items.name: dsh-wsl-terraform
items.desc: Terraform/OpenTofu plan summary + state list (never apply).

items.name: dsh-wsl-tmux
items.desc: Read-only tmux list + capture-pane.

items.name: dsh-wsl-tray
items.desc: Writes a Windows shortcut and tray launcher to start dsh web in WSL, with Health/Restart and the :3081 launch-token URL.

items.name: dsh-wsl-uia
items.desc: Windows UI Automation from WSL: enumerate top-level windows, read a bounded element tree, and wait for or trace the path to a named element.

items.name: dsh-wsl-vecmem
items.desc: Tiny local vector memory via Ollama embeddings and ~/.dsh/vecmem (workspace namespaces; optional IM crumb via vecmemOnReply).

items.name: dsh-wsl-vllm
items.desc: OpenAI-compatible vLLM client (default :8000).

items.name: dsh-wsl-winctl
items.desc: Enumerate and control Windows top-level windows from WSL: activate, minimize, maximize, restore, move, resize, set always-on-top, close.

items.name: dsh-wsl-wininput
items.desc: Targeted Windows input from WSL: invoke a UI Automation element by name, or send keys, clicks and mouse wheel to a chosen window.

items.name: dsh-wsl-winshot
items.desc: Capture a Windows window to a WSL file, whole or cropped to a region or to a named UI element.

items.name: dsh-wsl-workspace
items.desc: Lists WSL distros and validates a Linux workspace path for DSH.

items.name: dsh-wsl-wslconfig
items.desc: Gives read-only advice for Windows .wslconfig memory and mirrored networking.

items.name: dsh-win-toolkit
items.desc: Windows-native tools for DSH agents: clipboard read and write, system notifications, hosts file inspection and network diagnostics, each returning structured data with UI cards from injection-safe PowerShell.

items.name: dsh-wsl-native
items.desc: Use Windows and native Linux DSH sessions in one Windows window, with WSL environment switching and bidirectional system tools.

items.name: dsh-wsl-gpufix
items.desc: Adds /dev/dxg and /proc read-write grants to the DSH Landlock sandbox on WSL2, so CUDA is available inside a confined agent bash session.

items.name: dsh-open-folder-visible
items.desc: Fixes the Windows workspace-open action: the shipped opener spawns explorer.exe with windowsHide, so the File Explorer window is created invisible and the click reports success without appearing.

items.name: dsh-wsl-tray
items.desc: Windows desktop shortcut and system-tray launcher for DSH running in WSL, with fully hidden startup, tray open/restart/exit menu, and a plugin-configuration card to manage the shortcut.

items.name: dsh-windows-native
items.desc: Injects native-Windows (non-WSL) PowerShell, encoding, filesystem, and cross-platform-build gotchas into the system prompt.

items.name: dsh-wsl-bridge
items.desc: Runs persistent bash and Linux-path file and search tools inside the current WSL distribution. A new conversation that selects WSL mode asks which of that distribution's folders to use as the workspace, and nothing is installed inside the distribution.

items.name: dsh-wsl
items.desc: Linux-native DSH, extended to WSL. Commands run on a real kernel: exit codes, signals, timeouts. One long-lived shell for multi-step work, a clean one for everything else; subtasks stay visible above the composer. Your own terminal stays in the loop — commands in view, keyboard one click away. Path conversion, environment checks, background jobs; destructive commands ask first. Runs as you, below the DSH sandbox (it does not confine it); the in-view terminal exists up to DSH 0.2.0.

items.name: dsh-wsl-first
items.desc: Publishes an ordered system prompt section that names wsl as the command executor to reach for first, so the agent prefers WSL over PowerShell on Windows. Registers no tools, and only advertises executors the agent can actually call.

items.name: dsh-websearch
items.desc: Aggregated web search provider that fans one query out to 11 engines (Exa, Parallel, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Serper, Mojeek, DeepSeek, Anthropic, OpenAI) concurrently, URL-dedupes and merges the results. Ships a settings card for toggling backends, storing API keys in the credential store, and tuning concurrency and timeouts.

items.name: dsh-moli
items.desc: Drives a locally installed Moli headless browser from DeepSeek Harness: rendered fetch, JavaScript evaluation, Markdown, semantic trees, screenshots and PDFs. A CSS selector returns one container rather than the whole page (measured 40-80x fewer tokens on listing pages) and scroll triggers lazy loading. Installs Moli when it is missing; verified on Windows and Linux.

items.name: dsh-inpage-translator
items.desc: A persistent translate button lives in every page the browser opens: click it and every visible text node is replaced in place, click again to restore. Hold to drag, drop it near an edge and it tucks into a small handle; it is re-injected automatically after navigation. The host LLM service does the translation — the plugin holds no API key.

items.name: dsh-web-tools
items.desc: Unified multi-provider web search and fetch: BYOK key pools, health monitoring, and deterministic fallback.

items.name: dsh-firecrawl
items.desc: Adds a Firecrawl search provider with multi-account API-key settings.

items.name: dsh-inapp-browser
items.desc: Shared browser panel for DeepSeek Harness via Better Sidebar, with local Chromium, human and agent mouse and keyboard control, page snapshots, screenshots, and per-chat persistent profiles.

items.name: dsh_use_browser#use-browser
items.desc: Generic browser automation with six tools (browser_open, browser_click, browser_type, browser_extract, browser_screenshot, browser_eval), @e element references, and dual Playwright-headless / CDP (connect to your own Chrome) backends.

items.name: dsh-tavily-web
items.desc: Tavily search and page fetch: tavily_search queries with a rotating pool of up to eight API keys that backs off per key on 401/403/429 so one exhausted account does not take the tool down, and web_fetch retrieves a single page through curl, returning its HTTP status with de-tagged text.

items.name: dsh-connectors#browser-connector
items.desc: Browser automation connector: drives the local Edge or Chrome over the DevTools Protocol with zero runtime dependencies — launch a headless throwaway-profile browser or attach to one started with --remote-debugging-port, then navigate, read page text and interactive elements, click, type, and screenshot through 11 agent tools.

items.name: dsh-plugin-webrelay
items.desc: Embeds external AI chat sites in a DSH side panel through the same-origin reverse proxy with per-site DOM adapters, and adds a composer button that either rewrites the draft with the host model or runs a two-round loop: compress the conversation, optimize, send to the embedded site, capture the reply, then finalize it into the composer.

items.name: dsh-web-window-companion
items.desc: Opens the dsh web GUI in a dedicated Edge/Chrome app-mode window on its own browser profile and gracefully stops the server when that window is closed.

items.name: dsh-plugins#reference-library
items.desc: Adds CodePen, Pinterest, Z-Library, and GitHub data cards to the native @ reference menu, with Pinterest pagination and Z-Library sorting.

items.name: web-search-advanced
items.desc: Switchable web-search provider for DSH: native DeepSeek web search or an OpenAI-compatible custom backend. Installation automatically routes DSH web searches to the plugin; only provider, API key and model are required. Published on npm as @lp181818/web-search-advanced@0.1.3.

items.name: dsh-browser-control
items.desc: Controls your real Chrome from DSH over a local WebSocket bridge: tab management, navigation, DOM snapshots, page JS evaluation, clicks, typing, screenshots, waits and dialog handling behind a Settings toggle.

items.name: kimi-webbridge-dsh
items.desc: Provisions the kimi-webbridge bridge daemon (auto-install with SHA-256 verification, auto-start) and registers a 25-action skill that drives the user's real browser through the local bridge.

items.name: dsh-web-fetch-playwright
items.desc: Playwright/CDP web-fetch provider for the built-in web_fetch tool: renders pages in a real browser, denoises them (Readability + DOMPurify) and returns markdown.

items.name: dsh-web-search-aggregation
items.desc: Aggregated web-search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one prioritized queue over nine providers (AnySearch, TinyFish, Tavily, Brave, Exa, Firecrawl, Jina, SerpApi, Serper), with multi-key rotation per provider, ordered fallback on failed attempts, and a live settings card.

items.name: dsh-browser
items.desc: Give the dsh agent a real browser: each conversation gets its own Chrome or Edge process with its own profile and CDP port, driven by six tools and mirrored live in the right sidebar, where you can watch the work and take over by clicking or typing on the picture. Nothing else to install — it uses the Chrome or Edge already on the machine, downloads no browser, needs no companion app or extension, and keeps its tabs and sign-ins between tool calls.

items.name: dsh-dschat
items.desc: Chat with the DeepSeek web app (chat.deepseek.com) in a native DSH panel — a real browser drives the site on your existing web login, with streaming replies, deep-thinking and smart-search toggles, and image or document attachments. Conversations can be recovered from the web side, exported as Markdown, and distilled or replayed into a harness session, and the agent reaches the same web chat through six tools (dschat_status, dschat_send, dschat_stop, dschat_recover, dschat_import, dschat_transfer).

items.name: dsh-free-search
items.desc: Web search provider with switchable engines, several usable without an API key (Bing, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG and others) and a fallback order between them; adds multi_search, platform_search, image_search with an in-chat image wall, page_images and save_images, plus a settings page for engines, keys and per-engine proxy.

items.name: dsh-plugins#web-fetch
items.desc: A guarded local fetch provider for the ctx.web seam — the backend dsh does not ship for its own web_fetch tool. Every redirect hop is re-resolved and checked against the non-routable ranges, with a streamed size cap and a content-type allowlist.

items.name: dsh-plugins#web-search-searxng
items.desc: Points web_search at a self-hosted SearXNG instance instead of the native route: pages until maxResults is satisfied, and reports degraded coverage when engines fail so a thin result set is not read as a thin web.

items.name: dsh-web-annotator
items.desc: Annotate pages inside the existing Harness Browser: click or drag to select, comment or ask, then send marked screenshots or DOM location details to the current session. While enabled it replaces the official Browser, Chat and Layout providers; targets Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2.

items.name: dsh-web-fetch
items.desc: Decodo Web Data API as the fetch provider behind the built-in web_fetch tool: returns Markdown by default, pins fetchProvider to decodo, and enforces a configurable per-process fetch cap. Requires a Decodo API key; web_search is unchanged.

items.name: dsh-free-web-search
items.desc: Free web search with 10 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG/AnySearch free + Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), automatic fallback chain, time-filtered advanced search, platform search (GitHub/Reddit), web page fetching, LRU caching, and a settings UI. No API keys required for basic use.

items.name: dsh-browser-use
items.desc: Real browser tools for DeepSeek Harness: browse and extract web content, fill forms, manage multiple tabs, and execute multi-step tasks, with incremental DOM, session isolation, screenshots, action-result checks, and archived evidence recall.

items.name: dsh-browser#packages/browser/bridge-browser
items.desc: Open the extension side panel and it takes over the page you are browsing right now. On top of upstream it adds: hover, coordinate clicks, drag, batched action chains, whole-page screenshots, local file upload, image listing, and switching between several connected browsers. Pages reach the model as structured text with a numbered element list; actions wait for your approval and sensitive fields stay masked. Ships as the bridge plugin, with the extension in the same release. This project is a fork of omdsh-dev/dsh-browser: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser

items.name: dsh-cdp
items.desc: Drives a Chromium browser you are already running — Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Chromium, Arc or Thorium — over one long-lived CDP connection, so the remote-debugging approval is asked once instead of per command. Commands for tabs, navigation, JS evaluation, DOM snapshots, clicks, typing, screenshots and CSS/DOM/pixel assertions go over a loopback HTTP route that the agent calls with the shell tool it already has, so no new tools are registered, and the plugin registers its own usage skill with no runtime dependencies.

items.name: dsh-browser-cdp
items.desc: Visible agent browser over CDP: 30+ bcdp_* automation tools, realtime SSE watch panel with direct click/scroll/IME input, element picking quoted into the composer as balanced @"picks/*.json" references, and human-verification notices.

items.name: dsh-web-search-microsoft-webiq
items.desc: Microsoft Web IQ search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, endpoint, language, region, passage length and SafeSearch.

items.name: dsh-web-search-ext
items.desc: Multi-backend web_search provider (Exa + Firecrawl) for the built-in web_search tool, with automatic failover, per-backend 429 cooldowns, and key-free anonymous access.

items.name: qp-exa-dynamic
items.desc: Exa-backed web search provider for the ctx.web seam, with Exa Dynamic Highlights on by default and the Exa-Beta header that setting requires; exposes all eight Exa retrieval types, adds an /exa command to change highlights, search type and result count at runtime, and registers an exa_search tool that takes its own result count.

items.name: dsh-web-search-bing
items.desc: Bing-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: prefers Bing's RSS feed with the public cn.bing.com HTML page as fallback, no API key, reachable from mainland China, and keeps searches off the model's own search quota. Endpoint, result count and result language configurable; targets DSH 0.2.x (also works on 0.1.7+).

items.name: dsh-browser#packages/browser/bridge-browser
items.desc: Side-panel Chrome and Firefox extension that lets DSH drive the tab you are on: pages reach the model as structured text with a numbered element list, and clicks, typing and navigation wait for your approval. Beyond upstream it adds viewport screenshots, opening a URL in a new window, scrolling inside nested scroll containers (chat transcripts, side panes, modal bodies), permission-mode, model and slash-command controls in the composer, and an opt-in developer-tools group (elements and CSS, page JavaScript, network requests) that is off by default and approved per call. The install is two halves: the bridge plugin comes from the prebuilt release tarball, and the companion extension ships as a tgz in the same release and is loaded unpacked, which is the only way Chrome accepts it. This project is a fork of omdsh-dev/dsh-browser: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser

items.name: dsh-web-fetch-moli
items.desc: Ultra-lightweight Moli (Rust headless browser) web-fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness: renders complex SPAs, micro-frontends, and dynamic pages with ~60MB memory.

items.name: opencu
items.desc: Computer use with browser automation, approvals and annotations for DSH; full desktop UI and native monitoring require matching host source adapters, patching and a host build.

items.name: dsh-browser-agent
items.desc: 19 browser_* tools that let agents drive DeepSeek Harness's built-in sidebar browser over a loopback bridge: accessibility-tree reads with stable refs, real CDP clicks and keys, screenshots, network interception, device emulation, a cookie vault, document-start script injection, multiple browser instances, and raw CDP passthrough. Requires DSH launched with --remote-debugging-port=9222.

items.name: dsh-web-search-openai
items.desc: OpenAI-compatible web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one baseURL/apiKey/model config powers Qwen Token Plan, OpenAI and any Responses API gateway.

items.name: dsh-opencli
items.desc: Logged-in browser automation with 170+ site adapters as deterministic one-shot commands (requires the OpenCLI CLI, npm i -g @jackwener/opencli, and its BrowserBridge browser extension) — action-evidence verification (no silent failures), site knowledge & health cards, watch monitoring, trace replay, provenance reports, and a write-approval gate.

items.name: dsh-browser
items.desc: Gives the agent a real headed Chromium under the harness home, with browser_open and browser_interact tools that keep page state across calls.

items.name: dsh-browser-agent#dsh-plugin
items.desc: Chrome side-panel browser agent for DeepSeek Harness with tools to inspect pages, navigate, click, type, scroll, and capture screenshots through a local bridge.

items.name: dsh-dschat
items.desc: Embeds the DeepSeek web chat (chat.deepseek.com) in a DSH Desktop main panel through an Electron webview guest, with a back/forward/reload toolbar and a local snapshot of login-related localStorage restored on the next open.

items.name: dsh-webchat
items.desc: Opens the official DeepSeek web app (chat.deepseek.com) inside DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar entry renders the real page in the center column through the desktop shell's native browser guest, and keeps you signed in across restarts. The official client keeps its model picker, deep think, smart search, history and attachments. Falls back to opening a window where no guest bridge exists.

items.name: dsh-plugin-chrome
items.desc: A visible Chrome window per DSH session: 16 chrome_* tools (open/status/close/navigate/tabs/snapshot/screenshot/click/click_at/fill/type/press_key/hover/scroll/evaluate/wait), a Chrome tab in the Web GUI with a live screencast view (screenshot-heartbeat fallback for idle pages), tab management, window controls and a screenshot history.

items.name: dsh-web-recorder
items.desc: Records real clicks, inputs, navigation and network traffic in a user-guided browser session for DSH, then generates a Markdown timeline report (report.md + events.jsonl) to build API-level skills.

items.name: dsh-web-fetch-fakeip
items.desc: A fake-ip-aware ctx.web fetch provider that takes over the stock http provider id: a hostname is accepted when every DNS answer is a placeholder inside the proxy's fake-ip block (198.18.0.0/15 by default), so web_fetch works under mihomo/Clash TUN mode without disabling fake-ip or setting proxy environment variables. IP literals and private, loopback and reserved destinations stay blocked.

items.name: dsh-browser
items.desc: Controlled browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: the agent_browser tool and BrowserAutomationService drive a real Chromium or Chrome page (or an explicit CDP endpoint) through the agent-browser CLI, with allowedDomains containment and per-call output limits.

items.name: dsh-keenable
items.desc: Keenable web search and page fetch for the built-in web_search and web_fetch tools, working with any model and no API key.

items.name: dsh-web-kimi
items.desc: Kimi Coding web search and web fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness — one coding-plan key fills both ctx.web seams (POST /v1/search and /v1/fetch), a settings card in the GUI stores it via the credentials service, and the fallback chain reads the Kimi CLI config for zero-setup installs.

items.name: dsh-web-search-doubao
items.desc: Doubao Search (Volcengine 豆包搜索) web search provider for the DeepSeek Harness — swaps the active web_search backend to the standalone Doubao Search API with its own key and billing (500 free searches per month), and ships a dedicated settings card that stores the key via the credentials service.

items.name: dsh-web-search
items.desc: Configurable web search for DeepSeek Harness using SearXNG, Wikipedia, Tavily, Brave, or Gemini, with per-client engine selection and bounded retries.

items.name: dsh-browser-ops
items.desc: Browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: agent-driven real-browser control (managed Chrome with an isolated persistent profile, or attach to your daily Chrome over CDP) with snapshot, click, fill and page-reading tools; records manual operation flows and replays them with variable slots to create test data on demand; ships 27 browser_* tools plus a Settings panel.

items.name: dsh-douyin-agent
items.desc: Browses Douyin videos in a dedicated Edge browser with configurable time limits, shared local persona and interest memory, native settings, and Markdown viewing reports. Messaging, sharing, greetings, and public comments each require separate opt-in permissions.

items.name: dsh-native-browser
items.desc: Controls user-authorized Chrome tabs from DeepSeek Harness through a local native-messaging broker, with semantic page reads, actions, screenshots, and explicit handoff.

items.name: dsh-web-search
items.desc: Web search and fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness and Pi: anonymous-first routing across Exa, Tavily, Parallel, Firecrawl and TinyFish, with opt-in billing, quota preflight and bounded cancellation.

items.name: dsh-browser-tabs
items.desc: Type /tabs to pick a browser tab (via chrome-devtools-mcp) and auto-fill its URL into the composer.

items.name: pi-control-chrome#dsh-tool-control-chrome
items.desc: Chrome and Edge browser control that drives the real logged-in profile, tabs and cookies through an MV3 extension and a loopback Bridge, exposing browser_* tools, a Skill and /chrome commands.

items.name: dsh-browser-service
items.desc: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless Chromium over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.

items.name: dsh-moli-browser
items.desc: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless moli browser over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed; single-engine moli serve with auto LD_LIBRARY_PATH/FONTCONFIG_FILE injection and a persistent profile dir for logins), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.

items.name: dsh-search-hub
items.desc: Configurable web search hub for the built-in web_search tool: switch the active entry between DeepSeek official native search and Zhipu GLM web_search, with entry and credential management on a Settings page tab.

items.name: deepseek-harness-zhipu_plan_tools
items.desc: Zhipu (GLM Coding Plan) web suite as native DSH providers and tools: rebinds the built-in web_search and web_fetch to Zhipu web search and Markdown page reading, optionally registers github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure / github_read_file repo tools, and adds a settings card with toggles and a credential-ref field.

items.name: dsh-tinyfish-search
items.desc: TinyFish-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: each search is one GET to the TinyFish Search API, no model call.

items.name: dsh-plugin-browser
items.desc: Native headless and visible Chromium browser automation agent for DeepSeek Harness with DOM tree extraction, screenshot capture, and built-in SSRF protection.

items.name: dsh-browser-playwright-codex
items.desc: Browser automation for DSH: the agent fills in forms, scrapes lists and works across tabs in real pages, using the logins you already have. It drives its own visible window on your desktop — minimise it and it keeps working without stealing focus — and a sign-in, CAPTCHA or native dialog stops the run and hands the page back to you: it never confirms on your behalf. Login state persists (own profile plus session-cookie re-injection). 23 Playwright tools (20 always on, 3 gated and off by default), with a URL allowlist, dialog suspension and a CDP method allowlist that are mechanism-level and pinned by tests.

items.name: hermes-web-mcp
items.desc: Keyless web powers for any MCP client: web_search, JS-rendered web_extract over dual CDP Chrome with proxy failover, and 7 real-browser page_* tools in an isolated context.

items.name: dsh-gui-auth-url
items.desc: Agent tool that returns the running DSH Web GUI URL including its per-process launch token, so browser automation can open the GUI instead of getting a 401.

items.name: dsh-web-search-glm
items.desc: Zhipu GLM web search provider: registers as `glm` on the ctx.web seam and runs the native web_search server tool through GLM's Anthropic-compatible API (Coding Plan billing).

items.name: dsh-browser
items.desc: An AI-native browser workspace for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), combining multi-tab browsing, live page annotations, lightweight code editing, workspace previews, and Agent-assisted iteration across Web and Desktop.

items.name: dsh-chrome-bridge#plugin
items.desc: macOS only (native messaging); needs Chrome 116+ and Node 18+. Controls the Chrome you are already logged into, over native messaging and chrome.debugger instead of a listening port. Ships 11 browser_* tools and a cb CLI, dispatches real CDP input events, draws an on-page cursor that also appears in screenshots, and adds a toolbar panel with live status, the controlled tabs and a pause switch. The native host and the MV3 extension travel inside this tarball: on first load the plugin copies them into place and writes the native-messaging registration itself, so there is no clone, no install.sh and no python3 - the one step left is adding the extension to Chrome: install DSH Bridge from the Chrome Web Store (https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bippcbbbipppmhjkjomgdnjbooecbimo, no Developer mode), or load the bundled unpacked copy at chrome://extensions (the plugin opens that page and puts the folder on the clipboard for you). Until then the tools fail loudly with those steps. On Windows/Linux the plugin reports the macOS-only platform requirement instead of failing silently.

items.name: dsh-keyless-search
items.desc: Registers a keyless search provider for the built-in web_search tool so it works without an API key, failing over between the documented no-key tiers of Tavily and Firecrawl; a TAVILY_API_KEY or FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is picked up automatically when present. Two Bing scrape backends are included but off by default.

items.name: dsh-browser-plus
items.desc: Visible Electron browser for DSH with one shared BrowserWindow, isolated task views, explicit human-Agent handoff, snapshot-reference and native navigation tools, operation trails, demand-driven page thumbnails, keyed session recovery for reliable tab switching and closing, and site-scoped cookie clearing for login maintenance.

items.name: dsh-web-search-zhipu
items.desc: GLM (Zhipu bigmodel) web search provider - routes ctx.web search through Zhipu's Anthropic-compatible endpoint with the native web_search server tool, billing your existing GLM quota or Coding Plan instead of the DeepSeek platform. Includes a translation layer for Zhipu's non-standard tool_result response layout.

items.name: dsh-browser4
items.desc: Installs the browser4-cli runtime and registers the Browser4 skills (browser4-cli, browser4-experience, browser4-plugin, scent-miner) into the DSH skill registry, providing an AI-native browser engine for autonomous agents, intelligent extraction, and large-scale web automation.

items.name: dsh-research-plugins#dsh-mcp-firecrawl
items.desc: Firecrawl MCP bridge: hosted Firecrawl MCP server with keyless search, scrape and parse; an API key unlocks the full tool surface including crawl and map.

items.name: dsh-research-plugins#dsh-tavily
items.desc: Tavily Search API as a web search provider (settings toggle with DeepSeek fallback, keyless search) plus a Tavily MCP bridge: keyless search and extract tools, crawl and map with an API key.

items.name: dsh-web-search-fetch
items.desc: Aggregated web_search and web_fetch providers for DeepSeek Harness, sitting behind the built-in tools. Search fans one query out to AnySearch, Zhipu and Zhihu concurrently, dedupes URLs, fuses ranks with Reciprocal Rank Fusion and optionally reranks through SiliconFlow. Fetch is URL-aware: static pages pass through the built-in HTTP fetcher, dynamic ones fan out to Firecrawl and AnySearch extract and pick one body by quality. One shared circuit breaker skips an engine for the day after a quota or 429 signal, and a settings card keeps each engine API key in the credential store without ever showing its value.

items.name: dsh-webstack
items.desc: SearXNG search and Scrapling multi-tier fetch provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness ctx.web with SSRF protection and markdown conversion.

items.name: dsh-web-search-tavily
items.desc: Tavily-backed search provider for native web_search, with a Settings → Plugins card for API key management and toggling DeepSeek replacement.

items.name: dsh-browser-use
items.desc: Browser provider for DeepSeek Harness: hand it a web task — open a page, click, type, fill a form, read what is on it — and it drives a real browser step by step, seeing an indexed table of what can be done on the current page instead of raw HTML or screenshots. Each step is one bundled-Jev decision rather than a full model turn (1.1 s median per step versus 2.8–3.6 s for chat-model turns in the repo benchmark), and the main conversation receives only the conclusion, so its context does not grow with the page. Targets come from the page it just read and a changed page is re-read rather than clicked blind, and it runs in the browser that Session owns, leaving your everyday Chrome untouched unless you switch to attach mode.

items.name: dsh-html-inspector
items.desc: Selection mode for HTML preview and browser tabs: click any element in a locally served demo page and its locator (selector, text, HTML snippet) is written into the chat input for precise AI editing.

items.name: dsh-browsercontrol-mcp
items.desc: Mounts Microsoft's Playwright MCP through the official dsh-mcp-client so the agent gets its browser tools over stdio; the one-time CDP authorization is guided by a prompt note, a call guard and the /bw-setup command.

items.name: dsh-doyourweb
items.desc: Reference already-open Chrome and Edge tabs with @ mentions in DSH; reuse login state to read pages, run batched actions, take screenshots and call WebMCP tools on supported pages through a paired browser extension.

items.name: dsh-web-search-ollama
items.desc: Routes the DSH web_search tool through Ollama's web search API, reusing OLLAMA_API_KEY. No DeepSeek official key needed.

items.name: dsh-tavily-pool
items.desc: Takes over the built-in web_search and web_fetch providers with Tavily, each behind its own toggle: a key pool with balance-aware scheduling that reads real credit balances from /usage, failover with hard exclusion of cooling or exhausted keys, and call history with a 14-day credit chart.

items.name: dsh-webmcp
items.desc: WebMCP bridge: your agent discovers & calls site tools exposed over the W3C WebMCP protocol via a built-in headless Chromium.

items.name: dsh-tabbit
items.desc: Gives DeepSeek Harness control of the Tabbit Browser: auto-loads the tabbit-browser skill on install, detects official Tabbit and Tabbit Browser releases (>= 1.9.0), checks the tabbit-cli persistent runtime, diagnoses the per-platform DSH sandbox mode needed to call the CLI, and downloads the region-matched official installer via a background job when no qualifying version is present.

items.name: better-crawler4agent
items.desc: Registers a real-browser URL-to-text MCP server in a DSH profile: fetch_url and fetch_urls render JavaScript-heavy and anti-bot Chinese pages (Zhihu, CSDN, Juejin, cnblogs) and return clean article text as JSON with per-tier diagnostics, and crawler_status reports whether the browser is available. Needs a one-time Python dependency setup after install.

items.name: browserskill#dsh-plugin-browserskill
items.desc: BrowserSkill bridge for controlling visible Chrome and Edge Agent Windows from DeepSeek Harness, with native browser tools, accessibility and VOM observations, screenshots, owned multi-session control, and a live Web UI overlay.

items.name: dsh-search-enhance
items.desc: Grok-compatible web search with retained source pagination, Context7 and Exa documentation lookup, bounded page extraction, site mapping, offline research planning, and read-only diagnostics.

items.name: dsh-web-search-openrouter
items.desc: The built-in web_search bills a full model turn against DeepSeek's own endpoint; this runs it on an OpenRouter-compatible gateway instead, so search is billed where your chat already is, at the model and price you pick.

items.name: dsh-dragon-control
items.desc: Windows x64 only, 0.5.3 preview: two scoped tools (dragon_browser and dragon_desktop) that drive a visible browser through the DOM or CDP and Windows apps through UI Automation, with per-origin and per-executable read/control scopes, batch steps, a physical-Esc emergency stop and a redacted action log. Two long-lived native processes remove the per-action process spawn, so a single key step takes about 0.7 s on the same machine; when another window steals the foreground the step is aborted instead of typing into the wrong place. The browser side ships its own Edge/Chrome launcher and CDP client, so it no longer needs another browser plugin or the Electron runtime. It is not an OS sandbox; logins, admin windows and secure desktops stay with the user.

items.name: dsh-bing-search
items.desc: Maintained fork of godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing adapted to DSH 0.1.5-rc.1: Bing-backed provider for the built-in web_search tool, scraping the public cn.bing.com HTML results page with no API key, reachable from mainland China, and keeping searches off the model's own search quota. Endpoint and result count configurable.

items.name: dsh-web-fetch-fakeip-plugin
items.desc: Makes the built-in web_fetch tool work when Clash / mihomo runs in TUN mode with fake-ip: it lets the fake-ip address ranges (198.18.0.0/15, fdfe:dcba:9876::/64, 2001:2::/48) past the public-address check that otherwise rejects them, while loopback, private and link-local addresses stay blocked as before. Works with no proxy environment variables and no Clash changes.

items.name: dsh-chrome-cdp
items.desc: Chrome DevTools Protocol Plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Use chrome-remote-interface to connect to and control Chrome via CDP. The connection includes a graphical interface.

items.name: dsh-jev-ultrafast
items.desc: Drive a browser from one natural-language goal: a decision service picks the next operation and target from an indexed element table, so a DSH session spends one tool call instead of one turn per click.

items.name: aginxbrowser#dsh-aginxbrowser
items.desc: Web access for DSH agents: fetch JS-rendered or protected pages as clean markdown, aggregated search across 14 engines, and stateful interactive sessions (click, type, scroll, eval, screenshot) against a hosted or self-hosted Rust browser engine. Every session returns a live view URL so a human can watch the agent browse and take over with the mouse.

items.name: dsh_academic_web_proxy
items.desc: Opens academic sites through institutional proxy rules and optionally renames eligible new PDFs using matched article metadata, with Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and US English settings.

items.name: dsh-browser-crossplatform#bridge
items.desc: Desktop half of the dsh browser extension: mounts a token-authenticated WebSocket bridge on the dsh webserver and exposes the browser_* tools that let the model read the tab you are on as text and act on it, with image recognition off until the user enables it.

items.name: browser-mcp
items.desc: Drives a real Chrome through a local MCP server so the agent can search Google/Bing/Sogou, read any page including JS-rendered and login-only content, automate click/scroll/type/key-press/select in a background window, and run platform search/detail/comment/download for Zhihu, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, X and Reddit; resumable comments, SHA-256-verified downloads, cookies never returned, localhost only.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-tavily-search
items.desc: Tavily backend for the built-in web search: an in-process endpoint at 127.0.0.1:8787/v1 turns its requests into Tavily searches; up to 10 API keys stay in the DSH credential store, rotate per request and switch on auth, rate-limit or quota errors; a settings card manages keys, runs a test search and points web search at the endpoint.

items.name: dsh-web-search-tavily
items.desc: Registers a Tavily search provider for the ctx.web seam and switches web_search to it, with a comma-separated apiKey list that rotates on 401/403/429/5xx and transport errors.

items.name: dsh-image2-plugin
items.desc: Registers an `image2_generate` tool that calls your own OpenAI-compatible image relay to generate or edit pictures (text-to-image via POST /images/generations, image-to-image via POST /images/edits with a local PNG/JPEG/WebP reference, accepting b64_json or image URLs), saves them in the session working directory, and renders them inline in the conversation through its `@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer` dependency.

items.name: dsh-image-conatiner
items.desc: Displays generated images in a conversation gallery with a lightbox viewer.

items.name: dsh-vision-bridge
items.desc: Adds image input and recognition through configured DSH providers or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

items.name: dsh-image-preview
items.desc: Image previews for DSH sessions: read_image thumbnails plus user, assistant, Markdown and present images in a lightbox with zoom, rotate, pan, download, sidebar and native file actions.

items.name: dsh-pdf-reader
items.desc: A content-aware PDF reading plugin for vision models: profiles each page for figures (vector and raster), tables, formula risk and double-column layout, then applies content-aware hybrid extraction, rendering figure/table/formula pages as high-DPI region crops. Provides a low-resolution preview to understand the page layout, and renders a specified region at high resolution. Packaged as multiple tools for agents.

items.name: dsh-client-vision#tool-vision
items.desc: Screen capture and external vision recognition: take_screenshot, list_windows, analyze_image and view_image tools with a configurable GPT vision channel (gpt-5.5 / gpt-5.6-sol / gpt-5.6-terra), API key via the credentials service, and a settings card; view_image shows the screenshot in the Web UI while the model context keeps text only.

items.name: dsh-image-generation#tool-image-generation
items.desc: Model-facing image-generation tool with a configurable channel and normalized image parameters.

items.name: dsh-highres-vision
items.desc: For the DeepSeek Harness native vision model deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp, raises image admission limits to 32 MiB / 8192 px / 600 images and adds a highres_read tool that tiles large images, then returns the whole image plus 800x800 tiles through the host read_image tool.

items.name: dseyesopen
items.desc: Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek: send images (alone or mixed with text) and a fast tiny vision model describes them behind the scenes — the chat keeps the picture, DeepSeek sees only text. Pure plugin: uninstall restores everything.

items.name: opencode-eyes
items.desc: Eyes for text-only models: mounts the bundled stdio MCP server as mcp__opencode_eyes__describe_image, which sends an image file to StepFun step-3.7-flash and returns a detailed description.

items.name: opencode-eyes-nvidia
items.desc: Vision through NVIDIA NIM: mounts the bundled stdio MCP server as mcp__opencode_eyes_nvidia__describe_image, which describes an image with any of seven hosted vision models (MiniMax-M3 by default) and rotates several API keys.

items.name: opencode-ppocr-mcp
items.desc: Local OCR with nothing sent to a cloud: mounts the PP-OCRv6 Medium stdio MCP server (PaddleOCR on ONNX Runtime, CPU) as mcp__ppocr__ocr_image and mcp__ppocr__ocr_pdf for images and multi-page PDFs.

items.name: phone-eye
items.desc: Let your AI agent see and operate a real Android phone: phone_look (vision + UI-tree fusion), tap/swipe/type, screenshot — over adb, for any MCP client.

items.name: dsh-vision-plugin
items.desc: Configurable image recognition for text-only DSH models: attached images are preserved through the DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 adapter pipeline, transcribed by an OpenAI-compatible vision model, and passed to the main model as text. Supports selectable OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or Azure auth headers and reports a missing API key before sending a request.

items.name: dsh-gpt-image
items.desc: Generate images through a logged-in web ChatGPT session and download them to a local directory.

items.name: dsh-image-compare
items.desc: Adds a right-column panel that compares a set of images the user picks from the workspace — 1/2/3/4/6 per page, per-image zoom and pan, the zoom and viewed position of one image synced onto the whole set, and a reorderable filmstrip. The browser loads every image, so none of it reaches the model.

items.name: aura-vision
items.desc: Free vision OCR with adaptive tile recognition for long documents and Markdown/Word/PNG/Excel export.

items.name: dsh-image-gen
items.desc: Image generation with a sidebar gallery page and three agent tools (paint_image, paint_images, edit_painting); preset providers include ModelScope, Google Gemini, OpenAI, SiliconFlow, Volcengine Seedream, Alibaba DashScope, xAI and Zhipu, plus any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, each with its own proxy setting.

items.name: local-ocr
items.desc: Registers one `ocr` tool for text-only models: it runs the offline script bundled in the repo over a single image or PDF and returns the recognized text — Windows native OCR first, then RapidOCR, then Tesseract. Recognition runs locally with no network request and no API key. Needs Python 3.11 on PATH plus `pip install winocr pillow` (winocr is the preferred engine; RapidOCR and Tesseract are fallbacks). Per-line results for images, per-page results for PDFs.

items.name: dsh-image-pathify
items.desc: Lets text-only models handle pasted chat images, with a native vision experience, batch image viewing, and a built-in OpenAI-compatible analyze_image tool; vision-capable models are unaffected.

items.name: dsh-vision-diff
items.desc: Pixel-level screenshot diff for visual regression. Two local PNGs in; a machine-readable first line (`PIXEL_CHANGED=true|false`, greppable as an assertion), then the difference ratio, per-region bounding boxes, maximum channel delta and mean absolute error, plus a self-contained HTML comparison page. An ignore-region list with absolute or fractional coordinates excludes clocks, cursors and other per-render noise. It deliberately does no content recognition: it answers only "did this change", which is the part that can be made deterministic. Entirely local — no model call, no network, no upload.

items.name: dsh-vision-better
items.desc: Vision relay for text-only models: a configurable GLM-compatible vision endpoint analyzes the images you attach in the background and the original model keeps answering in the same session, leaving your message, image, model and history untouched.
