Requires applying patches/0001-session-image-admission.patch to a stock DSH install (images are rejected before storage otherwise); the repo ships an apply/restore script.

items.name: dsh-labnana
items.desc: Labnana image generation for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image / image-to-image / precise editing with credits estimation, subscription balance and web settings UI.

items.name: dsh-comfyui
items.desc: Drive a local or remote ComfyUI server from DeepSeek Harness: comfyui_run / comfyui_object_info / comfyui_workflow tools generate and edit images and videos, with a workflow library (graph extraction: per component / main flow / all), a load area with resolution auto-match, a live queue, SDXL and Wan 2.1 templates, a companion skill, and a same-origin media proxy.

items.name: dsh-vision-bridge
items.desc: Routes images to a vision model of your choice - auto-rewrite, explicit tools, or hybrid - so a text-only chat model does not fail a turn that contains a picture.

items.name: dsh-ocr-local
items.desc: Local OCR fallback for text-only routes: when the session model declares it cannot accept images, the attached image is cached locally and its path injected so the model can call ocr_image — PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime on CPU, no API key, images never leave the machine. Silent when the model can see images.

items.name: dsh-vision-analysis
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness vision plugin: 8 analysis modes (describe, OCR, chart data, UI review, object detection, compare, code-gen, debug), any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible vision API, with a built-in free vision model and automatic rate-limit failover.

items.name: dsh-maclens
items.desc: Apple on-device Vision tools for text-only dsh models: local OCR (zh-Hans + 30 langs), image classification, face detection, document layout, and a combined describe — 100% offline, no API key, tall-screenshot slicing.

items.name: dsh-omni-workstation
items.desc: Omni-modal workstation for DSH: analyze_image over an ordered multi-card VLM failover chain, a six-tool vision toolkit (zoom, colour sampling, pixel diff, OCR, element detection, inline display) sharing the same image resolver, generate_image over OpenAI/DashScope/ComfyUI protocols, multi-card async generate_video with a /build-video-tool builder, and speak/clone_voice TTS over seven providers, all driven by one auto-saving settings page.

items.name: dsh-tool-visual-primitives
items.desc: Analyzes conversation images through mode-specific prompts (caption, UI, document, grounding, topology, etc.) and injects structured evidence with coordinate primitives (boxes, points, refs) as text, with session-level caching for reuse across replay and compaction.

items.name: dsh-mmroute
items.desc: Transparent multimodal routing for text-only models: every image in every model call is fully transcribed (verbatim OCR, data, uncertainty zones, injection-hardened) by your own multimodal understander, with focused re-look via vision_relook and automatic retry on image-related failures. No bundled endpoints, no borrowed logins.

items.name: dsh-auto-vision
items.desc: Auto-switch the DeepSeek route to the vision model on demand: flash main session switches (A), pro keeps deep reasoning and delegates image reading to a vision subagent (B), subagents always switch, with fatal-failure fallback. No manual model switching.

items.name: dsh-qwen-studio
items.desc: Qwen Image 2.1 workspace for DSH: Apple Silicon MLX or your own NVIDIA server, native reference editing, LoRA, ControlNet, inpainting, shared presets, gallery and live agent progress. Includes verified updates and an agent setup guide.

items.name: deepseek-plugin
items.desc: Turn every idea into an image or video with Kling AI. In DeepSeek Harness, use natural language for text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-image creation, task tracking, and result previews.

items.name: dsh-visibridge
items.desc: Structured vision evidence (OCR/layout/semantics) plus a USB camera capture tool for a "shoot-look-adjust" debug loop; backends: Ollama, DeepSeek, Xiaomi.

items.name: godot-imagegen
items.desc: Local art pipeline for DSH: drives the locally installed SD WebUI and ComfyUI backends through ten image_* tools and an Art Studio sidebar panel with an embedded ComfyUI canvas, post-processes with the Python shipped with those installs (rembg cutout, Real-ESRGAN upscale, seamless tiling), and writes Godot-ready assets with res:// paths once a project root is set.

items.name: deepseek-continuity
items.desc: Local image, voice, music and SFX generation plus transcription, with pinned identity: characters, animals, objects and actor voices are defined once and reused on every later call, degenerate output (a near-flat image, silent audio) is rejected instead of returned as success, and a generated line can be read back as text so a clone that swallowed its ending becomes visible. The engines unload when idle, and image generation and transcription can each be pointed at an OpenAI-shaped API instead of the local Vulkan backend.

items.name: screenshot-feedback-hook-mcp#dsh-screenshot-feedback-hook-mcp
items.desc: Adds a take screenshot tool plus two optional automatic capture points, putting the screen into the conversation as an image block; requires an image-capable model.

items.name: visionforge
items.desc: Vision understanding + image generation/editing for DeepSeek Harness (read images with Qwen/OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini, generate and edit with Qwen-Image). A rework of liustack/modlens (MIT). Remove @liustack/modlens first — both register the same vision providers and image interception hooks, so co-installation breaks image reading.

items.name: dsh-image-guard
items.desc: Trims historical images in outgoing chat requests down to a recent-image count, learns the provider per-prompt image cap from HTTP 400 responses, and retries with fewer images so image-heavy sessions keep working.

items.name: dsh-capture
items.desc: Dual-engine screen capture for DSH: inside the SSiD desktop shell, a global hotkey or tray opens a fullscreen box-select overlay (all monitors, per-display pixel-perfect frames) with in-place red-box annotation and a WeChat-style toolbar; in plain DSH (browser), the composer camera button captures the display via getDisplayMedia and reuses the same single-phase box-select + annotation overlay in-page. The cropped image lands in the current conversation composer through the official attachment intake.

items.name: lookover#dsh-look
items.desc: Scene-awareness probe for DSH on macOS: a privacy-first, pull-model `look` tool that reads the frontmost non-self window (app info, AX title/selection, gated local OCR), plus a summon-hotkey snapshot captured the instant you press.

items.name: dsh-image-insight
items.desc: Structured image recognition: local sharp measurements plus a cloud vision model return description, OCR with coordinates, object locations and fine-grained attributes in one call; a fingerprint cache makes repeated images return in milliseconds without spending model quota.

items.name: dsh-read-animation
items.desc: Reads animated GIF and WebP as animations: a pasted one keeps playing in the UI while the model gets a labelled sheet of frames sampled across it, and the read_animation tool samples a file on demand.

items.name: dsh-hos-scrcpy
items.desc: Control a HarmonyOS phone from the DSH web UI with AI: live H.264 screen mirroring, mouse touch and system keys, hilog streaming, and agentic tools that let the model read the screen, locate UI controls, then tap, long-press, press keys, or type.

items.name: dsh-draw
items.desc: Multi-engine text-to-image generation (OpenAI Images and Zhipu CogView presets) with per-session quota tracking, engine failover, credential-safe config, and a result card with regenerate.

items.name: dsh-imagegen-video
items.desc: AI image and video generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image over per-channel model catalogs with per-family request shaping (gpt-image, Grok Imagine, Nano Banana, Seedream, GLM-Image, Qwen-Image, MiniMax image-01, DALL-E 3), a sidebar generation studio, an infinite canvas with node workflows, files preview and canvas skills, and a prompt template library; the video side adds text-to-video, image-to-video, first/last-keyframe and multi-reference modes on an async submit/poll/download pipeline, host-side video tools, video nodes on the canvas, and clip stitching of two or more video nodes into one MP4 with the local ffmpeg.

items.name: dsh-comfyui-image
items.desc: Generate images from the agent on the user's own GPU by queueing a workflow on a local ComfyUI install over its HTTP API: Z-Image-Turbo for fast drafts and Qwen-Image-2.1 for final assets and legible in-image text. Registers comfyui_generate and comfyui_status plus a skill covering model selection and prompt craft, has no runtime dependencies, and starts ComfyUI headless when no server is listening.

items.name: dsh-omni-vision
items.desc: Local eyes for text-only models: eyes_render draws text/shapes/Mermaid onto a canvas in the Web GUI, eyes_paste captures pasted images, eyes_ocr reads text via the built-in Windows OCR (offline), and eyes_analyze inspects pixels as structured data — no vision model required.

items.name: dsh-tool-vision
items.desc: Send local images or HTTP(S) image URLs to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint with the inspect_image tool and return its text response to the conversation.

items.name: dsh-vision-pro-bridge
items.desc: Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek models: transcribes attached images with deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp before they reach deepseek-v4-pro, with no third-party dependencies.

items.name: dsh-video-kit
items.desc: Reads a local video or page link with ffmpeg and Paraformer ASR, returning a timestamped transcript plus key-frame images the agent can open; finds candidate videos by keyword and installs its own runtime dependencies on first use. Requires Python 3.8+ on PATH; video_discover also needs a one-time douyin/xiaohongshu login.

items.name: dsh-image-tiler
items.desc: Shows oversized images to the model at readable resolution instead of one downscaled copy: before admission, a large upload is split into as many tiles as the attachment store allows (an 8000x8000 screenshot becomes 20 tiles of 2000x1600), so small text survives. Replaces the local attachment store; adds no settings of its own.

items.name: taxue-dsh-artisan
items.desc: Integrated visual creation toolchain for DSH: prompt reverse-engineering and audit optimization plus multi-provider image generation with async background rendering.

items.name: dsh-paddle-ocr
items.desc: Add PaddleOCR vision to text-only LLMs like Agnes, DeepSeek, MiniMax, GLM and Mimo. Supports local files and URLs. Free tier of 20,000 pages/day; needs a PaddleOCR API token you apply for (free, 1-3 business days).

items.name: dsh-ocr-free
items.desc: Local OCR using Apple Vision on macOS: text from screenshots, photos, and scans, with no install, no network and no API key.

items.name: dsh-comfyui-image
items.desc: Image generation through a local ComfyUI server: one generate_image tool covering text2img, img2img, inpaint and background removal.

items.name: dsh-image-generation
items.desc: Configure multiple image providers in Settings and call image_generate with the one selected model; images save under generate/image and show inline in the conversation.

items.name: dsh-vision-unlock
items.desc: Removes the model-capability gate that blocks image prompts: patches llm.resolveModelInfo results and adapter model tables to declare image input, so routes with no declared input modality can send and read images. No app.asar or config-tree edits.

items.name: dsh-appshots
items.desc: Codex-style window capture for DSH Desktop on macOS and Windows: press both Command keys (macOS) or both Ctrl keys (Windows), or the camera button, to grab the frontmost window, attach it to the current chat, and inject a VoiceOver-style accessibility tree as hidden context.

items.name: dsh-image-viewer
items.desc: Upgrades DSH image viewing with pointer-centered zoom, pan, galleries, downloads, keyboard support, and inline region notes.

items.name: dsh-image-vision
items.desc: Image understanding for any DSH model: vision, OCR, grounding, and crop tools with domain presets for histopathology, cell biology, anatomy, clinical images and scientific figures.

items.name: dsh-vision-hub#tool-vision
items.desc: Enhanced vision toolbox: 14 pixel-level vision tools (describe, ground, detect, crop, pixel-diff, OCR, long-screenshot OCR, vectorize, colors, cutout, screenshot, present, materialize, html-screenshot) driven by one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with clean \[图片: path] bridge markers, content-safety classification and rate-limit auto-retry.

items.name: computer-use-vision
items.desc: Windows computer-use capability for DSH: screenshot → vision model → simulated mouse/keyboard with self-evolving knowledge base. Dual-mode plugin tools + skill-only pwsh fallback.

items.name: deepseek-harness-plugins#vision-bridge
items.desc: Let text-only models see images: when a picture arrives with a placeholder like \[image omitted because this model accepts text only], the model calls the vision_describe tool and the plugin forwards the image reference plus the question to a multimodal model, retrying with a fallback model on failure. Configured in the settings page and persisted via the official settings API.

items.name: phone-lens#phone-lens
items.desc: Turn a phone camera into a live viewfinder and photo input for your dsh session, over LAN or USB.

items.name: dsh-omni-modal
items.desc: Adds an Omni-modal settings section to DeepSeek Harness that points the harness at any OpenAI-compatible image and video endpoint: switchable config profiles with separate endpoint, API key, model, path and size for each side, free-form extra request parameters, a connectivity test that does not spend generation quota, and three model-visible tools — generate_image, generate_video and check_video — with async video tasks that survive restarts.

items.name: dsh-image-router
items.desc: Digests the images in a prompt with a vision model before admission, so any model — a text-only one included — can read them without the session ever switching models, and adds a describe_image tool for image paths.

items.name: dsh-ocr
items.desc: Registers two tools for DeepSeek Harness. `doc_ocr` turns scanned PDFs and images into structured text (per-page text, financial tables with a balance-sheet tie-out check, contract-clause hits) through a local RapidOCR engine or a Zhipu GLM-OCR cloud engine, and `doc_preprocess` turns a directory of raw files into an Obsidian-ready knowledge base through a seven-stage pipeline with backend routing and sha256-based incremental skipping. Numbers that fail the tie-out are reported, not invented. The local engine needs Python 3 with rapidocr-onnxruntime, pypdfium2 and Pillow (pip install -r requirements.txt); the GLM engine needs ZHIPU_API_KEY.

items.name: dsh-agnes-studio
items.desc: AI image and video studio as a floating DSH panel, so creation runs alongside the conversation instead of replacing it: text-to-image, image-to-image and multi-image composition at 1K-4K across eight aspect ratios; text-to-video and image-to-video with first-frame control at 4-12 seconds; short-drama mode that imports a script (.txt/.md/.json), breaks it into storyboard shots for preview and batch generation; and a prompt-expert workspace. Zero runtime dependencies.

items.name: dsh-mimotts
items.desc: MiMo TTS speech synthesis for DeepSeek Harness: a speak button on finalized assistant messages with an inline player (draggable progress bar), a plugin-page configuration card with preview playback, and a voice-history settings page.

items.name: dsh-tts-flash
items.desc: Reads AI replies aloud as they stream, with voiced waiting phrases while the model thinks. Edge TTS built in, any OpenAI-compatible cloud engine supported.

items.name: dsh-livevoice
items.desc: Realtime WebRTC voice using Codex OAuth, with task delegation to a DSH session.

items.name: dsh-localtts
items.desc: Connects existing IndexTTS 2.5 and GPT-SoVITS installations for sentence-level assistant reading in Harness web, with local process launch and playback controls.

items.name: dsh-dictation-hotkey
items.desc: Push-to-talk dictation for the Web composer: hold a hotkey to record and the transcript is written into the draft through DSH's own speech Remote (local SenseVoice), with an optional auto-send.

items.name: dsh-soundscape
items.desc: Dual-MediaPlayer daemon ($think loop + $fx one-shots) with volume ducking, mood-aware sounds (smooth/struggle/deep_think triggered by consecutive success/failure streaks and prolonged agent runtime), 15 built-in PCM WAV synthesised from sine/square waveforms, per-tool sound mapping with 51 categorised tools, custom WAV/MP3 drop-in with auto-conversion, and a full settings UI with dark-mode fix.

items.name: dsh-voice-call
items.desc: Voice call assistant for the DSH desktop app and the Web GUI (the same plugin, only the profile name differs): a draggable floating call ball, browser-side VAD that sends each utterance after a pause, speech recognition through the local SenseVoice model already downloaded by the official voice-input plugin (no second model), FunASR HTTP or streaming, or a cloud-compatible API, MiniMax / MiMo-V2.5-TTS (director mode and voice clone) / OpenAI-compatible TTS replies, an optional wake-word mode with auto-sleep, and task dispatch to separate sessions with progress, stop, and spoken completion reports.

items.name: dsh-read-aloud
items.desc: Adds a speaker button immediately right of the Like button on every finalized assistant reply; click it to hear the reply through the browser speech engine, and hover it for a speed and voice panel.

items.name: dsh-ears-prosody
items.desc: Local offline prosody analysis for DeepSeek Harness: reports how something was said — speed, pitch, pauses, energy — alongside the transcript.

items.name: dsh-voice-talk
items.desc: Voice conversation mode for the DSH Web GUI: tap the mic to start a full-screen call, talk hands-free, and hear each reply read aloud as it streams. Bilingual (Chinese/English) UI, light and dark themes, adjustable speech rate, and switchable voices.

items.name: dsh-say
items.desc: Speaks your agent's reports in a voice you choose, compressing long reports before speaking. Character voices need no training - a 3-10 second reference clip clones one, and community-trained models work too - and no 6.4 GB GPT-SoVITS install: the plugin installs its own runtime and voice. An existing GPT-SoVITS can be used instead, and it is the same voice model.

items.name: dsh-funasr-voice
items.desc: Offline voice input for the DSH Web UI: mic to local FunASR (SenseVoiceSmall), one-click install, no cloud.

items.name: dsh-voice-announcer
items.desc: Voice announcements when a conversation ends (session title, round, outcome) plus live sentence-by-sentence reading of replies, via built-in edge-tts with zero third-party dependencies.

items.name: dsh-voice-doubao
items.desc: Adds two Volcengine Doubao cloud speech recognizers to the DeepSeek Harness voice-input picker, optionally rewriting the transcript with an LLM.

items.name: dsh-tts
items.desc: Speaks agent replies in the DeepSeek Harness web UI through a provider fallback chain (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google, Azure, Groq, Deepgram, OpenRouter, Edge, Piper, eSpeak), so a failing or rate-limited provider falls through to the next instead of going silent.

items.name: dsh-voice
items.desc: Voice input for the web UI: dictation chunked by pauses and voice messages, each with its own provider fallback chain (Deepgram, Groq, HuggingFace, local whisper.cpp, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint).

items.name: dsh-plugin-mynah
items.desc: Give the agent a talking face: seven tools that drive a self-hosted Mynah realtime digital human — speak (queued or interrupting), play a gesture clip, interrupt, list live sessions and channels, check health, add text to its knowledge base.

items.name: dsh-asr-plugin
items.desc: Local meeting transcription with microphone and system audio recording, speaker labels, and transcript export for DeepSeek Harness on Apple Silicon macOS.

items.name: dsh-ximalaya
items.desc: Listen to Ximalaya podcasts and audiobooks inside the DSH web UI: search albums, browse paginated tracks, and play through a now-playing bar (prev/play/next, seek, volume, rate). After QR login the "Mine" page lists your liked tracks (click to play), subscribed albums with latest-episode hints, and followed anchors with their public albums; the host relays audio streams with Range support and registers an `ximalaya_play` tool so the agent can search and play on request.

items.name: dsh-hold-to-dictate
items.desc: Hold-to-talk dictation in the composer that ships no recognizer of its own and reuses the speech service the official voice-input bundle already mounts - long-press the input box with mouse or touch, release to write the transcript into the draft, slide up to cancel, and it never sends.

items.name: dsh-live-voice
items.desc: Consent-bound one-turn voice preview for DSH Web with a credential-free local synthetic demo, optional Qwen Audio, exact Session isolation, and explicit transcript-to-draft handoff without automatic submission.

items.name: dsh-music-studio
items.desc: Music composition inside the conversation: the model writes a score against a bundled composing skill, and a play_score tool renders it as an inline card with a piano roll, Web Audio playback and WAV/JSON export.

items.name: dsh-meeting-room
items.desc: Meeting notes for dsh: one meeting per conversation, transcribed and speaker-separated on the machine itself, with points, assignments, handwritten notes, reviews and monthly scores in the same panel. Exports SRT/Markdown/Word and packs a meeting into a portable zip another dsh can import; confirmed assignments go to DingTalk/WeCom in one click, following your robot settings. Recognition models are swappable (a stronger local model can be imported from a file), and cloud recognition is off by default with no request made before consent. Word export needs Python and python-docx; the first run downloads a recognition model (28 or 77 MB).

items.name: dsh-pianist
items.desc: Piano performance plugin: ask the agent to play a piece and it renders on a Canvas2D grand piano with real Salamander Grand samples, an immersive stage, and an interactive 88-key keyboard.

items.name: dsh-mimo-tts
items.desc: MiMo voice for DeepSeek Harness — reads each finished answer aloud, turns composer dictation into text, and offers nine built-in voices plus a cloned-voice slot.

items.name: dsh-voco
items.desc: Continuous voice conversations for DSH with hands-free listening, push-to-talk, speech recognition, TTS replies, and background Agent delegation.

items.name: dsh-voice-alert
items.desc: Speaks or plays a sound at the end of every turn and plays a failure cue when a tool call or a turn errors. Ships 20 built-in effects (10 alert chimes + 10 nature sounds) and defaults to effect mode, so it needs no API key and no audio files; an optional Volcengine voice-clone route generates the three announcement clips in one click. Plays through winmm/waveOut as-is, never changing the system volume or mute state. Windows only.

items.name: dsh-voice-chat
items.desc: Doubao-style voice chat for DSH: press-and-hold mic in the composer converts speech to text and auto-sends, and AI replies are read aloud. Optional LLM condensing (long replies summarized into short spoken lines, following the current conversation model), TTS-friendly text cleaning, selectable Edge TTS voices, adjustable silence auto-stop, and settings embedded in DSH settings dialog.

items.name: dsh-typewriter-blip
items.desc: Turns a streaming assistant reply into short blips, one per character at a configurable minimum spacing, for the reply text only, and keeps sounding when the window is minimized, covered, or in a background tab. Two built-in voices, or a custom one shaped by waveform, or loaded from an audio file.

items.name: dsh-xiaoai-bridge
items.desc: Plugin that turns a XiaoAI (Xiaomi) smart speaker into a voice assistant: hosts the local bridge process, listens for the wake word, runs speech recognition (ASR / STT) on what you say, keeps the conversation in the host session, and speaks the answer back through the speaker with text-to-speech (TTS) playback.

items.name: dsh-voice-scribe
items.desc: Voice input for the web UI: tap Alt (or Alt+Space) to start/stop dictation, browser Web Speech (zero-config) or OpenAI-compatible cloud ASR, optional polish through DSH-configured LLM, settings UI.

items.name: dsh-talk
items.desc: Voice I/O for DeepSeek Harness — speech-to-text and text-to-speech over the microphone and audio output.

items.name: dsh-omi-voice
items.desc: In-chat read-aloud for DeepSeek Harness: tap to read, pause and resume AI replies with natural Doubao TTS voices (BYOK), reading only the final answer with code, tables and diagrams filtered; local engine, plugin keeps no API key.

items.name: dsh-plugin-xiaomi-mimo-tts
items.desc: Adds Xiaomi MiMo text-to-speech to DSH Web with assistant-message read-aloud, PCM streaming, preset and custom voice design, browser speech fallback, playback controls, and optional UI sounds.

items.name: dsh-voice-mode#dsh-voice-mode
items.desc: Full-duplex voice mode for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: toggle (2s-pause auto-send) or hold-to-talk dictation into an editable draft with zipformer2 streaming ASR, optional wake word; sentence-by-sentence Edge TTS read-aloud with live captions, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). On-device ASR, no API key.

items.name: dsh-voice-input-cn
items.desc: China-ready voice input for the composer. Requires a local Python bridge (pip install dashscope websockets, run bridge/voice-bridge.py) — the plugin alone does not work. Browser mic streams 16 kHz PCM to the bridge, which runs Alibaba Cloud DashScope ASR (paraformer-realtime-v2); interim text fills the draft at the cursor, silence auto-stop, optional auto-send.

items.name: dsh-audiogen
items.desc: AI audio generation for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — multi-vendor TTS, music, sound effects and voice design with a sidebar panel, model comparison, resource library and Agent tools.

items.name: dsh-voice-control
items.desc: Voice control for the DSH web composer: push-to-talk speech-to-text into the input box (with optional auto-send), spoken playback of assistant replies via the Web Speech API, right-click settings popover, and a global Ctrl+M hotkey.

items.name: dsh-voice-assistant
items.desc: Voice assistant for dsh web: say the wake phrase (e.g. "小鲸") to activate hands-free dictation — what you say is transcribed and typed into the chat box automatically. Supports spoken edit commands (send, clear, new line, stop reading) and reads assistant replies aloud in Chinese. Speech recognition runs locally in-browser via sherpa-onnx WASM, so it works offline without an API key.

items.name: dsh-gsv
items.desc: Real-time local TTS for DeepSeek Harness: voice presets, auto-read, engine setup assistant, a read-aloud button, and a settings panel for the GSV-TTS-Lite engine.

items.name: dsh-xiaozhi
items.desc: Connects the Xiaozhi voice assistant to DSH Web over MCP: DSH is the tool provider, weaving 35 DSH Web endpoints into 16 voice-friendly tools for workspaces, sessions, chat, models, settings and files — outbound WebSocket to the Xiaozhi MCP access point by default (no public IP or port forwarding needed), several devices bound at once, plus a DSH settings page with live status.

items.name: dsh-volume-knob
items.desc: Speaker button left of the model selector in the composer tool row — one click scrolls to the start of your newest question, marks it with a blinking caret and reads from there through the newest agent reply (dsh-tts, browser voice as fallback); press-and-hold the icon and then click anywhere on the page to pick another reading start position; press-and-drag-up opens a vertical mixer for in-page media volume and system output volume.

items.name: dsh-hold-to-talk
items.desc: One-handed, keyboard-free input for the composer: press and hold the mouse on the input box, speak, release — the text lands in the draft, and sliding up cancels without leaving a half sentence behind. No mic button to aim at and no shortcut to remember; the hand never has to leave the input area, which is the point when the other hand is busy. Recognition runs fully offline (SenseVoice via sherpa-onnx, no API key, audio never leaves the machine).

items.name: dsh-voice-agent#voice-app
items.desc: A conversational voice frontend Agent for dsh: speak naturally over ByteDance Duplex, delegate requests to background tasks, and hear their asynchronous results reported by voice.

items.name: dsh-ears
items.desc: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a microphone button in the composer turns speech into a draft transcript, with a choice of speech-recognition backends, optional polish through dsh own LLM routes, and a native settings page.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-ding-sound
items.desc: Turn-end notification sound for DSH: built-in internet meme voices (ni gan ma ai yo, ji ni tai mei, shen ying ge, etc.), Settings panel with preview/switch/random, custom audio folder support.

items.name: dsh-multi-tts
items.desc: Per-reply read-aloud with a multi-provider settings page — MiniMax or any OpenAI-compatible /audio/speech endpoint, with voice, emotion, speed and model selection plus an auto-read toggle.

items.name: dsh-dania-voice
items.desc: Local GPT-SoVITS text-to-speech that reads DeepSeek Harness assistant replies aloud, with a draggable mascot toggle and a one-click installer. Requires Python 3.10–3.12 preinstalled (the installer only locates it, it does not install Python); about 5 GB of disk and a GPU are recommended.

items.name: dsh-tool-lipsync
items.desc: Free lip-sync video generation plugin for DSH with 3000+ voices and 500+ languages.

items.name: dsh-duet
items.desc: Full-duplex Chinese voice interaction for DSH Web: dictate and edit tasks, submit requests, manage sessions, answer DSH questions, and hear concise task-completion announcements.

items.name: dsh-tts-bridge
items.desc: Reads DSH conversations aloud using the DeepSeek web page's built-in read-aloud, driven by a small browser extension.

items.name: dsh-watch-video
items.desc: Subtitle-first video transcription with SRT export, cancellable job controls, and a faster-whisper large-v3 fallback when subtitles are unavailable.

items.name: creating#plugin
items.desc: GPT-SoVITS voice output for DSH: a speak tool and /voice command, a read-aloud speaker button under each reply, and a settings tab to switch voices, tune synthesis, manage the local service and one-click install a voice pack. Windows only; needs a local GPT-SoVITS checkout with trained weights and its Python environment.

items.name: capmap-skills#dsh-capmap-viz
items.desc: CapMap docs visualization with Obsidian-style semantic graph and capability panel.

items.name: dsh-md-annotator
items.desc: Markdown sidebar preview and source editor for dsh-better-sidebar, with block- and text-range annotations that can be sent to the conversation as structured revision requests.

items.name: dsh-fullwidth-punctuation
items.desc: Converts half-width punctuation in AI replies to full-width Chinese punctuation, so copied answers stay publication-ready.

items.name: second-brain#dsh-client-ui-second-brain
items.desc: Distills daily AI conversations (Doubao, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Kimi) into structured Markdown notes in your Obsidian vault.

items.name: my-dsh-plugins#dsh-md-render

items.name: dsh-image-serve
items.desc: Serve any local file in DSH web sessions - /ws/<absolute-path> maps disk files to same-origin http URLs that session markdown can render. Any drive, no staging directory.

items.name: dsh-report-studio
items.desc: Turn DeepSeek Harness sessions into daily, weekly, handoff and article reports, with a verifiable HTML export and a receipt that re-checks the saved file.

items.name: ptt-studio
items.desc: Design-first PowerPoint builder: six pptx_* tools turn a deck.json design draft into an editable .pptx with AI backgrounds, cutout illustrations and decoration pieces, run layout and contrast checks, render slide previews, and review pages with a configurable vision model; chat cards and a settings page in the Web UI. items.desc: Windows only: the agent edits documents inside the Word, Excel and PowerPoint (Microsoft Office or WPS Office) windows you have open, through the applications' automation interface, so changes appear live and you can edit alongside; it reads structure, applies batches of edits, renders pages to images to check layout, and saves or exports PDF.

items.name: dsh-openwiki
items.desc: Brings the codebase knowledge-base capability of langchain-ai/openwiki into DSH — one-click generate/read/update of the repository Wiki, Grounded Claims (source-traced knowledge cards) and a project knowledge base built from uploaded local files, reusing the model DSH already has configured, with no second API key.

items.name: dsh-launch-card
items.desc: Generates release material from what a local repository can actually support: a hero image, a feature grid and bilingual copy rendered as SVG and HTML from `README.md`, `package.json` and optional screenshots. Facts are quoted from those files — name, version, license, summary, features, install snippet — and a field that is missing is left unrendered rather than filled with placeholder text. Every feature carries a source citation such as `README.md#L42`, and a claim the repository cannot substantiate is linted out before anything is written, with the reasoning left in `lint-report.json`. `manifest.json` records a sha256 for each input and output, and `--now` or `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` makes a run byte-identical. items.name: dsh-docx-sidebar
items.desc: A dsh-better-sidebar reading view for .docx files: headings from the style map, paragraphs, lists, real table cells, inline pictures and header notes. Ceilings on archive size, per-part inflated bytes and rendered blocks keep a document from freezing the tab.

items.name: dsh-opensheet-sidebar
items.desc: A dsh-better-sidebar reader for CSV/TSV/PSV files and xlsx/xlsm workbooks: a sortable, filterable table with sheet tabs. Ceilings on rows, columns and cells, plus two zip-container gates, keep an input from freezing the tab.

items.name: dsh-pptx-sidebar
items.desc: A dsh-better-sidebar reading view for .pptx decks: slides in deck order, bullet levels, speaker notes and inline pictures. Ceilings on archive size, per-part inflated bytes and slide count keep a deck from freezing the tab.

items.name: dsh-notes
items.desc: Notes workspace in the right sidebar: a notes tree beside a live-preview Markdown editor with tabs, split panes, outline and trash, over plain .md files plus a thin per-workspace index that agents organize through one `knowledge` tool.

items.name: eduwork#dsh-knowledge-studio
items.desc: A workspace-based Studio for source-grounded reports, slides, tables, mind maps, quizzes, flashcards, audio and video, using DSH models and shared artifact services. Office generation requires Python 3.12+ with its dependencies and DSH_OFFICE_PYTHON configured; media rendering requires Chromium, and local ASR additionally requires whisper.cpp and a model.

items.name: dsh-latex-guard
items.desc: LaTeX and BibTeX guardrails for DeepSeek Harness: compile checks with automatic xelatex/lualatex detection, BibTeX entry deduplication and field filling from Crossref, and \cite key audits against the .bib file.

items.name: dsh-paper-reader
items.desc: Paper reading workbench: library + PDF reader + tutor-style companion. Answers cite clickable page numbers that jump back and flash the exact passage; select-to-ask without leaving the paper; bundled strict-tutor preset (reading plan, section coaching, graded quizzes tracked across sessions). With MinerU configured (self-hosted, no signup / mineru.net cloud token): scanned PDFs become readable, formulas become click-citable (one click sends the LaTeX source into the chat) and searchable (QK^T hits directly), plus a per-page formula panel; optional embeddings endpoint adds semantic recall for plain-language questions. Rename/delete topics and papers — deletes go to a recoverable .trash with a batch-clear flow for non-empty topics; reader with scroll/single-page modes, rightbar-fullscreen safe, one-click path copy and translated-PDF export; in-place original ↔ Chinese toggle (babeldoc, zero preinstall). Transcription and search run locally by default — documents never leave your machine; only when cloud MinerU, an embeddings endpoint, or a translation endpoint is enabled does the corresponding text go to the service you configure.

items.name: dsh-mermaid-smooth
items.desc: Renders mermaid fences in dsh web chat as SVG diagrams by default, with cursor-anchored smooth zoom and pan, a per-fence diagram/code toggle persisted in localStorage, dark-mode follow, and a bundled offline engine.

items.name: dsh-overleaf
items.desc: Embeds an Overleaf site (overleaf.com or a self-hosted instance) into a conversation tab through a same-origin reverse proxy, with cookie or popup login, selection quoting, caret insertion, compile-log driven fixes, outline navigation, and .bib / .tex synchronization.

items.name: dsh-notebook-studio
items.desc: Turns up to 30 uploaded PDF papers into prompt-driven literature reviews, key findings, research ideas and study designs, exported as page-cited reports (DOCX/PDF) or slide decks (PPTX/PDF).

items.name: dsh-agent-outputs-reader
items.desc: Overlay reader for agent output files: Markdown rendering, in-panel PDF, DOCX/XLSX/PPTX text preview and reply-end file chips, with search, outline and position memory.

items.name: dsh-outline
items.desc: Search, read and write an Outline knowledge base from conversations, with whitelist-guarded approval for every document write.

items.name: dsh-ima

items.name: markdown_monitor
items.desc: Bridge to the local doc2md (markdown_monitor) CLI — one doc2md tool with convert, read, scan and status actions over docx, doc, xls, xlsx, pdf and image files.

items.name: dsh-plugin
items.desc: Tools over the local jetformat CLI: convert DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX to PDF, extract text, validate files, and inspect, merge, extract pages from, or render PDFs. Requires the jetformat CLI.

items.name: dsh-code-server-app

items.name: pdf-electronic-signature

Stamping first keys an opaque background out to transparency - un-compositing each pixel so the ink keeps its original colour - and trims to the ink, so a seal stamped over a signature does not erase it.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-dev-index
items.desc: Read official DSH docs in the Plugins page; Creator mode searches docs and checks plugin npm metadata with native tools.

items.name: dsh-gh-pages-artifacts

items.name: dsh-plugin-dev-kb
items.desc: Offline mirror of the official DeepSeek Harness documentation as a dsh skill: 168 site pages (EN/zh) plus 52 repository-only reference docs, with topic navigation and a full-text search index for plugin development.

items.name: dsh-industry-research
items.desc: Deterministic industry research reports for DeepSeek Harness — company and industry research flows produce structured, verifiable reports from staged evidence.

items.name: dsh-paperforge
items.desc: Paper reading workbench: a paper library, the PDF beside Markdown notes and one dedicated AI session per paper. Highlights and region screenshots go straight into notes; select-to-ask sends the passage with its page; notes are editable in place with autosave; sessions can be combined into a Summary.

items.name: dsh-knit
items.desc: Puts the Markdown documents, source files, images and video that already exist anywhere in the session workspace into the DSH sidebar, ranked by relevance to the current conversation. The default lexical mode matches your recent messages against title, summary and body locally with IDF weighting (BM25) — no model calls, no network, nothing leaves the machine. The list comes from scanning the workspace rather than from a recent-files list, so restarting DSH or opening a new session does not empty it. Results are organised into a three-tier reading order (primary / supporting / related) with a verifiable reason on every row — which field matched, which document cites this one — and one click opens an in-place preview: Markdown as rendered text, relative-path images actually drawn, source code with the host's own syntax highlighting, video streamed over HTTP Range. The same Context Pack is exposed to the agent as a knit_docs tool. Later versions added read evidence and lifecycle tracking (attribution is frozen at the moment of reading), pin / exclude (exclusion applies before retrieval, and is undoable), relation evidence (references / imports / tests, with line numbers) and an incremental index reused across restarts. Since v0.23 there is also an optional hybrid mode: it is off by default and only runs once you configure an Ollama or OpenAI-compatible embedding provider yourself. When it runs, what leaves the machine is your query text plus each candidate file's title and summary — a Markdown summary is an excerpt of the body's first paragraph (at most 60 characters), a code file's summary is its workspace-relative directory, and an image or video contributes its file name; full bodies and absolute paths are not sent, and a loopback provider keeps everything on this machine. Since v0.24 it also associates uncommitted changes: a read-only git status (fixed argv, no shell, whitelisted child-process environment) combined with the same reference / import / test / mention evidence shows which files a change is likely to drag along, and it is off by default. The benefit of semantic retrieval still awaits a real-provider run, so no recall improvement is claimed.

items.name: dsh-doc-quick

items.name: dsh-markdown-reader
items.desc: Renders workspace Markdown files in a standalone full-screen reader with GFM, KaTeX, Mermaid, outline navigation, live file reload, and browser printing/PDF export.

items.name: dsh-storyboard

Server-only, zero runtime dependencies.

items.name: dsh-pdf-reader

items.name: dsh-shareone-plugin
items.desc: Publish TXT, Markdown, HTML, PDF, Word, and PowerPoint files as ShareOne links with passwords, watermarks, text-page updates, and TXT/Markdown/HTML comments.

items.name: dsh-workbuddy-ppt
items.desc: Generates editable PPTX decks in DSH with a bundled authoring Skill, deterministic PPTD scene checks, native PowerPoint objects, and local PPTD source-project delivery.

items.name: dsh-tylina#bundle-wasm
items.desc: A WYSIWYG Typst editor for papers, reports, exams, resumes, charts, posters, sheet music, and slides exported as PPTX.

items.name: dsh-kp-notes#dsh-kp-notes

items.name: dsh-kb

items.name: dsh-openspec

Reads docx, pptx, xlsx, pdf, txt, md, csv, json and html. Zero runtime dependencies, zero network, fully local.

items.name: dsh-pptx-editor
items.desc: Preview and edit attached PowerPoint presentations in the DSH sidebar through conversation or manual controls, with shared undo/redo and PPTX download.

items.name: dsh-plugin-office-markdown
items.desc: Converts Office and PDF files in the DSH workspace to Markdown locally — no network, no API quota — before the model reads them. Writes each .md next to its source so only a file path enters the context, and returns byte size, line count, token estimate and a heading outline, for a single file or a whole directory.

items.name: docs-mode
items.desc: Technical documentation agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: template-driven writing with a self-learning template library, AI-flavor removal for tech docs, and a quality-assurance toolkit (document audit, cross-document consistency, numbering resequencing, version sync, PDF and Word export, screenshot automation).

items.name: dsh-mega-plugins#dsh-openwiki-visualize
items.desc: Previews a workspace OpenWiki in the DSH Web right Sidebar: detects the wiki directory, serves it with the official `openwiki visualize` reader on a loopback port, and embeds it in its own tab, reporting the installed openwiki and DSH versions against configurable floors and checking the registry for its own updates.

items.name: dsh-notes-plugin
items.desc: Notes and folder reader in the main panel: a file tree with pinned files, closeable tabs, Markdown split edit/preview with synced scrolling, plain-text editing, manual save, and drag-to-move. Deleting a file moves it to the system trash where one exists (macOS, Linux), falling back to an in-folder dsh-notes-trash directory; Windows has no delete entry.

items.name: no-ai-style

items.name: dsh-ls125-uv-probe

All code and documentation written by an AI agent (DeepSeek Harness).

items.name: dsh-video-pipeline
items.desc: Bundles 19 short-video production skills (1 entry point, 1 orchestration, 17 atomic) into the agent skill catalog: Chinese TTS pronunciation fixes, text-to-image and text-to-video, image panning, composition, covers, media verification, data review and four-platform publishing. Ships skills and scripts only, so a runnable pipeline still needs ffmpeg, Python 3 + Pillow, Node.js and playwright installed locally, your own Bilibili biliup credential and WeChat Channels / Douyin / Xiaohongshu login states, and the placeholder values under skills/*/scripts/ filled in with your own. items.name: dsh-at-skill
items.desc: Invoke user-accessible Skills with @name tokens and show matching Skill suggestions in the conversation composer.

items.name: dsh-fact-check
items.desc: Skill that fact-checks a claim against the open web rather than model memory: it splits the claim into independently checkable fact points, routes each point to the primary-source ladder for its domain (policy, academic, medical, financial, disaster and accidents, food safety, science, education, sports, entertainment, judicial, and more), searches domestic and international ecosystems in parallel, fetches primary pages, grades sources by type, re-searches with debunking keywords, and reports conclusion-first with a full URL and citation position behind every statement, keeping unverified and undecidable points separate from confirmed ones. Three factual judgements can be routed to a TypeSafe Jev (System One) decision model when a key is configured, falling back to the skill's deterministic rules when it is not; a model verdict can only lower a confidence tier.

items.name: dsh-math-olympiad

items.name: dsh-multiplatform-balance

items.name: dsh-bilibili-subtitles

items.name: dsh-skill-intelligence
items.desc: Read-only Skill inspector for DeepSeek Harness. It shows which Skills a conversation actually loaded — from observed loading evidence only — and which Skills the current environment can discover, and gives each Skill a detail page whose left column switches between the framework, the evidence, validation, evaluation, step evidence, run logic, the before/after of a modification when there is one, the definition facts and the raw SKILL.md. Declaration and run stay apart: the body is split into structure, declared workflow and progressive disclosure, the run logic is read from local receipts, and every declared step carries its own evidence — no observed evidence is reported as exactly that, not as executed or not executed, and the run's instruction hash sits beside the current definition as match, mismatch or unavailable. The evidence view gives each subject one of three states (declared, observed, unavailable), walks definition → load → use → outcome, names what each stage cannot reach, declines to attribute an outcome to the Skill, and can copy the snapshot out as byte-stable JSON. Validation checks the Agent Skills open standard and the platform profiles separately, each finding on a rule id and labelled standard compliance or platform compatibility. Evaluation keeps repeatable cases with the conditions each run was recorded under and the four stages of runtime evidence, comparing two runs of one case item by item without scoring them. The trigger boundary keeps should-trigger and should-not-trigger prompts, has you run them in a real new session, then records what was observed — whether a load record appeared and whether it was model-invoked or user-explicit; a typed /name is not a natural trigger, and an absent load record is reported as not observed, not as not triggered. The same projections are exposed to the agent as a read-only skill_review tool, which returns a structured review packet and says what it omitted when the packet will not fit whole. The inspector, the evidence chain and these reviews are computed on this machine from the definition and the session receipts; the Chinese reading version sends the body through the host's model when you ask for it, keeping code fences, paths and frontmatter verbatim and storing the result on this machine. A Skill can also be cloned into a local copy. It does not write back to the source Skill and does not run its scripts.
