items.name: dsh-we-wallpaper-sync
items.desc: Reusable skill to browse, search and download Wallpaper Engine (Steam 431960) workshop wallpapers and wire them into the DSH skin center, including bypassing the Steam HTTP block and the region-mismatch sign-in block via a matching SOCKS proxy.

items.name: dsh-skill-center
items.desc: Browse, preview and install public Agent Skills from inside the DSH web GUI, aggregating five sources (claudeskills.info, skillsmp.com, the awesome-claude-skills repository list, the official anthropics/skills repo, and skill packs shipped by installed DSH plugins). Skills install pinned to a commit rather than a branch name, so what you previewed is what lands; the panel reports provenance, whole-tree update checks and a trash instead of deleting. Before writing anything it validates the skill name and frontmatter against the rules the harness silently enforces, lists files that SKILL.md references but the fetch did not bring, flags partial fetches, and offers overwrite, rename or skip when a name is taken.

items.name: dsh-verify-cheap
items.desc: Ships a skill for verifying a change with the cheapest check that still yields a definite answer: an L0-L3 cost ladder from static checks to a single suite, condition polling with a timeout instead of fixed sleeps, assertions that can actually fail, and durations that are measured rather than remembered. The package also carries the two zero-dependency Node tools the skill calls - wait-until.mjs (poll a command, a file, or a port until it is ready) and measure-runtime.mjs (wall-clock timing for any command, plus a segmented timer for library use).

items.name: dsh-skill-evolution
items.desc: Watches agent execution traces and fires an LLM review at every successful turn end when signals trip, crystallizing reusable workflows into registered skills that improve progressively with later runs.

items.name: tripo3d-plugin-dsh#plugin
items.desc: Tripo 3D generation skills driving the tripo-cli through the shell: text-to-3D, image-to-3D, rigging with locomotion clips, decimation and LOD chains, and export to GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/USDZ/3MF, with headless device login for both China-mainland and international accounts; installable as `tripo-dsh`.

items.name: dsh-echocat-skill-panel
items.desc: Reports which skills each turn invoked (loaded by the model, typed as /name, or none) and manages the local skill directory: install from a pasted repository, folder, SKILL.md or zip address, set a Chinese display name in the skill meta.yaml, and remove a skill while keeping a backup.

items.name: dsh-skillhub
items.desc: Browse the public skillhub.cn catalog from Settings and install selected SKILL.md bundles into ~/.dsh/skills.

items.name: ai-eight-honors-eight-shames
items.desc: DSH plugin that registers the ai-eight-honors-eight-shames skill: eight checkable working rules for coding agents (verify before calling, confirm ambiguity, cite evidence, reuse before creating, test before claiming done, follow local conventions, separate fact from inference, keep changes reversible) plus a ninth rule that logs each user request and the change made in report files at the workspace root.

items.name: ctf-solve-teach
items.desc: Teaching-first CTF solving skill: narrates each step's pattern, tool choice and underlying mechanism, then writes a reproducible writeup under solves/<challenge>/ gated by a nine-section check.

items.name: new-project-init
items.desc: Project documentation scaffolding skill: question-driven setup of project standards, AI-collaboration workflows, and memory discipline across DSH, Reasonix, Claude Code, and Codex.

items.name: dsh-skill-creator
items.desc: Skill-creation console for the Web UI: fetches the official creator skills, hands the requirements to the Huawei Cloud, generic, or REST API creator, then scores the generated skill against a 10-point rubric and returns the itemised deductions to the creator until it reaches 8.5/10.

items.name: wavespeed-dsh-skill
items.desc: Generate and edit AI media (image, video, audio, 3D) with WaveSpeed models via the open-source wavespeed CLI: live catalog search, per-model input-schema introspection, local-file upload with @path markers, and price checks before running.

items.name: skills-management
items.desc: Skill marketplace and manager: manage skills from all local coding agents (10+ executors, incl. Claude Code and Codex) in one page and import them into the DSH skill library; built-in market of 6600+ skills, per-skill token-overhead stats, and model visibility control.

items.name: dsh-ponytail
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness plugin: DietrichGebert/ponytail lazy senior mode & 7-rung ladder port, 6 skills with bilingual descriptions & per-skill toggles, zero tools, zero-cache-miss.

items.name: dsh-superpower
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness plugin: 15 obra/superpowers engineering skills, bilingual descriptions, per-skill toggles.

items.name: screenshot-review
items.desc: Screenshot-review skill for DeepSeek Harness: the agent opens a frontend page, screenshots it, views the screenshot itself, revises the code, then re-screenshots — iterating until the page visually matches the user's requirements. Ships as a dsh.bundle, so it installs with `dsh plugin add`.

items.name: dsh-stock-jt
items.desc: A-share technical analysis (ladder dynamics) plugin: chanlun structure via struct_calc, hang-slope D+/D/D- and strong-start E+/E/E- signals, with an in-app settings page and work prompts.

items.name: human-writing-skills
items.desc: Natural AI-assisted writing with multilingual editing, chunked long-form collaboration and continuity review. Requires Python 3.9+ on PATH.

items.name: dsh-skill-station
items.desc: Sidebar skill hub: scan Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini skill directories for one-click import, manage global/project skills (toggle, trash), and install from dropped folders, zip archives, or local paths of any size.

items.name: dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-verify-isolated
items.desc: Isolated-environment browser verification skill for DSH plugin development: a throwaway DSH_HOME, its own `verify_<random>` profile, its own port and its own browser instance in one command, cleaned up on exit, so the profile you are actually using is never touched; ships a zero-dependency raw-CDP driver (snapshot / click / screenshot / eval) and an optional isolation audit.

items.name: dsh-skills-manager-plugin
items.desc: Matches prompts to installed skills for automatic activation, applies skill-declared lifecycle hooks and tool policies, and manages GitHub-hosted skills from Settings or the skill_manager tool.

items.name: dsh-answer-me-with-html
items.desc: Answers a hard question with a one-page visual HTML explainer: the model writes a short Markdown draft and the bundled dependency-free `am` CLI builds the layout, CSS and diagram coordinates. Vendors the upstream answer-me-with-html skill verbatim as a skill-only DSH bundle with no Host code.

items.name: dsh-skillshub
items.desc: Skill center panel for the DSH web GUI - search online skill registries (SkillHub, skills.sh, GitHub), install skills to user or project roots, and manage local skills with enable, create, edit, delete and preview.

items.name: dsh-any-skills
items.desc: Import, install and invoke Agent Skills in DeepSeek Harness from Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, GitHub or npm — composer-side ⚡ picker inserts /skill-name into the draft, and a Skill 管理 settings page offers per-source/per-skill import, expandable source paths with skill counts, uninstall and one-click restore from .trash.

items.name: dsh-google-skills
items.desc: Google's Agent Skills (google/skills) for DeepSeek Harness: 128 bundled SKILL.md skills for Google Cloud, BigQuery, GKE, Gemini, Firebase, ads and analytics.

items.name: dsh-skillopt
items.desc: Nightly self-improvement for your DeepSeek Harness agent: harvest past sessions offline, replay recurring tasks on your own API budget, and consolidate validated skills behind a held-out gate. Brings microsoft/SkillOpt's SkillOpt-Sleep engine to dsh as native tools plus a bundled skill - no weight training. Requires Python 3.10+ and the SkillOpt-Sleep engine (pip install skillopt).

items.name: dsh-token-caveman
items.desc: Terse prose for DeepSeek Harness — compress the agent's own output so every reply costs fewer tokens (layer 4). Style, never substance.

items.name: dsh-token-handoff
items.desc: Session context handoff for DeepSeek Harness — stop re-reading and re-deriving context every session. A single skill (layer ①) that keeps the next session warm.

items.name: dsh-token-headroom
items.desc: Context compaction / headroom for DeepSeek Harness — compress the live context so the prompt stays small without losing the state that matters (layer 3).

items.name: dsh-token-rtk
items.desc: Input redundancy pruning for DeepSeek Harness — drop repeated/redundant tokens before they reach the model (layer ②).

items.name: dsh-token-skills
items.desc: Cut token cost in 4 layers without cutting model intelligence: handoff, rtk, headroom, caveman token-saving skills — each also available as a standalone installable plugin.

items.name: dsh-invest-bundle
items.desc: Investment research bundle: 10 tools (search, page fetch, source audit, claim verification, numeric rigor, channel health, workflow loader, chart engine, PDF renderer, PDF gate) and 23 skills adapted from ai-berkshire. Runs a six-phase workflow where four parallel agents (Duan Yongping, Buffett, Munger, Li Lu) research a company, cross-examine each other, and ship a chart-rich PDF with cover, tables, captions and page numbers. Requires Python 3.10+; the chart and PDF tools also need python-docx and matplotlib.

items.name: dsh-skill-select
items.desc: Sidebar skill picker: lists installed skills with Global and repo badges, session checks plus persistent auto-start, optional Guard, Codex/Grok/Hermes user skills, and /skill injection.

items.name: dsh-amphoreus
items.desc: Turns the 13 δ-me13 (Amphoreus) role skill cards into seat workspaces: per-seat theme and wallpaper, first-turn skill injection, chat stickers, per-seat memory notes and presets, Alt+digit seat switching, and an overview canvas for dispatch and handoff; the skill suite itself is read from a configurable local directory and is not bundled.

items.name: dsh-skills-nexus
items.desc: Universal skill adapter that registers any GitHub repo containing a SKILL.md as a DSH skill by cloning and symlinking into the official skills root.

items.name: dsh-learn
items.desc: Reads the session event stream, with no extra model calls, and turns corrections, failures and fixes into pending lesson candidates. Every candidate is judged against written criteria and carries the reason it passed or was refused; only confirmation writes a skill, and only through the single validated writer `learn_skill_manage`. An idle curator marks unused skills stale and archives them by moving rather than deleting, and spares any skill that is still being loaded. Five tools: `learn`, `learn_review`, `learn_curator`, `learn_skill_manage`, `learn_skills`. Registers a prompt section stating the criteria, and a tool guard that refuses direct edits to skill files so the writer cannot be bypassed.

items.name: learning-skills
items.desc: Provides three learning skills for course notes, conceptual explanations, and self-contained lecture chapters, with bundled references and course helper scripts.

items.name: dsh-gui-handoff
items.desc: Hand a command-line-verified operation over to the GUI: drive it once, verify with ground truth, and hand back a self-contained illustrated tutorial.

items.name: dsh-plugin-zerone
items.desc: Self-evolving project-level Agent for DeepSeek Harness: 16 SDD workflow skills (clarification, PRD, issue, coding, locating, acceptance, review) plus project memory and knowledge that compound over time.

items.name: dsh-knj-extension-center
items.desc: Skill center for DSH: browse skills by region, install them from a zip archive, and manage them afterwards with enable/disable, uninstall, trash restore and search.

items.name: dsh-skill-manager
items.desc: Three-layer skill management for DeepSeek Harness: a library pool, per-workspace enablement whitelists, and per-session picks, with a Web settings panel, a conversation-embedded view, a skill file browser/editor, zip and folder import, and engine-load validation.

items.name: yinchao-ai-music-skill
items.desc: Generate complete AI songs and BGM from prompts or lyrics, with reference-audio creation and song extension.

items.name: dsh-creative-studio
items.desc: Image and video production toolkit for DeepSeek Harness - background removal with quality tiers, local inpainting retouch, headline and logo compositing, batch platform-size exports and image QA reports; for video, AI subject matting with background replacement (RVM ONNX, plus a chroma-key path), animated titles with fade/slide/typewriter/karaoke presets, 53 transitions with stylized variants, and light-effect and grading presets with LUT support, alongside footage inventory, accurate cutting, subtitle burn-in, music mixing and platform-spec exports; it provisions its own local Python runtime through a bundled bootstrap script.

items.name: dsh-video-to-notes
items.desc: Turns course, lecture, tutorial, meeting, and talk videos into structured study notes: it extracts the audio track with ffmpeg, transcribes it with Whisper, then writes notes with a chapter outline, emphasis markers, and a quick-reference card.

items.name: dsh-skill-starter
items.desc: Skill manager for DSH with a pack system. Installs skills as versioned packs and never overwrites files you have edited - upgrades skip your changes and report them. Also ships 6 built-in skills, a problem-grouped settings panel, and tools that let the agent read and write the skill library in conversation.

items.name: dsh-i-have-adhd
items.desc: Always-on ADHD-friendly output shaping: one system-prompt section makes replies action-first with numbered steps and concrete time estimates; adhd_on / adhd_off / adhd_status tools persist the mode across restarts.

items.name: dsh-skill-status
items.desc: It shows the number of confirmed loaded skills in the conversation header. Click **技能** (Skills) to open the right sidebar and check whether each skill's full main body remains in the current main assistant context, along with its recorded versions and sources.

items.name: lelogin-skill
items.desc: Provide a LeLogin skill for credential injection and authenticated business applications without exposing plaintext secrets.

items.name: skill-injector-plugin
items.desc: Auto-injects user-chosen skills into DSH sessions, either every prompt or once at session start, with a settings page and a composer indicator.

items.name: dsh-session-lab
items.desc: DSH session workflows for packaging verifiable capsules, evaluating reusable Skills, and comparing controlled session trajectories.

items.name: dsh-fix-duplicate-loader-id
items.desc: Diagnoses and fixes "duplicate loader entry id" boot crashes - finds duplicate loader rows across profile bundles and converts them into id-targeted patches via a zero-dependency CLI (detect / preview / fix / verify).

items.name: dsh-skill-studio
items.desc: Skill studio for DeepSeek Harness: visualize every agent skill (name, description, source, nested flag, model/user invocation), view and edit the full SKILL.md body, toggle model/user invocation, and mine DSH session logs to extract reusable personal skills that the agent auto-loads — from the web settings panel and via skillmgr_* / skillmgr_extract_* tools.

items.name: project-cross-migration
items.desc: Registers the project-cross-migration skill for DSH: five-layer agent project migration (conversations, memory, persona, tools, environment) with entry validation, JSONL integrity checks and readable restore. 1,418-message real migration verified across three platforms; pure Python stdlib, MIT.

items.name: dsh-web#packages/dsh-skill-explorer
items.desc: Skill center for the dsh web GUI: browse all loaded skills grouped by source, enable or disable model invocation, create new skills, and delete into a recoverable trash.

items.name: dsh-skill-router
items.desc: On-demand skill tools for DeepSeek Harness: registers skill_search / skill_load / skill_ref so the model searches a staged skill library first and loads a skill body only when it needs it, keeping the library out of the resident session catalog and out of every turn's context; adds a Skills tab to the conversation view ring that reads back the whole session and lists which skills were actually loaded, and in which turn. Zero dependencies, and the records render client-side only, never entering the model's context.

items.name: dsh-opengis-skill
items.desc: Bundles the 32 gis/ skills of opengis-skills (GDAL, QGIS, GeoServer, PostGIS, PROJ, PDAL, GRASS GIS, JTS, GeoPandas, Shapely, CesiumJS, OpenLayers, Leaflet, deck.gl and more) into the DSH skill catalog; only names and descriptions appear up front, and instruction bodies plus reference documents load on demand.

items.name: dsh-forge-studio#plugin-daily-log
items.desc: Work reports for DeepSeek Harness: gathers Git commits and local agent conversations (DeepSeek/Claude/Codex) and renders daily, weekly or monthly reports from your own templates; the agent tool is injected on demand.

items.name: dsh-folderwatch
items.desc: Arms a watch on a directory and delivers a batched, deduplicated diff when the tree goes quiet, filtering out the writes the session made itself; delivery is per watch, either waking a new turn or queueing for the next step.

items.name: dsh-plugin-ide-hub
items.desc: One hub over every coding IDE you run — dsh, Claude Code, Codex, ZCode, Qoder, CatPaw, Trae, OpenCode. Zero-API: it reads each tool's own on-disk state and gives a session inventory, per-IDE usage with cache-hit rates, one-line resume commands, and a single .hub/ rule body wired into all eight via marker-delimited pointer files. The domestic-IDE adapters (Trae/Qoder/CatPaw) were verified against the installed binaries — a gap no overseas tool covers.

items.name: dsh-plugin-task-forge
items.desc: Compiles a rough need into a versioned task book (goal / context / constraints / acceptance / decisions / open gaps, all numbered) and hands it to any AI window losslessly: the receiver must pass a read-back handshake — restate, list gaps, declare READY — before work starts; /answer closes gaps with an automatic version bump, /forge-list tracks which window holds which version.

items.name: oh-my-deepseekharness
items.desc: Multi-agent orchestration layer for DeepSeek Harness — autopilot/ralph/team execution modes, 19 role cards, 40 bilingual skills, and a bundled MCP state server, ported from oh-my-claudecode.

items.name: dsh-trellis
items.desc: Trellis-style workflow for DeepSeek Harness: per-turn phase breadcrumbs via agent/pre-step, bundled skill provider, and DSH-native task/phase state with git-cleanliness guardrails.

items.name: ai-look-up
items.desc: AI Look-Up: detects aimless grinding (repeated commands, failure loops, long runs with no output) and injects mid-run self-review nudges, plus a real local-clock anchor so the agent stops estimating elapsed time.

items.name: verdict-engine#dsh-tech-lead
items.desc: 21 read-only lifecycle governance tools in one self-contained DSH plugin: task tiering, state/plan/evidence validation, gate precheck and aggregation, release/install audits, context and progress analysis, critical path, resume reconciliation, and a mutation preview that always denies execution. Installs from npm as @240xu/dsh-tech-lead.

items.name: dsh-eteams
items.desc: Captain-led multi-agent teams that split a goal into tasks and dispatch them along an execution chain to members running in their own sub-sessions, each with its own model.

items.name: dsh-plugin-orchd
items.desc: Read-only orchd panel for the DSH right sidebar: task board, ideas board, dependency graph, review timeline and an install entry for the project of the current session.

items.name: dsh-auto-shutdown
items.desc: Windows-only: adds a switch to Settings → General that powers the computer off when the finished conversation ends (default delay 60 s, configurable 5–86400 s), behind a native countdown dialog that cancels the pending shutdown in one click (shutdown /a).

items.name: dsh-workflow-templates
items.desc: Preset workflow template library: 12 reusable orchestration script templates with wf_template_list / wf_template_search / wf_template_run / wf_template_validate tools and static template validation.

items.name: dsh-plugin-crossfire
items.desc: Adversarial review for DeepSeek Harness: put one settled plan on the stand, send read-only red-team experts at it by dimension, then split their findings into single defects you endorse or reject one by one. It never rewrites the plan and never fixes code.

items.name: dsh-plugin-roundtable
items.desc: Visual round-table meetings for DeepSeek Harness — expert nodes on a ring with directed edges, an aggregation gateway, proxy thinking for black-box worker models, and adversarial review (red-team) of settled plans with per-viewpoint endorse/reject.

items.name: dsh-cron-panel
items.desc: Scheduled tasks panel for managing DSH agent and system crontabs with natural language input and execution logs.

items.name: dsh-autoresearch
items.desc: Creates, runs and monitors persistent research experiment loops from the DSH Web UI.

items.name: dsh-orca-agents
items.desc: Dispatches coding tasks to local Orca-managed agents and reports completion to DSH; documented for DSH 0.1.5-rc.2.

items.name: pstack-dsh
items.desc: Ports poteto's pstack engineering playbooks to DSH, covering planning, review, verification and release workflows.

items.name: dsh-codex-dots
items.desc: DeepSeek-led background orchestration of Codex and DSH subagents, with existing conversation handoff, Markdown history, quota pauses, and bounded decision retries.

items.name: dsh-schedule-later
items.desc: Schedule a message into a dsh chat for later: a Schedule button in the message box with a date and time picker, a sidebar panel of pending messages across chats, delivery as a normal user message even with the browser closed, and schedule_message, list_scheduled_messages and cancel_scheduled_message tools so the model can come back to a chat on its own.

items.name: dsh-plugin-auto-answer
items.desc: Keeps an unattended DeepSeek Harness session moving when nobody answers ask_user_question: it fronts the question waterfall, leaves a human answer untouched, and after a configurable window (120 s by default) submits the option marked (Recommended)/（推荐）, or the configured first/last fallback; plan reviews stay with the human unless explicitly enabled.

items.name: dsh-automation
items.desc: Runs one-time and RFC 5545 recurring Agent tasks in fresh DSH sessions, with visual schedule editing and session-linked history.

items.name: dsh-kanban
items.desc: A shared kanban board that lets people and DSH agents manage workspace tasks through a Board tab and kanban tools.

items.name: gzhflow
items.desc: Six-stage WeChat Official Account content-publishing workflow with quality-gate tools and a bundled skill.

items.name: dsh-orchestrator2#dsh-orchestrator2
items.desc: Agent preset: one session runs a three-phase auto-development pipeline — interactive design with parallel research subagents, goal-driven development with reviewer/developer subagents and per-package budget ledgers, then an acceptance fix loop.

items.name: dsh-super-code
items.desc: A faster, more efficient, and more accurate coding Agent preset. On 100 hard SWE-bench Pro tasks selected using multidimensional difficulty criteria, average elapsed time decreased by 36%, average input tokens per task decreased by 17%, and accuracy increased by 5 percentage points.

items.name: jarvis-mission-control-deepseek#dsh-plugin-mission-control
items.desc: Streams DeepSeek Harness sessions, messages, tool activity, and turn outcomes to a JARVIS Mission Control board with task status and human review.

items.name: dsh-tripo-studio#plugin
items.desc: A visual workbench for reference-image generation, cropping and component-wise Tripo 3D modeling, with per-task paid-operation approval and local asset previews.

items.name: my-dsh-plugins#dsh-task-reliability
items.desc: Task reliability: auto-retry on model timeouts/failures, auto-continue unfinished tasks, completion verification, thinking-repeat interruption, resume after sleep or restart, autopilot mode and a remote trigger endpoint (npm: `dsh-task-reliability`).

items.name: dsh-task-runner
items.desc: Coordinates PUA and Completion Guard tasks from /task-run or a CLI, requiring frozen acceptance and a current candidate/Goal certificate before completion, with an 8-round and 90-minute ceiling. Verified on macOS Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2. Since 0.3.7, PUA 0.3.27, Completion Guard 0.9.0 and SpecWorkflow 0.1.1 are bundled, so only Task Runner itself needs installing.

items.name: dsh-plan-checkup
items.desc: Checks each step of a plan before you approve it, using command rules plus Jev or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with logprobs, and marks steps that can't be undone, affect things outside the workspace, weren't asked for or are too vague on the plan review card.

items.name: dsh-devflow
items.desc: Multi-agent delivery workflow for dsh: a commander dispatches to fixed and temporary agents through a persisted task state machine, with a canvas and roster in the right sidebar.

items.name: dsh-agent-team-presets
items.desc: Reusable Agent Team presets for DeepSeek Harness: a Settings page stores named Teams — a captain with its own prompt and tool allow-list, plus members carrying their own provider/model route, reasoning effort, prompt and tools — and a composer control applies one Team to the current Session, installing the captain prompt and registering the spawn_team_member, get_team_preset and update_team_preset tools.

items.name: dsh-project-context
items.desc: Turns each DSH workspace into a project: every new session auto-injects a project-workspace convention (read code before acting, empty folder means a brand-new project); a per-session Project toggle in the composer downgrades the session to a plain workspace with an explicit notice, with the state kept in the session log.

items.name: dsh-codex-bridge#dsh-plugin
items.desc: Lets Codex delegate tasks to Desktop sessions through a local authenticated bridge and companion MCP server, with Workspace grouping, model and reasoning effort selection, event tracking, waiting, and cancellation.

items.name: dsh-sysbrief
items.desc: Parse PRDs and PDFs, ask clarifying questions in batches, consolidate a BRIEF.md system brief, and package deliverables for upload.

items.name: deepseek-kanban-plugin
items.desc: Kanban board for DSH: task state machine with git branch isolation, agent auto-execution, and review-driven merge.

items.name: goal-acceptance
items.desc: Acceptance-criteria-driven goal completion: locks verifiable criteria, tracks task dependencies, and gates completion behind formal reviewer validation (18 MCP tools).

items.name: dsh-ambiguity-handling
items.desc: Appends ambiguity-handling rules to the dsh system prompt so the agent asks clarifying options before guessing.

items.name: dsh-harness-one#dsh-ccpg-one
items.desc: Visual multi-agent DAG workflows for DeepSeek Harness with live execution, restart recovery, and Feishu integration.

items.name: dashi-taskboard#deepseek-harness
items.desc: Embeds the active installed Codex Taskboard runtime in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, using its launcher runtime descriptor instead of a fixed port.

items.name: dsh-node-flow
items.desc: Visual node-based workflow canvas for DSH with sub-agent calls, code execution, branching, loops, scheduling, and workflow import/export.

items.name: dsh-agent-team
items.desc: A persistent agent team for long-running collaboration in DeepSeek Harness: durable agent identities, per-project Workspaces, responsibility-bearing Channels, and Task Threads chaining session agents.

items.name: dsh-task-dispatch-table
items.desc: Scheduled task dispatcher: a dsh host plugin that drives recurring agent tasks from a single task table, dispatching each run as an independent dsh session; scheduling is pure logic and uses zero model calls.

items.name: dsh-plugins#hookkit
items.desc: Config-driven lifecycle hooks, including context injection: declare event, handler and outcome in YAML, where the handler is an in-harness tool (MCP included), a shell command or an HTTP endpoint, and the outcome is model-visible context, a denied tool call, or fire-and-forget.

items.name: dsh-plugins#research-mode
items.desc: Deep research as an agent mode: one reviewed loop that plans, researches in adaptive parallel rounds driven by the gaps the researchers themselves declare, synthesises a cited report and then reviews it adversarially, instead of a script the model rewrites per call. Questions the round budget never reached are named in the report rather than dropped.

items.name: dsh-agent-preset-router
items.desc: Auto Mode for DSH: a flash-model router that auto-picks the best agent preset (standard/code/minimal/cordis) for each new session and executes immediately, no confirmation.

items.name: dsh-step-pause
items.desc: Counts agent steps and, every N of them, adds a progress-report instruction to the batch that is about to be sent, so the agent states what it is doing, what it finished and what comes next, then carries on without stopping for you. Interval, prompt text and a main-agent-only default are editable in its settings page.

items.name: specwave
items.desc: ICVO coding-standards kit for DeepSeek Harness (formerly dsh-coding-kit): a bundle plugin that registers tools on load and injects the standards only when apply_coding_standards is called, plus a P0 gate CLI (npx spec-wave) with G1-G7 process commands, skills install, host apply, and IDE-block refresh.

items.name: dsh-daily-tasks
items.desc: Daily and weekly task manager: startup popup reminder, a marquee strip above the composer, one-click circle completion, editable task cards, and a Sunday AI weekly summary, plus a sidebar DeepSeek API usage widget with balance card, today/cumulative tokens and cost, per-model breakdown and a 7-day chart. Persists as JSON under $DSH_HOME.

items.name: dsh-ditto
items.desc: Review-first batch automation for DeepSeek Harness: three reviewed samples, a full preview, one approval, then a safe apply across many files.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-plan-board
items.desc: Captures every plan the agent presents through exit_plan_mode as markdown under <workspace>/.dsh/plans, opens a review window, and keeps a Plans history tab recording the outcome of each plan.

items.name: dsh-daily
items.desc: Daily brief for DeepSeek Harness. Every day at a fixed hour it ranks the plugin market by real install counts and stars, cross-checks it against your own agent memory and working conventions, and proposes two kinds of item: concrete deltas on the plugins people actually use (original does A, the proposal does B) and directions nobody has built yet. The popularity numbers come from the catalog the market itself publishes and are quoted into the prompt rather than guessed; an entry the market has not measured is shown as unmeasured, never as zero. Approving an item opens a new session named after it and hands that session a fixed delivery contract — implement independently, never fork, test green before publishing. Rejected sources are remembered so they stop coming back.

items.name: dsh-den
items.desc: A resident assistant for DeepSeek Harness that is deliberately not another chat box: one floating window plus one standing conversation, both independent of every other session. The heartbeat is held back by four gates — an authority grant, a daily turn budget, quiet hours and a pacing cooldown — and it keeps working across restarts through a lease it has to hold. Each wake is decided by a model that must answer SKIP or a short message, so silence is a decision rather than a failure. The window shows the standing conversation's real message flow, read from the host session store, or from the on-disk session log when the host does not publish that session, and it can send into that conversation directly. den carries the same reach as the person it stands in for, with one limit: read-only. It may read every session, this machine and work channels such as GitHub, but it does not write, send or publish, it never asks anyone for permission, and it never gates another session's tool calls. `npm run digest:github` turns GitHub notifications and your own open pull requests into three Chinese sections — waiting on you, waiting on your review, and yours — with reply drafts that are explicitly marked as unsent.

items.name: team-craft#team-flowise
items.desc: Dependency-ordered multi-agent team runner for DeepSeek Harness: define roles with their own model, persona and tools, run a node graph with an independent review gate and bounded rework, and watch progress in the web UI.

items.name: dsh-later
items.desc: Scheduled reminders and delayed send for DSH: /later delivers what you type as yourself at the time you pick, while the timer panel (or /schedule) posts a reminder row — even with the page closed. (scheduled send / reminders / delayed send)

items.name: dsh-pre-duediligence
items.desc: Pre-visit due diligence and company research in DeepSeek Harness for customer background checks and risk briefs, with Qichacha MCP tool-call budget approval and entity confirmation.

items.name: dsh-tender-workbench
items.desc: Tender search and bid intelligence in DeepSeek Harness with proposed project search, rule screening, human review and Excel/PDF exports using user-authorized Qichacha MCP.

items.name: codex-dsh-collab

items.name: dsh-task-board

items.name: dsh-init

Independent open source (MIT), not an official DeepSeek product; requires Node >= 24.11.0 and currently targets DSH 0.1.2-rc.1.

items.name: dsh-odoo-sdd

items.name: dsh-plugin-nexus-sdlc

items.name: dsh-council

items.name: superself#dsh-plugin

items.name: dsh-task-engine
items.desc: Preset engineering workflows for DeepSeek Harness: a dev_task tool that gates stage transitions, artifacts, verification, review and commit scope, plus a web workbench for installing project or user skills and rules.

items.name: dsh-cron
items.desc: Scheduled cron tasks, background automation and agent execution for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-kanban
items.desc: Visual Kanban board for DeepSeek Harness with Gitea-backed tasks, workflow columns and a dedicated agent session per task.

items.name: dsh-yolo

items.name: dsh-chaos

items.name: dsh-hermit#hermit-budget

items.name: dsh-startup-command

items.name: dsh-plugin-stardeck

items.name: dsh-orbit
items.desc: Deterministic engineering orchestration runtime for DeepSeek Harness: the orbit_controller tool and OrbitService run Commander, Executor and Smart Watchdog children through PLAN, EXECUTE, EVALUATE, bounded correction and runtime recovery, with durable state in <project>/.cx/state.json.

items.name: dsh-plugin-product-design
items.desc: Product Design workflow suite for DeepSeek Harness - a router plus nine pd-* skills carrying ideas from a minimum design brief through visual directions, evidence-grounded research and audits, URL cloning, frontend builds and a blocking design-QA gate.

items.name: dsh-meeting-coordinator

items.name: dsh-timer-agent

items.name: dsh-squad
items.desc: Cross-workspace worker fleets: one orchestrating session spawns named worker sessions in other project workspaces, queues or steers tasks into them, watches them in the background via a real host job, and collects their reports. Worker completions deliver themselves to the orchestrator's session rather than needing to be polled, so an idle orchestrator still reacts. Escalations and failed workers deliver by steer when the orchestrator is mid-turn and by queue when it is idle; a turn that ends without a report counts as a failure and the worker is replaced after a configurable limit. The roster persists to disk and each worker session carries a durable title, so a restart neither loses the fleet nor spawns duplicate sessions. Ships five agent presets at full plugin parity with the standard preset.

items.name: oh-my-dsh-slim
items.desc: Match your models and token budgets to each role, then let DSH delegate specialized subagents by task type. Covers architecture analysis, UI/UX, code implementation, codebase exploration, and documentation research, with automatic setup plus per-role reasoning effort and tool permissions.

items.name: dsh-external-agents
items.desc: External Agent control plane for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor Agent, and Antigravity adapters with settings and background job visibility.

items.name: dsh-claude
items.desc: Runs Claude Code as a DSH conversation while preserving its native agent loop, tools, skills, hooks, and MCP integrations.

items.name: dsh-expert-group
items.desc: Role-based expert subagents for DeepSeek Harness with a task sidebar: explorer, librarian, oracle, designer and fixer delegate in parallel, each with its own model and reasoning depth.

items.name: dsh-gme-test-generator
items.desc: Drives the GME Test Agent from inside Harness: three tools list interface catalogs, start and repair autonomous test generation in a local Python backend, poll the task until review, and keep PR, skip and cleanup actions behind explicit user consent.

items.name: dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine
items.desc: An approval-gated OME engineering delivery preset with session-isolated lifecycle evidence.

items.name: dsh-scheduled-send
items.desc: Scheduled send: fire a drafted message into the bound conversation as a normal user bubble at a set time. Runs host-side, so the browser can stay closed; per-session isolation and restart-safe redelivery.

items.name: dsh-task-splitter
items.desc: Host-side long-task detection for small-context local models: long outputs are scaffolded into a parts skeleton (one part per reply, then assemble), and multi-step work into a PLAN.md ledger with notes/ (plan first, one step per reply). Detection is heuristic and host-side, so it does not depend on the model judging its own limits.

items.name: deep-read-summarize
items.desc: Deep reading & summarization for DSH: books/papers/videos/web into structured Obsidian notes via plugin parsers, MapReduce parallel deep-read subagents, JSON Schema outputs and an idempotent cache.

items.name: dsh-research-report
items.desc: Verifiable research-report engine for DeepSeek Harness with a content-addressed evidence ledger, versioned sealed reports where every claim carries a verification verdict and the manifest hash seals the directory, and retrieval orchestration that reuses the ctx.web and ctx.jobs seams.

items.name: dsh-team-rooms
items.desc: Persistent, cross-session multi-agent team rooms for DeepSeek Harness — members, a message bus, a shared task board, and a shared timeline that survive restarts.

items.name: dsh-batch-triage
items.desc: Deterministic ticket triage: a rule prefilter classifies clear cases and returns everything else as needs_review instead of guessing.

items.name: dsh-workflow-canvas
items.desc: Visual drag-and-drop workflow builder for DSH — orchestrate tool calls, sub-agents, and conditional branches on a React Flow canvas.

items.name: dsh-workproof#dsh-delivery-receipts
items.desc: Session-scoped delivery receipts for local artifacts: compare current file hashes with a recorded baseline, keep agent claims separate from explicit user acceptance, flag changed or unavailable files, and export a Markdown receipt through a tool, slash command, and conversation panel.

items.name: dsh-workproof#dsh-evidence-ledger
items.desc: Session-scoped research evidence ledger with sources, linked claims, open questions, and explicit user review; provides a tool, slash command, and conversation panel, with selected-claim Markdown export that omits excerpts, review notes, and local paths by default; does not fetch sources or verify their truth.

items.name: dsh-notes-plugin#dsh-notes-plugin
items.desc: Local Markdown notes as governable working memory for DeepSeek Harness agents: dual-mode source/WYSIWYG editor with images, convention or reference notes auto-inject into the system prompt with sensitive values masked, plus snapshot version history, recycle bin, undoable archiving, AI reorganization, backlinks and full-text search. Compatible with DSH 0.1.7-0.2.x.

items.name: task-board-plugin#dsh-agent-board
items.desc: Kanban task board for DeepSeek Harness sessions: the main agent dispatches tasks to one-shot worker/verifier subagents, with dependency scheduling, file-level exclusion locks, arbitration hold/freeze, milestone progress reporting, and per-task token usage stats.

items.name: dsh-punky-swarm#dsh-punky-swarm
items.desc: Engine-enforced guardrails for DeepSeek Harness agent swarms: quality gates reject half-done work, crash-safe checkpoints resume in place — keeps AI teams from breaking, not just running.

items.name: dsh-subagent-watchdog
items.desc: Automatically continues a native continuable DSH subagent once when it ends with explicit max-tokens termination, then stops.

items.name: dsh-darwin#forge
items.desc: Self-evolution actuator: consumes problem tickets mined from session logs, synthesizes skill candidates (zero-code tiers by default) behind an eval gate with hold-out canaries, then promotes to project .dsh/skills with human confirm and deterministic rollback.

items.name: dsh-more-agent-presets
items.desc: More agent presets for DSH, derived from other coding agents such as Qwen Code and iFlow.

items.name: dsh-workspace-monitor
items.desc: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that periodically detects added, modified, and deleted files in a workspace and reports the changes.

items.name: dsh-image-gen
items.desc: Optimized fork of dsh-image-gen with batch generation (count), gallery pagination, lazy loading, fetch retry/timeout, and 7 providers: Gemini/OpenAI/Seedream/DashScope/Agnes/GLM-Image/Stability AI.

items.name: recowork#recowork-dsh
items.desc: Creates and inspects RecoWork local-agent-project workspaces through two bounded DSH tools and a web workspace card.

items.name: rex-harness#ui-workflow
items.desc: Turns a product or UI request into an implementation-ready design spec with /ui-workflow and /ui-rerun. Analysts run through a read-only ui_analyst tool, and the lead agent writes docs/ui-workflow reports.

items.name: dsh-focus-supervisor#dsh-plugin
items.desc: DSH self-discipline companion with recurring tasks, a gaze-tracking desktop mascot, evidence logs, final AI review, reminders, and window intervention on Windows and GNOME Wayland.

items.name: sandbase-harness
items.desc: Connects dsh to a local SandBase Harness runtime over stdio MCP for managing agents and sessions, streaming turns, inspecting artifacts and cancelling work.

items.name: dsh-tick
items.desc: Session-local scheduled tasks: inject a prompt into the current session after a delay, at a fixed time, or on a repeating interval, so the model wakes up and runs it on time. Manage them from a panel above the composer, the /schedule command, or seven model-facing tools. Timers freeze while DSH is closed and never auto-resume; pause keeps the remaining time, so resuming continues from where it stopped.

items.name: 1acp#acp-service
items.desc: Persistent Codex, Grok Build and Claude Code sessions through ACP, with native model controls, permission approvals and optional A2A delegation.

items.name: dsh-grokbot-dispatch
items.desc: Bidirectional dispatch for DSH: opens visible desktop sessions for tasks dispatched in by Grok Bot / Yobiru, adds /dispatch-grok and /dispatch-zcode slash commands to send tasks out, and reports the session result back to the dispatching peer on completion (peers are user-configured; nothing is sent until configured).

items.name: dsh-multitask
items.desc: A Multitask agent preset where the main conversation only plans, briefs subagents and summarizes results, while file reads, commands, search and builds run inside subagent contexts; four worker kinds, an approval gate for dangerous operations, and zero changes to DSH source.

items.name: agent relay
items.desc: Cross-session task relay for DSH Desktop 0.2: six relay_* control tools, independent sidebar sessions, live host-origin discovery, durable turn-completion checks, and a bundled relay skill.

items.name: kaipu-dsh-plugin-release#plugin-platform
items.desc: An audit workspace for DeepSeek Harness: a multi-agent consultation venue where each review seat is filled by an agent, every judgment is routed to a named review face, and the whole run is kept as a traceable record. Works out of the box: the service endpoint is built in, a workspace is provisioned automatically on first launch, and review scenes come with their seats and agents listed.

items.name: kaipu-dsh-plugin-release#plugin-workstation
items.desc: Companion operations panel for the Kaipu site plugin: round timeline, run status, jump gates and browser entry. Installs and uninstalls on its own; the site plugin stays fully usable without it. Renders the persisted workstation state (no live stream yet).

items.name: dsh-novel-workbench
items.desc: A full-screen novel-writing workbench: chapter board, draft candidates reviewed and merged paragraph by paragraph, plot summaries carrying an index header, and a writing pack assembled from the outline, character cards and earlier chapters. It also reads a shelf of finished books you import, extracts their writing habits in one run, merges them into a single style standard, and puts that standard in the prompt for every later generation.

items.name: dsh-image-gen
items.desc: Native conversational image generation for DeepSeek Harness: ask the agent to create an image, and it handles generation and keeps the result directly in the conversation.

items.name: narrative-prompt-polish
items.desc: ✨ One-click prompt polisher for the DSH composer — an agent refines your rough draft in a side chat over multiple turns, and you copy the result back when you're happy.

items.name: dsh-thincoder-suite
items.desc: Advisor reviews that converge over rounds, an engineering mode whose writes require a design token, escalation of a task to a stronger model, and parallel multi-model consultation; a settings page edits the model routes, timeouts and budgets.

items.name: dsh-novel-craft
items.desc: A novel-writing workbench for DeepSeek Harness: you tap thumbs-up or thumbs-down on candidate passages, and the model distils them into a short preference profile that carries into later drafting calls while the manuscript stays out of the drafting context. Adds a chapter board, per-chapter writing packs, annotation-scoped revision that rewrites only the annotated paragraph and verifies the rest byte-for-byte, a project ledger, and local pacing checks.

items.name: dsh-tool-workflow-plus
items.desc: Drop-in enhanced fork of the official workflow tool: a verbatim fork of the stock tool plus a persisted saved-workflow library (workflow_save / workflow_list / workflow_get / workflow_delete / workflow_run_saved) backed by ctx.storageDomain, so scripts can be stored, retrieved and re-run with new arguments.

items.name: routinekit
items.desc: Capture selected DSH, local MCP, or native WebMCP calls as reviewed, parameterized routines, expose typed tools, and replay with fresh approval.

items.name: dsh-study-desk
items.desc: Study workbench for exam prep and research: three-column task board with tags and filters, a spaced-repetition queue (simplified SM-2) that keeps finished cards coming back, a heatmap lit by actual focused minutes, weekly reports, per-day review notes, a pomodoro timer that survives panel switches, and Markdown export/import for Obsidian. Installable via dsh plugin add (dsh-study-desk on npm).

items.name: dsh-plugin-list-sync
items.desc: Synchronizes DeepSeek Harness third-party plugin lists through S3-compatible storage with diff preview, local snapshots, rollback, and optional LLM provider configuration sync.

items.name: jimu
items.desc: Jimu (积木): domain-based orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness — domain_plan confirmation, per-domain sub-agents with hand-off, and automatic LLM audit.

items.name: dsh-cron
items.desc: Host-side unattended job scheduler: runs one-shot agent tasks or shell commands on cron, interval, or one-time schedules, with persisted at-most-once dispatch state, overlap/misfire policies, and bounded run history.

items.name: dsh-suite
items.desc: All-in-one combo patch for STARDUSTLC's 18 DSH plugins: one command injects shared default configs across office, media, DevOps and notification presets; each component installs directly via a one-line add command (flat design, no git subdependencies).

items.name: xingyuan-dsh
items.desc: Agent preset bundle for wish and task management: create wishes or tasks from conversation, opportunity-day check-ins, micro-actions, plus a memory store and progress charts in the web UI.

items.name: statedock-plugins#deepseek-harness
items.desc: Provides shared plan, context pickup, and progress update Skills through StateDock Remote MCP without executing tasks or scheduling agents; targets Harness 0.2.0-rc.2.

items.name: dsh-complex-project-preset
items.desc: Agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: the standard tool stack plus four working rules written into the persona prompt — a project keeps at most four documents (intro, decisions, change log, current state and next steps), those documents describe only the current state with no AI edit history or superseded decisions, no git commit or push or pull request until the user explicitly asks, and a careful-coding workflow (restate the goal and done-criteria first, surgical diffs, evidence before claiming success) with plain-language reports.

items.name: dsh-cliworker-now
items.desc: Multi-CLI worker sidebar for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS and Windows, with task dispatch, live conversation views, stop and follow-up controls, and custom role presets.

items.name: dsh-collab-dev
items.desc: Saves architecture and validated plans, runs native AgentTeams workers with approval, parallel coding and independent review, and summarizes progress and verification results.

items.name: dsh-sparkos
items.desc: Self-media workbench plugin: 8-tab dashboard (daily brief, narrative lines, topics, drafts, knowledge-card distill review, sources, publish, advice) with hard guards (48h window, event dedup, card/line existence, read-only advice) and a read-only intel module following the four red lines.

items.name: dsh-tauri-monitor
items.desc: Generic monitor plugin for DSH Desktop: an HTTP polling rule engine. Poll any endpoint on schedule (multi-step, variable extraction, JS condition expressions); when conditions hit, wake a visible agent session to act — zero model calls otherwise. Configure everything in a sidebar GUI panel: create/edit/pause/test/fire-now/run history, same UX as the built-in scheduler plugin.

items.name: dsh-dpia-workbench
items.desc: Adds a versioned DPIA workbench to DeepSeek Harness for source-linked facts, follow-up answers, reassessment, and reviewable reports. Needs Python 3.9+ with `python-docx`, `pypdf`, and (for PDF templates) `reportlab` + `pdftoppm`.

items.name: dsh-littlestar-meeting
items.desc: Cross-session meeting room for DSH: a host session opens a room with a topic and a round limit, invites other sessions in order, they speak one at a time, and the meeting closes with written minutes.

items.name: dsh-agent-studio
items.desc: Visually configure an agent's prompt, tools, visible skills, subagents and fallback models, and assemble several of them into a team. It never writes or edits any host preset file.

items.name: dsh-kanban-flow
items.desc: Agent-driven kanban board: one board per workspace, per-task agent sessions, and a guarded human/agent workflow (Backlog → To Do → In Progress → Review → Done).

items.name: dsh-openreelbench
items.desc: Gated four-stage video pipeline: brief, script, assets and compose, turning one sentence into a narrated explainer with ComfyUI workflows or image/video APIs and FFmpeg assembly.

items.name: dsh-novel-solo
items.desc: "Single-Core Writing" plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Thoroughly tool-streamlined and output-hardened for quantized small models, suitable for running long-novel pipelines locally with on-device models.

items.name: agentflow
items.desc: Lifecycle orchestration engine for AI agent teams with task-scoped Git worktree isolation, state-gated delivery transitions, and off-context memory.

items.name: dsh-taskboard
items.desc: Full local-first issue board embedded in the DSH web GUI: Kanban / list / Gantt / workflow / dashboard views, AI chat per task, attachments and labels, auto-claim of todo tasks driven by dsh-routines — data lives in local SQLite (dsh plugin add @ttmouse/dsh-taskboard).

items.name: dsh-cron-job
items.desc: Scheduled DeepSeek Harness Agent tasks with mandatory end-to-end tests, run history, and bidirectional delivery through nine messaging channels.

items.name: dsh-automation-center
items.desc: Schedules workspace Agent runs in fresh Result Sessions with persistent audit history, using a stock DSH Conversation tab or a global Shell page when its slots are available.

items.name: dsh-outcome-loop
items.desc: Keeps a local task-outcome ledger for DSH, verifies acceptance criteria from deterministic evidence, records user disposition and token usage, and supports digest-bound export.

items.name: dsh-jev-subagent-dispatch
items.desc: Cut LLM costs: a Jev (System One) classifier vets each turn against a declarative policy and recommends the subagent model route, so routine work runs at flash rates while the main model keeps the hard parts; explicit /route trigger, runtime delegation-capability gate, credential redaction, and offline policy replay over the verdict log.

items.name: gitee-ai-employee
items.desc: Gitee/GitHub AI employee: @ the bot on an issue (Gitee or GitHub), it clones the repo, implements the fix on the branch you name, opens a PR to that branch, and can auto-merge and auto-close the issue. v1.2 adds security scanning: configure scan repos, audit with built-in/custom prompts, deduplicate, and file new findings as issues.

items.name: dsh-flow
items.desc: Execution flow chart: renders the current session's execution as a vertical node flow (turns, user, assistant, tools, approvals, retries, compaction), appended in real time over SSE with auto-follow scrolling — the chart draws wherever the session executes.

items.name: dsh-process
items.desc: Process management: brings ntd-style processes (multi-stage, multi-step agent workflow templates) into the dsh web UI — browse, edit, validate, import/export and AI-generate processes; the built-in library is read-only while the personal library is writable with live file sync, and agents read the library through process_* tools and advance work stage by stage.

items.name: dsh-tasks
items.desc: Scheduled tasks: run a prompt on cron schedules, each run opens a new agent session to do the work, with workspace binding, manual run, session auto-naming, and a fullscreen task management page.

items.name: dsh-thinktank
items.desc: Think tank: a built-in library of 161 classic mental models (decision/strategy/cognition/psychology/communication/learning/system/innovation/execution) — enter one question and several selected models analyze it in parallel via AI, producing a synthesized report with consensus, disagreements, blind spots and an action checklist; supports both automatic analysis and prompt round-trip import.

items.name: dsh-plugin-task-runner
items.desc: Task Runner mode for DeepSeek Harness: the main agent decomposes large tasks into independent subtasks, dispatches them to subagents (default local model) in fresh short contexts, and synthesizes results; concurrency and worker/orchestrator models are configurable in the settings panel.

items.name: dsh-round-table
items.desc: Round-table meetings for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 on Windows desktop, reusing existing Agent sessions with discussion, editable task cards, sequential and parallel steps, shared meeting files, and secretary minutes.

items.name: dsh-multi-candidate
items.desc: Multi-candidate mode for DeepSeek Harness (test-time scaling): floating panel config, the agent auto-runs parallel candidates plus verifier selection, scoped to the current session.

items.name: dsh-tandem
items.desc: Runs a second agent: hands independent subtasks to a local Codex CLI in parallel (up to three at a time), and asks it to review a design or a plan before the user sees it, returning conclusion, evidence, counterexamples and a verification step. A dispatch missing its timeout or its acceptance check is rejected by the plugin, not by the model remembering to check.

items.name: dsh-character-presets
items.desc: Luna preset for DeepSeek Harness — a little-demon persona on the full standard tool set, composed by six deterministic rule layers (perception, understanding, state, style, regulation, memory) plus a derived vitals layer, with a gated, suppressible cross-session memory file.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-wx-push
items.desc: Auto-send every DSH turn result to WeChat: listens for task completion, extracts the final assistant message and pushes it raw via the WeChat iLink bot (real delivery check, never fake success). Requires the wechat-acp daemon, a separately installed process you log into WeChat with.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-thesis-workbench
items.desc: Thesis and empirical-analysis workbench that drives IBM SPSS from the conversation: spss_check (environment self-check), spss_variables (list .sav variables with labels, types, measurement levels, case counts), spss_data (sample case rows to inspect missing and outlying values), spss_run / spss_run_file (execute SPSS syntax or an .sps file, relative CD and GET FILE paths auto-rebased), and spss_analyze (one-shot frequencies, descriptives, crosstabs with chi-square, t-tests, one-way ANOVA, correlation, linear regression). Results come back as structured tables extracted through OMS. SPSS 25-31 is auto-detected; the bundled MCP server is zero-dependency stdio.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-todo-guard
items.desc: Task-list staleness guard for DeepSeek Harness: watches the session event stream and counts tool calls since the last todo_write; past a configurable threshold it appends one short notice before the next step, quoting the current list, so the model writes it back to the real progress instead of leaving a stale snapshot on screen. Pure prompt injection, no blocking and no data mutation.

items.name: dsh-subagent-pool
items.desc: Maintains reusable named subagent profiles for DeepSeek Harness and runs them with per-profile model, reasoning effort, and agent-preset settings.

items.name: dsh-modes
items.desc: Settings page for agent modes (presets): switch up to 15 capabilities per mode (commands, files or read-only files, web, subagents, and more) or individual plugin rows; edit each mode's system prompt with variable checks, a full preview, version history, optional live updates for running sessions, and an approval-gated mode_prompt chat tool; create modes from four starter templates or copies; merge built-in updates after a dsh upgrade while keeping your changes, and turn off rows that fail to load.

items.name: dsh-root-planner-preset
items.desc: Recursive delegation for dsh agent trees: a preset plus Host limits bound what each subagent may do, subagents work in separate _agents/ workspaces, and the parent decides which results to integrate.

items.name: dsh-subagent-router
items.desc: Adds subagent_route and subagent_fork_route delegation tools where the model itself picks the provider/model route for each child; the deployment only sets the spawn/fork backend, background policy and allowedProviders allowlist, while continuable children and background jobs reuse the official send_message / job_output tools.

items.name: dsh-context-window
items.desc: Extends the composer model selector menu with a third Context window row, preset capacities (64K–2M), custom input, provider-wide sync, and adaptive compaction guard.

items.name: dsh-milestone-guard
items.desc: Milestone progress soft-enforcement guard: injects persistent system-prompt rules and post-execute notices when tool calls omit visible progress text, with a Web settings form.

items.name: dsh-md-convert
items.desc: Convert Office documents and PDFs (including scanned ones) to structurally formatted Markdown via a CPU-first routing OCR pipeline (RapidOCR/SLANet/FormulaNet).

items.name: dsh-expert-team
items.desc: Role-based multi-agent team for DeepSeek Harness — your digital workforce. One goal assembles a team of product, architect, frontend, backend, reviewer and QA roles that deliver through a nine-phase gated pipeline, plus a persistent team you can keep directing across sessions. Zero runtime dependencies, no build step.

items.name: dsh-knj-scheduler
items.desc: Cron task scheduler for DSH: on schedule, automatically creates a new session and injects your prompt as its first message, with task history and manual run/stop controls. Also runs KNJ workflows: pick files directly (stored as persistent snapshots, re-handed to the workflow on every fire) or reference them by path. Its sidebar entry is provided by dsh-knj-menu; install together: dsh plugin add dsh-scheduler dsh-knj-menu.

items.name: dsh-knj-workflow
items.desc: Config-driven development-task orchestration for DSH: graph workflows (task/gateway/human nodes) with per-stage persistence, plus an in-editor AI assistant that configures workflows through conversation with live validation. Hand documents to nodes as generic attachments (no declaration needed): files land in the task workspace and ${inputs.附件} gives the newline-joined absolute paths, so a node parses them with its own prompt.

items.name: dsh-plugin-background-tasks
items.desc: Antigravity-style run_command for DSH: short commands return inline within a configurable wait window (default 10s) while longer ones auto-promote into ctx.jobs for later collection and completion notices — executed via ctx.shell under the session sandbox and approval pipeline.

items.name: dsh-agent-team-roster
items.desc: Agent Teams roster plugin: newest-first ordering for the roster, task board and subagent catalog, plus bulk cleanup and teammate rename/delete.

items.name: dsh-home-migrate
items.desc: Export and import DeepSeek Harness configuration across machines as same-OS .dshmig archives, with credential redaction, verification and rollback.

items.name: dsh-itranslation#bundle
items.desc: Whole-book translation production line for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic chapter detection and segmentation, per-chapter subagent translation, glossary control, full-book review, targeted revision, and auditable meta.json evidence.

items.name: dsh-nexus
items.desc: Personal coding assistant that schedules, follows up on and verifies local Codex or Claude Code tasks from DSH, with WeChat, WeCom and Feishu remote channels.

items.name: dsh-feedback-bridge
items.desc: Turns DSH conversations into reviewable community feedback and, after confirmation, submits it to the official DeepSeek Harness Discussions.

items.name: ai-company-framework
items.desc: AI Company Framework: turn one sentence into a multi-agent company — 15 flat Skills (boss/pipeline/role-template/11 roles/generic customer-memory), 7 workflow templates, AgentTeams runtime + activity panel, employee sidebar with per-session isolation, Feishu bot bridge (boss and per-employee bots, group routing, autonomous push, human decision gate, external-contact guide), per-customer SQLite memory with three-layer memory (cross-group merge), /company mode switch; no RAG.

items.name: alpharsi
items.desc: AlphaRSI — three-role self-improvement loop that evolves the training recipe of alpha sequence models. Operator runs walk-forward, Evaluator grades with OOS RankIC, Refiner proposes hyperparameters via TPE Bayesian search; only strictly-better recipes are kept. Offline one-command run, data bundle shipped with sha1 reconciliation, GPU auto-detect. Ships one skill.

items.name: attest
items.desc: Training attestation — reproducible, attributable, auditable off-site standardized training for asset pricing. Hard-gates four failure modes (half-refresh, hash mismatch, unknown-read-as-pass, master pollution). Ships one skill.

items.name: za_analysis
items.desc: Model training stage — end-to-end analysis, model training, and estimation for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.

items.name: za_data
items.desc: Data stage — data discovery and quality assessment for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.

items.name: za_literature
items.desc: Literature review stage — search, synthesis, and citation-chain tracking for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.

items.name: za_ppt
items.desc: PPT stage — presentation generation (Beamer/Quarto) from the paper for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.

items.name: za_report
items.desc: Report stage — academic paper writing for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.

items.name: zagent
items.desc: Zagent — unified three-role self-improvement loop with three operators. Data-RSI (daily cross-sectional cleaning: winsorize → cross-sectional standardization → median fill, plus experience extraction), Harness-RSI (evolves system prompt / memory / skills), and Model-RSI (evolves alpha training recipes via framework-native walk-forward with 2-day gap and multi-seed). Offline one-command run, GPU auto-detect. Ships one skill.

items.name: dsh-bot-mode
items.desc: Bot Mode for DeepSeek Harness: a roster of named bots with avatars, personas and per-bot chats, each backed by one durable continuable subagent session that keeps memory across turns.

items.name: dsh-agent-swarm
items.desc: Chinese multi-agent workflow with per-role model fallback, versioned Mermaid task plans, independent Agent and Jev reviews, persistent expert collaboration, and pure-function calculation tools.

items.name: dsh-programming-mode
items.desc: Programming Mode agent preset bundle: the standard coding agent with its persona mandating the Superpowers discipline (skills first, brainstorming before building, plans before code, TDD, systematic debugging, verification before completion) plus an always-on Ponytail code-volume discipline (7-rung minimal-code ladder, default full); ships all twenty skills bundled (14 superpowers + 6 ponytail) and mechanically injects the full using-superpowers skill into every new session's first request.

items.name: dsh-task-workspace
items.desc: Task workspace convention: one folder per session, one PROGRESS.md per task overwritten on each update, and per-task git once the task runs long.

items.name: dsh-crew
items.desc: Dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code or Codex: native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge for vision and image generation.

items.name: dsh-personal-todo
items.desc: Persistent personal todos shared across DeepSeek Harness sessions and projects: SQLite storage, Agent tools, a native sidebar and turn-tail cards, with user-managed workflows or optional dispatch of individual todos to Agent sessions.

items.name: dsh-workflow-ui
items.desc: In-conversation workflow run timeline for DSH Web: a horizontal rail with phase stations, agent pills, loop arcs and parallel bands replaces the stock workflow tool card and workflow-run chat node. Planned stations render before the run starts via client-side script scanning; status dots and icons follow DSH official primitives.

items.name: dsh-parallel-dev
items.desc: By default, blocks marking a team task complete without a passed independent verification record whose commit matches the worktree HEAD, and adds a dependency DAG board and a settings page.

items.name: dsh-ask-peer
items.desc: Peer-to-peer colleague-agent consultation for DSH: ask one or several configured peers, queue asynchronous questions, discover peers through signed friend cards, and review inbound requests in the Web UI.

items.name: dsh-diff-approval
items.desc: Pending-change review for DeepSeek Harness: every `edit`, `write` and `str_replace_editor` change is collected automatically into the file list, where a single change block, the blocks within a selection, or the whole file can be kept or reverted, and undo/redo is supported. It imports the workspace's version-control changes, shows the diff in a single-column or side-by-side view, and provides a Markdown preview in which changes can also be kept or reverted, in-file search, block jumping and copyable line references; the diff data is stored persistently, so the review continues after a restart.

items.name: harness-github
items.desc: DSH GitHub connector: review PRs, triage issues, debug CI, prepare changes (18 tools, gh-first + REST fallback, approval-gated writes).

items.name: dsh-git-panel
items.desc: Git sidebar panel with commit graphs, ahead/behind tracking, branch operations, and one-click chat context injection.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-git-graph
items.desc: Right-sidebar page for DSH that draws the current session's repository as a VS Code-style commit graph - colored branch/merge lanes, ref chips and per-commit details - with a working-tree Changes area above it (staged/unstaged sections with inline diffs) for every working tree of the repository; read-only, works with or without dsh-better-sidebar, and follows the session's worktree label when dsh-session-worktree is installed.

items.name: codex-guard#dsh
items.desc: Pre-submit pull-request hygiene checks inside DeepSeek Harness: scans the current diff for TODO leftovers, hardcoded secrets, and non-conventional commit subjects.

items.name: dsh-gitmate
items.desc: Git panel in the right sidebar plus fifteen agent tools: editor-style diffs, a commit graph across every branch, staging and committing, branch, stash and remote operations, and model-assisted commit messages, pre-commit review and commit splitting.

items.name: dsh-worktree
items.desc: A minimal worktree management solution with only one button and one dialog.

items.name: dsh-github
items.desc: GitHub account management plus a local Git workflow for the web GUI with clone, fast-forward pull, status, commit, push, and host-side push guards.

items.name: dsh-github-router
items.desc: Read-only GitHub access for agents, wrapping several tools. Inside the tool it automatically probes and selects whichever GitHub access method works locally, and tries network proxies on its own. That cuts down the network and parsing problems an agent may hit when accessing GitHub, and the overhead of it repeatedly trying different approaches.

items.name: dsh-review
items.desc: A code review workflow that reviews uncommitted changes, changes against a base branch, a single commit, a GitHub pull request, or a file.

items.name: dsh-open-code-review
items.desc: Review code with Open Code Review: deterministic scope and rule resolution, judged by your own DSH model, no API key.

items.name: dsh-fork-worktree
items.desc: Fork and delete buttons on each workspace row of the Harness sidebar, plus a /fork-worktree command: fork creates a git worktree and registers it as a new workspace, delete removes the workspace folder through git worktree remove (asking again before discarding uncommitted work) and drops the registration.

items.name: dsh-review-checkout
items.desc: Codex-style review of session file changes: per-turn cards (optionally taking over the shell edited cards) whose totals are the turn net diff, a review tab with syntax-highlighted diffs that never wrap, real line numbers, open-at-line and a draggable split, a hover preview of the whole file with three lines of context around each change, one-click per-turn revert, and the on-disk record size with a clear button in the review toolbar. Records are sharded per session, with content-addressed snapshot blobs that dedupe and are garbage collected. Light/dark presets follow the DSH theme, typography follows DSH and installed skins (or any font on the machine, with a px stepper), and a settings switch injects a think-in-Simplified-Chinese rule into the global AGENTS.md.

items.name: dsh-git-plus
items.desc: Sidebar Git panel for the DSH web GUI: Local Changes and All Commits views, branch, tag and stash management with fetch, pull and push dialogs, merge with conflict handling, and a zsh-style branch marker in the input bar.

items.name: dsh-zcode-git
items.desc: Structured git tools for DeepSeek Harness agents: status, diff, log, branch, commit and stash. Output is pinned with ten `git -c` overrides so a user pager, colour or quotepath setting cannot reshape what the agent reads; every invocation is an argv array, so no shell ever parses an argument; and the mutating actions go through the harness approval service, refusing rather than proceeding when no approval service is mounted.

items.name: clutch-dsh#clutch-dsh-worktree
items.desc: Adds a Worktree view to DSH Web UI that groups Sessions by Git worktree while keeping DSH as the source of truth.

items.name: dsh-plugin-git
items.desc: Git service plus right-sidebar UI — a Changes tab (stage/unstage, per-file diffs, commit/amend, push and rebase-then-push sync, confirmed discard), a paged canvas commit-graph tab, a Worktrees tab to list, enter and create checkouts, a composer branch selector, and opt-in LLM commit-message generation.

items.name: dsh-cool-git
items.desc: Git plugin — adds Git management to the session tab bar, covering the basics: commit | pull | push | branch | diff.

items.name: dsh-git-manager
items.desc: A GitHub-connected visual git manager for DeepSeek Harness: guided GitHub-Flow steps, commit graph with PR/CI badges, one-click GitHub login, PR and issue management, and structured git tools for the agent. Renamed from gitcompass in 2.0.0.

items.name: dsh-wending-git-workbench
items.desc: Codex-style Git workbench: workspace-scoped changes, diff, stage, commit, guarded branch operations, graph history, fetch, fast-forward pull, and upstream push through official plugin APIs.

items.name: dsh-pr-board
items.desc: Maintainer and developer PR board for the DSH sidebar: a five-state review queue (waiting on me / waiting on author / ready to merge / merged / inbox), a three-column issue board, and a global view of the PRs you authored (my move / waiting on others / merged), with CI rollup badges, an inactivity filter, and one click per card to open or start the matching review conversation.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-git
items.desc: Git Changes tab for the DSH web GUI: staging, diffing, AI-drafted commit messages, branch/merge/stash/worktree operations and sync, with live updates via fs.watch plus a changeToken poll.

items.name: dsh-changelog-zh
items.desc: Turns real git history into two Chinese changelog drafts (short for users, long for developers); every entry carries its commit SHA and an evidence-backed verified/unverified mark, and commit subjects are never translated.

items.name: dsh-git-push
items.desc: Git commit-and-push automation for DSH with pre-push auditing, rule-based quality scoring, SSH key generation, and a three-tab settings sidebar.

items.name: dsh-git-graph
items.desc: Git view for DeepSeek Harness: status, commit graph, branches and tags in one picker, diff, staging/commit, push/pull and blame.

items.name: dsh-code-review
items.desc: Read-only Git and SVN code review using the current DSH agent model, with change previews, explicit context and approval-gated model requests.

items.name: dsh-vcs
items.desc: Read-only Git and SVN change review inside DeepSeek Harness, with repository browsing and side-by-side diffs.

items.name: agentsgitflowcontroller
items.desc: Branch-role guard for AI coding agents: configurable integration/preview/production/archive roles, blocking direct push, force-push and delete on protected branches and agent merges into production/archive.

items.name: dsh-git-panel
items.desc: The session page has an extra "Git" page; on the left is a preview of the non-staged/staged changes, and on the right is a diff preview with a row-level action bar (staged/discarded).

items.name: dsh-github-push
items.desc: One-step GitHub uploader: initializes git, auto-creates or improves README, sets repository topics, and pushes a local project to GitHub.

items.name: dsh-git-branch
items.desc: Branch and worktree management for DeepSeek Harness: the workspace toolbar shows the current branch with in-place switching, plus an IDEA-style branch selector, remote branch checkout, context menus (create, rename, delete, copy), push and update, and branch isolation into standalone worktrees with managed creation and deletion.

items.name: dsh-simple-worktree-plus
items.desc: Manages Git worktrees in DeepSeek Harness with branch deletion controls and scoped workspace management.

items.name: dsh-gitea
items.desc: Gitea and Forgejo integration for DeepSeek Harness with issue, pull-request and worktree tools plus a Git status chip.

items.name: dsh-git-sidebar
items.desc: VSCode-style uncommitted-changes sidebar docked to the right of the DSH web conversation page: staged / unstaged / untracked file groups, status badges, per-file +/− line counts, click-to-expand diff, rename as old → new, untracked content preview, and open with the system default application.

items.name: dsh-blast-radius
items.desc: Reports the semantic blast radius of agent code edits: which symbols changed, who calls them, and which of those callers have no covering test.

items.name: dsh-git-review
items.desc: Review tab for DeepSeek Harness sessions: workspace changes versus HEAD or any two refs as a filterable file tree with side-by-side diffs, a lane commit graph with blame and file history, three-scope search, line comments back to the composer, and guarded stage/commit/branch/tag/stash/conflict operations.

items.name: dsh-plugin-git
items.desc: Git workbench in the DSH session header and overlay: view changes, commit, fetch, pull, push, and browse branches and history in existing local repositories.

items.name: dsh-pr-guardian
items.desc: Authored pull request feedback inbox with paginated GitHub collection, priority favorites, and version-bound local progress shared by the DSH panel and CLI.

items.name: dsh-tool-radar
items.desc: Score a GitHub repo's contribution-friendliness from live merge and maintainer evidence.

items.name: dsh-worktree-panel
items.desc: Git worktree panel for DSH Web: replaces the workspace sidebar with project → main/linked worktree → session groups, creates and removes worktrees, switches the main branch, and migrates configurable project-local or global storage with dirty-tree and active-session safeguards.

items.name: dsh-gitee-chat
items.desc: Gitee Enterprise project management inside the conversation: issues, pull requests, kanban and the Gitee MCP toolchain.

items.name: dsh-git-flow
items.desc: Branch chip in the composer tool row that switches, creates, and refreshes workspace branches, commits a checked subset of changed files with a message the session's own model writes from the diff, and pushes the current branch.

items.name: deepseek-harness-desktop-ultra#dsh-plugin-repopanel
