items.desc: Browse the GitHub issues and pull requests of a workspace's origin remote, filter and comment, close or reopen, and file one as a task on dsh-plugin-taskboard for an agent to claim.

items.name: dsh-github-flow
items.desc: Wraps the local GitHub CLI (gh) in agent tools for pull requests, issues, Actions runs, repository search and raw API calls, plus /gh status and /gh help slash commands and two web panels (a global repository cockpit and a per-session workspace panel).

items.name: dsh-command-code-review
items.desc: Registers a /code-review slash command with five parallel review lenses and per-finding confidence scoring, for both pull requests and local code.

items.name: dsh-git-workbench
items.desc: Git development workbench for DeepSeek Harness: captures branch, status, worktrees, stashes and recent commits, with commands, tools and a settings UI.

items.name: dsh-worktree-space
items.desc: Worktree Space: puts a workspace task that spans one or more Git repositories in its own task space directory - each repository in it gets its own worktree on one shared task branch; the space is registered as a DSH Workspace so sessions start right there, and multiple tasks run side by side without interfering. Finishing a task can merge the work back into each repository's target branch, remove the worktrees, and file whatever Git does not track in an archive directory you choose.

items.name: dsh-ide-git
items.desc: JetBrains-style Git tool window for the sidebar: branch tree with ahead/behind badges, commit graph with text/author/date/path filters, per-file line diff, changes list and commit box, plus branch, tag and stash actions, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, reset and fetch/pull/push.

items.name: dsh-workspace-git-badge#dsh-git-badge
items.desc: Git status badges for DSH: sidebar workspace-row badges and an input-row chip showing the current conversation's workspace git state, with event-driven freshness over SSE.

items.name: dsh-dev-git-graph#dsh-dev-git-graph
items.desc: A Git Graph tab for DSH Web: a faithful port of vscode-git-graph 1.30.0 that registers a native tab in the dsh-better-sidebar right rail (prerequisite), auto-binds to the session workspace, runs the full git operations (checkout/merge/rebase/push/tag/stash) directly on the host, and opens file diffs in the built-in DiffTab.

items.name: dsh_vscodemode
items.desc: VSCode-style editing experience for DeepSeek Harness: a Monaco-based central file editor (tabs, Ctrl+P quick open, status bar) and interactive diff review of agent edit/write results with per-change Keep/Undo, rollback and archiving, persisted across restarts.

items.name: dsh-task-worktree
items.desc: Task-scoped git worktrees for DSH: durable per-repo manifest, worktree mode injects a creation instruction with your first message under an automatic worktree/ branch prefix, header badge instead of workspace clutter, and bring-back or force-remove cleanup.

items.name: dsh-codex-parity
items.desc: Codex-style Git panel for DeepSeek Harness: a header button opens a menu with commit, push, branch switching and creation, and repository initialization; shows the current branch and the total additions and deletions of uncommitted files.

items.name: dsh-git
items.desc: Local Git plus the four GitHub remote tabs in the official DSH right sidebar: Changes (per-file staging, line diffs, and commit messages written by the model already configured in DSH), History, then Code, Issues, Pull requests and Actions proxied by the host half. The token stays in the host half through ctx.credentials and /dsh-git/* accepts loopback requests only.

items.name: dsh-plugin-github
items.desc: Agent-facing GitHub repository tools: binds an account through a first-run prompt, then clones into the workspace and reads, exact-replaces, commits and pushes files, with writes off by default.

items.name: dsh-git-composer
items.desc: Claude-style Git branch and PR composer bar for DeepSeek Harness: quick branch switcher, native diff drawer integration, and adaptive PR creation with Actions CI status.

items.name: dsh-review-squad
items.desc: Runs a parallel code review squad of read-only reviewer subagents (security, correctness, tests, style), each optionally on its own model, and aggregates one severity-grouped report from /review or a code_review tool call.

items.name: dsh-ma-plugins#dsh-librarian
items.desc: Evidence-first GitHub research subagent with bounded tools and in-memory request caching.

items.name: dsh-git-plus
items.desc: DSH Source Control tab in dsh-better-sidebar that mirrors VS Code Git workflows.

items.name: dsh-forge
items.desc: Read-only Gitea and Forgejo tools over the REST API both projects share: instance info, repository listing, issue and pull request search and read, PR diffs and changed files, and Actions runs, jobs and job logs. Tool metadata is available in English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Japanese.

items.name: dsh-git-idea
items.desc: Git integration for DSH modelled on IDEA's VCS: a git icon beside the permission mode in the composer shows the current branch and the pending-change count, opens a branch switcher on hover and an IDEA-style VCS panel on click (branch tree, commit graph, changes and staging, commit detail, file diff), plus a settings page for commit identity, the git binary and the network flags. Registers no model tools with DSH.

items.name: dsh-backstory
items.desc: A `/backstory` command and tool that annotate each line with the git commit that last touched it and the agent turn + prompt that wrote it, from a persistent per-line ledger (drift-proof by content hash), DSH-* commit trailers, or the live session log.

items.name: dsh-git-change
items.desc: Git status badge in the composer tool row: a 14px branch glyph left of the model selector, with branch name, changed-file count and +added/-deleted lines on hover. Counts staged, unstaged and untracked files; nothing renders outside a git work tree.

items.name: dsh-github-workbench
items.desc: GitHub sidebar workbench for DSH: remote tree plus Issues, Pull requests and Actions tabs, with create/comment/edit/close, merge/squash/rebase, and rerun or cancel CI; mounts as a better-sidebar tab or a standalone right panel.

items.name: dsh-code-review
items.desc: Adds /review, /review-status, and /review-cancel to spawn an independent native subagent that inspects a chosen Git scope (base branch, uncommitted changes, a commit, or custom instructions) and returns a findings report in the current conversation, with English or Chinese output from the host locale.

items.name: dsh-open-code-review
items.desc: Alibaba Open Code Review for DSH: host-model delegation with native preview/rule tools and a review skill, plus optional OCR-managed reviews.

items.name: dsh-github-connect
items.desc: Connects your GitHub account to DSH agents from the composer GitHub button (OAuth device flow or personal access token) and lets them call the GitHub API through the github_api tool.

items.name: dsh-git-manager
items.desc: Git workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness: a repo-gated composer button opens a settings-style panel for diff/commit, branch, conflict, and worktree management, plus a commit history with branch-graph lines.

items.name: gitnexus-plus
items.desc: Reads a GitNexus index in the DSH sidebar, reports skipped files, index freshness and language coverage, searches symbols, and reviews recent Git activity.

items.name: gord-dsh-worktree
items.desc: Git worktrees for DeepSeek Harness — isolate parallel work in its own directory and branch. Ships Fast mode (快速模式).

items.name: dsh-git-forge
items.desc: Project-scoped Git credentials: forge accounts (GitHub, Gitea, GitLab, Bitbucket or a custom host) live in the right-sidebar "Git Forge" tab, are granted per project, and reach the agent as an HTTPS credential helper so the token never enters the conversation. Pushes to a host the project has not granted are rejected.

items.name: dsh-worktree-studio
items.desc: Human-operated Git worktree task board for DeepSeek Harness with validation-bound merge delivery.

items.name: dsh-git-statusline
items.desc: Compact Git status line for DSH Web: the current branch, staged and unstaged line changes, ahead/behind commit counts against upstream, and a clean-worktree marker — placeable in the sidebar footer, the session header, or above/below the composer, with the position switched on the settings page.

items.name: dsh-git-commit
items.desc: DSH slash command /commit: stages all changes, summarizes the staged diff with the session model, and commits; no browser UI required, with a local fallback when the model call fails.

items.name: dsh-web-git-sidebar
items.desc: Source Control panel in the DSH Web left rail: search, switch and create branches with ahead/behind counts, a topo-order commit graph, and a click-to-expand preview of any commit showing its files (A/M/D), insertions and deletions, message, author and timestamp. An always-on footer dock above Settings carries the branch dropdown and recent commits and follows the open session; fetch and fast-forward pull are one button, and a git_worktree agent tool creates, lists and removes worktrees.

items.name: dsh-git-plugins#bundle
items.desc: Git and source-control plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness: local git operations plus GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps and Gitea adapters, with self-evolving memory.

items.name: dsh-worktree-manager
items.desc: Git worktree management for dsh — group workspaces by repository, create and switch worktrees, and browse their changes, commit history and file diffs.

items.name: dsh-git-view
items.desc: Git tab in the DeepSeek Harness conversation view: reviews every repository in the session working directory and commits each on its own, with change groups, whole-file / changes-only / side-by-side diffs, in-panel editing, and a push button that lists every commit it would publish.

items.name: dsh-git-tools
items.desc: Four dependency-free local git tools (status, diff, log, commit) for DeepSeek Harness operating on the session workspace.

items.name: dsh-review
items.desc: Snapshot-bound multi-agent Git review with independent verification, majority voting, resolution tracking and an AI review gate.

items.name: dsh-git-connector
items.desc: Git repository connector for DeepSeek Harness: saved repo profiles addressed by name, work-copy operations (clone/fetch/pull/push/commit), Gitea/Forgejo/GitHub API tools, keys in the DSH credential center, and per-repo safety flags (TLS bypass, overwrite, force push).

items.name: dsh-ci-co-pilot
items.desc: GitHub CI co-pilot for DeepSeek Harness: PR review, CI failure fixing, issue triage and release notes.

items.name: dsh-git-vcs
items.desc: A right-sidebar Git panel in the IDEA style — local changes with per-file checkbox commits, a commit tree with per-commit details, branch, remote and stash management, push with a credential fallback, all driven by the plain git CLI.

items.name: dsh-github-companion
items.desc: 33 github_* tools covering REST reads, issue writes, Git data writes, private repo creation, and clone; in-process permission gate and cost-discipline companion skill; no gh CLI required.

items.name: dsh-codex-review
items.desc: A /review command that hands the current change set to a reviewer subagent pinned to the model you choose, with one continuing reviewer session per chat.

items.name: dsh-llm-verifier
items.desc: Runs 3 or 5 coding-agent candidates in detached Git worktrees, validates their patches with project commands, ranks only passing candidates, and requires separate approval before applying the winner.

items.name: dsh-git-server
items.desc: Git server: embeds ts-gogs (a TypeScript reimplementation of Gogs) and serves a full Git service on its own port — HTTP clone/push, web UI, issues/PRs/wiki — reusing user-management credentials, start/stop from the settings page.

items.name: dsh-github-sync
items.desc: Bidirectional GitHub repository sync for DSH: git sync with conflict rollback and pre-push checks, Actions/CI monitoring with per-step run detail, repository add/remove/rename, a web panel with local and remote file browsers, scheduled automation, and six agent tools.

items.name: dsh-git-panel
items.desc: IDE-style Git panel in the DSH Web GUI: a resident tab with a three-column overview (branch/tag list, searchable commit-history graph, commit detail with changed-file tree and message) and a changes page (stats bar, uncommitted list with per-file stage/unstage/discard, commit box with amend); side-by-side diffs carry lazy highlight.js syntax highlighting, on-demand between-hunk context expansion and word-level intra-line emphasis, with image files shown as before/after panes; plus a zsh-style branch marker in the input bar. Every git command runs as an argv array through the host subprocess service, cwd locked to the repo root.

items.name: dsh-solution-explorer
items.desc: DSH Web GUI right sidebar: VS Code-style file explorer plus source control (git status, stage/unstage/discard, commit, diff, commit graph, fetch/pull/push sync, branch and remote management, git init, multi-repo switch, color-coded file status, file-type icons), an editor view that opens every file reached from the chat, the file tree or source control (Markdown/HTML/PDF/image previews, 15-language syntax highlighting, hunk-level diff editing, Ctrl+S save), file operations (new/move/copy/delete, reveal in file explorer), a collapsible icon rail, a multi-tab bottom terminal (ConPTY), and commit messages generated from the staged diff by a host-configured model.

items.name: dsh-source-control
items.desc: VSCode-style Source Control page in the DSH Web right sidebar: a paged commit lane graph with ref markers and per-commit diffs, grouped working-tree changes with stage/discard/unstage, a commit box with amend and AI-generated messages, a side-by-side and unified diff page, GitHub repository and pull request creation through the gh CLI, and bidirectional HTTPS/SSH remote switching.

items.name: dsh-knj-version-control
items.desc: Version-control workbench for the DSH Web sidebar: local changes grouped by type, per-file and multi-file staging, preview-confirmed commit / update / push, and a failure dialog that shows the raw Git output instead of a four-second toast.

items.name: dsh-import-repositories
items.desc: Runs git in the Host process so push, pull and fetch work inside the agent sandbox; exposes 8 agent tools (status, diff, log, stage, commit, push, fetch, pull) and 11 slash commands including /git-status, /git-commit, /git-tag and /git-name-set.

items.name: dsh-code-review
items.desc: One-click standalone two-column code review page for Git diffs in the conversation: line numbers, add/delete coloring, character-level highlight, hunk-aware per-file sections, a file nav sidebar and a stats bar; line comments submit back to the DSH composer, and the UI follows the DSH locale.

items.name: dsh-plugin-git-workbench
items.desc: Local Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness: branch search and switching, hunk-level staging, commit graph, file history and blame, stash and worktree management, conflict resolution, and eight git tools for the agent.

items.name: dsh-tauri-turnrewind
items.desc: Turn-level workspace undo for Git worktrees: every agent turn gets a private snapshot, /undo previews a red/green diff card that is confirmed in place, files changed after the turn are refused with a conflict diff unless --force or --skip-conflicts is passed, and HEAD, index, stash and commit history of the user repository are never written.

items.name: dsh-turnsnap
items.desc: Zero-config per-turn git checkpoints: after every completed agent turn in a git workspace, stages all changes into one tagged \[turnsnap] commit (serialized queue, sandbox-policy aware), so any turn is a rollback point.

items.name: dsh-review
items.desc: Runs a diff past several reviewers at once — a CLI coding agent such as codex or claude, or a DSH subagent — and merges their separate sections into one report; reviewers and named review modes are configured in the settings UI.

items.name: dsh-svn-tools
items.desc: SVN (Subversion) toolset for DeepSeek Harness: 33 agent tools (status, diff, log, blame, commit, merge, props, lock, changelist...) plus a sidebar panel with side-by-side BASE/working-copy diff, conflict resolution and AI commit logs.

items.name: dsh-auto-git
items.desc: Runs git init in each newly registered DSH workspace, with an empty initial commit by default, so git-aware plugins have a repository to attach to; directories already inside a work tree are skipped.

items.name: dsh-web#packages/dsh-git-graph
items.desc: Git branch selector and Git graph for the dsh web GUI: switch branches and explore branch-lane and commit history from the conversation header.

items.name: dsh-update
items.desc: One-click update for the local DeepSeek Harness checkout — compare versions, pull and rebuild, then restart, and roll back to any past release, all from a sidebar panel with live progress.

items.name: source-code-mgmt
items.desc: Code management panel for the DSH web UI that handles everyday Git in five steps: ① env check auto-detects git/gh/ssh and one-click installs missing tools (gh mirror download sources speed up installs, Windows included) with check-update; ② SSH ed25519 key generation / connection tests plus one-click 443 config to bypass blocked port 22, with the Gitee personal token configured here; ③ repo status, side-by-side diffs, stage/commit, branch switching, history with revert/cherry-pick, one-click repo creation and push, auto-ignoring >100MB files; ④ lists all repos of your account for one-click clone; ⑤ five-step npm publish wizard. GitHub / Gitee dual-platform, with the UI switching between 中文 and English live.

items.name: dsh-github-mcp
items.desc: Connects GitHub's official remote MCP server as a DSH plugin: stores the PAT in DSH's credential center (.credentials.yaml) via github_set_token, and exposes GitHub tools as mcp__github__*.

items.name: dsh-github-mcp-hint
items.desc: GitHub MCP helper panel: shows copyable example prompts at Settings → Plugins → GitHub MCP (random 4 from a 30-example pool), visualizes a public user's repo star/fork/language, and adds the gh_repo_stats and gh_current_user model tools.

items.name: dsh-discord-richpresence
items.desc: Push vague or rich, user-configurable DSH interaction states to the local Discord client as Rich Presence — real-time, content-free, with a user-editable status list and an optional rich-mode toggle in Settings.

items.name: dsh-im-qq
items.desc: QQ official bot (q.qq.com) integration for DeepSeek Harness: chat with the full agent from private chats, groups and channels — WS long connection (heartbeat / reconnect / RESUME), per-chat session isolation, standard agent preset, approval inline buttons with /revoke, slash commands, whitelist fail-closed, credentials via the credentials domain.

items.name: dsh-notifier
items.desc: Multi-channel notifications for DeepSeek Harness: registers a send_notification tool and a settings page fanning out to NotifyX, WeCom app webhook, WeCom group robot, email (Resend), SMTP, DingTalk, Feishu robot; plus browser notifications and automatic notification on task completion and blocking events.

items.name: dsh-message-gateway
items.desc: Multi-platform message gateway and WeCom AI bot bridge with session context compression and smartsheet creation.

items.name: dsh-smart-reminder
items.desc: Smart calendar and checklist assistant with lunar dates, macOS/Windows native notifications, and WeCom push.

items.name: dsh-gateway
items.desc: Connects a DSH Host to Slack and Feishu using your own bot applications.

items.name: dsh-notch
items.desc: Connects DSH session status, approvals and questions to a native macOS notch app; requires the native app and Focus companion.

items.name: dsh-notch#dsh-notch-focus
items.desc: Companion for DSH Notch that synchronizes session navigation and read state with DSH Desktop and Web.

items.name: dsh-attention-notifier
items.desc: Sounds and notifications when a task completes or waits for your approval or answer; notification sounds are configurable in the settings page (synth styles or your own audio file), with built-in cat hachimi sounds, just for fun. An optional Windows patch adds a taskbar digit, flashing and native toasts.

items.name: dsh-gotify-notify
items.desc: Push a Gotify notification when each conversation turn ends, with configurable templates, priority and per-cause titles.

items.name: dsh-plugin-mac-notify
items.desc: Sends a macOS Notification Center alert when a session finishes or the agent is blocked on an answer, an approval, or an error. The banner carries the last reply and plays your system alert sound, and clicking it returns you to the DSH page.

items.name: dsh-feishu
items.desc: Connects a Feishu self-built app over WebSocket, routes each chat to an independent DSH agent session, and streams replies through a Card JSON 2.0 card with plain-text fallback.

items.name: dsh-notify-relay
items.desc: Routes eight DSH lifecycle events through dedup, quiet hours and digest batching into seven channels. Severity maps to the fields Bark, ntfy, Telegram and webhooks actually support; failed deliveries retry with jittered backoff and survive a restart; per-channel circuit breakers stop hammering a dead endpoint; and a self-check reports a degraded relay instead of going silent.

items.name: my-dsh-plugins#dsh-my-notify
items.desc: Browser notifications and a beep when a session turn ends, the agent asks a question or approval is pending; clicking the notification jumps to the session; remote trigger endpoint and SSE channel (npm: `dsh-my-notify`).

items.name: dsh-notify-ding
items.desc: Browser system notification, sounded by the OS notification itself, when a session needs a reply or a run goes idle; no page-focus check, at most one notification per session with a newer one replacing the old, and an idle notice reports how many background tasks are still running.

items.name: dsh-plugin-notify-sounds
items.desc: Plays a soft chime when the agent needs your decision or finishes a task, with system notifications that jump back to the window, repeat reminders, quiet hours, and one-click self-update.

items.name: dsh-notify
items.desc: Native desktop notifications for DSH — approvals, questions, turn completion, session end and errors — with click-to-session, per-event toggles, quiet hours, a privacy switch that keeps message text off the banner, and a Web Audio tone per event type.

items.name: cc-monitor#dsh-cc-monitor
items.desc: Reports DeepSeek Harness session activity to a self-hosted cc-monitor server, which surfaces Claude Code and DSH sessions as color-coded state cards in one web dashboard and pings your browser and Android app when a session needs attention.

items.name: dsh-herald
items.desc: Tri-channel task notifications: in-page toasts with chimes, browser OS banners, and host-direct OS toasts that keep working with the browser closed, plus a bell panel with persistent history.

items.name: dsh-bili-scroll
items.desc: Let your DSH agent browse Bilibili on its own, read subtitles, write a daily digest, and @ you when it finds something worth your attention.

items.name: dsh-agent-bridge
items.desc: Bridge a Feishu bot to a DSH session: open a real session in a workspace, run tasks with the existing model and plugins, and report results back.

items.name: dsh-feishu-task-recorder
items.desc: Poll Feishu (Lark) group and direct chats through lark-cli, extract candidate tasks with a review workflow, and two-way sync them with the task-board plugin, with a floating browser panel and one-click device-flow authorization.

items.name: dsh-qq-onebot-bridge
items.desc: Bidirectional QQ bridge over OneBot v11 (reverse WebSocket): per-group and per-private-chat sessions, @-quoted voice speech-to-text, private image/animated-sticker viewing, face and sticker tools.

items.name: dsh-perch-notify
items.desc: Webhook notifications for dsh sessions: a POST when an approval is requested or a turn ends, to ntfy, Bark, a Slack/DingTalk/WeCom bot URL, or any HTTPS endpoint.

items.name: dsh-agent-notify
items.desc: Windows system-level notifications when the agent finishes a task or needs your input: task-done, question, approval and plan-review alerts via the browser Notification API, click-to-open the session, background-only mode, and a first-level settings page (Settings → 任务提示).

items.name: dsh-ping
items.desc: Telegram notifications for DeepSeek Harness questions, approval requests, and completed turns. Notification-only: one runtime file, zero runtime dependencies, no custom question cards.

items.name: dsh-notify-me
items.desc: Notification reminders, message alerts and desktop notification for DSH — a desktop notifier that raises a system toast, a sound and a tab-title marker when the agent needs your input (approval, plan review, question) or a reply is finished in the background (task complete / completion alerts, notify when done); the Settings page holds the master switch, sound and volume, the per-case toggles and the zh/en notification language.

items.name: dsh-approval-chime
items.desc: Plays a chime when DeepSeek Harness asks for approval; tone, volume and on/off are set in Settings → Notifications.

items.name: dsh-feishucard
items.desc: Bridge DeepSeek Harness agent sessions into Feishu (Lark) chats over the official SDK long connection, with a streaming reply card, many bots per instance, and mention-gated group replies.

items.name: dsh-wechat
items.desc: WeChat bridge for DeepSeek Harness over Tencent's iLink bot channel: one session per contact, inbound text/images/files, and WeChat's native typing indicator while a turn runs.

items.name: notification
items.desc: Task-completion notifications: desktop alerts via macOS Notification Center and Windows Toast, plus mobile push through Bark, ntfy, ServerChan or any webhook when an agent run goes idle, errors or blocks.

items.name: dsh-hermes-bridge
items.desc: Task-queue execution endpoint for DSH: requires a separately self-deployed Hermes Agent gateway plus your own WeChat inbound script; verified on a single environment — expect to adapt it.

items.name: dsh-genshin-lisa-notice
items.desc: Plays a voice alert and a browser notification when a turn finishes, asks for input, or fails, and can push the same summary to a Feishu bot webhook as a card.

items.name: dsh-web-ding
items.desc: Plays a short synthesized ding in the browser tab the moment an agent finishes a turn, built entirely with the Web Audio API; no backend audio and no OS notification.

items.name: dsh-desktop-notifications
items.desc: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness covering approval requests, questions, run completion, errors and sign-in prompts, with the conversation name as the first line of every notification.

items.name: dsh-gap-feed
items.desc: During long agent thinking, posts a hot-news or reminder message directly into the conversation stream.

items.name: dsh-task-time
items.desc: Reminders and task timing for DeepSeek Harness: interval alerts while the model runs and overdue alerts past the planned time, plus a persistent red decision alert when the model needs your input (in-app reminder cards with sound while you are in DSH, system toasts when you are away, configurable or keep-until-dismissed card dwell time, and clicking a card jumps to its session); plan time per session, count model runtime only, and report actual vs. planned when the task ends, with a task board and persistent local records.

items.name: dsh-messenger-gateway
items.desc: Telegram bridge for DeepSeek Harness: bidirectional sessions, conversation steering, home-channel routing, and TTS voice notes sent as Telegram audio messages.

items.name: dsh-high-fee-alert
items.desc: Automatically retrieves time-of-use pricing data (with Beijing Time) and notifies users during peak periods to reduce costs.

items.name: dsh-wechat-persistent
items.desc: Persistent WeChat bridge for DSH: one WeChat user maps to one persistent agent session via the official iLink channel, with context and the user-to-session registry surviving restarts. There is no sender allowlist — anyone who can message the paired WeChat account can start a conversation with a session that has tool access, and the working directory defaults to the home directory; use a dedicated account and set WECHAT_PERSISTENT_CWD.

items.name: dsh-zentao#zentao
items.desc: Floating ZenTao work center: a right-edge sidebar listing tasks, bugs and stories assigned to you, with drag-to-chat, original links and auto-refresh.

items.name: dsh-task-reminder
items.desc: Windows toast and a chime whenever a conversation task stops: completed, waiting on your approval or answer, or failed. Clicking the toast reopens that session at your last question, and in DSH Desktop it also raises the window.

items.name: dsh-task-sounds
items.desc: Task-complete and question notification sounds for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a soft chime when the agent finishes a turn, a ding-dong when it asks you something (questions, plan reviews, approvals). Synthesized Web Audio, zero assets, mute toggle and volume slider in the session header and settings.

items.name: dsh-rss-monitor
items.desc: Native RSS monitor for DeepSeek Harness: multi-source subscription, keyword filtering, scheduled polling with smart dedup, and email notifications for new items (HTML template with thumbnail cards), with SMTP passwords stored only in the credential store.

items.name: dsh-notify
items.desc: Reminder bubbles beside the input for DeepSeek Harness: any plugin or AI can push reminders (text/link) with chat-style stacking, drag-resize, AI summary, visual customization and random outfit presets. A static profile plugin available in every preset without disappearing on restart.

items.name: dsh-state-notifier
items.desc: Five task-state reminders for DeepSeek Harness (completion, approval, question, block, error) with four synthesized browser sound presets, system notifications that open the right session, and a terminal-BEL fallback when no browser is ready.

items.name: dsh-a2a-notify
items.desc: Windows balloon notifications for session lifecycle events (new / running / finished / error) across all workspaces, with a session-store watch that catches headless and A2A dispatch sessions whose events never reach the host bus. Windows only.

items.name: dsh-host-notify
items.desc: Host-side macOS notifications for questions, approvals and finished replies — immune to hidden-renderer notification loss, with icon, sound and click-to-raise.

items.name: dsh-notify
items.desc: In-page task notifications with collapsible status toasts, sound, and session navigation.

items.name: avernet#deepseek-harness-channel-bcn
items.desc: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Avernet's Bot Collaboration Network over WebSocket V2, with automatic onboarding, isolated agent sessions, tool-call events, and multi-bot routing tools.

items.name: dsh-niulai-sound
items.desc: Approval sound effects from the movie NiuLai: plays 「妈妈」 when user confirmation is requested, interrupts it and plays 「牛来！」 the moment the user approves; native Windows playback, zero external dependencies.

items.name: dsh-imbot
items.desc: Two-way agent bridge for Feishu (Lark) and DingTalk groups: chat with a DeepSeek Harness agent from IM groups via long-connection / Stream Mode — no public port needed. Workspace selection/creation, session switching, archiving (synced with DSH GUI), configurable from the DSH settings page. Feishu uses interactive cards, DingTalk uses text commands.

items.name: dsh-connect#connect
items.desc: Bridges DeepSeek Harness sessions to Feishu/Lark, Telegram and DingTalk: each chat is bound to a resumable DSH session, replies stream back as cards, and a task-end card reports the model, token usage, step count and duration. Question and permission-approval cards are answerable from the chat, and a web settings pane configures the per-channel credentials.

items.name: dsh-telegram-control
items.desc: Telegram remote control for DeepSeek Harness: list conversations with titles and workspaces, resume paused persisted sessions on demand (preset remount), turn-tracked reply relay, first-line reasoning summaries, inline-button approve/reject with outcome edits, and a bot command menu.

items.name: dsh-task-toast
items.desc: Top-right status plate for six session states (complete, error, approval, question, unopenable, subagent), plus an OS notification when you are away.

items.name: dsh-helper
items.desc: Send local files to WeChat from any DSH session by reusing an installed IM plugin, plus cron-scheduled tasks that run in fresh sessions, a workspace activity glow, a header activity indicator, a completion chime, a macOS sidebar vibrancy toggle and a one-click host restart.

items.name: dsh-hybrid-notify
items.desc: Multi-channel notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness: dispatches in-page toasts in the foreground and PWA system notifications (Service Worker) or browser notifications in the background, with per-event toggles for task complete, approval request, question, plan review and errors, persistent notifications, and Web Audio synthesized alert sounds without audio files.

items.name: dsh-im-humanize
items.desc: Humanized fork of @xmanrui/dsh-im (base 4.21.2): humanized message delivery with send-delay and typing two-phase, message_break + streaming coexistence, status reactions, reply quotes, per-bot humanize overrides, and a no_reply reclaim tool — across WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Telegram, Slack and WhatsApp channels.

items.name: dsh-notify
items.desc: Native desktop alerts when dsh needs the human — approvals, questions, plan reviews, turn completion, goals, errors and workflow runs — plus a Settings tab for every option, hot-applied.

items.name: dsh-win-notify
items.desc: Real Windows OS toasts for DeepSeek Harness: task-finished, needs-input and needs-approval alerts that persist in Notification Center under DeepSeek branding. Windows-only, zero runtime dependencies.

items.name: dsh-wechat-bridge
items.desc: Two-way WeChat bridge for DeepSeek Harness via the iLink protocol: bind your personal WeChat with a QR scan and chat with a local DSH agent from the chat box (text, images, voice-to-text, files); a web settings panel handles binding/start/stop/status, project-session binding continues the conversation on desktop, proactive wechat_notify pushes include throttling, and the pure-Node daemon runs on Windows/macOS/Linux.

items.name: dsh-bell-notify
items.desc: Web Audio lifecycle cues for DeepSeek Harness: ten configurable events, three low-noise defaults, per-event custom sounds, and no shipped audio assets.

items.name: dsh-dingtalk-notify
items.desc: DingTalk alerts when the agent needs your choice or approval, or finishes a turn; it stays quiet while you are watching the DSH page.

items.name: dsh-ai-question-chime
items.desc: Plays a chime when the AI asks a clarifying question (a `?` / `？` in the message, or an `ask_user_question` tool call). Synthesized via Web Audio API, no audio file, works on every OS.

items.name: dsh-pharos
items.desc: Desktop notifications for DSH: a system toast, a per-kind chime and a tab-title marker when the agent needs you (approval, plan review, question) or a reply finishes in the background; errors, interrupts, usage limits and multi-agent workflow progress alert too. A host half adds SSE delivery, webhook push (WeCom/Feishu/DingTalk/generic), per-turn token/cache/TPS stats, plus three message-format presets (concise, detailed, custom); settings changes auto-save.

items.name: work-personal-secretary#work-personal-secretary
items.desc: Installer and configuration base for a five-plugin DSH assistant suite: probes the Python, WPS and workspace environment, installs the sibling plugins shipped in the same repository, and generates the workspace baseline (instruction layer, memory seed, skills, settings); it also contributes its own settings section and its own host-side setup and check logic.

items.name: dsh-status-chime
items.desc: Speaks a short status line when DSH changes state — turn done, turn error, job done, job failed, goal complete, goal blocked, an approval waiting, or the agent needs your answer — using eight pre-recorded clips in Chinese (default) and English. The audio is played by the host process through ffplay, or through the Windows PowerShell player that ships with the OS, so it does not depend on a Web Audio tab. Windows only.

items.name: dsh-ask-notify
items.desc: Shows a reminder card in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI whenever the agent is waiting for your answer, and adds a desktop notification plus a flashing tab title when you are on another tab or window.

items.name: dsh-weixin-plus
items.desc: WeChat bridge and native Web settings panel with QR scan login, live token health probe, and credential management.

items.name: dsh-message-reminder
items.desc: Raises a Windows desktop notification card when DSH asks you a question, and returns to the asking Session when the card is clicked.

items.name: dsh-you-should-know
items.desc: Surfaces important facts and trade-offs from the current task, with on-demand explanations and optional discussion in the main session.

items.name: dsh-windows-notifications
items.desc: Adds Windows desktop notifications, optional sounds, and DSH-styled in-page notifications for task events.

items.name: my-dsh-plugins#tlnotify
items.desc: Pushes DSH session events to phone IM and lets you reply straight under that message, injecting the text back into the right session. Covers nine event kinds: task completion, execution error, execution blocked, manual abort, token limit reached, abnormal interruption, waiting for your answer, permission request, and waiting for plan confirmation. Channels are QQ single-chat bots and Feishu custom apps, both over WebSocket long connections — no public IP, domain or tunneling needed. Several bots can be configured at once, each subscribing to the sessions it cares about. Approvals and questions arrive with tappable buttons, and replies route home through three layers (button, quoted reply, explicit short-id prefix), falling back to the most recent intervention-needed notification and echoing which session it went to.

items.name: dsh-plugin-noticeme
items.desc: Background notification plugin: desktop notification, with a tab-title fallback, when an approval prompt or an ask-user-question card appears while the page is in a background tab. The host queues approval and question events behind a same-origin endpoint that the client polls every 3 seconds; clicking the notification focuses the page, and the tab title is restored once the page becomes visible.

items.name: agents-plugins#task-complete-notify-for-dsh
items.desc: Sends a desktop notification and chime when a DeepSeek Harness run completes, errors, or waits for approval, with a configurable duration threshold.

items.name: dsh-alert-sound
items.desc: Audio and voice alerts for the dsh web GUI: distinct tones and optional speech for approvals, questions, completions and errors.

items.name: dsh-notice-card
items.desc: Shows a focus-free notice card in the corner when a turn ends or DSH is waiting on an approval or a question.

items.name: dsh-serverchan-watchdog
items.desc: Unofficial host-side ServerChan notifications for DeepSeek Harness: sends mobile alerts through WeChat (ServerChan Turbo) or the ServerChan³ app when approvals, plan reviews, or questions go unanswered beyond a configurable threshold, even with the browser closed.

items.name: dsh-onebot
items.desc: QQ channel for dsh via OneBot 11 (NapCat and friends): reverse or forward WebSocket, DM and group chats, image and voice transcription, t2i text-image cards, merged forwards, and a settings page.

items.name: dsh-harmonyos-hiboard
items.desc: Push DSH task results to the Huawei HarmonyOS assistant-today screen as service cards. After installing, enter the auth code on the plugin settings page: DSH top-left Plugins - dsh-harmonyos-hiboard.

items.name: dsh-session-attention
items.desc: Desktop notification and sound when a turn completes, the agent asks a question, or an approval is requested, each independently toggleable, plus an activity ball that lists live sessions and jumps back to one.

items.name: dsh-notion-oauth-ui
items.desc: Connect Notion from the GUI with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE — official Notion MCP, no integration token.

items.name: dsh-quake-alert
items.desc: Real-time disaster alerts for DeepSeek Harness: Japan earthquakes (P2PQuake) and JMA EEW, tsunami and weather telegrams, global earthquakes (EMSC/USGS) and NOAA tsunamis, mainland China earthquakes (CENC via Wolfx) plus nmc.cn rainstorm and geological-hazard warnings, and US/Canadian NWS and ECCC flood, rainfall and storm-surge warnings — matched against your watch regions and thresholds.

items.name: dsh-desktop-notify
items.desc: Notifies you about 11 configurable DSH agent events (task completion, questions, denied approvals, background subagents/goals/jobs, team tasks, context compaction, triggered schedules, plugin startup and permission changes) as browser Web Notifications through a bundled service worker, falling back to Windows toast or Linux D-Bus, with three silence levels and click-to-open.

items.name: dsh-plugin#dsh-turn-notify
items.desc: Turn event notifications: six event classes (completed, error, interrupted, approval requested, AI question, limit reached) delivered via sound, system notification, in-page banner, webhook, IM and host desktop-notification channels; when several browser windows are open, only one rings.

items.name: dsh-desk-card
items.desc: Windows-only plugin that shows permission requests, waiting questions, task errors and finished turns as native card windows, and can allow a permission request straight from the card.

items.name: dsh-plugin-notifications
items.desc: Adds a Settings card that pops a system notification and optional chime when a conversation turn completes.

items.name: dsh-relay
items.desc: Relay agent approval requests and questions to iMessage / Email / WeChat channels and resolve them by replying with the request number (#N 批准 / 拒绝 / 回答).

items.name: dsh-plugins#serverchan-notify
items.desc: ServerChan3 (Server酱) push notifications when a turn finishes — title, model, project directory, git branch, status and a reply excerpt, with subagent filtering and fire-and-forget delivery.

items.name: dsh-halo
items.desc: One-click publish of DSH conversations as Markdown articles on a Halo CMS blog: confirm in the GUI, type the console password (never stored), and the Q&A record is created through the Halo REST API.

items.name: dsh-notification
items.desc: Desktop and webhook alerts on macOS, Linux and Windows when an agent finishes a turn, errors, or waits for approval — zero-dependency native notifications (osascript / notify-send / PowerShell toast) plus a Slack-compatible webhook, with a configurable minimum turn duration.

items.name: dsh-open-obsidian
items.desc: Opens the Obsidian vault a DSH session is working in, on the first human message — so your sync plugin (Nutstore sync, Obsidian Sync, Obsidian Git, …) starts running and the files the agent edits actually get synced. Skips a vault that is already open, and opens a new window behind the current one instead of stealing focus. Also serializes writers per vault — a second conversation's write is refused before it runs and queued until the holder is done, so a sync client cannot splice two conversations' edits together. Windows only.

items.name: dsh-pet-company
items.desc: Quiet break, water, long-session and late-night reminders delivered by three bundled chibi companions, with cloud bubbles and a light bounce. Works in-page without extra downloads; the optional macOS desktop window uses a separately downloaded Electron helper.

items.name: dsh-deepcanary
items.desc: Evidence-first attention supervision for DeepSeek Harness with C0–C3 policy, deduplicated Inbox alerts, quiet hours, and redacted outcome records.

items.name: dsh-notify-desktop
items.desc: Windows toast notifications for DSH desktop sessions from the host process: turn ends, approvals, questions and a reminder for an unanswered wait, with a selectable sound per situation and imported custom sound files; clicking a toast raises the DSH window.

items.name: dsh-plugin-weixin
items.desc: WeChat (personal WeChat, iLink Bot API) channel: chat with your DSH agent from WeChat, with images, files and voice-note transcription. One WeChat conversation can hold several DSH Sessions (/new, /list, /use) and every option is editable from the settings page. Also published to npm as dsh-plugin-weixin.

items.name: dsh-plugin-notify
items.desc: Adds Windows-native toast notifications and a system tray icon to dsh: alerts when the agent finishes, stops, or errors, with a tray menu to reopen the web page or quit the background process.

items.name: dsh-pocket-console
items.desc: Forwards an unattended DeepSeek Harness run's tool-call approvals and ask_user_question prompts to Feishu cards on your phone. The desktop GUI answers first — a card is only sent after `delaySeconds` (120 by default) with no answer there — and a phone approval grants `allowed-once`, so no authority accumulates on the phone. One outbound WebSocket long connection to Feishu: no public IP, domain, tunnel or relay.

items.name: dsh-task-feedback
items.desc: Live session status on the browser tab favicon with sound notifications for pending input and completed tasks.

items.name: dsh-hiboard-push
items.desc: Huawei HarmonyOS assistant-today (负一屏) task-completion push for DeepSeek Harness: hiboard_push / hiboard_verify tools post Markdown task results to the phone card feed, wire-compatible with the OpenClaw today-task skill, with the authCode managed from the dsh settings panel.

items.name: dsh-turn-music
items.desc: Turn-finished music reminder: when an agent turn ends, play a ringtone or any local audio file (bundled synthesised telephone ring, custom absolute path, or an in-page upload), with a floating chip to pause, resume or dismiss it and loop-until-paused playback; configured in Settings, defaults overridable per deployment.

items.name: dsh-session-attention
items.desc: System notifications, a tab-title dot and a PWA taskbar badge when a reply finishes in the background or a session waits for your approval, plan review or answer, all cleared when you return to the window.

items.name: agent-pet#dsh-agent-pet
items.desc: Reports DeepSeek Harness session state (working, done, error) to the agent-pet macOS desktop overlay and lets it open sessions or start a chat.

items.name: dsh-notify-sound-plus
items.desc: Per-event sound alerts and system notifications for DeepSeek Harness. Four events — turn complete, question, approval and error — each get a switch, a sound picker with instant preview and a system-notification master switch. Nine built-in tones (four per-event defaults plus chime, bell, soft and alert, and a silent option) are synthesized at runtime with the Web Audio API, so no audio files ship with the package. A mode dropdown in General settings offers on, off and a smart mode that defers to the whale widget so the two never double up; the same row has a preview button and a gear opening a full settings dialog with volume, a skip-while-focused option and upload of your own audio up to 2 MB. A speaker button in the composer mutes sound without touching notifications. Works in the web GUI and the Electron desktop app.

items.name: dsh-notice-center
items.desc: Turn the tab icon into a green/amber status light and send browser notifications when a session finishes or awaits your input, with 47 selectable notification sounds.

items.name: dsh-emacs-bridge#dsh-plugin
items.desc: Two-way bridge between GNU Emacs and a running DeepSeek Harness session over loopback HTTP + SSE: submit prompts, stream replies, manage sessions and workspaces, and answer ask-user/approval prompts from Emacs, with a Plugins-page card that installs the Emacs package.

items.name: dsh-guild
items.desc: Discord-like communities in DSH with channels, roles and permissions, message search, and sharing or cloning of DSH sessions.

items.name: dsh-rss-daily
items.desc: Daily news digest from 46 curated RSS sources, edited by the model already configured in dsh, delivered to your IM via webhook, and broadcast in the chat like a regular model reply with zero context cost.

items.name: dsh-feishu-remote
items.desc: Control a DeepSeek Harness agent from Feishu/Lark: send a task by DM, an agent runs it with your configured model and replies in the chat, and a feishu_send tool lets the agent push results. Uses lark-cli's WebSocket connection, so no public webhook is needed, and ships a resident launcher. Note: the plugin does not check who sent a message, so anyone who can DM the bot — by default, members of the Feishu tenant the app belongs to — can drive an agent running with the host's own model credentials and file permissions. Setup is not one `dsh plugin add`: `lark-cli` must be installed and authenticated once, and a Feishu self-built app with the permissions the README lists is required.

items.name: dsh-im-channel
items.desc: Unified IM channel for DeepSeek Harness: Feishu, Telegram, DingTalk, Slack, Discord — persistent conversations, true streaming replies, 40 MCP Feishu tools, slash commands, and an IM-bot status tab in the plugin settings.

items.name: move45clock
items.desc: Move45clock: a health clock for DeepSeek Harness. A 45-minute work timer (5–120 minutes), 12 guided 12–15 minute seated/standing break plans, a visual plan editor, reminder cards scalable to 200%, night reminders at 21:30/22:00/22:30, and optional action-name voice coaching. Window wake is Windows-only.

items.name: dsh-qq-bridge
items.desc: Connects one existing DSH session to QQ through OneBot/NapCat without starting a new session, and uses a fail-closed whitelist plus @-mention, nickname and configurable-probability wake rules to decide which messages reach the model.

items.name: dsh-finreport
items.desc: Scheduled bilingual financial reports for DSH: market quotes, news and macro calendar, with per-target timezones and delivery through eight dsh-im channels.

items.name: dsh-health-reminder
items.desc: Periodic water, stand-up, eye-break and stretch reminders on your own work schedule, with daily and 7/30-day statistics and multiple switchable reminder plans.

items.name: dsh-bulletin#dsh-bulletin-announce
items.desc: An announcement file shared by several agent sessions on one machine. It is a plain text file the agents only append to; before each step a session receives the entries it has not seen yet, a new session catches up on the ones still in effect, and a session whose context was compacted gets them re-sent.

items.name: dsh-focus-notify
items.desc: Focus-aware notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approvals, questions, plan reviews and finished replies appear as one alert only when the conversation window loses focus; background conversations alert at any time and subagent sessions never do.

items.name: dsh-sound-notification
items.desc: Plays a chime when any session's response finishes (rising tone) or a question/approval is asked (falling tone), with a click-to-mute badge.

items.name: dsh-done-sound
items.desc: Play different configurable sounds for five conversation events in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: normal completion, interrupt, error, approval wait, and auto-retry success; each event has its own audio setting and bundled default, with auto-retry after errors using a configurable wait (10-300s), plus a community sound library. Compatible with DSH 0.1.5-rc.2.

items.name: dsh-audio-cue
items.desc: Audio cues for DeepSeek Harness: a short synthesized sound when an agent needs confirmation, finishes a turn or a background job, or fails, with five sound packs, per-event toggles and volume, and do-not-disturb rules stored in the host settings document.

items.name: dsh-notify
items.desc: Desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness — a web notification while a browser page holds the plugin (turn completion and pending questions), and a native Windows toast from the host for finished turns once the browser is closed.

items.name: dsh-session-notify
items.desc: Notifies you with a browser notification and toast whenever a session turn ends, with 5-language templates and custom presets.

items.name: dsh-overdrive#gateway-core
items.desc: DSH-side remote session driver for the dsh-overdrive chat gateway: exposes sessions, trajectory replay and tap-to-approve to Telegram / Discord / Slack / WhatsApp / Feishu / DingTalk / WeCom bridges. Requires running @dsh-overdrive/gateway alongside.

items.name: dsh-plugin-discord
items.desc: Discord bridge loaded into the same Host as the desktop app or dsh web, with no separate process or profile — chat with sessions in any workspace from DMs or threads, attach to sessions open on the desktop, and answer tool approvals and model questions from whichever side responds first.

items.name: dsh-notify-say
items.desc: Windows desktop notifications for DSH that speak the turn result by default: Windows TTS needs no download, and 13 VOICEVOX voice packs can be installed from the settings page. A completed alert waits until running subagents and background jobs finish; approval, question and error alerts fire immediately. Voice packs are downloaded from GitHub after a terms confirmation.

items.name: dsh-email-notify
items.desc: Email notifications for DSH with an away-mode switch: mails you when a turn ends, a tool waits for approval, or the assistant asks a question. Title and body are editable templates.

items.name: dsh-lark-link
items.desc: Fork of amlyczz/dsh-lark-link (MIT), maintained by Very12345. Per-conversation reasoning-effort controls, multi-app isolation, and streamed task-status cards.

items.name: dsh-plugin-sound-alert
items.desc: Sound alerts for the DSH web UI: a chime when an answer completes and a three-tone prompt when your approval or question is pending, with optional custom WAV stored only in the local browser (pure client-side, zero assets).

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-feishu
items.desc: Talk to DeepSeek Harness from Feishu / Lark. A chat maps to a DSH session, messages become turns and answers are pushed back as cards; questions, permission requests, model switches and conversation switches are interactive cards, and inbound files and images are downloaded into the workspace.

items.name: dsh-no-long-sit
items.desc: Sit-and-water reminder for DeepSeek Harness, with a cat that sits in the corner of the Web GUI. A focus cycle of 30-90 minutes ends in a centered overlay plus a triple chime that gets you up to walk and drink; the later button answers with one real sourced case about prolonged sitting and one about dehydration (built-in library of 17 entries, each with publisher, date and a link to the original); stopping produces a session report with worked time, completed rounds, successful interruptions, snoozes, suggested drinks and a good/mid/bad grade. The cat can be dragged anywhere with its position remembered and loops one animation per state. The timer and the ledger live in the host half, so a page refresh never loses a cycle; it only reminds while a DSH page is open. Cycle lengths, chime volume, cat opacity and grade thresholds are configurable on the plugin settings page.

items.name: dsh-your-turn
items.desc: Turn-handoff reminders in the DSH Web UI with a modal or top banner, six browser-synthesized chimes, configurable auto-dismiss, and a sidebar speaker toggle with an unread session list.

items.name: dsh-complete-chime
items.desc: Plays a short chime when a conversation turn finishes, with three built-in tones or one custom upload, configured in Settings → Plugins.

items.name: dsh-wechat-media
items.desc: Personal WeChat and WeCom (企业微信) bridge: QR pairing, one DSH conversation per chat, two-way text/image/video/document/archive transfer, chat commands (/help, /status, /new, /stop, /friends) answered by the bridge itself without spending a model turn, a switch that restricts the bot to 1:1 chats (group messages are dropped silently and counted), remote approval by replying 1 or 2 in the chat, and a two-way WeCom intelligent robot over its long connection (no public URL needed) that also receives and sends images, files and videos.

items.name: dsh-notify-linux
items.desc: Linux desktop notifications and a chime for DeepSeek Harness, sent by the host process so they still arrive with the browser page closed: turn completion, pending questions, tool approvals and turn errors, delivered through notify-send and paplay with a canberra-gtk-play fallback. A browser half adds an in-page toast, a Web Notification and a synthesized Web Audio chime as fallback; every switch lives in a Settings page or a JSON file.

items.name: dsh-qq-notify
items.desc: Send QQ private-message notifications via a local NapCat bot: qq_send / qq_status / qq_napcat / qq_deploy native tools plus one-click deployment scripts.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-pet-bridge
items.desc: Bridge dsh session status to the cc-pet desktop pet bubble: thinking, tool calls, and completion in real time. Ships on npm as `dsh-pet-bridge`.

items.name: dsh-channels#channels
items.desc: Connects WeChat, QQ, DingTalk, Lark, and Telegram to DeepSeek Harness with unified configuration, private-chat and group access controls, and channel-side Agent chat and session commands.

items.name: dsh-mailbox-notify
items.desc: Emails you when a long turn finishes or errors, when a goal completes or blocks, and when an approval or a question has waited past a timeout; each new notification deletes the previous one from the inbox over IMAP, so the inbox holds at most one.

items.name: dsh-auto-email
items.desc: Daily AI digest by email: fetches ten sources (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Hugging Face, arXiv, Hacker News and others), clusters near-duplicate stories, scores them in code and with an LLM, then emails the top three on a daily schedule with a four-part reading (facts, why it matters, impact, open questions). Adds four conversation tools and a sidebar panel for previewing the digest, sending it now and changing the schedule.

items.name: ui-beep
items.desc: Web Audio agent-heartbeat cues for the DSH web GUI: a low working hum while an agent is busy, ticks on streaming output, and a chime when a session awaits input or work finishes, with per-voice volume, mute toggle, and optional local audio files.

items.name: dsh-notify-xc
items.desc: Browser notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness - system toasts when a task finishes, a run errors, or your input is needed (question / approval / plan review), click to open the session, per-type toggles, and no false 'done' while the main session waits on its subagents.

items.name: dsh-chime
items.desc: Task-completion chime for DeepSeek Harness, playing the original opencode sounds for done, question, plan-review and error events with zero external dependencies.

items.name: dsh-caps-beacon
items.desc: Turns the MacBook keyboard Caps Lock light into an agent status light: on while the agent works, flashing when it waits for your approval or answer, off when idle.

items.name: qqbridge-plus
items.desc: Diving-Fish score lookup for MaimaiDX inside QQ, plus qq-bridge chat extensions. #查分 renders a B50 with song artwork from an OAuth authorisation that any member can use, and works without the bridge running; the extensions cover balance and auto-shutdown, reasoning tier switching by billing peak hours, holiday-table coverage, start/shutdown greetings, and an in-QQ feature toggle.

items.name: dsh-localnotify
items.desc: In-app local notification center for DSH: a sidebar Notifications entry with unread badge, full-screen center with level color coding (info/success/warn/error), time/source filters, sorting, title/content search, read/unread, delete, detail popup with one-click copy, and pagination; written by the notify_add agent tool or the dsh-localnotify CLI (with auto-cleanup retention), page refreshes live, UI follows dsh web language (zh/en).

items.name: dsh-quiet
items.desc: Attention gate for DeepSeek Harness: sorts run events into blocked / terminal / progress and alerts only on the first two, holding everything non-blocking during a /focus block and delivering it when the block ends. Alerts flash the taskbar button only - no toast, no sound, no focus steal. Windows only.

items.name: dsh-task-watcher-plugin
items.desc: Windows-only tray monitor for DeepSeek Harness: deploys and manages the standalone DshTaskWatcher tray app - four-state tray icon (gray=disconnected, green=idle, amber=running, red=attention), a per-task panel with live duration/tps/tokens, and completion & outcome notifications. Start/stop switch in Settings > Plugins; the watcher is an independent process that survives DSH restarts.

items.name: dsh-notify-yimit
items.desc: Windows system and custom desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness events: task completed, failed, running, awaiting approval, and awaiting answer. Click-to-jump to the session.

items.name: dsh-qqbot-lite
items.desc: Connects QQ Bot private and group chats to DeepSeek Harness Desktop, with per-chat personas, interactive questions, and optional image understanding.

items.name: dsh-ping
items.desc: Sounds a chime and raises a desktop notification when the agent needs you — stage completion, approval requests, awaiting input, task completion, and errors, each with its own tone.

items.name: dsh-notification-sound
items.desc: Plays a Windows system sound when the agent opens a question dialog, when a tool asks for permission, and when a conversation turn ends, plus a fish_beep tool to trigger a sound on demand. Custom audio folders are supported.

items.name: dsh-qqbot
items.desc: QQ official bot channel for DeepSeek Harness (feature-rich fork of tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot): group and private chat with the full agent, sticker library with auto-tagging and AI meme replies, group management (join approval and mute), botplay interactive card events with paginated catalogs, user extension registry (custom slash commands and QQ tools), scheduled wakeups, remote approvals over QQ, and a floating dock web UI.

items.name: dsh-completion-notifier
items.desc: Native macOS completion notifications and user approval alerts with Settings UI for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-win-notify
items.desc: Host-layer Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness: agent turn done, error or interruption, subagent done, and background job done, plus alerts when the model asks you a question or a tool approval is pending. The notification logic runs in the DSH host process, so toasts still arrive with the tab or the browser closed; a Win32 foreground probe suppresses them while you are looking at DSH. Windows only.

items.name: dsh-voice
items.desc: Speaks a cue for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: a configurable phrase when an agent turn completes normally, a second phrase when the agent needs you to choose — a question, a plan approval, or a permission request — and a time-of-day greeting when a new conversation starts. A small bubble in the lower-left corner mutes and unmutes every cue with one click, with its own toggle chime. Phrases are synthesized with a Microsoft Edge neural voice (skipping aborted and errored turns, subagent turns, and rounds that a goal is still driving), cached under the DSH home directory and replayed locally, with the desktop SAPI voice as the offline fallback.

items.name: dsh-task-dispatcher
items.desc: TickTick (滴答清单) daily task dispatcher: an interval timer pulls due tasks from a chosen list into a Markdown task file and notifies only when the task set changes (WeChat via ClawBot / flomo / macOS); it can also auto-execute each task in its own headless DSH session under a configurable timeout, optionally gated to DeepSeek's off-peak hours so peak-time work queues to the next off-peak window instead of starting, plus a settings panel for the deferred write-back queue and dispatcher_status / dispatcher_config / dispatcher_run / dispatcher_report tools.

items.name: dsh-approval-voice
items.desc: Plays a chime and speaks a Chinese voice alert when an approval, question, or plan-review popup appears in the DSH web GUI, so you never miss a request.

items.name: dsh-mobile-notify
items.desc: Mobile push when a DSH task goes idle, over 10 channels: ntfy, Bark, DingTalk, WeCom, Feishu, ServerChan, PushPlus, Telegram, Qmsg and generic webhooks. The message carries the session, workspace, elapsed time, turn number and a reply excerpt, and it runs host-side rather than in the browser page.

items.name: dsh-notify
items.desc: Windows toast notifications when a DeepSeek Harness task finishes: the session title, the outcome, and a summary of the final reply, sent once when the agent really stops rather than once per round of a running goal.

items.name: dsh-capybara-notify
items.desc: Capybara secretary for DSH: desktop pet notifications with ding sound, alert inbox API, session-aware alerts (turn done / approval needed / turn blocked), check scripts, and daily high-star plugin recommendations.

items.name: dsh-reaper
items.desc: Inventory every listening TCP endpoint and grade each holder as agent-spawned, workspace, dev-server, unattributed, system or protected; only the first two can be auto-selected, and a reap previews its descendant-closure plan unless confirmed.

items.name: dsh-which
items.desc: Command resolution forensics: which file a command actually runs, which PATH entry won, what it shadows, how many entries are duplicates or dead, and whether the copies behind one name report the same version.

items.name: agent-body#dsh-organism
items.desc: The organ kernel of Agent-Body: plugins organized as one body. Each command is turned into a nerve impulse that deterministically innervates the organ which should handle it and names the capability to use; a heartbeat with a variable interval (faster on alerts, slower when idle) pumps operator directives, proprioception and homeostasis warnings system-wide; reflex arcs fire with zero model calls; failures go through deterministic attribution (missing tool / arguments / permission / timeout / network), a prescription, and a re-check loop, with argument errors never auto-retried. A missing organ is compensated by the one with the highest capability overlap, and tool schemas are gated by the current intent (84.7% measured reduction, reproducible in-repo). This entry is the kernel plugin package inside the agent-body repository.

items.name: dsh-plugin-proxy
items.desc: Runtime-switchable outbound HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy for DSH with a web settings card.

items.name: dsh-wrapup-guard
items.desc: Enforces a check-fix-recheck loop when a task is wrapping up: it auto-runs your tests/lint/audit, blocks any round that still has unfixed problems, and only calls the task done after three consecutive clean full checks, then notifies the user.

items.name: dsh-restart-dock
items.desc: A small dock in the DSH Web UI: restart the host or reload the page in one click. Restart asks first (now / 30s / 60s / 2min / cancel); the dock drags to any edge only after a 320ms hold, and stays anchored when the window resizes. Refresh refuses to run unless the plugin bundle is verifiably loadable (timestamp baseline + real bundle fetch + syntax compile), so a reload can never brick the app. Restart is Windows-only (PowerShell 5.1); the UI and page refresh work on all platforms.

items.name: agent-development-constraints
items.desc: Installs a self-evolving development-constraints rule library, exposes it to the agent through a constraints tool and a once-per-session reminder, and audits AI token cost and context usage.

items.name: dsh-lsp-packs#dsh-lsp-cpp
items.desc: C/C++ LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using clangd.

items.name: dsh-lsp-packs#dsh-lsp-csharp
items.desc: C# LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using OmniSharp.

items.name: dsh-lsp-packs#dsh-lsp-go
items.desc: Go LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using gopls.

items.name: dsh-lsp-packs#dsh-lsp-java
items.desc: Java LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using the Eclipse JDT language server.

items.name: dsh-lsp-packs#dsh-lsp-kotlin
items.desc: Kotlin LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using kotlin-language-server.

items.name: dsh-lsp-packs#dsh-lsp-lua
items.desc: Lua LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using lua-language-server.

items.name: dsh-lsp-packs#dsh-lsp-php
items.desc: PHP LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using Intelephense.

items.name: dsh-lsp-packs#dsh-lsp-pyright
items.desc: Python LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using Pyright.

items.name: dsh-lsp-packs#dsh-lsp-ruby
items.desc: Ruby LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using ruby-lsp.

items.name: dsh-lsp-packs#dsh-lsp-rust
items.desc: Rust LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using rust-analyzer.

items.name: dsh-lsp-packs#dsh-lsp-swift
items.desc: Swift LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using sourcekit-lsp.

items.name: dsh-lsp-packs#dsh-lsp-ts
items.desc: TypeScript and JavaScript LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using typescript-language-server.

items.name: dsh-auto-update
items.desc: Self-update for the harness launcher; checks npm for a newer @deepseek-ai/dsh, stages the tarball, and applies it on harness exit or via update-and-restart from the web panel.

items.name: dsh-creator-mode-plus
items.desc: Creates, activates, checks and removes external DSH plugins from a conversation through fixed tools; requires the external DSHX devkit.

items.name: dsh-opendesigner
items.desc: Local visual React and Tailwind designer with project-scoped file tools; documented for DSH 0.1.5-rc.2.

items.name: dsh-evidence-gate
items.desc: Evidence-first conclusion gate that cross-checks first-hand claims against a durable per-session tool-activity index, blocks unverified guesses and tracks blocked-versus-converted metrics.

items.name: agentdebugx#dsh-agentdebugx
items.desc: Diagnoses current and saved DeepSeek Harness trajectories with AgentDebugX and opens structured reports in its dashboard.

items.name: dsh-restart
items.desc: Restarts the running DSH process from a model tool or a bottom-right GUI control, with launchd KeepAlive detection, a detached-supervisor fallback that aborts the exit when its handshake fails, a macOS desktop restart path, and JSONL restart records correlated by arm id, pid and profile so a restart stays distinguishable from unrelated log activity.

items.name: dsh-qa-suite-n23
items.desc: Quality suite: background tsc --noEmit diagnostics fed back after the agent edits TypeScript, plus a /code-review command running five parallel review lenses with confidence scoring; absorbs dsh-code-check and dsh-command-code-review.

items.name: dsh-model-everything
items.desc: Turns what a design, plan or document claims into a model and decides it: UML diagrams rendered, read and reviewed; state machines, protocols and data models checked as models; migrations tested for coverage and rollback symmetry; concurrency claims mined and routed to the checker that can decide them; dependency graphs audited; reports diffed.

items.name: dsh-codebase-memory
items.desc: Bridges the Codebase Memory MCP code knowledge graph into DSH and keeps indexed repositories fresh with a debounced filesystem watcher. Windows-only MCP bridge (the watcher half is cross-platform); auto-installs its npm CLI via npx on first start.

items.name: dsh-devforge
items.desc: Spec-driven service forge and integrated operations workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: code-rag#dsh-code-rag-index-panel
items.desc: Code RAG semantic index panel and settings card: live index bar with start/rebuild/cancel, plus one-click detection and configuration.

items.name: dsh-substrate#plugin
items.desc: Diagnose duplicate DSH loader entry IDs before startup, report version-locked repair status in a read-only settings card, and apply or revert audited loader repairs through an external CLI.

items.name: dsh-plugin-preflight
items.desc: Preflight checks for a DeepSeek Harness plugin before submitting it to the community list: verifies the dsh.bundle manifest, cordis.patch.yml wiring, client bundle shape, and peer ranges that silently exclude prerelease harness builds. CLI plus one read-only agent tool.

items.name: dsh-backup-sync
items.desc: Backup, restore and machine-migration for DSH: packs skills (which live outside ~/.dsh, in ~/.agents/skills), plugin manifests, core config, memories, todos and optionally sessions into a tar.gz with a sha256 sidecar, then imports it on another machine as a three-way merge against a baseline, listing per-file differences instead of overwriting changes made there. Credentials never enter an archive (filename deny-list of 27 names plus 7 private-key suffixes plus a content gate, enforced again on the import side), every import writes a pre-restore snapshot first, and an archive can be uploaded to any WebDAV server and pulled back on the new machine. Also includes scheduled backups, a read-only viewer for individual files, and an in-panel cloud card; no npm runtime dependencies (packing uses the system tar).

items.name: dsh-conflict-guardian
items.desc: Scans the DSH loader tree at startup for plugin conflicts (duplicate mounts, failed or pending plugins, duplicate config row ids), auto-stops or restores the affected plugins, and shows a conflict report popup in the web UI.

items.name: my-dsh-plugins#dsh-file-activity
items.desc: DSH sidebar file-activity tab: records file reads/creates/modifies by the agent and the sidebar (including file ops hidden inside bash commands), per-session isolation, survives restarts, click a file for a floating preview (npm: `dsh-file-activity`).

items.name: my-dsh-plugins#dsh-my-guardian
items.desc: Plugin governance: new/updated plugins stage in a candidate area first, then hot-mount after startup — success promotes, failure auto-disables, repeated failures freeze, one-click safe mode, sidebar diagnostics panel (npm: `dsh-my-guardian`).

items.name: my-dsh-plugins#dsh-my-observability
items.desc: Observability and git tooling: a persistent cross-session event audit log with a query API, a resource watchdog sidebar panel, structured Conventional Commits and pre-commit incremental diff review (npm: `dsh-my-observability`).

items.name: dsh-write-create-only
items.desc: Host-side guard that lets the write tool only create new files: when the target already exists it denies the call before execution and tells the model to use edit instead, applied to all sessions.

items.name: dsh-write-rule-guard
items.desc: Blocks edit/write writes that contain characters matching configurable regex rules, executed before the tool runs, with configurable messages and same-turn pwsh propagation; default rule matches full-width parentheses.

items.name: dsh-claude-compat
items.desc: Bridge Claude Code's .claude/ directories into DSH with zero migration: project and user-level skills, commands, rules (one system-reminder envelope), agent files, hooks (PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/ SessionStart/SessionEnd) and .mcp.json servers, plus Claude Code plugin marketplaces. Ships /cc-plugin for full plugin/marketplace management (claude CLI first, self-implemented fallback), /cc-resume to list and import Claude Code sessions into DSH as native event-sourced logs, and /cc-export to write DSH skills back as Claude Code skills. Two-way Claude Code <-> DSH bridge, versioned and released as dsh-claude-compat.

items.name: codex2dsh
items.desc: Migrate Codex (OpenAI Codex CLI / Desktop) MCP servers, skills, instructions, memory and session history into DeepSeek Harness with a visual panel or CLI, with dry-run previews and secrets migrated as-is.

items.name: dsh-plugin-forge
items.desc: Scaffold DSH local bundles in the dph format from any workspace and keep a pitfall experience library to steer later development.

items.name: dsh-profile-multica
items.desc: Bridges Multica to DeepSeek Harness through a versioned JSONL process protocol.

items.name: dsh-information-environment-governance
items.desc: Governs the persistent information and project constraints an agent works with - project orientation and scope, information and document lifecycle, and persistent workspace mutation - through one additive system-prompt section plus deterministic runtime checks.

items.name: dsh-render-engine#code-render
items.desc: Escaped, theme-aware HTML code-block rendering service for DSH Web plugins, built on structured syntax-highlight tokens with source line-ending preservation.

items.name: the-binding-of-dsh
items.desc: Bidirectional RPC between DSH Host and Client through the native Connection and Typert Gateway, with targeted peer calls, cancellation, and connection lifecycle handling.

items.name: dsh-stability-audit
items.desc: Stability audit for installed dsh plugins: static risk grading (hook surface, startup work, inject, entry, dep ranges) plus optional isolated install verification.

items.name: dsh-tauri-launcher
items.desc: Tauri 2 desktop application for Windows that detects (or installs) the global @deepseek-ai/dsh package, launches the DSH Web server and embeds it in its own window, with system tray management, login autostart, a global hotkey and desktop shortcuts.

items.name: dsh-preset-reload
items.desc: Rebind running sessions onto a rebuilt agent-preset revision, so preset changes apply without restarting dsh.

items.name: dsh-refix#dsh-refix
items.desc: Self-diagnosing, self-repairing watchdog for DSH plugins: 15s health patrol, version-switch repair with observe window and auto rollback, unknown symptoms escalated to human.

items.name: dsh-desktop-auto-restart
items.desc: Restarts the DSH desktop app on Windows and wakes the sessions listed for it afterwards. The agent-facing restart tool is off by default and refuses while the host is busy.

items.name: rulemux#dsh-plugin
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness plugin for rulemux: asks the local rulemux CLI for the rules rendered for this workspace (rulemux inject --agent dsh) and injects the output into the session at the first user turn, once per session. Nothing is written into the workspace for rules; skills are the only part that lands on disk.

items.name: duo#dsh-plugin
items.desc: DSH plugin for bounded agent evaluation: compare an original with candidate prompt or supported configuration changes against user-supplied checks, record evidence and costs, and leave adoption to the user.

items.name: dsh-cursor-dev
items.desc: Runs the local Cursor CLI as a child coding agent from DSH - a `cursor_code` tool plus the native one-shot `cursor_subagent` tool, one mirrored DSH sub-session per run, per-task model choice, resumable conversations, a step timeline with real file diffs, and a usage, model and session panel.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-headless-plus
items.desc: Replaces the headless startup to add --model provider/model, --resume <id|latest>, --continue and --session-info flags to dsh headless runs.

items.name: dsh-error-tell#client-tell
items.desc: Boot-time watchdog for DSH web: detects broken plugins, disables them persistently so the UI opens, with quarantine audit, automatic probe recovery, and one-click restore.

items.name: dsh-plugin-pwsh7
